jobs.title: Applied Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ SPREEAI builds AI virtual try\-on that fashion brands embed in their sites and apps. Every try\-on starts with the same question: did we read the person and the garment correctly? This role owns the computer vision pipelines that answer it, from preprocessing through evaluation, and keeps them reliable in production. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build and maintain preprocessing pipelines for try\-on: segmentation, pose estimation, human parsing, and body mapping * Validate and standardize inputs so downstream models get clean, consistent data * Benchmark and integrate new vision models, and measure how they perform on our own evaluation datasets * Run dataset quality checks and fix the failures they surface * Work with ML scientists to move research into pipelines that run every day **Qualifications** ------------------ * Hands\-on production experience in applied computer vision with Python and PyTorch * Experience with segmentation or pose estimation and a record of shipping pipelines, not only research * Comfort owning data quality and evaluation, not just model training * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup, in San Francisco (hybrid) **Why Join SPREEAI?** --------------------- * Real ownership: a small team where the pipelines you build run in production for brand partners * Hard, visible problems: accurate try\-on across a wide range of people and garments SPREEAI is a fast\-growing, innovative AI company at the forefront of fashion and e\-commerce, revolutionizing how consumers engage with fashion through lifelike photorealistic try\-on technology and hyper\-personalized shopping experiences. Our mission is to redefine the retail landscape with cutting\-edge AI solutions that blend high fashion and technology. We thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment where creativity meets technology to drive real impact. If you are passionate about innovation and shaping the future of fashion, SPREEAI offers a platform to make your mark. The pay range for this role is: 145,000 \- 180,000 USD per year (San Francisco, CA)

jobs.title: Data Operations Engineer
jobs.description: To enable the achievement of 3X growth in the company’s annual revenue, with 1/3rd of the revenue from recurring SaaS subscriptions by initiating global sales conversations with manufacturers who need to know how to detect and resolve the source of their bonding problem. While this may sound mundane, this is the challenge at the root of making products smaller, lighter, and of higher quality. This is a need that thousands of manufactures and product teams are challenged by daily. Customers look to Brighton Science to provide their unique instrumentation to understand how to create better products, as well as improve the quality of the products that they are already making. We are helping our customers understand their problem in new ways, leading to measurable, breakthrough performance. Brighton Science offers a patented solution that detects flaws that cause bonding failure with adhesives and coatings. Unlike other solutions, we find the issue where it happens and lead to faster root cause analysis. The solution from Brighton Science allows for detection and analysis within an individual process, across company facilities, and across a supply chain or innovation network. The company already has relationships with some of the world’s most well\-known technology and manufacturing companies. We are embarking on a period of rapid expansion globally. The right candidate will have the opportunity for career defining growth. **Job Duties:** --------------- The Data Operations Engineer is a technical role that lives inside our business systems — roughly ninety percent of the work happens in HubSpot — building the workflows, integrations, and data movement that connect Sales, Revenue Operations, Service, and Finance into one reliable system of record. It is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys untangling how a business actually runs and then automating it so that people spend their time on customers instead of on spreadsheets. You will work alongside our commercial, service, and finance teams to design data models, automate processes end to end, and make sure the numbers everyone reports from are the same numbers. You will also partner closely with our Data Engineer/Data Scientist on data definition and standardization across the business. As a Data Operations Engineer, you have previous hands\-on experience administering and automating a CRM platform — HubSpot strongly preferred — and moving data cleanly between systems. The position reports to the Chief Technology Officer and will provide opportunities for career advancement as the company grows. **What will I be doing?** ------------------------- * Own the design, build, and maintenance of HubSpot workflows, properties, data models, pipelines, and integrations across Marketing, Sales, Service, and Finance. * Partner with Revenue Operations and the sales team to automate lead routing, lifecycle stages, deal stage hygiene, forecasting inputs, territory and ownership rules, and reporting that leadership can trust. * Support the operations and service organization by automating calibration scheduling, instrument and asset records, service tickets, renewal notifications, and the data flow between field service activity and the customer record. * Support the finance team across the quote\-to\-cash process — quoting, approvals, product and pricing data, order handoff, invoicing, and revenue recognition inputs — by automating handoffs and eliminating manual re\-entry between HubSpot and our ERP and finance systems. * Build and maintain integrations and data pipelines between HubSpot and other business systems using native integrations, iPaaS tools, APIs, and scripting where needed. * Establish and enforce data governance: naming standards, required fields, deduplication, validation rules, and documentation so the CRM stays clean as the company scales. * Apply large language models — such as Claude or ChatGPT — to speed up and improve the work, from data cleanup and classification to drafting automation logic and documentation. * Translate business requirements from stakeholders into automation designs, then test, document, and train users on what you build. * Monitor automations in production, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve process performance and data quality. * Build reports and dashboards that give each team a clear, shared view of the business. * Solving technical challenges and problems within the development process * Working within a Scrum team designing and developing solutions to support our continued business and product initiatives * Self\-motivating and self\-managing in a rapid development environment * Taking ownership of project components * Assisting internal teams with collaborative testing projects * Ensuring projects align with annual and quarterly Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) * Promote inquisitiveness within the team * Continuously challenging the status quo **We'd love to hear from you if you have:** ------------------------------------------- * B.S. degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, or related work experience * 2\+ years of experience administering, automating, or integrating a CRM platform — HubSpot strongly preferred (Operations Hub experience a significant plus) * Hands\-on experience building automated workflows and moving data between business systems (APIs, webhooks, iPaaS tools such as Workato, Zapier, Tray, or similar) * Working knowledge of SQL; scripting experience (Python or JavaScript) a plus * Hands\-on experience working with large language models such as Claude or ChatGPT, and a practical sense of where they help and where they don't * Experience partnering with data engineering or data science on data definitions, standardization, and governance a plus * Familiarity with revenue operations concepts — pipeline, lifecycle stages, forecasting, and quote\-to\-cash * Experience integrating a CRM with an ERP or finance system a plus * Manufacturing or industrial B2B environment experience a plus * Comfortable executing autonomously in the face of ambiguity * Excellent oral presentation skills, organization, and project management skills.

jobs.title: Especialista en CI CD Pipelines
jobs.description: Especialista en CI CD PipelinesDescripción del puesto Buscamos un Especialista en CI/CD Pipelines con experiencia en automatización de procesos de desarrollo, integración continua y entrega continua de software. El profesional será responsable de diseñar, implementar, administrar y optimizar pipelines de CI/CD que permitan acelerar los ciclos de desarrollo, mejorar la calidad del código y garantizar implementaciones confiables en diferentes entornos tecnológicos. Tendrá un papel fundamental en la automatización de procesos de compilación, pruebas, integración y despliegue de aplicaciones, trabajando estrechamente con los equipos de desarrollo, operaciones, infraestructura y control de calidad. Deberá garantizar que las soluciones implementadas sean escalables, seguras y eficientes, aplicando buenas prácticas de DevOps y metodologías ágiles. Responsabilidades principales * Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar pipelines de integración continua y entrega continua (CI/CD). * Automatizar procesos de compilación, pruebas, integración, empaquetado y despliegue de aplicaciones. * Administrar y mantener herramientas de CI/CD como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps y CircleCI. * Configurar flujos de trabajo automatizados para diferentes entornos de desarrollo, pruebas, preproducción y producción. * Integrar pruebas unitarias, pruebas funcionales y pruebas de integración dentro de los pipelines. * Colaborar con desarrolladores para mejorar los procesos de integración y entrega de software. * Implementar estrategias de automatización que reduzcan errores manuales y optimicen los tiempos de implementación. * Administrar repositorios de código fuente y establecer políticas de control de versiones mediante Git. * Configurar y gestionar contenedores utilizando Docker y plataformas de orquestación como Kubernetes. * Supervisar la ejecución de pipelines, identificar fallos y resolver problemas relacionados con los procesos de despliegue. * Implementar mecanismos de monitoreo, registro y notificación para garantizar la visibilidad de los procesos automatizados. * Gestionar variables de entorno, credenciales, secretos y configuraciones de manera segura. * Aplicar prácticas de seguridad dentro de los pipelines mediante metodologías DevSecOps. * Optimizar el rendimiento, la estabilidad y la escalabilidad de las infraestructuras de integración y entrega continua. * Documentar procedimientos técnicos, configuraciones y estándares de automatización. * Participar en reuniones técnicas, planificación de proyectos y actividades de mejora continua. Requisitos y cualificaciones * Título universitario o formación terciaria en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ciencias de la Computación, Desarrollo de Software o carreras relacionadas. * Experiencia profesional en implementación y administración de procesos CI/CD. * Conocimientos sólidos de metodologías DevOps y prácticas de integración y entrega continua. * Experiencia utilizando herramientas como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions o Azure DevOps. * Dominio de Git y conocimientos de estrategias de ramificación y administración de repositorios. * Conocimientos de lenguajes de scripting como Python, Bash o PowerShell. * Experiencia trabajando con Docker y tecnologías de contenedorización. * Conocimientos de Kubernetes y herramientas de orquestación de contenedores. * Familiaridad con plataformas de infraestructura en la nube como AWS, Microsoft Azure o Google Cloud. * Conocimientos de sistemas operativos Linux y administración básica de servidores. * Experiencia configurando automatización de pruebas y procesos de validación de software. * Conocimientos de infraestructura como código (IaC) y herramientas como Terraform o Ansible. * Capacidad para diagnosticar y resolver errores en pipelines y entornos de despliegue. * Conocimientos de seguridad informática, administración de accesos y protección de credenciales. * Habilidades de comunicación, organización y trabajo colaborativo. Competencias deseables * Experiencia implementando prácticas DevSecOps en entornos empresariales. * Conocimientos de monitoreo y observabilidad mediante Prometheus, Grafana o ELK Stack. * Experiencia en arquitecturas de microservicios y aplicaciones distribuidas. * Familiaridad con estrategias de despliegue Blue\-Green, Canary y Rolling Deployment. * Conocimientos de administración de artefactos mediante Nexus o JFrog Artifactory. * Experiencia optimizando pipelines para proyectos de gran escala. * Conocimientos de gestión de infraestructura híbrida y entornos multinube. * Familiaridad con metodologías ágiles como Scrum y Kanban. Formación académica Se requiere formación universitaria o terciaria en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ciencias de la Computación, Desarrollo de Software o disciplinas afines. Se valorarán certificaciones profesionales en DevOps, administración de plataformas cloud, Kubernetes, automatización de infraestructura y herramientas de integración continua y entrega continua. Perfil profesional El candidato ideal será una persona analítica, organizada y orientada a la automatización, con capacidad para identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos de desarrollo y despliegue de software. Deberá demostrar autonomía en la resolución de problemas técnicos, atención al detalle y capacidad para colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios. Se espera un profesional comprometido con la innovación tecnológica, la eficiencia operativa y la implementación de soluciones que permitan entregar software de manera rápida, segura y confiable. jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Discernis** =================== Discernis builds AI for legal discovery at a scale where general legal AI tools fall apart. When a litigation team needs to know what a group of people knew, and when, across millions of emails, chats, and documents, our platform finds it with the recall attorneys can stake a case on. We deploy in private cloud and fully air\-gapped on\-prem for AmLaw firms and corporate legal teams. We're seed\-stage and venture\-funded, have paying Big Law customers, and have a pipeline of AmLaw firms and Fortune 500 companies lined up for paid pilots and future deals. Industry incumbents are coming to us to integrate. Discovery is our wedge: the bigger goal is helping enterprises understand and act on their largest, messiest datasets. We're a small team based in NYC, and you'd be joining before our next stage of growth. **How we work** =============== We value ownership, curiosity, and shipping. We hire people who teach themselves new things, make good calls without much direction, and care about getting it right for the attorneys who depend on us. We work hard at a sustainable pace, without crunch culture or arbitrary deadlines. **The role** ============ Today our founder runs the AI stack personally. He holds a Columbia PhD in AI and built Amazon's first customer\-facing RLHF pipeline. You'll take the stack over, all of it: agentic workflows, retrieval and evaluation, inference optimization, fine\-tuning, and post\-training. For your first \~90 days you'll work side by side with him. After that, you set our AI direction and grow the team around it. At a larger company, this would be three separate roles. Here, it's one. This is likely the single highest\-impact role at the company, and we need someone who can do the engineering and the science. **Rough split** =============== * **\~40% agentic systems:** orchestration, tool use, and reliability * **\~20% inference:** serving and optimization, including small models on constrained on\-prem hardware * **\~40% longer\-horizon research:** model adaptation, post\-training, and RL **Problems you'll own** ======================= * High\-recall retrieval and synthesis across billion\-token document collections * Agents that are reliable, testable, and deployable, not just impressive in a demo * Getting strong performance from small open\-source models in air\-gapped environments * Evals that capture what "correct" means to a litigator * RL that trades off tool use against compute **Our stack** ============= * **Models:** open\-weight models we fine\-tune, adapt, and post\-train for legal reasoning, then serve as our own versions * **Serving:** vLLM on our own H100 and H200 GPUs * **Deployment:** the same models run in private cloud and fully air\-gapped customer environments * **Language:** Python * **Around it:** PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes (K8s), Vue.js **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've trained or post\-trained real models (fine\-tuning, RLHF, or RL). Experience calling APIs is not enough. * You've also shipped LLM or agentic systems to production that real users depend on. * You have strong evaluation instincts and know how to tell real gains from noise. * You have hands\-on inference and serving experience. * **When you apply, please include a link to a repo, paper, write\-up, or system you built.** We're hiring for this role across levels, from strong AI engineer to AI lead. Compensation reflects the level we hire at. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience on a big tech AI team or at an AI startup * A PhD or MS in ML * Research publications or open\-source work in LLMs, agents, RL, or evaluation * Distributed training or large\-scale GPU experimentation **Our process** =============== * A call with our founder * A screen with our Head of Engineering * A deep dive on a real problem **Why Discernis** ================= * Research problems with a direct path to production and paying customers * A founder who speaks your language * Meaningful equity with a 4\-year vest and 1\-year cliff * Health insurance * Unlimited PTO plus standard US holidays If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, email us at careers@discernis.ai. Compensation Range: $170K \- $250K

jobs.title: Founding GTM
jobs.description: **About SketchPro** ------------------- SketchPro is building the first AI architect: an AI copilot for architects and engineers that accelerates construction documentation. We work with leading architecture firms to help streamline production and deliver documentation at the highest level. **The Role** ------------ We're hiring our first marketer to find and tell the stories of how firms use SketchPro. SketchPro runs inside Revit, and the people who use it are experts. Architects notice quickly when marketing doesn't understand their work. You'll learn from our in\-house architects and customers how they use the product on real projects, then turn what you learn into stories, videos, and launches for architects and firm leaders. You'll write, edit, and ship the work yourself, using AI tools for most of the production. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Stories \& Content** * Interview customers and our in\-house architects to find the story in a project: what the team was trying to do, what was hard, and what changed * Tell those stories in LinkedIn posts, videos, demos, launch announcements, and blog posts * Make case studies, before\-and\-after examples, and technical deep dives * Ground claims in evidence from real projects and customers * Edit and fact\-check the work until it's ready to publish ### **Positioning \& Website** * Explain what SketchPro does and which problems it solves * Adapt that message for different firm sizes and roles, including production staff, BIM managers, and principals * Keep the website copy current as the product changes * Use what you hear in customer calls and pilots to sharpen the message ### **Launches** * Tell the story of each product release: what changed and why it matters to architects * Plan and ship launches, including the message, content, distribution, and follow\-up ### **Distribution \& Demand** * Get the work in front of the right people through LinkedIn, search and AI answer engines, email, PR, and referrals * Plan our presence at industry events, and host roundtables and dinners for firm leaders * Track how stories and channels contribute to demos and pilots, and use that to decide where to spend your time ### **Sales \& Pilots** * Make pilot materials and decks with our Forward Deployed Architects, so people can make the case for SketchPro inside their firms **What Good Looks Like** ------------------------ * Our stories help architects explain SketchPro to others at their firms * Launches show architects what changed and get firms asking for demos and pilots * Case studies and customer stories help firms evaluate SketchPro during sales conversations and pilots * We have a good read on which stories and channels bring in demos and pilots **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years of B2B marketing at early\-stage startups * A portfolio of stories, content, campaigns, or launches you made yourself, and what your part was * You write clearly and edit your own work * You ask experts good questions and turn their answers into a story others can follow * You use AI tools for most of your production, and you can tell when the output isn't good enough yet * You can figure out what to work on next without a marketing team around you Storytelling and strong writing come first. You should also be comfortable getting the work out there and learning what brings people in. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience as an early or first marketing hire * Experience marketing a technical product to expert buyers * Experience in architecture, engineering, construction, or design software, including Revit. None is required. * Experience editing video or comfort on camera * A newsletter, channel, community, or side project you built yourself * Experience with automation or no\-code tools **How We Hire** --------------- We weigh work samples over resumes. Expect to walk us through things you've made and to work on a real SketchPro feature with one of our in\-house architects. **Why Join Us** --------------- * Shape the future of how buildings get designed and built. * Join a fast\-growing, venture\-backed team supported by Khosla Ventures, Neo, and top leaders from OpenAI, Ramp, Harvey, Brex, and more. * Work in person in San Francisco with architects and engineers * Competitive compensation ($150k–$200k salary \+ competitive equity) **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, Dental, Vision coverage * Expensed lunch and dinner 5x/week in SF office * Health \+ Wellness Stipend Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Fraud Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About Coinflow** Coinflow is the next\-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI\-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud \& chargeback indemnity, global pay\-ins, multi\-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide. Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi\-billion\-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest\-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments. Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash. **About The Role** ------------------ We're hiring a Fraud Data Scientist to be the analytical brain behind our fraud models. You'll dig into how our models and rules are performing, spot where fraud is shifting, and tell the team exactly which features, signals, and strategy changes will move the numbers. You'll work on fraud across card, bank, and alternative payment rails, for merchants in gaming, marketplaces, remittance, and ecommerce, where fraud patterns shift weekly. You'll partner closely with the engineers who build and deploy our models, plus risk operations and compliance, turning data into decisions they can act on. You'll be hands\-on with AI\-native tooling as a force multiplier for analysis, feature exploration, and experimentation. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Model Performance Analysis:** Track how our fraud models and rules perform over time and by merchant segment. Dig into approval rates, fraud loss, false positives, and drift, and explain what changed and why. **Fraud Trend Analysis:** Spot emerging patterns early, from fraud rings and account takeover to card testing, friendly fraud, and bonus abuse. Size the impact and get ahead of it before it shows up in chargebacks. **Feature Recommendations:** Explore transaction, device, behavioral, identity, and network data to find new signals. Prototype and validate features, then hand engineering a clear, evidence\-backed case for what to add to the models. **Label Quality \& Feedback Loops:** Own the ground truth. Make sense of delayed and noisy labels from chargebacks, disputes, and manual review, and flag where bad labels are misleading the models. **Experimentation \& Evaluation:** Design and analyze backtests, shadow tests, and champion/challenger experiments. Evaluate third\-party fraud vendors against our own models on our data, and give a clear answer on what to trust. **Rules \& Strategy:** Partner with risk operations to tune thresholds, rules, and step\-up authentication. Recommend decision strategies per merchant segment and quantify the tradeoff between loss and approvals. **Reporting \& Explainability:** Turn analysis into clear reporting for leadership, merchants, banks, and auditors: what drives model decisions, how performance is trending, and what we're doing about it. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years as a data scientist or analyst working on fraud, risk, or abuse, ideally at a payments company, fintech, or marketplace * You've used analysis to measurably improve production fraud models or rules: new features, better thresholds, lower loss, higher approvals * Strong SQL and Python. Fluent with the stats and ML concepts behind fraud models (gradient\-boosted trees, calibration, imbalanced data) even if you're not the one deploying them * Solid grasp of the fraud problem space: card\-not\-present fraud, account takeover, card testing, friendly fraud, chargeback reason codes, and how fraudsters adapt * Comfort with messy, imbalanced, delayed\-label data and the judgment to evaluate model performance honestly on it * Experience designing and analyzing experiments where a false positive and a false negative cost very different amounts * A strong feature intuition: you can look at a fraud pattern and propose the signal that would have caught it * Ability to explain model behavior and tradeoffs to merchants, risk ops, banks, and auditors in plain language * Familiarity with graph or network analysis for detecting linked accounts and fraud rings is a plus * Comfort working with AI\-native tooling as a daily driver, or genuine excitement to start * A bias toward action. We'd rather have a clear recommendation this week than a perfect analysis next quarter The base salary range for this role is $120,000 \- $180,000 USD \+ equity. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications, and business needs. Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross\-border payments market.

jobs.title: Front End Engineer
jobs.description: **Software Engineer, Frontend** **About the Company** Troveo builds the data platform that AI labs and model builders need to train the next generation of models. We have created the world's largest licensed platform of scarce, proprietary data for AI, spanning video, audio, text, and business workflows. Troveo indexes, enriches, and packages this high\-quality data into formats ready for training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, and agentic use cases. Backed by top investors, we’re a small, high\-impact team solving one of the biggest bottlenecks in AI development. **Role Overview** Troveo is hiring a frontend developer to join the Applications team in Engineering. You'll build and maintain the web applications our customers and internal teams use every day. The stack is React and TypeScript; some of it runs inside a Rails application, while the rest consists of standalone Vite and Next.js apps. We use Tailwind and Radix UI for styling and components, TanStack Query for server state, and Vitest and Playwright for testing. **How we work** You'll work across the frontend stack, collaborating with design, product, and backend engineering to ship reliable, polished applications. We value strong engineering judgment, thoughtful code reviews, clear documentation, and maintainable patterns that help the team move quickly without sacrificing quality. We also use coding agents as part of our development workflow, and you'll have opportunities to use them where they add value. **What you'll own** * Features across customer\-facing and internal apps, in both the Rails\-embedded and standalone environments * The shared component library: adding components, keeping them documented in Storybook, and making accessibility practical rather than theoretical * Implementing designs from Figma with fidelity, and pushing back when the spec has gaps * Performance work where it matters: rendering, bundle size, large lists, and uploads * Test coverage: maintaining it where it exists and extending it where it doesn't * Investigating production issues with Sentry and PostHog **Requirements** * 5\+ years building production web interfaces in React and TypeScript * Strong HTML, CSS, and responsive layout skills; comfortable with Tailwind * Comfortable working directly from Figma files: inspecting specs, extracting tokens and spacing, and flagging inconsistencies with designers * Experience integrating REST APIs and handling auth, loading, empty, and error states well * Experience with at least one of Vitest, Jest, or Playwright * Familiarity with coding agents and practical judgment about when they are useful * Clear written communication with designers, backend engineers, and product **Bonus Points** * Radix UI or a shadcn\-style component system * TanStack Query, React Router, or Next.js * Experience integrating coding tools with a design system or component library, including Figma\-to\-code workflows, design tokens, or Storybook documentation **Compensation** * **Base Salary**: $130,000 – $165,000 (depending on experience and location) * **Equity**: Competitive equity package in a well\-funded AI startup with significant upside **What We Offer** * **Comprehensive Health Benefits**: Medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% employer\-paid for employees) * **Flexible PTO \& Paid Holidays**: Unlimited PTO with encouragement to actually use it * **Remote\-First Policy**: Work from anywhere in the US (with occasional team offsites) * **Learning \& Growth**: Annual learning stipend, access to top conferences, and direct mentorship from experienced founders * **Equity Ownership**: Competitive equity package with clear growth potential as we scale * **Modern Tech Stack \& Tools**: Budget for the best equipment and software * **Strong Culture**: High\-trust, low\-ego environment focused on impact, transparency, and work\-life balance. We believe great work happens when people are supported, challenged, and given ownership. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Troveo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description: ### **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. ### **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will build web applications end to end, from the interface a user sees to the data layer behind it. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. ### **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you building full\-stack features in PHP and Laravel, with Python alongside. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build features end to end: Laravel on the back end, React or Vue on the front, and REST application programming interfaces (APIs) into third\-party systems. These applications carry heavy concurrent traffic, and you write unit and integration tests for what you ship. * Deploy and run it on Amazon Web Services (AWS). You write the Python automation behind it and the caching that keeps it fast as traffic grows. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of professional full\-stack development experience with PHP/Laravel and Python * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field * Expert\-level PHP and Laravel: MVC architecture and Eloquent ORM * HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+), with at least one front\-end framework (React or Vue.js) * Python for scripting, automation, and web development (Django or Flask) * Relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and query optimization for web applications * AWS deployment experience: EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, and Route 53 * Git\-based version control and modern tooling (Composer, npm/yarn) * HTTP, web security principles, API design, and responsive design * Clear writing and speaking for both technical and non\-technical readers: documenting decisions, writing for client stakeholders, presenting your own work ### **Preferred** * Large language model (LLM) API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt engineering * Blockchain and smart\-contract integration (Web3\) * A portfolio of shipped full\-stack projects * Federal information technology experience * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tooling ### **Who you are** You build the whole feature, not just your half, and you care whether it holds up under real traffic. When something breaks, you can trace it across the interface, the data, and the deployment, and fix it wherever it actually lives. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. ### **What you bring** * Production PHP and Laravel, with the architectural judgment to keep an application responsive as concurrent users grow. * Modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with React or Vue, to build responsive interfaces. * Relational data models and query optimization for web applications, in MySQL or PostgreSQL. * Python for the data processing and automation that support the application. * Practical delivery on AWS using EC2, RDS, S3, and CloudFront, including the caching and loading strategies that keep a growing application fast. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. ### **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a live Python coding exercise. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $100,000 to $150,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. ### **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. ### **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.title: ML Ops Engineer
jobs.description: **About Coinflow** Coinflow is the next\-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI\-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud \& chargeback indemnity, global pay\-ins, multi\-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide. Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi\-billion\-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest\-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments. Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash. **About The Role** ------------------ We're hiring an MLOps Engineer to own the platform that takes our fraud, risk, and payments models from notebook to production. You'll build the pipelines, serving infrastructure, and monitoring that let us score every transaction in real time, retrain safely. Our models sit in the authorization path of real money, so latency, reliability, and explainability matter as much as accuracy. You'll be hands\-on with AI\-native tooling: we use AI as a force multiplier for building pipelines, writing evals, and automating the boring parts of model operations. If you want to be one of the first ML infrastructure engineers building this way at a fast\-growing PSP, you'll fit in well here. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Real\-Time Model Serving:** Build and operate the inference layer that scores transactions in the authorization path. Hit tight latency budgets, design safe fallbacks when a model or feature is unavailable, and make sure a model outage never becomes a payments outage. **ML Pipelines \& Feature Store:** Own training, validation, and deployment pipelines end to end. Build reproducible feature pipelines from our transaction, device, and chargeback data, with point\-in\-time correctness so offline training matches online scoring. **Model Deployment \& Rollout:** Make shipping a model boring. Versioning, registries, shadow mode, champion/challenger, canary rollouts, and one\-click rollback. Every change is gated by evals, not vibes. **Monitoring \& Drift Detection:** Instrument models the way we instrument services. Track latency, score distributions, feature drift, approval rates, and fraud and chargeback outcomes, wired into our observability stack with alerts that fire on real problems. **Third\-Party Model Integration:** Integrate and evaluate external fraud and risk vendors alongside our own models. Run parallel and shadow testing, compare performance on our data, and give the team a clear answer on what to trust. **Merchant\-Facing Risk Tooling:** Power the data and scoring behind our merchant\-facing risk products, so merchants can see risky customers and set their own blocking rules on top of our signals. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years in MLOps, ML infrastructure, or ML platform engineering, ideally at a fintech, payments company, or other regulated environment * You've run models in production with real latency and uptime requirements, not just trained them. Experience with real\-time inference in a transaction or decisioning path is a big plus * Strong Python and solid production engineering habits. Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript/Node, since that's where most of our services live * Hands\-on experience with ML pipeline and serving tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex, BentoML, Feast, or similar) and the judgment to know when not to use them * Solid infrastructure skills: containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and at least one major cloud provider * Data engineering chops: you can build reliable feature pipelines over operational, warehouse, and streaming data, and you understand training/serving skew * Experience monitoring models in production: drift, calibration, and tying model metrics back to business outcomes like fraud loss and approval rates * Familiarity with fraud, risk, or credit modeling, and with explaining model behavior to non\-ML stakeholders like banks and auditors * Comfort working with AI\-native tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily driver, or genuine excitement to start * A bias toward shipping. We'd rather have a working v1 of a model pipeline today than a perfect platform next quarter The base salary range for this role is $120,000 \- $180,000 USD \+ equity. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications, and business needs. Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross\-border payments market. Compensation Range: $120K \- $180K

The datasets bring together property data, geospatial data, and AI\-derived intelligence to power our insights and products. TypeScript/Node is a plus for our Application layer and AWS ingest paths. **Orchestration \& compute** * **Prefect 3** for pipeline orchestration (YAML/config\-driven flows, retries, logging) * **Coiled** for elastic EC2 workers on GDAL\-heavy and batch Python jobs * **Wherobots** (managed Apache Sedona / PySpark) for large\-scale spatial joins, parcel ingest, and lakehouse work **Data lake \& formats:** Apache Iceberg, Cloud\-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), and PMTiles. Queried with PySpark and DuckDB. **Geospatial:** GDAL, rasterio, GeoPandas, and tippecanoe. Large\-scale spatial work runs on Sedona/Spark via Wherobots. **Databases \& serving:** PostgreSQL \+ PostGIS (and pgvector on the app side) as the production store. **Working at Aarden** --------------------- Aarden is a high\-trust, high\-output team. We’re striving to be intentional about our team growth. This allows us to test the outer boundaries of our individual capabilities, while also going deeper on developer tooling and support. You’ll work hard here, and we’ve got your back. Practically, this means you’ll be asked to take on large projects, have a high bar of expectations to meet, and have a strong support system to help you meet that high bar. That support system includes: * **At least 2 in\-person days per week at our office in Capitol Hill \|** We’ve found that while heads\-down time at home is fantastic for task\-related productivity, in\-person time is magic for longer\-form productivity. Our in\-person days are used to plan, troubleshoot, and check\-in with each other on progress and questions. Expect team lunches and whiteboarding. * **Focused ownership in your role \|** The rest of the team is here to help you and cares about the evolution of our data products. With that said, we’ll be looking to you to own your lane, go deep, and own the development of these products. * **Dedicated monthly AI tooling budget \|** We’re in a golden era of AI\-powered developer tooling. We care about *what* you ship, not *how*. **Details** ----------- * **Reports to:** CTO * **Compensation:** $150,000 \- $180,000 based on skills and experience * **Location / remote policy:** Seattle\-based, able to commute to our office in Capitol Hill Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: Sr Lead Network Security Engineer - Zero Trust
jobs.description: **ADP is hiring a Senior Lead Network Security Engineer \- Zero Trust** **Are you ready to help us design the future\-state to secure our Data?** Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark? We are seeking a **Senior Lead Global Security Engineer** to bring deep network engineering experience to ADP’s Global Security Organization (GSO)! Help govern and strengthen the Security Service Edge (SSE) controls that protect associates and servers' access to the internet and Saas applications. You will combine advanced troubleshooting with technical security governance of SASE platform (e.g. Palo Alto Networks Prisma Access, Zscaler, Fortinet) and associated firewall and proxy controls. This opportunity is designed for experienced network security engineers and architects who are ready to broaden their impact beyond direct network platform administration and shape a path into technical security governance. You will remain closely involved in traffic analysis, troubleshooting, policy assessment, and remediation validation while expanding your influence across enterprise security decisions. Working with infrastructure owners, you will define security requirements and drive corrective action through established change processes. Your knowledge of routing, traffic inspection, global policies, and access exceptions will inform security decisions, uncover gaps, and guide implementation by partner teams. Success requires technical credibility, attention to detail, and the ability to move people toward a shared resolution. Responsibilities include protecting the company and client data from exploitation or misuse, influencing and partnering with the network \& cloud engineering teams to develop, deploy, and maintain security controls and services that protect ADP’s network infrastructure and traffic. This role serves in a leadership position that will continuously modernize ADP’s Internet policies, identifying weak control/policies and engineering relevant mitigating controls, that drive towards reducing operational risks associated with data in motion and at rest. Like what you see?**Apply now!** **Learn more about ADP at tech.adp.com/careers** **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** **Key Responsibilities:** * Assess Secure Web Gateway (SWG), next\-generation firewall, URL filtering, SaaS inline, and related SSE controls against ADP policies and standards; identify configuration, coverage, and enforcement gaps. Govern access exceptions, allow/block lists, inspection exclusions, and rule lifecycle reviews, confirming business justification, least privilege, accountable ownership, expiration, and evidence of approval. Evaluate new platform capabilities and vendor limitations; define acceptance criteria and validate that deployed controls achieve the intended security outcome. * \<**Network Egress \& Proxy Security**\> Lead assessments of enterprise internet egress, including firewalls used as forward proxies, explicit proxies, PAC configurations, and alternate routes serving associates and server workloads. Correlate traffic logs, policy configurations, identity, and application dependencies to identify access paths that produce inconsistent enforcement or bypass required SSE controls. Partner with Global Network Solutions (GNS) to rationalize legacy egress, close unauthorized access paths, and align approved exceptions with enterprise standards while preserving required business connectivity. * \<**Advanced Troubleshooting \& Remediation\>** Investigate complex access issues, suspected vulnerabilities, and control failures using packet captures, session and threat logs, policy matching, DNS analysis, and TLS inspection evidence. Lead technical triage with GNS, Digital Workspace Experience (DWE), security partners, application owners, and vendors; define containment and corrective actions, assign owners, and validate resolution. * \<**Shadow SaaS \& AI Application Governance\>** Use SaaS discovery, application risk signals, and data loss prevention (DLP) insights to identify unsanctioned applications, risky AI usage, and potential data exposure; coordinate investigation with accountable teams. Improve native SaaS discovery, categorization, and inline controls; connect findings to application intake, governance decisions, exception processes, and enforceable access requirements. Partner with SaaS Governance, AppSec, Privacy, and Legal to implement approved access decisions and location\-specific requirements. * \<**Technical Leadership \& Communication**\> Provide senior technical direction, mentor engineers and analysts, and improve the quality and consistency of team investigations without relying on direct reporting authority. Proactively convene working sessions and escalation calls, resolve competing priorities with sound judgment, and communicate immediate actions alongside longer\-term corrective plans. Maintain accurate technical documentation, audit evidence, and metrics covering enforcement coverage, exception aging, a SP, CISM, CCSP, CSSLP, CEH, SANS/GIAC certifications**, or Network Security Certificates such as **Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator (PCNSA)** **YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:** * **Have courageous team collaboration.** Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to net out the best solution. * **Deliver at epic scale.** We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity. * **Be surrounded by curious learners.** We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes. * **Act like an owner \& doer.** Mission\-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands\-on and willing to master our craft. * **Give back to others.** Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation. * **Join a company committed to equality and equity.** Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. What are you waiting for?**Apply today!** Find out why people come to ADP and why they stay: https://youtu.be/ODb8lxBrxrY (ADA version: https://youtu.be/IQjUCA8SOoA ) \#LI\-SD4 \#LI\-Hybrid Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Matched Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short\-and Long\-Term Disability, Charitable Contribution Match, Holidays, Personal Days \& Vacation, Paid Volunteer Time Off, and more. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating a down\-to\-earth culture that embraces our core values, welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. This hands\-on role combines end\-to\-end ML product ownership with ownership of defined components within shared MLOps, Feature Store, model\-observability, AgentOps, and GenAIOps capabilities. You will lead moderately complex implementations, mentor junior team members and interns, and work with ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, Product and Domain Owners, and business partners. AI and BigQuery where appropriate. * Own and enhance defined components of shared MLOps, Feature Store, model\-observability, AgentOps, GenAIOps, deployment, or reusable ML\-service capabilities that jobs.title: CFSA - Senior Developer - D365/Power Platform/Azure (815049)
jobs.description: CFSA requires a hands\-on Senior Developer to build, release, and operate STAAND (Stronger Together Against Abuse and Neglect in DC), the District's federally certified Comprehensive Child Welfare Information System (CCWIS). STAAND is built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform in a Government Community Cloud (GCC) tenant, with Azure services operating in Microsoft's commercial cloud. The Resource will personally write complex code, own CI/CD and Power Platform ALM end to end, gate quality through pull request review, run the production support and release process, and engage directly with social workers, supervisors, private agency partners, and the CFSA training organization to ensure delivery meets real operational needs. This is a working lead role—the Resource is expected to be in the codebase daily. 3\. Scope of Work and Responsibilities 3\.1 Hands\-On Development * Personally design and write complex work in the backlog: Dataverse plug\-ins and custom APIs in C\#/.NET, PCF controls, TypeScript/JavaScript client extensions, complex Power Fx, Azure Functions and Logic Apps, and integration components. * Build and maintain integrations across the GCC/commercial boundary, including retry, idempotency, dead\-letter handling, and reconciliation logic. * Optimize platform performance: plug\-in execution ordering and depth, query and FetchXML tuning, batching against API and service\-protection limits, portal page and cache behavior, and form/view load times. * Implement portal functionality across six external portals, including web roles, table permissions, and external\-user authentication flows. * Build and maintain automated test coverage — unit tests for plug\-ins and custom code, integration tests for interfaces, and UI regression suites. * Produce prototypes and spikes to de\-risk design decisions before entering the sprint backlog. * Refactor and retire technical debt on a defined cadence. 3\.2 CI/CD, ALM, and Release Engineering * Own the Azure DevOps YAML build and release pipelines, Power Platform Build Tools tasks, solution export/pack/unpack, environment variables, connection references, and automated deployment across Dev, Test, UAT, Train, and Production. * Own branching and merge strategy, versioning scheme, and release train cadence; keep all solutions and code under source control with no manual production changes. * Maintain environment strategy and hygiene with the Architect: refresh cadence, data masking for lower environments, managed environment policies, DLP policy alignment, and capacity monitoring. * Integrate quality gates into the pipeline: static analysis, Power Platform solution checker, dependency and secret scanning, test execution, and enforced failure thresholds. * Automate infrastructure provisioning for Azure components (Bicep/ARM or Terraform) so environments are reproducible. * Plan and execute releases: release notes, deployment runbooks, rollback plans, go/no\-go criteria, and post\-deployment verification. * Execute Dynamics 365 biannual release wave and monthly Power Platform update readiness: early\-access testing, deprecation remediation, and regression validation against the Architect’s impact plan. * Continuously reduce release cycle time, deployment failure rate, and manual deployment steps; report DORA\-style metrics. 3\.3 Code Review and Engineering Quality * Serve as primary reviewer and merge authority for pull requests into protected branches. * Enforce coding standards, security requirements, performance patterns, and test coverage thresholds; reject work with specific, actionable findings. * Maintain the definition of done, PR checklist, and code review SLA so review does not become a bottleneck. * Review specifically for security defects: injection, insecure deserialization, hardcoded secrets, unsafe portal permissions, and unsafe handling of PII/PHI. * Review AI\-related changes — prompt modifications, agent tool scoping, grounding source changes — against the Architect’s evaluation framework before merge. * Mentor CFSA staff and other contract developers through review; treat review as a capability\-transfer mechanism. 3\.4 Production Support and Solution Health * Own triage, diagnosis, and resolution of production defects across modules and portals; drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes. * Maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability: Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Dataverse audit and plug\-in trace logs, portal telemetry, and integration failure dashboards. * Operate to defined severity tiers and response/resolution targets; provide hypercare coverage following each release. * Participate in escalation rotation for critical production incidents, including outside core hours as required. * Monitor capacity, storage growth, license and API consumption, and Azure spend; flag trends before they become constraints. * Maintain and exercise backup, restore, and disaster recovery procedures; validate RTO/RPO periodically. * Keep runbooks, known\-error records, and support documentation current. 3\.5 Customer and Stakeholder Engagement * Work directly with social workers, supervisors, private agency partners, resource development specialists, and fiscal staff to understand requests before building. * Facilitate requirements refinement and story elaboration sessions; translate practice language into buildable, testable acceptance criteria. * Run demos at end of sprint and before release; collect and act on feedback. * Plan and support User Acceptance Testing; triage defects during UAT and provide go/no\-go recommendation. * Partner with the training organization on release notes, tip sheets, training calendar alignment, and change communications. * Serve as the technical point of contact for the super\-user community and the STAAND help desk escalation path. * Brief the District Program Manager and CFSA leadership on delivery status, risk, and trade\-offs in plain language. **Requirements:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a closely related technical discipline Required 16 Years Progressive software development experience Required 10 Years Hands\-on Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse / Power Platform development Required 6 Years C\#/.NET plug\-in and custom API development for Dataverse Required 5 Years TypeScript/JavaScript client extensions and PCF control development Required 4 Years Technical lead role over a development team (min. 3 developers) Required 4 Years Azure DevOps pipeline authoring and ownership (YAML, multi\-stage) Required 4 Years Power Platform ALM — solution layering, environment variables, connection references, managed deployments Required 4 Years Pull request review as designated merge authority on a protected branch Required 4 Years Production support ownership with defined severity tiers and SLAs Required 4 Years Azure development — Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault Required 4 Years Automated testing — unit, integration, and UI regression for D365 solutions Required 3 Years Power Pages / portal development including web roles and table permissions Required 3 Years Operating a live system through Microsoft biannual release waves Required 2 Years Direct engagement with jobs.description: American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a leading global insurance organization. AIG member companies provide a wide range of property casualty insurance in approximately 70 countries and jurisdictions. These diverse offerings include products and services that help businesses and individuals protect their assets and manage risks. We’re also committed to making a positive difference for our colleagues and in the communities where we work and live. We encourage colleagues to give back to the causes they care most about, supporting these efforts through our Volunteer Time Off and Matching Grants Programs. **Get to know the business** ============================ At AIG, technology is at the heart of everything we do, from underwriting risks to processing claims. The Information Technology team equips our colleagues with the latest tools to complete their work efficiently and with the highest standards of excellence. The team is responsible for shielding the company’s systems from security risks, while designing technology strategies that enable AIG’s businesses to achieve their goals. AIG’s Information Technology functions include enterprise architecture, software and systems engineering, cybersecurity, and technology risk and compliance. **About the Role** ================== We are looking for a **Network Automation Engineer** to help build and scale automation across our enterprise network environment. You’ll combine strong networking knowledge with software and automation skills to reduce manual work, improve network reliability, and enable API\-driven operations. A key part of the role will be developing and operating our **Network Source of Truth (SSoT/NSoT)** using **Nautobot**, and integrating it with network infrastructure, automation, observability, and other enterprise platforms. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving real network problems with **Python, APIs, Ansible, Git, and modern automation practices**, not simply administering network devices. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== **Requirements** * Design and build network automation for provisioning, configuration, validation, migrations, and operational workflows. * Help lead the implementation and ongoing development of Nautobot as the Network Source of Truth. * Integrate Nautobot and other network platforms using REST APIs, GraphQL, and Python. * Develop reusable automation using Python, Ansible, Jinja2, Terraform, and related technologies. * Automate synchronization and validation of network inventory, IPAM, configuration, and operational data. * Build automated pre\-change and post\-change validation to make network changes safer and more reliable. * Apply Git, CI/CD, testing, and Infrastructure as Code practices to network automation. * Integrate automation with network management, observability, and enterprise platforms. * Troubleshoot complex issues spanning networks, automation, APIs, and data. * Partner with network architects, engineering and operations teams to identify opportunities for automation and improve how the network is operated. * Evaluate and prototype emerging network automation technologies and capabilities. **Qualifications** * 7\+ years of network engineering, network automation, or related experience in large enterprise environments. * Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and IPAM. * Strong Python development or scripting skills. * Hands\-on experience with Ansible or similar automation platforms. * Experience building integrations using REST APIs and working with JSON/YAML. * Experience with a network Source of Truth, IPAM, DCIM, or inventory platform, ideally Nautobot or NetBox. * Experience with Git and CI/CD practices. * Experience automating network technologies from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, F5, or similar. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, architecture, operations, and technology teams. **Preferred Skills** * Hands\-on experience developing Nautobot Jobs, Apps/plugins, APIs, GraphQL integrations, or data models. * Experience with NetBox, Nornir, Netmiko, NAPALM, pyATS, Jinja2, or similar automation technologies. * Familiarity with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code. * Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and Linux environments. * Cloud networking experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Knowledge of VXLAN/EVPN, controller\-based networking, intent\-based networking, or SDN. * Relevant Cisco, Juniper, DevNet, cloud, or automation certifications. You’ll help move network operations from manual, device\-by\-device processes toward automated, data\-driven workflows, with Nautobot serving as a trusted source of network data and APIs, automation, validation, and CI/CD providing the foundation for scalable network operations. Ready to step up to new challenges? We would love to hear from you. For positions based in Jersey City, NJ, the base salary range is $99,000 \- $143,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: 2025 Benefits Summary Veteran's are encouraged to apply. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: **About Ande** We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use. **About the Role** You will own the intelligence behind the Ande Agent. That's the concierge and its team of subagents that take a request from one sentence ("dinner for 12 with the Acme team next Thursday, somewhere private") to a confirmed, paid, on\-policy booking. Along the way they source venues, compare options, email the venue and negotiate terms, and handle every change after that. This is not a chatbot or a demo. The agent acts on real money, on behalf of real executives, with real venues on the other end of the thread. It runs in production today for reservations and private dining. Our strategy depends on carrying more of the work with every request: more kinds of entertainment, more cities, more of the workflow, without growing headcount to match. You will set how we get there. **What You'll Do** * Own the agent system. Ande runs on a root concierge agent with specialist subagents for sourcing, comparison, and venue coordination, on a self\-hosted agent harness behind queued turn workers. You’ll own its architecture, model choices, and upgrade path, and make sure it holds up under latency budgets, provider failover, and real\-world load. * Build tools the agent can trust. The agent has about 75 typed capabilities that let it search, hold, book, pay, and message. Each one runs as the acting user and respects who they’re acting for, such as an assistant booking on behalf of an executive. Consequential actions become proposals that the booker confirms. You’ll decide what the agent is allowed to do, and how to make it safe. * Make evals the gate for every change. You’ll build scenario suites, graders, and LLM judges calibrated against human labels. They replay from recorded runs on every PR and run in full nightly. Your goal is evals trustworthy enough that a model upgrade or prompt change can ship on the strength of the number alone, and cheap enough to run all the time. * Power venue correspondence. Our agent negotiates with venues over email. It reads replies, pulls out offers, minimums, deadlines, and payment requests, and knows when to push, when to wait, and when to hand off to a person. You’ll make sure all of it is resistant to anything a third party writes into a thread. * Build memory and the supply learning loop. You’ll shape what the agent remembers about a company, its people, and its venues, with clear rules on what’s shared and what stays private. You’ll also build the loop that turns every venue conversation into structured supply data, like which room actually fits 14 or what a venue will do on a Tuesday, so each recommendation is better than the last. * Ship fast, reliable judgments. You’ll build typed classifiers for consent, triage, ranking, and urgency. Each has labeled thresholds, a timeout, and a fallback, and each rolls out from shadow mode to live. * Set the bar for building with AI. You’ll define how Ande builds with AI: agent behavior as versioned config, product teammates proposing changes through evals, and AI coding agents as the default way the team ships. You’ll mentor engineers and partner closely with our AI product manager. **What We’re Looking For** * Education and experience: a degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. You have 5\+ years building production software, including 2\+ years shipping LLM agents to real customers (tool use, multi\-step planning, structured outputs, long\-running conversations). * Production evals: you’ve owned evals in production, from writing them to finding failure modes in real traffic and improving quality turn by turn. * Systems engineering: strong TypeScript and backend skills, including queues, concurrency, idempotency, and how distributed systems fail. * Sound judgment: you know where a model belongs and where deterministic code does, and you have the discipline to make agent actions safe, auditable, and reversible. * AI\-native workflow: you use AI coding agents every day. Our codebase is built to be worked on by them, and we expect you to raise that bar. * Clear communication: you can explain agent behavior and trade\-offs to product, operations, and customers. **Bonus Points** * You've been a founding or early engineer and know how to balance craft, ownership and speed. * You've built agent harnesses, orchestration layers or tool brokers, not just prompts. * Experience with search, ranking or recommendation systems. * Experience with marketplaces, booking or payments, where a wrong action costs money. * Experience defending agents against prompt injection from untrusted content. **Why This Role Matters** The Ande Agent is how we scale. Every request it handles end to end is work we don’t have to hire for, so how far it can take us depends on the person who owns its intelligence. The stakes are real. The agent moves real money for executives and negotiates directly with venues, so a mistake costs customers money and costs us venue relationships. Every venue conversation also makes the agent smarter. That learning loop is an advantage competitors can’t easily copy. This isn’t an AI feature bolted onto a product. The agent is the product, and you’ll own how it thinks. **This is an in\-office position (4 days/week) in New York City** **Equal Employment Opportunity** *Ande is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and will consider all applicants for employment without regard to any legally protected status* Compensation Range: $210K \- $280K

jobs.title: Component Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. (AOI) is seeking a Component Reliability Engineer to support the qualification and reliability improvement of optoelectronic semiconductor components at its Sugar Land facility. This position will plan, execute, monitor, and analyze component\-level reliability testing for semiconductor lasers and related optoelectronic devices. The engineer will evaluate electrical and optical performance before, during, and after reliability stress, identify degradation trends and failure signatures, and assess product lifetime and reliability risk. The engineer will work closely with R\&D, Product Engineering, Yield Engineering, Quality, Test Engineering, Equipment Engineering, and Data Engineers, to connect reliability behavior with fab process history and physical failure mechanisms. **Responsibilities** * Develop and execute component\-level reliability qualification and monitoring plans based on product requirements, industry standards, and customer\-specific requirements. * Plan and analyze reliability tests such as burn\-in, HTOL, accelerated life testing, temperature cycling, thermal storage, humidity testing, mechanical testing, and electrostatic\-discharge testing, as applicable. * Define stress conditions, sample sizes, read points, electrical and optical measurements, and pass/fail criteria. * Analyze device characteristics such as operating voltage, current, series resistance, threshold current, optical power, slope efficiency, wavelength, spectral performance, and other product\-specific parameters. * Monitor parameter shifts and degradation rates before, during, and after reliability stress. * Identify early failures, wear\-out behavior, abnormal populations, and reliability outliers. * Perform statistical reliability analysis using Weibull, lognormal, Arrhenius, acceleration\-factor, lifetime\-projection, confidence\-interval, and distribution\-analysis methods. * Prepare qualification reports, customer reliability summaries, risk assessments, and technical presentations. * Lead component\-level reliability investigations by defining failure signatures, selecting representative samples, and establishing the technical questions for physical failure analysis. * Partner with the failure analysis team to develop targeted root\-cause analysis plans based on electrical, optical, and reliability results. * Maintain reliability test records, failure classifications, investigation conclusions, and traceability to physical failure\-analysis results. **Qualifications** *Required* * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Reliability Engineering, or a related technical field. * Three or more years of experience in semiconductor, optoelectronic, photonic, or electronic\-component reliability. * Strong knowledge of electrical characterization and component\-level reliability testing. * Experience interpreting reliability failure signatures and developing technically sound failure\-analysis plans. * Understanding of semiconductor device physics, degradation mechanisms, and the relationship between electrical behavior and physical defects. *Preferred* * Master’s degree in electrical engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Reliability Engineering, or a related field. * Experience with InP, GaAs, semiconductor lasers, photodetectors, or other optoelectronic components. * Working knowledge of Python, SQL, or other tools for reliability\-data reduction, automation, and visualization. **Location** This position will be on\-site based in Sugar Land, Texas. **Why AOI?** In addition to competitive salary, AOI offers * Flexible and competitive health (medical, dental, vision) plans offer the employee with the right options to meet individual and family needs * Employer matching on 401(k) deferrals * Generous PTO policy, with unused PTO payout at end of the year * Relocation package available within US * Immigration sponsorships
