jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Observability)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200\+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80\+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we're moving to wide events, with one context\-rich event per request, improving the signal\-to\-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We're also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI\-assisted code is well instrumented by default. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You'll spend most of your time hands\-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross\-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams. **What You'll Do** * You will own the architecture of Affirm's telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200\+ TB/day. * You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents. * You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships. * You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year\-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business\-impacting projects. * You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design \& analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade\-offs are well understood and managed. * You will act as a force\-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes. * You take ownership of your team's operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support "keep the lights on" \& on\-call efforts. * You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks. * You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example. **What We Look For** * You have 8\+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin. * You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes. * You have built or operated high\-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform. * You have a well\-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs. * You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement. * You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. * You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work. * Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross\-functional peers. * You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. **Base Pay Grade** \- P **Equity Grade** \- 13 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job\-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT): $230,000 \- $290,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states): $204,000 \- $264,000 \#LI\-Remote **Remote\-first with flexibility built in** Affirm is proud to be a remote\-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in\-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office\-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in\-person onboarding experience. **Benefits designed for you** Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: * Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. * Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. * Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. * Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.description: **Company Description** ======================= ASG is backed by Alpine Investors and acquires market\-leading vertical SaaS companies, accelerating their transformation into AI\-native platforms. You'll help companies discover what's possible, take ideas from discovery through production, and demonstrate measurable business outcomes. **You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will:** opportunities for AI. * Redesign, improve, remove, or replace outdated internal workflows across customer onboarding, support, go\-to\-market, finance, and other business operations. * Architect, build, integrate, and deploy AI\-powered workflows and agentic systems from initial discovery through production, with clear owners and success measures. * Create AI\-powered operational intelligence and observability that exposes bottlenecks, anomalies, risks, and actionable insights across fragmented systems and data. * Identify and deliver opportunities to reduce operating costs, increase capacity, improve margins, and elevate customer experiences. * Work with OpCo product and engineering teams to explore AI\-enabled customer and product opportunities when appropriate. * Recognize patterns across companies and develop reusable components, integrations, and deployment approaches that accelerate future projects. * Balance business value, usability, technical feasibility, and responsible data handling when evaluating solutions and emerging capabilities. **We're Excited About You Because:** ==================================== * You have strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of personally architecting, building, and shipping production systems, not just managing delivery or configuring tools. * You have customer\-facing experience in solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a similar role that requires working with varied stakeholders. * You can engage credibly with CTOs and senior business leaders, ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions, and translate ambiguity into an executable plan. * You understand business operations and economics, can prioritize by potential impact, and measure results beyond technical completion. * You have experience with APIs, enterprise integrations, data flows, orchestration, and practical AI approaches, including models, agents, and multi\-step workflows. * You have demonstrated creative problem\-solving across different customers, industries, or operational environments and can learn unfamiliar businesses quickly. * You are resourceful, pragmatic, and comfortable owning outcomes independently in a fast\-moving environment. * You understand responsible handling of business data, permissions, and system access while partnering with established security and governance teams. * You bring substantial relevant experience; senior engineering depth and stakeholder maturity matter more than a specific title, tenure, employer, or framework. **Base Salary Range** ===================== The target salary range for this position is ($200,000\-$225,000\), and is part of a competitive total rewards package including an annual bonus, employer\-paid benefits, L\&D stipend and incentive pay for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. Please be wary of communications from similar domains that may contain misspellings or slight variations. These could be attempts at phishing or impersonation. ASG will never ask you for sensitive personal information during the hiring process such as social security numbers, banking information or other personal details.

We spend a lot of our time with the people who actually use these tools: in the field, during exercises, wherever they are. **ABOUT THE ROLE** This is not a product manager who happens to spend some time forward. The forward work is the product work. As a Forward Deployed Product Manager, you own the path from a warfighter problem to a fielded solution. That covers applications, data models, user experiences, integrations, and infrastructure. Most of all, you work as a translation layer between the warfighter and the engineering teams. You embed with units, build real expertise in how they fight, and earn enough trust that influence runs both ways. You are there to solve their problems, not to sell them something, and you build an open, trusting relationship by doing exactly that. Sometimes an introduction is made for you. You have to be comfortable with walking into a unit that has never heard of Lattice, and earn your footing from the bottom up. The profile we are hiring for: a product manager who can walk into a formation, understand the fight, earn the trust of the people in it, map the workflow and the data underneath it, and then pull the right parts of Anduril together to solve it. You walk in with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility, but you back it up with real curiosity and humility. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * **Own warfighter outcomes, not features.** Embed with units, learn the mission, find the problems that matter most, and own them through development, fielding, and the work that comes after. * **Build real relationships with the people in the fight.** Earn the trust of warfighters, commanders, staff, and subject matter experts. Become a partner who understands how the unit actually fights, not just what shows up in a requirements document. * **Do the research in the field.** Learn by watching, asking questions, and taking part in real workflows. Turn what you learn into clear priorities. * **Connect the fight to the product.** Map the users, decisions, workflows, systems, data, and dependencies behind an outcome, and use that to drive what gets built and integrated. * **Design across the whole stack.** Do not default to a new app or a new screen. Work out whether an outcome needs an application change, a new or richer data model, an integration, a workflow that spans applications, or a change in how data moves across the Mesh. * **Use the data model as a product tool.** Get to know what data exists, how it is represented, where it comes from, who uses it, and what has to change to make a workflow possible. * **Design for the tactical edge.** Understand how the network and the hardware affect what the user sees and does. Account for degraded conditions, bandwidth, latency, and compute when you define a solution. * **Pull the right people together.** Get warfighters, engineering, design, and the other teams around the same problem, and drive them toward one coherent answer. * **Make ambiguous problems workable.** Be just as comfortable writing a strategy, sketching a workflow, working through a data flow with an engineer, or standing at a whiteboard with the people who will use the product. * **Run the room.** Lead workshops, working groups, and design sessions. Get useful information out of a room, settle competing views, and leave with decisions and next steps. * **Brief well and tell the story.** Communicate clearly to a few operators, to a large room, and to senior leadership. Adjust the level of detail for the audience without losing the substance. * **Prototype before you spend engineering time.** Test ideas quickly with users so you get to the right answer faster. * **Stay with it through fielding.** Watch whether the solution actually helps the mission, find where it breaks under real conditions, and feed that straight back into the product. * **Look past the single request.** Spot the patterns that can become reusable across units and programs, instead of building a one\-off every time. **WHO YOU ARE** Anduril moves fast and is  ghts and for Army staff processes, TTPs, and doctrine. * A range of product experience across internal tools, customer\-facing applications, and tools for technical users. * Working knowledge of data models, system integrations, networking, or distributed and edge systems, enough to reason about data flows and network constraints. * A self\-starter who does well with ambiguity and loose organizational structure. * Experience fielding capabilities and improving them based on real operational feedback. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Bioinformatics
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As a Senior Software Engineer on the Life Sciences team, you'll build biology software that our own scientists and the wider research community can depend on, and you'll be one of the main people representing that work to computational biologists outside Anthropic. The Life Sciences team works to accelerate progress in biology with AI, combining frontier models with hands\-on computational and experimental research. We want the tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks we build in genomics and structural biology to be useful beyond our own projects, so we plan to release them to the community. Computational biology has a long tradition of open, shared software, and we want to contribute to it well. Every release should be something a researcher can install, run on their own data, and trust: correct on real inputs, validated against reference data and established methods, documented, versioned, and maintained after launch. You'll own that standard. You'll write a large share of the code yourself, decide when something is ready to ship, and stay with it once people start using it. You'll also be an active member of the biology software community: maintaining public repositories, answering issues, speaking at conferences and workshops, and bringing what you hear from researchers back into what we build next. We use Claude and AI coding agents heavily to build software, and we expect you to do the same across design, implementation, testing, and review. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand: you should understand it, test it, and measure its performance before it ships. We're looking for someone with deep software engineering experience who already works this way. The shape of the role is flexible. You might spend most of your time as an individual contributor, or you might lead a small group of engineers and scientists while continuing to contribute directly. Your focus can be genomics, structural biology, or both. Experience in other areas of computational biology is welcome, and we expect the work to range more widely over time. What matters most is a record of biology software that other people have adopted and relied on. This is a chance to shape how AI is put to work in biological research, on problems that matter for human health and scientific understanding. If building software that scientists trust is the work you want to do, we want to hear from you. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, build, and maintain biology software in genomics and structural biology (libraries, command\-line tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks) for use by researchers and AI agents, inside Anthropic and externally * Own the path from research code to public release, including testing, validation against reference data and established tools, benchmarking, documentation, and packaging, and make the call on when something is ready to ship * Maintain what we release: triage issues, review outside contributions, and manage breaking changes * Represent the team in the biology community through conferences, workshops, tutorials, and direct work with researchers and maintainers, and turn what you learn about their needs into priorities for the team * Partner with the team's computational and experimental scientists to turn research code into well\-tested, reusable software * Lead the technical direction of the projects you own through design review, code review, and mentoring, and, depending on your interests and the team's needs, lead a small team * Build with Claude and AI coding agents as your default way of working, hold agent\-written code to the same standard as your own, and set the team's practices for reviewing and validating it **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Have built, released, and maintained biology software that researchers outside your own group use, with evidence of adoption you can point to (for example public repositories, package downloads, citations, or use in other groups' pipelines) * Have deep working expertise in genomics or structural biology, including the data types, file formats, standard tools, and common failure modes of at least one of these fields * Are proficient in Python and comfortable working with large datasets in Linux and cloud or cluster computing environments * Practice rigorous testing and release engineering: unit and integration tests, continuous integration, validation against reference data, packaging, and versioning * Use AI coding tools as a central part of how you build software, and can show how yo systems on large language models, or training machine learning models on biological sequence or structure data The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 \- $320,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next\-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. **What We Offer** Salary: $184,000\.00 \- $253,000\.00 Location: Santa Clara,CA You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . **Role Overview** ----------------- Join Applied Materials AI COE team to build intelligent systems that solve complex problems in semiconductor manufacturing. As an AI / Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll design, develop, and deploy production AI solutions across machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and AI agents. A key focus of this role is using reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize dynamic manufacturing decisions such as scheduling, dispatching, planning, and resource allocation. You’ll work with simulation environments, operational data, and real\-world feedback to build intelligent systems that can learn, adapt, and improve complex factory operations. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models. * Develop reinforcement learning solutions for complex decision\-making and optimization problems. * Build RL environments, reward functions, policies, and evaluation frameworks. * Train and optimize agents using simulation and operational data. * Explore techniques including policy optimization, model\-based RL, multi\-agent systems, and hierarchical learning. * Build scalable training, inference, monitoring, and retraining workflows. * Partner with software engineers to integrate AI capabilities into production and customer\-facing products. * Contribute to MLOps, experiment tracking, model versioning, observability, and lifecycle management. * Research and prototype emerging technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, RAG, and multi\-agent systems. * Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, cloud architects, and semiconductor domain experts. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- **Required** ------------ * Strong foundation in machine learning and deep learning. * Hands\-on experience building and deploying production ML systems. * Strong Python development skills. * Experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow. * Demonstrated experience developing reinforcement learning solutions. * Strong understanding of RL concepts including environments, policies, rewards, value functions, and exploration strategies. * Experience with modern RL methods such as PPO, SAC, DQN, Actor\-Critic, or similar approaches. * Experience training and evaluating RL agents in simulation environments. * Ability to formulate complex optimization problems as reinforcement learning problems. * Experience with Git, testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and production software development. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience building AI agents or autonomous decision\-making systems. * Experience with discrete\-event simulation or simulation\-driven learning. * Experience combining RL with optimization techniques. * Knowledge of scheduling, dispatching, operations research, or industrial optimization. * Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, or MLflow. * Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, agent frameworks, or RAG. * Semiconductor manufacturing experience is a plus. **Why This Role** ================= Reinforcement learning is a core strategic capability for this team, not simply a research topic. You’ll help develop next\-generation manufacturing optimization solutions and intelligent agents capable of learning and adapting to complex factory operations. You’ll join an experienced, collaborative team of data scientists, AI engineers, software developers, and cloud architects working on challenging industrial AI problems with direct customer and business impact. **Additional Information** **Time Type:** Full time **Employee Type:** Assignee / Regular **Travel:** Yes, 10% of the Time **Relocation Eligible:** No The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable. For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement. Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. In addition, Applied endeavors to make our careers site accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us via e\-mail at Accommodations\_Program@amat.com, or by calling our HR Direct Help Line at 877\-612\-7547, option 1, and following the prompts to speak to an HR Advisor. This contact is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Systems Safety Engineer
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** Own the safety assurance of the software and AI that run our humanoid robots, from architecture analysis through verification evidence. You will analyze software and AI safety architectures, lead the safety analyses, and assess whether the evidence supports our safety claims. You will draw on IEC 61508\-3, ISO/IEC TS 22440, and deep experience with safety\-critical software systems. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Collaborate on system\-level risk assessments, allocate risk reduction measures to software and AI elements, and own the breakdown of software\-domain safety requirements into subsystem and element\-level requirements * Analyze and define the software safety architecture, including partitioning and freedom from interference, watchdogs, diagnostics, plausibility and timing monitoring, communication integrity, startup/shutdown behavior, and fault handling * Lead software safety analyses, including software FMEA, fault tree analysis, dependent/common\-cause failure analysis, and timing and resource analysis * Specify safety\-related software behavior, such as monitors, diagnostics, and safe\-state logic, and review software team designs against IEC 61508\-3 requirements for the target SIL / SC * Define the IEC 61508\-3 software safety plan and lifecycle, and assess team conformance through reviews and audits, including existing in\-house, open\-source, and third\-party libraries, RTOS, and middleware * Assess software systematic capability and review verification evidence, including coverage, static analysis, fault injection, and software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test results, for adequacy against safety claims * Apply the AI safety lifecycle (ISO/IEC TS 22440\) to AI/ML\-enabled functions, defining the safety architecture around them, including independence of safety functions from learned components and the safety mechanisms that monitor them * Assess AI/ML safety evidence against the AI safety lifecycle, including data and model assurance, performance limitations, and operational design domain * Own software requirements traceability and the software portion of the safety case, including gap assessments against standards * Support product safety and compliance teams in certification and demonstration of standards conformity **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * Demonstrated experience analyzing and assuring safety\-critical software architectures, including software safety analyses and safety case development * Practical application of the IEC 61508\-3 or ISO 26262\-6 (automotive) software lifecycle, with depth in software safety activities and qualification of existing software and tools, and experience with IEC 62061, ISO 13849, ISO 10218, ANSI/A3 R15\.06, or ISO 25785\-1 as relevant * Strong knowledge of embedded software architectures, including RTOS, mixed\-criticality partitioning, watchdogs, communication buses, and diagnostics * Hands\-on experience with FMEA/FMEDA, FTA, and dependent failure analysis, and with reviewing verification evidence such as fault injection, software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and test coverage * Working knowledge of safety for AI/ML\-enabled systems, such as ISO/IEC TS 22440; familiarity with ISO/PAS 8800, UL 4600, or SOTIF preferred * Experience with requirements and traceability tools such as JAMA; familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and static analysis; certification or third\-party assessment experience preferred * Ability to work cross\-functionally and make sound, risk\-based engineering decisions * Experience with common Product Development Processes / Product Lifecycle management including Agile, CMMI, Waterfall, etc. helping teams to deliver to organizational milestones. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's Degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field (or equivalent experience); Master's preferred * 8\+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial responsibility for safety assurance or analysis of safety\-critical software in complex electromechanical products **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times * Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen * Hearing and speech to communicate The annual salary range is $200,000 \- $240,000 base * This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. Apptronik provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Brief Position Description:** The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for working with both Aptys customers and Aptys internal personnel to design and build Aptys products for use by Aptys customers and their customers as applicable. The Senior Software Engineer also works with internal Aptys personnel and Aptys customers to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues with the Aptys products and services in both customer and Aptys environments. The Senior Software Engineer interacts with customers on a regular basis. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Designs, develops, and supports financial applications for use by Aptys customers * Provide ongoing maintenance, support, and enhancements for existing products * Work In a cross\-functional team to identify solutions to issues Aptys customers are facing * Identify and escalate priority issues as needed * Work with other members of the Aptys Development, Product, and Support teams to identify resolutions to issues found during the software development cycle * Identify areas with current Aptys products that require enhancement or improvement * Develop both unit tests and higher\-level tests as part of standard development practices * Work with other members of the Aptys Development, Product, and Support teams to support customers as they roll out solutions across thousands of users * Research issues discovered by QA or customers to Identify and develop workable solutions * Design and build robust scalable solutions to support customer’s workloads * Research new technologies, tools, and utilities for possible use in developing and supporting Aptys customers **Required Skills/Abilities:** * Ability to work under pressure to design and develop new product functionality or updates to existing product functionality * Ability to work under pressure to resolve customer production issues * Ability to work in a cross\-functional team environment or independently as needed * Ability to adapt to rapidly changing priorities * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills * Strong organization skills * Strong communication (written and verbal) skills * Strong attention to detail * Self\-motivated * Ability to follow standard processes and procedures * Ability to work with various configuration management technologies **Experience:** * Undergraduate degree in a technical field such as Computer Science or Information Systems or equivalent work experience Master's degree is a plus * Experience designing and developing e\-commerce systems is required * Experience with financial systems a plus * In\-depth experience with the following technologies or activities: * Strong NET experience preferably in C\# * Strong experience developing ASP.NET applications * Strong experience developing and interfacing with web services (WCF and Web API) * SQL database design and development * UI design and development * Problem\-solving in a complex environment * Payments (check, ACH, credit card, etc...) or other experience related to the financial Industry is preferred * Experience scaling infrastructure as demand grows is also a plus * Strong interest in emerging technologies, especially mobile and cloud technologies * Experience implementing unit tests and automated testing platforms * DevOps experience and focus on building and deploying Infrastructure using cloud deployment methodologies **About Aptys** Here at Aptys, we build systems used by thousands of financial institutions every day to process payments; in fact, we are responsible for providing these payment processing services to approximately one\-third of the nation’s financial institutions! You may have already benefited from our software without even realizing it. That’s because we’re good at what we do. That doesn’t mean we’re complacent, though. Our mission is to be the financial industry’s most customer\-centric company, offering payment solutions that enable financial institutions to grow, innovate, and become even more effective at servicing the nation’s consumers with cutting\-edge technology. This role will play a key part in our continued success moving forward. If the idea of being an integral part of our nation’s financial system is exciting to you, you’re in the right place. We believe that our employees are our organization, which is why we have gone 100% remote. It is important to us to find the very best people wherever they are, and that doesn’t just mean having great skills; we take our culture very seriously! We are bound together by a shared set of core values and you can expect the following principles to be embodied in our company and team culture: * Cooperation \- We believe wholeheartedly that we succeed or fail together as a team. If you need help, or even just a sounding board, you will always have somewhere to look or someone to ask. * Independence \- We are all adults! We rely on each other to do great work even when nobody is looking, and in exchange we trust one another enough to give each other the space we need to be our best. * Respect \- We are all human, and we don’t forget that. Your personal life will be respected, and your manager’s (virtual) door will always be open if you have any questions or concerns. As an employee of Aptys Solutions you will also enjoy the following benefits: * Excellent work\-life balance * Generous PTO and holiday schedule * Health, vision, and dental insurance * 401K with company match Aptys Solutions is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy status, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic disposition or any other reason protected by law. jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist, Computational Pathology
jobs.description: **About Us:** Artera is an artificial intelligence company dedicated to transforming cancer care. We’ve developed foundation models that analyze clinical and pathology data, generating actionable insights that guide therapy selection and improve outcomes for cancer patients. By continuously improving these models, we aim to uncover the biological mechanisms driving cancer progression. **Build ML that changes how cancer is treated.** Most medical AI stops with a publication. Our AI models guide treatment decisions today. Artera’s AI\-driven prostate test is standard\-of\-care in the US and cancer patients in all 50 states are using our models to help make decisions about their therapy. While we started in prostate cancer, we’ve grown into a multi\-cancer platform with more disease settings in development. You'll help build what's next. **The role** At Artera, we’re making ML development agent\-first. You won’t spend your days hand\-writing training loops, tuning hyperparameters in notebooks, or babysitting individual runs. Instead, you’ll design, direct, and evaluate autonomous research agents that propose hypotheses, write and execute experiments, and train models autonomously. You’ll be tasked with answering specific scientific questions: which patients can safely forgo aggressive treatment or inferring molecular traits from routine digital slides and your job will be to decide what’s worth investigating and which research directions merit investment. ### **Why the work is different at Artera:** * **Your models help cancer patients.** This isn’t AI for generating cat videos or customized emojis. Our work directly affects patients who are experiencing among the most difficult periods of their lives. * **Foundation\-model scale.** We train our own pathology foundation models from scratch with distributed multi\-node GPU training on AWS. While frontier labs may have cracked coding and math, their ability to read biology for our problems is unusable. Artera is working on the cutting edge of this space. ### **What you'll do:** * Build and evaluate AI models that predict patient outcomes and treatment benefit from whole\-slide images and clinical data, or infer molecular traits directly from slides. * Push the frontier in terms of our pan\-cancer self\-supervised pathology foundation models. * Manage coding agents to propose and execute experiments, improve the efficiency of our tooling, and identify biological insights that explain our models' behavior. * Review findings with product, medical, and biostatistics teams, and contribute to regulatory documentation that gets models into patients’ hands. * Co\-author papers and share your work at conferences. ### **What we're looking for:** You might be a few years into industry or finishing graduate research. Either way, we're looking for someone who has built ML that holds up on real data and has some grounding in biology or medicine. * 1\+ years building deep learning models (we use PyTorch), in industry or in substantial graduate research * Hands\-on experience with coding agents like Cursor or Claude Code * Experience taking models beyond a notebook and evaluating them rigorously on messy, real\-world data * A background in oncology, biology, or biomedical science, from coursework, research, or work (e.g., a biology or bioengineering degree, computational biology research, or ML work in healthcare or biotech) * Clear communication and an interest in working closely with product, medical, and biostatisticians If you meet most of this and the work excites you, we'd love to hear from you. **Nice to have:** large\-image computer vision or medical imaging; self\-supervised learning; weakly supervised learning (e.g., MIL); survival analysis; domain shift and robustness. **You don't need:** a PhD or regulatory experience. You'll learn the regulatory side here, and we'll deepen your oncology knowledge on the job. **How you'll grow:** close collaboration with senior ML scientists and engineers, experience across the full lifecycle of a regulated clinical ML product, and room to grow into leading a workstream. In addition to base salary, equity is a core component of our compensation. We also offer 401k matching, unlimited paid time off (PTO), and more. The base salary is competitive and commensurate with experience, qualifications, and other factors to be discussed during the interview process. **Equal Employee Opportunity:**At Artera, we value bringing together individuals from diverse backgrounds to develop new andinnovative solutions for patients and physicians. As an equal opportunity employer, we do notdiscriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy),physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information gender identity orexpression, sexual orientation, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other legallyprotected characteristic.

Together, you will create transformative experiences for our audience. ABOUT YOU You feel pride in every step forward, however big or small. The solutions we’ve created have: * Saved lives in the California wildfires and southern U.S. flooding * Provided security for the 2020 Presidential Inauguration, Super Bowl, and post\-attack Boston Marathon * Enabled augmented\-reality training environments for surgeons * Increased transparency and promoted patient wellness in hospitals and senior care facilities * Combined computer vision and robotics to automate dangerous manual labor tasks * And much more! **Why You’ll Want to Live Aviturian** Aviturians create technology that makes a meaningful difference in someone’s life. We leverage cutting\-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user\-friendly applications. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Machine Learning Research Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well\-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential. **Job Title:** Machine Learning Research Engineer **Location:** 100% Remote (Continental United States) **Position Type:** In\-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third\-party client or vendor) **Salary**: $100k \- $150k **Experience:** 6\+ years **Sponsorship:** No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates. **Employment Terms \& Visa Policy** **This is a 100% remote, full\-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.** **This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in\-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement.** The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third\-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved. We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third\-party arrangements for this role. **BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.** Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full\-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in\-house SOW deliverables. No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role. **However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.** For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands\-on experience. **Job Summary** We are seeking an Machine Learning Research Engineer to bridge cutting\-edge applied research and production engineering, designing and shipping advanced machine learning systems that solve high\-impact business problems. The role blends scientific rigor with practical software engineering, requiring deep understanding of modern ML and deep learning techniques alongside the ability to build robust, scalable, and well\-instrumented production pipelines. The ideal candidate stays current with the rapidly evolving AI research landscape, can critically evaluate new techniques for real\-world applicability, and is comfortable operating across the full lifecycle from problem framing and experimentation to deployment and continuous improvement. **Key Responsibilities*** Design, prototype, and evaluate applied AI solutions across natural language, vision, recommendation, and structured data domains. * Translate ambiguous business problems into well\-scoped ML formulations with clear success metrics and evaluation strategies. * Stay current with the latest research in deep learning, large language models, and adjacent areas, and assess applicability to internal use cases. * Implement rigorous experimentation workflows including baselines, ablations, and statistically sound evaluation methodology. * Build production\-quality training and inference pipelines using modern ML frameworks and orchestration tools. * Collaborate with ML platform engineers to ensure efficient use of compute, storage, and accelerator resources. * Optimize models for accuracy, latency, throughput, and cost based on production requirements. * Develop tooling for dataset construction, labeling, validation, and ongoing monitoring of data quality. * Partner with product, design, and domain experts to ensure model behavior aligns with user needs and policy requirements. * Implement safety, fairness, and reliability evaluations and incorporate findings into model selection decisions. * Document research findings, design decisions, and operational characteristics clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Mentor engineers on applied ML methodology, evaluation rigor, and responsible deployment. * Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, reading groups, and prototype\-to\-production playbooks. * Influence the broader AI roadmap based on research insight, capability gaps, and emerging opportunities. **Required Qualifications*** Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a closely related field; or equivalent applied experience. * Six or more years of combined research and applied ML engineering experience. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning, and evaluating deep learning models at non\-trivial scale. * Solid grounding in mathematics, statistics, and the theoretical foundations of modern ML. * Experience taking ML models from research prototype to production with appropriate observability and safeguards. * Familiarity with distributed training, mixed\-precision training, and accelerator hardware. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to explain complex methods clearly. * Demonstrated ability to read, evaluate, and adapt techniques from current research literature. * Track record of shipping impactful applied AI projects. **Preferred Qualifications*** Published research at top\-tier AI/ML venues. * Experience with large language model training, fine\-tuning, or evaluation. * Familiarity with retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic systems, or multimodal architectures. * Exposure to responsible AI, model evaluation, and alignment practices. * Experience contributing to open\-source ML projects. **How to Apply** Would you jobs.description: **Position Purpose** The Principal Engineer is the senior technical expert for global manufacturing\-process methods and standards. Define robust global methods for process definition, prototypes, pilots, validation, and readiness. **Global Process Standards** Own technical content and methodology for global process standards, GBOP, PFMEA, global assembly standards, manufacturing\-time methods, and process libraries. Establish internal standards and guide correct engineering methodologies. Develop unconventional approaches for unique process challenges. **Systems and Technology Integration** Define process requirements represented in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Manufacturing Execution System (MES), routings, work centers, and master data. Translate process requirements into equipment, automation, tooling, fixture, and specification requirements with AMT. **Technical Leadership and Coaching** Serve as company expert and advise stakeholders at all levels. Coach AMEs, regional engineers, and subject matter experts. Present complex topics to technical, non\-technical, and executive audiences. **Manufacturing Process Centers of Excellence** Lead through influence all manufacturing\-process Centers of Excellence (COEs) composed of subject matter experts in BAC core competency processes across regions and factories. Establish each COE charter, technical agenda, priorities, governance cadence, decision and escalation pathways, and expected deliverables. Use the COE network to develop, maintain, and improve manufacturing\-process standards, methods, specifications, technical guidance, and global best practices. Mobilize regional and factory subject matter experts to resolve complex process issues, compare methods, share learning, and strengthen global process capability. Develop technical depth and succession within core competency processes through peer coaching, benchmarking, and shared technical work. **Expansion Technical Content** Define process standards, design criteria, specifications, technical acceptance, and readiness evidence for the Manufacturing Processes expansion playbook. Provide technical review of layouts, process\-risk methods, and readiness packages. **Nature and Scope** The Principal Engineer is BAC senior technical expert for global manufacturing\-process methods and standards. The role works across functions, product platforms, regions, and plants, initiates technical projects within broad objectives, and advises technical and business stakeholders on complex process decisions. The role exercises matrix leadership of manufacturing\-process Centers of Excellence through influence, facilitation, technical governance, and shared accountability for enterprise deliverables. **Knowledge \& Skills** **Education \& Experience** Bachelor degree in Engineering required; advanced degree or professional designation preferred. 10\+ years in manufacturing engineering and process definition for new products. Experience in high\-variation, low\-volume manufacturing and influential technical leadership. **Technical Expertise** DFMA, industrial engineering, Lean process design, PFMEA, routings, manufacturing time, fixtures, process validation, and process governance. Ability to address unique issues using advanced and unconventional methods and establish internal technical standards. **Communication \& Leadership** Executive\-level technical communication, company\-wide influence, technical coaching, and relevant external technical engagement. **Working Conditions** Office and manufacturing environments. Standing and walking up to 50 percent; occasional lifting up to 30 pounds. Domestic and international travel up to 20 percent. Companies rely on Bitsight to prioritize their cybersecurity investments, build greater trust within their ecosystem, and reduce their chances of financial loss. Built on over a decade of technological innovation, its integrated solutions deliver value across enterprise security performance, digital supply chains, cyber insurance, and data analysis. * We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011 * Over 3500 customers trust Bitsight * Over 600 teammates are dispersed throughout Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a highly experienced and collaborative Senior Full Stack Engineer and team player to join one of our multicultural Engineering teams, focusing on our Third Party Risk Management business. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you are known for thinking on your feet, learning quickly, and owning a problem to resolution. You enjoy solving complex problems while contributing with new ideas and techniques, leading to continuous improvement for the team. You enjoy close collaboration to find better ways to deliver great quality software in a high\-trust Engineering culture. Apart from domain skills, what we truly value are strong generalists: those with the critical thinking skills to use a variety of technologies \& languages and pick up new concepts when needed. We deliver well\-tested, high\-quality code in a continuous delivery environment. **Requirements:** ----------------- * Curious and with a growth mindset. Have a passion for continuous learning, seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge, and stretching yourself and others to achieve goals. * Strong Computer Science fundamentals in system design, data structures, and algorithms. * Ability to own loosely defined features from technical design through completion, and deliver on commitments. * Five (5\) years of experience as a Software Engineer building and maintaining a SaaS application. * Experience with Python. * Experience maintaining, building, and optimizing REST APIs. * Solid understanding of modern Javascript (ES6\+) and experience with at least one modern web framework (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.). * Experience with CI/CD (e.g. Gitlab CI/CD, Jenkins) and container technologies (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience working with a team of engineers, and product owners in delivering a product to end\-users. * Results driven. You don’t want to just write code, you want to ship code that is loved by customers. * Excellent communication skills in English \- both written and spoken. **Preferred:** -------------- * Experience with modern Python frameworks and technologies, such as Django, FastAPI, Flask, SQLAlchemy. * Experience with cloud computing environments (E.g., AWS) * Hands\-on experience leveraging AI\-assisted coding tools in daily workflows, including but not limited to Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code. The anticipated hiring base salary range for this position is 119,000\.00 \- 150,000\.00 USD Annual for US\-based employees. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations, is based on a full\-time work schedule, and is Bitsight’s good faith estimate as of the date of this posting. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for participation in a bonus or commission plan and an equity grant. Bitsight also offers a competitive benefits package, including but not but limited to medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave; flexible time off; a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities; life and disability insurance; and tuition reimbursement. **Belonging \& Inclusion.** Bitsight is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, or status as an individual with a disability. **Culture.** We put our people first. Bitsight offers best in class benefits. We devote the same energy to nurturing our company's inclusive culture as we apply to serving our customers' needs. Working at Bitsight will give you the opportunity to fulfill your professional goals and expand your skills. **Open\-minded.** If you got to this point, we hope you’re feeling excited about the job description you just read. Even if you don’t feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We’re eager to meet people that believe in Bitsight’s mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways. Bitsight also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or based on a sincerely held religious belief in accordance with applicable laws. If you need to inquire about a reasonable accommodation, or need assistance with completing the application process, please email recruiting@bitsight.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only, and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. This role uses AI\-assisted transcription during the interview process. All hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team. **Additional Information for United States of America Applicants**: Bitsight is committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. Bitsight will not discharge, discipline or in any other manner discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because such employee or applicant has inquired about, discussed, or disclosed the compensation of the employee or applicant or another employee or applicant. **Massachusetts Applicants:** *It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. BlinkRx is the world's first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can't afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn't have the medication in stock. We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us! **The Opportunity:** BlinkRx is opening its first Bay Area engineering office, and we are building the founding team now. This is not a lateral move into an established org. This is a chance to be one of the engineers who was there at the beginning, setting technical standards, shaping how AI gets embedded into an engineering culture from day one, and writing code that ships to production fast and reaches real patients immediately. We are looking for Full Stack Engineers who build with AI as a way of working, not as a feature. Engineers who experiment relentlessly, integrate it into everything they touch, and are done waiting for permission to do their best work. The founding team sets the culture and the trajectory. That opportunity does not come around often, and it is rarer still when the company is already proven at scale. **Responsibilities:** * Lead architecture and execution for complex features or systems across multiple teams or domains, with an emphasis on AI\-integrated solutions. * Design and evolve backend and frontend architecture for scalable, high\-performance systems. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code and lead code reviews that raise the bar for the entire team. * Actively integrate AI tooling into your development workflow and help establish that standard across the engineering organization. * Investigate and resolve complex performance and reliability issues end\-to\-end. * Drive the release of new features with testing, documentation, and monitoring from day one. * Partner cross\-functionally with product, design, data, and operations to shape roadmaps and accelerate impact. * Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate with a learning mindset and a bias for action. * Communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with increasing scope and impact. * Proven experience owning significant systems or product areas from design through launch. * Strong expertise in at least one modern language such as Python, JavaScript, or Go. * Active, hands\-on use of AI tools as a core part of your engineering workflow. * Experience in distributed systems, API design, and performance optimization. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. **Why Join Us:** It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start\-ups. **Our Culture** --------------- **Who we are:** Led by two pioneering co\-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500\. **How we work:** * **We move Blitzy Fast:** Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally. * **Championship Mindset:** We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in\-person, and remaining focused on the mission. * **Passion for Invention:** We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration. * **We Work for the Customer:** We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships. **About the Role** ------------------ As a DevOps Engineer at Blitzy, you will be a critical force behind the infrastructure powering our cutting\-edge AI agents and enterprise software development platform. Based out of our Cambridge, MA headquarters, you'll architect and maintain the scalable, resilient systems that enable Blitzy to autonomously deliver production\-ready software at unprecedented speed. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on role for an engineer who thrives in a fast\-moving environment and takes deep ownership of the systems they build. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Build, manage, and scale Kubernetes clusters supporting AI agent workloads and production application deployments. * Design and implement robust CI/CD pipelines for both application services and AI\-driven workflows. * Automate infrastructure provisioning, scaling, and operations using Python and Terraform. * Deploy and maintain applications via Helm charts, ensuring consistency across environments. * Own the observability stack: alerting, distributed tracing, and monitoring for all production services and APIs. * Build and maintain infrastructure for AI agent orchestration, enabling reliable and high\-throughput agent execution. * Partner closely with engineering teams to improve developer experience, deployment strategies, and operational tooling. * Maintain and continuously improve the security, reliability, and cost\-efficiency of our cloud environments. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of DevOps or infrastructure engineering experience in production environments. * Deep expertise in Kubernetes including deployment, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting. * Strong Python proficiency for automation, scripting, and tooling. * Hands\-on experience with Helm for application package management. * Proven track record designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with major cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or, Azure). * Proficiency with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code. * Strong Linux administration skills and containerization expertise (Docker). ***Compensation: $160,000\-$230,000 \+ Bonus \+Equity*** *Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process*

jobs.title: Software Developer

jobs.title: Data Engineer and Technical Lead
jobs.description: Data Engineer and Technical Lead**The Opportunity:** Ever\-expanding technology like IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence means that there’s more structured and unstructured data available today than ever before. As a data engineer, you know that organizing data can yield pivotal insights when it’s gathered from disparate sources. We need an experienced data professional like you to help our clients find answers in their data to impact important missions, from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence. As a data engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll use your expertise to help build advanced technology solutions and lead data engineering activities on some of the most mission\-driven projects in the industry. You’ll guide data engineering activities by overseeing the development and deployment of pipelines and platforms that organize and make disparate data meaningful. Here, you’ll mentor a multi\-disciplinary team of analysts, data engineers, developers, and data consumers in a fast\-paced, agile environment. You’ll use your expertise in analytical exploration and data examination while you oversee the assessment, design, building, and maintenance of scalable platforms for your clients. Work with us to use data for good. Join us. The world can’t wait. **You Have:** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering or software engineering with a data focus, including Databricks in production * 7\+ years of experience using Python and SQL, with demonstrated PySpark performance tuning on large datasets * 5\+ years of experience with production including Delta Lake and bronze, silver, and gold medallion Lakehouse design, applied with judgment * 3\+ years of experience with Databricks Workflows and Jobs, Asset Bundles, and YAML\-defined deployments * 3\+ years of experience with Unity Catalog information architecture including catalog and schema design for operational, audit, config, and reference data outside the medallion layers and Unity Catalog governance including catalogs, grants, and lineage * 3\+ years of experience with software engineering applied to data including Git, automated tests for pipelines, and CI/CD for Databricks assets and dimensional data modeling including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions for Business Intelligence (BI) consumption * Experience supervising engineers and leading projects and Agile delivery within a collaborative, cross\-functional team environment * Knowledge of the AWS services Databricks depends on as a consumer such as S3, IAM roles, and Secrets Manager * Public Trust * Bachelor’s degree **Nice If You Have:** * 5\+ years of experience developing, maintaining and enhancing Tableau or other BI dashboards on top of existing data models * Experience migrating legacy ETL including SSIS, Informatica, stored procedures, and on\-prem warehouses into governed Delta Lake data products * Experience working on Delta Live Tables or Structured Streaming * Experience with Data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, and Databricks expectations * Experience with Natural\-language analytics tools, such as Databricks Genie * Possession of strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and business audiences **Vetting:** Applicants selected will be subject to a government investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements of the U.S. government client; Public Trust determination is required. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page. Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability and organizational requirements.
