jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Kubernetes
jobs.description: **WHAT IS BOX?** Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU** **Our Mission**: Simplify and accelerate how Boxers bring applications to life. We provide a unified platform for configuring, deploying, and running Box services seamlessly, securely, reliably, and efficiently across optimal regions worldwide. Our team owns Box's Platform as a Service (PaaS) based on Kubernetes. With Box being an early adopter, supporter, and contributor of Kubernetes, you will work for the company that introduced kubectl, kube\-state\-metrics, kube\-applier, and kube\-exec\-controller to the open\-source community. Every team and service at Box relies on our platform and we are looking for a leader for this team. This is where you come in! We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Kubernetes Platform Team. In this role, you will design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and secure Kubernetes\-based infrastructure that enables product teams to deploy and run applications efficiently. You will work on core platform services, improve developer experience, and contribute to the long\-term evolution of our cloud\-native platform. This role requires strong backend engineering skills, deep knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud\-native technologies, and the ability to work independently on complex technical problems. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Design, develop, and maintain Kubernetes platform components and services (e.g., clusters, operators, controllers, admission webhooks). * Build and operate scalable, highly available Kubernetes environments in hybrid cloud infrastructure. * Develop internal platform tools and APIs to improve developer productivity and self\-service capabilities. * Implement best practices for reliability, security, observability, and cost optimization across the Kubernetes platform. * Collaborate with application and security teams to understand requirements and provide platform solutions. * Troubleshoot complex production issues related to Kubernetes, networking, storage, and distributed systems. * Automate infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management using Infrastructure as Code terraform. * Contribute to technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and platform roadmaps. * Mentor early\-career engineers and provide technical guidance within the team. * Stay current with Kubernetes ecosystem trends, CNCF projects, and cloud\-native best practices. * Participate in our on\-call rotation, available at all times while on\-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise. **WHO YOU ARE** We are an AI\-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box. Required skills * 3\+ years of experience in software or infrastructure engineering * Strong knowledge of Kubernetes internals and ecosystem tools (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, Istio/Linkerd, Calico, Prometheus, etc.). * Experience managing production Kubernetes clusters on public cloud provider (GCP, AWS). * Proven experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines. * Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and containerization. * Passion about open source and staying up\-to\-date with the community Preferred skills * Experience with multi\-tenant Kubernetes environments or platform engineering. * Knowledge of security best practices in cloud\-native platforms (OPA/Gatekeeper, workload identity, network policies) * Familiarity with cost management strategies in the cloud (e.g., autoscaling, rightsizing, spot/preemptible instances). Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process. At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply! **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. Box strives to respect the dignity and ‎‎independence of people with disabilities and is committed to giving them the same ‎‎opportunity to succeed as all other employees. Inclusiveness is core to our culture at Box, and we strive to ensure you get the most from your interview experience. Box makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please complete this form. Reasonable accommodations may include scheduling adjustments, document dictation and beyond. Notice to applicants in Los Angeles: Box, Inc and its related branches will consider for employment, qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chair Ordinance. The Fair Chance Ordinance is provided here. Notice to applicants in San Francisco: Box, Inc and its related branches will consider for employment, qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chair Ordinance. The Fair Chair Ordinance is provided here. For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Personnel Privacy Notice. If you are a California\-resident, please read our California Applicant \& Candidate Privacy Notice here. **NOTICE OF USE OF AI** At Box, we believe in the power of AI to improve the recruiting process while keeping people at the heart of every decision. For more information on the use of AI in our hiring process, please visit our webpage here.

jobs.title: Engineer-System Protection (ES26-08)
jobs.description: Engineer\-System Protection (ES26\-08\) **System Protection Engineer** **Brazos Electric Power Cooperative \| Waco, Texas** **Power Reliability. Protect the Grid. Make an Impact.** Are you an Electrical Engineer passionate about power systems, protective relaying, and keeping the electric grid safe and reliable? **Brazos Electric Power Cooperative** is seeking a **System Protection Engineer** to join our Engineering team! In this role, you'll help protect critical electrical infrastructure by developing and coordinating protective relay settings, analyzing system performance, and supporting the safe and reliable operation of our transmission system. You'll collaborate with engineering teams, field personnel, Member Cooperatives, and industry partners to solve technical challenges and strengthen system reliability. Whether you're an emerging engineer or an experienced professional, this opportunity offers meaningful technical challenges, professional growth, and the chance to make a lasting impact. **What You'll Do** * **Protect System Reliability:** Develop, analyze, and coordinate protective relay settings, programming, and protection schemes for transmission facilities and interconnections. * **Perform Engineering Studies:** Conduct short\-circuit, fault\-current, breaker\-rating, and other system protection studies to support safe and reliable operations. * **Analyze \& Troubleshoot:** Investigate relay operations, fault records, and system disturbances to identify issues and recommend corrective actions. * **Collaborate Across Teams:** Partner with Engineering, SCADA/EMS, Communications, field personnel, Member Cooperatives, and other utilities to coordinate protection systems. * **Support Regulatory Compliance:** Assist with NERC, TRE, ERCOT, and PUCT protection standards, reporting, audits, and compliance requirements. * **Advance Technology:** Evaluate emerging relay technologies, communications systems, and engineering tools to improve protection system performance. * **Support Field Operations:** Provide technical expertise during installation, commissioning, testing, maintenance, and emergency restoration activities. * **Drive Continuous Improvement:** Contribute to engineering standards, technical projects, process improvements, and system reliability initiatives. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an **ABET\-accredited university**, preferably with an emphasis in electric power systems. * Engineering experience in power systems, protective relaying, transmission, substations, protection and control, or related disciplines. Experience requirements vary by engineering level. * Knowledge of protective relay coordination, programming, fault analysis, and electrical system studies is desirable. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and external stakeholders. **Why Join Brazos Electric?** At Brazos Electric, your work matters. You'll be part of a team committed to delivering reliable electric transmission service to the communities we serve. We offer the opportunity to: * Work on challenging, meaningful projects that support electric grid reliability. * Collaborate with experienced engineering professionals and industry experts. * Expand your technical expertise and advance your engineering career. * Contribute to a safety\-focused, team\-oriented environment that values innovation and continuous improvement. **Ready to Power Your Career?**Apply today and become part of the team that keeps Texas powered! Visit our careers page https://joblinkapply.com/Joblink/6972 **Brazos Electric Power Cooperative, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Provider and Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.** **Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. The company does not sponsor employment visas, including H\-1B visas, and does not participate in student visa training extensions or related employer\-supported work authorization programs, including F\-1 OPT or STEM OPT, due to administrative limitations.** With a history dating back to 1941, Brazos Electric has grown and evolved over the years to serve the changing needs of our member\-owner co\-ops and their customers throughout Texas. Brazos Electric Cooperative provides transmission and distribution services for 16 Texas electric co\-ops whose service territory extends across 68 counties from the Texas Panhandle to Houston. Those 16 co\-ops are the member\-owners of Brazos Electric, and our board of directors is comprised of one representative from each of our member\-owners. Brazos Electric offers competitive pay and benefits for you and your family, a welcoming culture, and the opportunity to advance. Search our current career opportunities: https://joblinkapply.com/Joblink/6972

jobs.title: IT Applications Senior Developer
jobs.description: Brinks Home™ is a leader in smart home and residential security, protecting more than 1 million people across the continental United States, Canada and Puerto Rico. Our teams work together to deliver a best\-in\-class experience for our customers and one another.**Position Overview** ===================== Brinks Home is seeking an IT Application Senior Developer to help lead the design, development and support of business applications that support our customer order, installation and monitoring journey. This role provides technical and architectural leadership while building and maintaining .NET applications, APIs and integrations. AI\-assisted development is a core part of how this team works. The Senior Developer will direct AI coding agents to prepare technical plans, generate code and tests, and open pull requests. The role requires sound engineering judgment to evaluate AI\-generated work, ensure quality and security, and remain accountable for changes released to production. The successful candidate will also help establish effective practices and mentor teammates. **Key Responsibilities****:** ============================= **Application Development and Support** --------------------------------------- * Lead the application development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, code review and ongoing support. * Design, build and maintain .NET web applications, APIs and integrations in accordance with company standards and REST principles. * Develop solutions across cloud\-based and service\-oriented architectures, integrating core business systems such as CRM, ERP, inventory and monitoring platforms. * Investigate and resolve production issues using application logs, telemetry, databases and AI\-assisted analysis; document fixes and maintain runbooks. * Maintain coding standards, improve application performance, address technical debt and support continuous integration. **AI\-Assisted Engineering** ---------------------------- * Translate Jira stories into clear, testable acceptance criteria, including edge cases and failure scenarios. * Direct AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, to develop file\-level technical plans and implement code, tests and pull requests. * Critically review AI\-generated plans, code and tests for accuracy, security, scope, quality and potential regressions. * Maintain traceability from requirements and technical plans through testing and deployment, including documentation for change approval requests. * Evaluate test results in system integration and staging environments and determine when changes are ready for production. * Improve shared agent prompts, skills and rules, and coach developers on effective AI use and appropriate human review. **Technical Leadership and Collaboration** ------------------------------------------ * Help establish technical and architectural direction for applications and systems. * Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to explore solutions and deliver business value. * Lead peer reviews and quality assurance activities, participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and recommend process improvements. * Mentor developers and share technical knowledge with engineering, support and cross\-functional teams. * Research new tools and frameworks and assess their impact on business processes, application health and performance. **Required Qualifications****:** ================================ * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least 8 years of experience designing, building and maintaining production web or business applications, including 3 or more years with C\#/.NET. * At least 8 years of experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. * Daily, hands\-on experience using AI coding agents or assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor on real development work. * Strong expertise in C\#, .NET Core/ASP.NET MVC and Entity Framework, with solid SQL Server skills, including query analysis and working with large production tables. * Experience designing, maintaining and consuming REST APIs; familiarity with GraphQL and third\-party or legacy integrations is beneficial. * Full\-stack development experience with Angular, React, Vue or a similar framework, as well as HTML5, CSS3 and JSON. * Experience with Azure, cloud application architecture, service\-oriented systems, Git\-based CI/CD and DevOps practices. * Ability to plan, implement, test and troubleshoot complex software and system solutions, and to identify security or quality issues in AI\-generated code. * Experience with Jira, Confluence, technical documentation, code reviews and established quality assurance practices. * Strong communication, problem\-solving and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with product owners, stakeholders and cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications****:** =========================== AI\-agent skills, MCP servers, custom tool integrations or AI\-assisted software development workflows. * Knowledge of AI\-related risks, including prompt injection, secret handling, data protection and licensing of generated code. * Familiarity with Azure App Services, Key Vault, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Entra ID, Sentry or ConfigCat. * Experience with API management tools such as Sentinet and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI or Octopus Deploy. * Python experience and knowledge of Linux; familiarity with Ruby, Nuxt.js, Heroku or Selenium. * Experience with ERP/CRM platforms such as Business Central or SalesLogix, home security systems or alarm\-monitoring workflows. * Experience mentoring developers through changes in tools, technology or development processes. **Technology Environment****:** =============================== The team works with C\#/.NET, Python, REST APIs and modern web frameworks; SQL Server and business application databases; Azure services including Key Vault, Application Insights and Log Analytics; Entra ID and ConfigCat; service\-oriented integrations and Sentinet API management; and GitHub, Jira and Confluence. AI tooling includes Claude Code and Cowork, shared agent skills, and MCP connections to systems such as logs, SQL and Jira. **AI\-Assisted Development Expectations****:** ============================================== AI use is a core expectation of this position. Each change request must include an AI\-written technical plan, and AI agents are expected to open pull requests for human review. Acceptance criteria define expected behavior and guide test creation. Human reviewers remain accountable for technical plans, code, tests and production promotion while automated verification is evaluated and improved. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Within the first 30 days, the Senior Developer is expected to deliver a change through the full AI\-assisted workflow. Within 60 days, the developer should own a feature area with plans and pull requests requiring minimal rework. Within 90 days, the developer should contribute a shared agent skill or rules improvement. Ongoing success includes improved delivery throughput, fewer escaped defects, evidence\-based quality controls and active mentoring of junior developers. **Location and Travel** ======================= This is a remote position open to candidates located in the continental United States. Candidates in the Dallas–Fort Worth area are preferred. Travel is expected to be approximately twice per year to our Farmer’s Branch, TX Headquarters. **Benefits:** * Brinks Home recognizes the value of benefits for you and your family, so we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits program: * + Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with Employer Match, Paid Time Off \& Paid Holidays, HSA/FSA, Life \& AD\&D Insurance, Disability Coverage, Maternity/Parental Leave, Mental \& Physical Health Benefits, Employee Resource Groups, Volunteer Hours, Discounted Equipment \& Monitoring, Employee Referral Program. * To learn more about our company culture and career opportunities, please visit our **LinkedIn** and **Career Page**. *Brinks Home provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* \#equalopportunityemployer \#veteranfriendly We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer, AI Support Systems
jobs.description: **About Broccoli** ------------------ At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world. We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep America running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done. Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences. Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built. Today: * Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day. * We've grown to **$25M\+ ARR in 2\.5 years.** * We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry. * We're backed by **Khosla Ventures** and **Y Combinator**. We're still just getting started. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for an AI\-first builder to transform how we deliver customer support at Broccoli AI. You'll own customer support experience and build the AI workflows, systems, and documentation that help us resolve customer issues faster and more effectively. You'll work closely with our Technical Support team, Customer Success and Product Engineering, to build tools and automate workflow, improve how our AI troubleshoots customer issues, and build a knowledge base that delivers accurate, helpful answers. This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants to use technical skills to impact directly how a world class technical support team works. You'll identify recurring customer issues, build and improve AI\-powered solutions, and use support data to identify opportunities to improve the customer experience. You'll report to our Head of Customer Success and partner closely with teams across the company. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and improve AI workflows that help resolve common customer questions and Tier 1 support issues. * Own our support knowledge base, ensuring documentation is accurate, easy to navigate, and useful for both customers and AI. * Build out the customer facing support platform (example). * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support tasks and build the tools, integrations, and workflows to make them happen. * Investigate recurring customer issues and AI failures to understand root causes and develop lasting solutions. * Partner with Technical Support, Customer Success, and Product Engineering to improve the customer experience and address underlying product issues. * Build reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into ticket trends, resolution rates, and support performance. * Help ensure enterprise customers and complex issues receive the attention they need while making routine support more scalable. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering or closely related technical experience, with a track record of building and shipping software. * A degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. * Strong coding skills and experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software. * Experience building integrations, working with APIs and databases, and connecting systems. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-powered applications, LLMs, AI agents, or workflow automation. * A product\-minded approach to engineering. You enjoy understanding customer problems and building solutions that address them. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to take projects from initial idea through implementation and iteration. * Experience working with customer support teams or building customer\-facing tools is a plus.

are not limited to:** * Promoting a safe working environment by following all safety procedures * Providing guidance on maintaining material handling control systems, industrial motor control systems, Profibus, AS\-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems. * Acting as the first level of escalation support for equipment automation issues and environment with fluctuating temperatures * Regularly required to type on a computer for 1\-2 hours per day **Why C\&W Services?** We're a global company with over 400 offices in 60 countries. jobs.description: CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. **The Role** ============ CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy, creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. The Role: You will build and ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows for our customers. These features automate the routine parts of a claim and guide customers on the rest, so they have to earn that trust with measured accuracy, not a convincing demo. Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system design, security, and hard debugging. You own features end to end.**Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows in Python and TypeScript, from a problem scoped with product managers and data scientists through production traffic, and help set the metrics you will be measured against. * Write the evals, guardrails, and feedback loops that make your features trustworthy, and hold them to explicit token and latency budgets. * Use agentic coding tools every day, and own the review of what they produce: catch the correctness, security, and design problems in generated code before you open the pull request. * Maintain and extend the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, blending semantic search, classical NLP, and LLMs. * Build and operate durable, event\-driven services in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, with checkpointed model outputs so a retry does not re\-invoke a completed LLM step. * Trace every model call and agent step so a recommendation can be reconstructed and audited, with citations back to the source documents, and wire that tracing into your alerts. * Model and query claims data across relational, document, and graph stores. * Design privacy and security in from the start: tenant isolation, least\-privilege access for agents and their tools, and a clear rule for what data may reach a model provider. * Write a technical design document before any significant change, and use it to get feedback and buy\-in from the team before you build. * Take part in a shared on\-call rotation for the services you build. **Requirements:** ================= * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one LLM\-powered feature you shipped and then operated in production. * Python and TypeScript: typed, tested, async code in both, and real depth in one. * Evals you have designed for LLM output, plus guardrails you have shipped. * A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work. * Pipelines that blend LLMs with semantic search and classical NLP: structured output, tool calling, embedding\-based retrieval, and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM. * Services built on message\- or event\-driven architectures, including long\-running workflows with retries, idempotent handlers, and event\-sourced state, plus an LLM or agent step you ran inside one. * Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition\-key, consistency, and tenant\-isolation calls you made. * Backend services built and operated on Azure or AWS, and exposure to a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler. * Technical design documents you have written to get feedback and buy\-in from a team before buildi  code review you can give as well as take. **Even Better if You Have:** * React and TypeScript experience, so you can deliver a full\-stack feature end to end. Chat, streaming, and citation\-heavy AI experiences especially. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code such as Terraform or Bicep. * Experience with agent frameworks, LangGraph and the Microsoft Agent Framework among them, and with the ways agents reach their tools: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, command\-line tools, and microservices. * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Arize, or Braintrust, and with OpenTelemetry\-based tracing. * Experience designing A/B tests for AI features, or what\-if simulations that replay historical claims through a proposed change before it ships. * Exposure to the insurance, claims, or automotive repair domains. **What Success Looks Like:** * In your first six months you ship an LLM\-powered feature, its evals run in CI, and you can name the metric it moved. * When a model migration or prompt change causes a regression, the evals you wrote catch it before a customer does. * You take ownership from concept to production with light direction, asking the right questions early. * You care that things hold up: the services you build survive retries, partial failures, and model migrations without incidents a customer can see. * When something goes wrong in production, the trace tells you which step and which model call, and you can show an auditor the same thing. * Privacy and security reviews of your features find nothing that was not already designed in. * You enjoy the craft, and it shows: engineers pick up your patterns without being told to. * You enjoy the back\-and\-forth that gets a feature scoped, and you can argue a position without needing to win it. * You embrace our ambitious, collaborative, and empathetic values, and you like problems where the answer has to be measured rather than argued. **Interview Policy \& Privacy Notice:** ======================================= A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE. **About CCC's Commitment to Employees:** ======================================== CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer\-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion \& Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real\-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success. CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including: * 401K Match * Paid time off * Annual Incentive Plan Performance Bonus * Comprehensive health insurance * Adoption Assistance * Tuition Reimbursement * Wellness Programs * Stock Purchase Plan options * Employee Resource Groups For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site. Here, you belong. You are seen, valued, and respected. We celebrate you for who you are and all you bring. Every voice is heard and is important to our success. You can hear what employees have to say about our culture here If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, please contact (800\) 621\-8070\.

jobs.description: SVP Chief Technology Officer **SUMMARY:** The Chief Technology Officer provides enterprise\-wide leadership for technology strategy, infrastructure, core systems, data architecture, project governance, and innovation. This role ensures that technology investments strengthen member experience, employee productivity, operational resilience, cybersecurity, and the credit union’s long\-term strategic growth. Reporting to the CEO or designated executive leader, the CTO works closely with executive leadership, Risk Management, Information Security, Operations, Member Experience, Digital Banking, and business line leaders to align technology priorities with enterprise strategy, regulatory expectations, member needs, and organizational capacity. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Leadership \& Management + Lead technology architecture including infrastructure, key applications, data and project management to ensure technology capabilities support the credit union’s strategic priorities, regulatory requirements, operational needs, and member experience goals. + Develop, maintain, execute, and adapt a comprehensive technology roadmap that directly supports the Strategic Plan, organizational goals, annual metrics, risk appetite, member experience priorities, and operational efficiency objectives. + Develop and manage the technology operating and capital budgets, ensuring effective prioritization of investments, resource allocation, cost optimization, and measurable return on technology expenditures. + Partner with the Member Experience team to identify technology\-related service delivery friction and drive automation, workflow improvement, efficiency, and faster service delivery. + Develop and champion comprehensive strategies for data\-driven decision\-making through robust data architecture, reliable reporting solutions, high\-quality data governance, and accessible business intelligence tools. * IT Infrastructure + Design, maintain, secure, and continuously improve technology infrastructure to support business needs, strengthen operational resilience, optimize industry\-leading security, maintain reliable service delivery, and drive operational efficiency. + Maintain strong internal service support for all technology needs. + Identify and implement technology solutions to support employee productivity and efficiency with focused training to support adoption. + Continuously improve Charter Oak’s security posture in partnership with Risk Management and Information Security by proactively implementing security solutions, strengthening controls, supporting regulatory readiness, and safeguarding member and institutional data. + Oversee enterprise technology disaster recovery capabilities, technology resiliency planning, testing, and recovery readiness to support business continuity objectives. * Project Management + Oversee key technology vendor relationships, contracts, service\-level expectations, due diligence, implementation performance, and ongoing third\-party risk considerations to ensure vendor solutions remain secure, reliable, cost\-effective, and aligned with credit union objectives. + Ensure all projects are strategically aligned, prudently scoped, properly approved, and sufficiently resourced with clear outcome\-based metrics. + Lead project resource capacity planning through the Project Management Office to support proper resource management and workforce planning. + Develop and document project management governance and methodologies for consistent application in support of proper organizational governance. + Orchestrate and lead large, strategic cross\-functional projects to ensure ROI and objective outcome tracking. * Core Systems, Applications, \& Integrations + Ensure proper management and maintenance of all core business applications to maintain maximum uptime and optimize efficiency. + Lead design, execution, and modification of data flows between systems and ensure efficient workflows and optimal data availability to support staff efficiency and member service experience. + Build and maintain seamless integration of systems through the best available tools and methodologies that optimize both security and operational efficiency in alignment with immediate and long\-term business objectives. * Emerging Technologies and Innovation + Monitor emerging technologies to identify, evaluate, recommend, and prioritize practical technology solutions that align with the credit union’s strategy, business needs, risk appetite, member expectations, and implementation capacity. + Cultivate key technology partners to support strategic implementation and member outcomes. + Foster and support a culture of innovation throughout the organization to continuously improve member and employee experience through process and technological improvement. **QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:** Qualifications should include progressively responsible technology leadership experience, preferably in a financial institution or regulated environment; demonstrated success leading infrastructure, core systems, integrations, data, cybersecurity partnerships, and enterprise projects; strong vendor management and project governance experience; the ability to translate business strategy into practical technology plans; and excellent communication skills with executive, board, technical, and non\-technical audiences. Must be an innovative, proactive leader who possesses sound analytical and critical decision making capabilities. Requires well\-developed interpersonal skills in order to communicate effectively with members, employees and vendors. **CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**ISC2 Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), ISACA Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), preferred. **Equal Opportunity Employer Veterans/Disabled** **Charter Oak offers paid time off, paid sick time, a variety of health, medical, and supplemental insurance plans, and a 401(k)\-retirement plan with an employer match.**

MDT moves petabyte\-scale training data between hyperscaler storage and Crusoe storage as a managed service, so AI labs and Physical AI companies can train on Crusoe GPUs without building their own transfer pipelines. You will design the control plane, the transfer worker fleet and the integration with Crusoe's storage and network, and set the path for adding other clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers. This is an engineering leadership role on a new team. Managed Data Transfer starts from a working prototype that already serves customers in production, so your first decisions are about what to keep, harden or replace, and how to sequence that work without disrupting the customers who depend on it. You define what partner teams build to and hold the line on it. * **Extensibility and Build\-versus\-Buy:** Design for new clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers with a pluggable transfer engine and regional worker pools, and evaluate open\-source and vendor options before the team builds. * **Operational Excellence:** Set the bar for reliability, observability and on\-call for every system the team ships. * **Product Partnership:** Work with Product on scope, pricing trade\-offs and milestones, and surface edge cases early enough to change the plan. * **Technical Mentorship:** Raise the team's level through design reviews, RFC feedback and direct coaching, so the team runs well without depending on you. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Distributed Systems Depth:** Hands\-on experience designing and operating data\-intensive distributed systems at scale, including the failure modes that only appear in production. * **Professional Experience:** 8\+ years shipping production software, including leading a service from prototype to general availability. * **Data Movement and Storage Performance:** Understanding of object storage semantics, file systems and TCP throughput, and the ability to profile and fix a transfer that is slower than it should be. * **Systems Integration Judgment:** Proven ability to evolve a live system toward a better design while keeping risk to current customers low. * **Cross\-Team Influence:** Experience defining API boundaries and schema contracts with partner teams, and negotiating them to agreement. * **Operational Ownership:** You have carried customer\-facing on\-call and built systems that are maintainable, observable and predictable. * **Software Engineering Craft:** Proficiency in Go or another modern compiled language (Go strongly preferred). * **Communication:** You can explain an architectural decision to an engineer, a PM and an EM, and you know which parts matter to each. **Bonus Points** * Experience building or operating bulk data transfer systems, such as AWS DataSync, Google Storage Transfer Service, or rclone at petabyte scale. * Familiarity with cloud networking and interconnects, such as AWS Direct Connect or GCP Interconnect. * Experience with cross\-account cloud IAM and threat modeling for services that hold customer credentials. * Approximate nearest\-neighbor (ANN) indexing in depth: HNSW, IVF, product and scalar quantization, DiskANN\-style indexes that live on SSD. * Experience with AI, HPC or Physical AI data pipelines. **Benefits:** * Competitive jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer, AI & Automation
jobs.description: Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. Remote (US, Canada) ### **What You'll Do** #### **Build AI\-Accelerated Test Automation** * Build and maintain scalable automation suites using Playwright across web, API, and mobile, contributing to broader QA frameworks and release validation standards. * Use AI coding assistants and agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Playwright's planner/generator/healer agents) to generate test plans, test cases, page objects, and test data from requirements, Jira stories, and PR diffs. * Review, validate, and harden every AI\-generated test before it merges — you own the correctness of the suite regardless of what wrote the code. * Drive down flaky tests and maintenance cost through resilient locator strategies, AI\-assisted self\-healing, and automated failure triage. * Integrate automated quality gates into GitHub Actions CI/CD so every deploy is validated by the pipeline rather than by manual sign\-off. * Build and maintain functional, regression, API, and performance/load testing coverage using tools like Postman, JMeter, or k6\. #### **Apply Testing Judgment Where It Matters** * Determine what should be automated, what can be delegated to AI, and what requires human testing — balancing coverage, risk, and release timelines. * Perform focused exploratory testing on new features, UI/UX changes, and complex user flows to catch edge cases and usability issues that automation and AI miss. * Turn every escaped defect into an automated regression check so the suite strengthens with each release. * Partner with engineers to embed tests, API contract checks, and AI\-assisted code review early in the SDLC to reduce downstream defect costs. * Help define how to test AI\-powered customer experiences (search, recommendations) where outputs are non\-deterministic and need evaluation rubrics rather than exact assertions. * Track and report quality metrics (automation coverage, defect escape rate, flake rate, test cycle time) to show where automation is paying off. #### **Contribute to a High\-Performing Team** * Collaborate with QA peers and engineering teams, sharing knowledge, best practices, and the AI prompts and workflows that work. * Provide input on quality practices and process improvements across the engineering org, focusing on reducing manual regression and UAT effort. * Support and mentor QA engineers on automation and responsible AI\-assisted testing, fostering a culture of quality ownership. ### **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Testing, including 3\+ years building and maintaining test automation that runs in CI/CD. * Proven, hands\-on experience with Playwright for web and API E2E automation; Cypress or Selenium experience is a plus. * Strong automation fundamentals: ability to design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable test suites and frameworks, and to diagnose and eliminate flaky tests. * Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python (Java a plus); you write test code to the same standard as production code. * Hands\-on, day\-to\-day use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) to write, refactor, and debug test code, with the discipline to validate and correct AI\-generated output. * Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred), including parallel execution, reporting, and quality gates. * Solid experience with functional, regression, API, and performance/load testing (Postman, JMeter, k6, or equivalent). * Strong exploratory testing skills and the judgment to build risk\-based test strategies across automated, AI\-assisted, and manual coverage. * Demonstrated SDLC and Agile experience with defect lifecycle management using Jira and TestRail. * Ability to operate effectively under a steady release cadence and manage competing priorities with minimal supervision. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * E\-commerce QA automation experience, particularly in environments shipping frequently with CI/CD integration. * Experience building or adopting agentic testing workflows (AI test generation, self\-healing tests, MCP\-connected tools, or LLM\-based failure triage). * Experience testing AI/ML\-powered features such as search, recommendations, or LLM\-generated content, including evaluation of non\-deterministic output. * Familiarity with BrowserStack or similar cloud device and browser grids. * Experience with observability tooling like Grafana or GCP\-based infrastructure, including using production signals to prioritize test coverage. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross\-functionally. ### **Why Join** The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work. * **Cross\-Functional Impact:** Your work touches every engineering team and every release — automation coverage and quality gates you build directly shape what ships to customers across web, mobile, and API. * **AI\-First Skill Building:** You will work at the frontier of AI\-assisted testing, using and evaluating emerging tools daily and building expertise that is defining the next generation of quality engineering. * **End\-to\-End Ownership:** You own the automation framework, the CI/CD quality gates, and the testing strategy — from choosing what to automate to deciding how to evaluate non\-deterministic AI features. * **Competitive Benefits (US):** Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands. * **Competitive Benefits (Canada):** Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands. ### **Interview Process** * **Recruiter Screen** \- A 30\-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for. * **Hiring Manager Interview** \- A deeper conversation focused on your automation experience, AI\-assisted testing approach, and how you balance coverage with release velocity. * **Technical / Case Discussion** \- A hands\-on session covering Playwright automation design, CI/CD integration, and your approach to evaluating and hardening AI\-generated tests. * **In\-Person Interview** \- We'd like to meet you at one of our office locations. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter. * **Reference Checks** \- Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible. * **Offer** \- We move quickly for the right candidate. *Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.* ### **Please Note** * Part of our interview process is a **mandatory in\-person interview** with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in\-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately. * Due to a high volume of fraudulent applications, **you must share a valid LinkedIn profile URL in** **the application questions below to be considered**. If you do not have a LinkedIn profile, you must provide a credible reason in that field and supply alternative evidence of your professional background to verify your identity. CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact hrbenefits@cscshared.com. Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates. with principles of Agile software development. * Ability to work independently yet collaboratively in a team environment. * Specialized Computer Skills: + Infor SyteLine ERP / CloudSuite Industrial jobs.description: Senior Staff Full\-stack Engineer, Global Payments Network Capital One has grown from a promising credit card startup into a Fortune 100 company. Our businesses span Card, Retail Banking, Commercial Banking, and Financial Services, backed by an Enterprise Services group that is Capital One's digital and technology backbone. Within that enterprise, the **Global Payment Network (GPN)** is one of the company's most ambitious builds: the unification of three legacy networks — Discover Network, PULSE, and Diners Club International — into a single, modern payment network. Rather than three separate acceptance footprints, three separate data models, and three separate operating teams, GPN is being rebuilt from a clean sheet so that a card issued anywhere on the network works everywhere on the network. This is the kind of ground\-up platform build most engineers only read about — a chance to define how data moves through one of the largest payment networks in the world, not maintain what's already there. **What You'll Do:** The **Senior Staff Full\-stack Engineer (IC)** for GPN will be responsible for architecting and delivering the real\-time and batch data infrastructure that every other team on the network builds on — ingestion, streaming, the canonical data model, and the catalog and metadata layer that gives the network a single source of truth. This role sits at the cross\-section of Core Network, Fraud/AML, Analytics, and the Modeling teams building on top of this data, and offers the rare opportunity to define how a payment network's data platform gets built from the ground up rather than inheriting one. A deep understanding of distributed systems, real\-time streaming architecture, data modeling at scale, and cloud infrastructure is required. This is a highly visible and influential individual\-contributor role, with no direct reports, that requires a combination of deep technical skill, setting vision and architecture, and effective partnership across engineering, data science, product, and risk. **Key Responsibilities:** * Architect the real\-time, event\-driven data pipelines that move authorization, transaction, settlement, into one shared model, with legacy formats translated at the network's edge only, never propagated inward. * Design and build the catalog and metadata layer (schema registry, lineage, data contracts, access policy) that gives every downstream team — fraud models, analytics, canonical modeling — one trustworthy source of truth instead of each team reverse\-engineering its own. * Set the technical architecture and standards for streaming, storage, and low\-latency serving at network scale, and serve as an evangelist for data standardization both internally and with the partner teams building on this platform. * Operate as the deep technical authority and trusted advisor across the data engineering function, reimagining what a modern, portable data platform should look like — favoring open, well\-understood components over one\-off tooling, so the platform is something new engineers can reason about on day one. * Partner directly with Fraud/AML, Analytics, and Canonical Modeling leadership so your architecture directly unblocks their roadmaps rather than trailing behind them. * Mentor and raise the technical bar for engineers across the organization, acting as a force multiplier on a brand\-new network build without owning a reporting chain of your own. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field jobs.title: Senior R&D Test engineer
jobs.description: At Capstan Medical, we’re driven by an unwavering commitment to transforming the treatment of heart valve disease. By merging surgical robotics with catheter\-based technology and next generation implants, we’ve pioneered a patient\-optimized approach to repair and replace heart valves. Our innovative technology offers a significantly less invasive alternative to traditional open\-heart surgery while ensuring precise and reliable placement of the heart valve implant. With these advancements, we may be able to provide patients with a solution to their heart valve disease while significantly reducing recovery time and minimizing the risk of complications. With a dedicated team of heart valve device experts and robotics engineers, we are fully committed to developing a comprehensive and transformative solution that will positively impact the lives of individuals affected by this condition. Capstan Medical is uniquely positioned in Santa Cruz. This gives us access to the amazing technical talent of the Bay Area, but in an environment that we feel is conducive to doing our best creative work. Our office is adjacent to large tracts of open space with bicycle trails straight from the office doors offering access to the hills and beaches of Wilder Ranch State Park for road/mountain bicycle riding, hiking, and surfing. Come join us and become part of a team revolutionizing heart valve treatment! ### **Responsibilities** The Senior R\&D Test Engineer will own testing for the hardware of a novel robotic platform and required to Come bring your experience to accelerate and strengthen our hardware testing strategy and be part of a successful initial product release. This is a hybrid position requiring 4 days per week on average at our Santa Cruz, CA location. **What you’ll do:** * Develop high level verification and validation test plans for the robot hardware systems. * Translate robot hardware requirements into test methods, test cases, and acceptance criteria. * Own and lead execution of test protocols for design verification testing including system reliability testing and mechanical testing against IEC 60601\-1\. Coordinate with external test houses for executing IEC 60601\-1 related mechanical testing as appropriate. * Write test protocols and test reports to support regulatory in accurately and clearly representing our test results in FDA submissions. * Design test fixtures needed to perform verification testing and identify pre\-existing fixtures and test methods that could be improved. * Collaborate with manufacturing to design test fixtures to qualify robot hardware in manufacturing. * Identify and communicate any issues or observations to the broader team. Collaborate with the team on root cause analysis or failure investigations. * Document and communicate your work through design reviews and as appropriate released documents as part of the product development process. * Align individual work to best support company goals, identifying high risk items and being part of developing solutions. ### **Requirements** **What you’ll need:** * BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline, or equivalent work experience. * 5\-8 years of relevant experience working in a regulated environment with formal verification testing, medical device experience strongly preferred. * Proficiency in CAD (SolidWorks preferred) for creating detailed parts, assemblies, and drawings for test fixtures, using GD\&T as appropriate. * Hands on prototyping capabilities and familiarity with sensing equipment (e.g. Chatillon, Instron) * Strong written communication skills, in particular writing technical content for a reviewer audience like the FDA. * Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity and an ability to convert that into tangible outcomes. **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience with various manufacturing methods and hands on prototyping, including manual machining, 3D printing, etc. * Experience with medical robotics, in particular testing hardware to IEC 60601\-1\. **Why join us:** * We offer a fun, hands\-on, fast\-paced, collaborative environment where you will be working on transformational technologies in the cardiac healthcare space. * We offer outstanding benefits with medical, dental, and vision covered at 100% for you and your family, as well as flex time off. * We thrive in our work\-hard, play\-hard environment. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Mechanical Engineer** **Position Title:** Mechanical Engineer **Location:** Platte City, Missouri **WHO WE ARE** Central Power Systems \& Services is a privately held company with a strong history dating back to 1954\. As a growing leader in the critical power industry, we design, manufacture, and support innovative power generation solutions that serve customers across a variety of industries. Our mission is **forging long\-lasting partnerships by providing first\-class customer support.** We accomplish this by investing in our people, delivering quality products, and continuously looking for ways to improve and innovate. As our Generator Manufacturing Division continues to grow, we are seeking a talented **Mechanical Engineer** who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, developing innovative products, and seeing their designs come to life. At Central Power, you won't just sit behind a desk designing products. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with manufacturing teams, influence product development, and play a key role in bringing new ideas from concept to production. We value individuals who are driven to win, smart, humble, relationship\-focused, and committed to doing what is right. **POSITION SUMMARY** Central Power Systems \& Services is seeking a motivated and technically skilled **Mechanical Engineer** to support the design, development, testing, and manufacturing of custom power generation equipment and related mechanical systems. This position will play an important role in developing innovative mechanical designs, improving existing products, and supporting the continued expansion of our Generator Manufacturing Division. The ideal candidate combines strong mechanical engineering fundamentals with hands\-on manufacturing experience and the ability to take projects from initial concept through design, testing, and full\-scale production. This role requires someone who is comfortable working across Engineering, Production, Fabrication, Procurement, and Quality to develop practical, cost\-effective, and manufacturable solutions. **We are looking for an engineer who enjoys the challenge of designing something new, solving real\-world manufacturing problems, and seeing the finished product in action.** **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** **Mechanical Design \& Product Development** * Design, develop, and improve mechanical systems, components, and assemblies used in industrial power generation equipment. * Create detailed engineering drawings, 3D models, specifications, and manufacturing documentation using AutoCAD and other CAD software. * Develop mechanical designs for generator enclosures, structural frames, mounting systems, ventilation systems, and related equipment. * Perform engineering calculations and analysis to validate product performance, structural integrity, and manufacturability. * Utilize Finite Element Analysis (FEA), Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), airflow analysis, and sound attenuation principles to optimize product designs. * Evaluate existing designs and identify opportunities to improve product quality, performance, reliability, and manufacturing efficiency. * Research and evaluate new materials, technologies, and manufacturing processes to support product innovation. * Lead product development initiatives from initial concept and prototyping through testing and full manufacturing implementation. **Manufacturing \& Production Support** * Work directly with Production, Fabrication, Machining, Welding, and Assembly teams to ensure engineering designs can be manufactured efficiently and accurately. * Provide technical support to resolve manufacturing challenges, design concerns, and production\-related issues. * Collaborate with Procurement and Production teams to evaluate materials, components, manufacturing costs, and supplier capabilities. * Develop and improve manufacturing drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and technical documentation. * Identify opportunities to simplify designs, reduce manufacturing costs, improve material utilization, and increase production efficiency. * Support engineering changes and design modifications to meet customer requirements and operational needs. * Participate in prototype builds, product testing, and manufacturing process improvements. **Testing, Compliance \& Quality** * Lead and support product testing and validation activities to ensure designs meet performance, quality, and regulatory requirements. * Coordinate testing programs for applicable UL, IEC, and other industry standards. * Review engineering documentation and product specifications to ensure compliance with applicable codes and regulatory requirements. * Evaluate structural performance, airflow, cooling, vibration, and noise reduction characteristics of mechanical systems. * Investigate product performance issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective design solutions. * Work closely with Quality and Manufacturing teams to maintain high st te across multiple departments. * Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement. * Ability to maintain regular and predictable full\-time attendance. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience designing or manufacturing **industrial generators, power generation equipment, generator enclosures, or other large\-scale industrial equipment**. * Experience with structural analysis and Finite Element Analysis (FEA). * Experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), thermal management, ventilation, and airflow analysis. * Knowledge of acoustic engineering, sound attenuation, and noise reduction design. * Experience with sheet metal fabrication, welding, machining, structural steel, and mechanical assembly. * Experience with hands\-on product testing, validation, and prototype development. * Familiarity with UL, IEC, and other applicable product safety and performance standards. * Understanding of diesel and natural gas generator systems, cooling requirements, and mechanical integration. * Experience with custom\-engineered or engineer\-to\-order manufacturing environments. * Experience with ERP systems and engineering change management processes. * Demonstrated ability to manage engineering projects from concept through production. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** The successful Mechanical Engineer will: * Develop innovative, reliable, and cost\-effective mechanical designs. * Successfully move engineering projects from concept through manufacturing. * Build strong relationships with Production and Engineering teams. * Proactively identify and resolve design and manufacturing challenges. * Improve product performance, manufacturability, and overall quality. * Support the development of new products and the continued growth of our Generator Manufacturing Division. * Take ownership of projects and consistently look for opportunities to improve processes and products. **WORK CONDITIONS / PHYSICAL DEMANDS** This position operates in both an office and active manufacturing environment. * Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, and climb stairs. * May require frequent walking throughout manufacturing facilities to inspect equipment, support production, and participate in testing activities. * May occasionally be required to lift or move materials weighing 50 pounds or more, with appropriate assistance or equipment. * Exposure to varying temperatures, industrial noise, moving equipment, welding fumes, sparks, dust, and other conditions commonly found in manufacturing environments. * May be required to work around energized equipment or participate in controlled product testing under established safety procedures. * Required to follow all company safety policies and wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when entering designated manufacturing areas. These requirements are representative of the position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** Central Power Systems \& Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. **DRUG\-FREE WORKPLACE** Central Power Systems \& Services maintains a smoke\-free and drug\-free workplace. Offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of applicable pre\-employment background checks and drug screening, including THC, in accordance with applicable laws and company policies. **WORK AUTHORIZATION** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Employment eligibility will be verified at the time of hire.
