jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Agentic Automation
jobs.description: **About Cerby** At **Cerby**, security is everyone's business. Cerby extends your security perimeter to include your disconnected applications, providing identity automation and eliminating manual processes. It's one of the biggest blind spots in enterprise security, and we're the team closing it. If you want to work alongside the team solving one of the hardest, most overlooked problems in security, you're in the right place. Founded in 2020, Cerby is backed by leading investors and trusted by enterprises across the globe. **OVERVIEW \& IMPACT** Every application Cerby protects needs Cerby to know how it works — its API, or the clicks behind its login, password rotation, MFA setup, or access change — and that knowledge breaks whenever a vendor redesigns its site or changes its API. We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to own the AI agents that onboard new applications and repair automations when they drift. You will start with two agent systems we have already built and benchmarked: **API catalog generation:** reads a vendor’s public API docs in a headless browser and produces a validated OpenAPI spec, with per\-job cost ceilings and an accuracy benchmark. **Browser workflow generation:** performs a task in a SaaS app’s web UI and writes a replayable automation workflow, handling MFA, one\-time codes, and CAPTCHAs along the way. Your job is to take them to production, make them self\-healing, and set the direction for agentic automation at Cerby. These agents handle real customer credentials and browse untrusted sites, so security is part of the job, not an afterthought. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ### **Ownership and Production** * Own agentic onboarding and self\-healing end to end: architecture, roadmap, and on\-call once live. * Take the existing systems to production on durable workflows (Temporal), with the observability to run them. ### **Self\-Healing Automation** * Detect drift — a changed login page, a moved button, a renamed API field — from failed runs, before customers notice. * Build agents that diagnose the break, repair the workflow or spec, and re\-validate the fix against real runs before it goes back into service. * Decide what heals automatically and what needs human review. ### **Evaluation and Cost** * Own the benchmarks for generated specs, workflows, and repairs, and make “good enough to ship” a measured threshold. * Own cost and latency per output, choosing between frontier and open\-weight models on measured accuracy versus cost. ### **Security** * Own the threat model: prompt injection from page content, credential isolation, token handling, sandboxed browsing, and egress. * Keep credentials out of prompts, logs, queues, and stored run state. ### **Collaboration** * Partner with the integrations, automation\-runtime, and platform teams; write the design docs they build on, and mentor contributors. **QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIRED SKILLS** ===================================== ### **Experience** * You have shipped an LLM agent with tool use that ran unattended for real users, and owned a backend system in production. ### **Technical Skills** * Strong in **Python or TypeScript**, and productive in both. * **LLM agents and tool use**: agent loops, structured outputs, retries, and the failure modes they create. * **Eval discipline**: you have built benchmarks or eval harnesses and used them to make decisions. * Depth in **browser automation** (Playwright or similar) **or** **backend and API\-integration systems**, and comfort in the other. * **Distributed systems**: queues, idempotency, and durable workflow engines (Temporal, Step Functions, or similar). * **Security judgment** for systems that handle secrets, including agent\-specific threats such as prompt injection. ### **Desirable** * Temporal in production; Pydantic AI or a comparable agent framework. * Open\-weight model serving (Fireworks, Together, Bedrock) and LLM cost modeling. * Computer\-use agents or browser extensions (Chrome MV3\); OpenAPI tooling. * Identity, IAM, or credential\-management experience; AWS and Terraform. ### **Soft Skills** * Clear technical writing and trade\-offs other teams can depend on. * You take an early system to production without waiting to be told how, and care that it keeps working after launch. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** =========================== * **6 months:** both systems run in production for real workloads, with improving error rates and cost per output, and drift is detected automatically. * **12 months:** onboarding a new application is predominantly automated, and most drift\-driven breakages heal without a human.

jobs.title: Data & AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: Cerro Wire LLC As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. At **Marmon Electrical**, we power a bright future for millions of people around the world. From homes to industries that shape lives, we deliver solutions that keep people connected and energized—and it all starts with you. We’re doing things that matter. Our electrical engineering solutions impact millions worldwide through safe and dependable energy supply. We deliver electrical solutions from the ocean depths to outer space. As part of Marmon, you’re helping keep millions worldwide healthy, connected and safe. **Cerrowire**®, a **Marmon/Berkshire Hathaway** company, is a leading U.S. copper wire supplier for residential, commercial and industrial applications. In addition to rugged and dependable, guaranteed products, including MC cables and aluminum wires, the **Cerrowire** focus is on customer service and delivering on time and in full from our wire manufacturing plants in Alabama, Georgia, Indiana, and Utah. We create our quality products in our new, state\-of\-the\-art MC cable plant. As part of the Marmon Electrical family of companies, **Cerrowire** benefits from the financial strength, operational discipline, and long\-term ownership philosophy of Berkshire Hathaway while maintaining the focused, entrepreneurial operating culture of a market leader in its category. The **Data \& AI Solutions Developer** builds the governed data products, Power BI solutions and applied AI tools that Cerrowire teams use to make decisions. Working in Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI Foundry, this role turns established business requirements into production solutions and owns technical delivery from design through support. The role’s primary focus is the gold layer: semantic models, standardized metrics and the BI and AI experiences built on them. The Senior Data Engineer owns ingestion through the silver layer; this role owns everything users consume from there. The successful candidate brings solid Fabric, SQL and Python skills, hands\-on generative AI experience, and the judgment to build AI that is secure, measurable and cost\-aware. **Why Join Us?** * Health Benefits effective day one (Life, Health, Dental, Vision) * Holiday pay effective day one * Vacation and Personal Time Off (prorated \& accrued) * Tuition Reimbursement * Employee Discount Program * Six Sigma \& Lean Training * Learning \& Development Training * 401k with company matching **Key Responsibilities:** Data \& Analytics * Build and maintain gold\-layer data products, semantic models and standardized business metrics in Microsoft Fabric, partnering with the Senior Data Engineer on upstream pipelines. * Develop Power BI reports and Copilot\-enabled experiences that let users securely interact with governed datasets. * Implement usage telemetry and adoption dashboards for BI, automation and AI tools, and recommend improvements based on usage patterns. Applied AI \& Automation * Design, build and deploy AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions and agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot and other approved enterprise AI platforms. * Build and maintain embeddings, vector stores and grounding strategies that connect AI solutions to governed data. * Evaluate AI solutions for retrieval quality, groundedness, reliability, latency and usability, and build in monitoring, logging, error handling and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Automate business processes with Power Automate and Power Apps where they are the right fit. Security \& Governance * Apply data classification, PII handling and access controls, including row\-level security and Entra ID, to every BI and AI solution. * Design AI solutions to resist prompt injection and limit agent permissions to the minimum required. * Serve as a technical resource in Data \& AI governance and use\-case reviews. Delivery \& Standards * Own technical delivery once requirements are approved: design, development, testing, deployment, documentation and production support. * Follow SDLC practices, including Git version control, Fabric deployment pipelines, testing, release management and documentation of designs, data definitions, lineage and runbooks. * Build reusable components, templates and prompt patterns that speed future development. * Run proofs of concept and make evidence\-based technology recommendations covering fit, security, scalability and cost, including Fabric capacity and AI consumption. Collaboration \& Enablement * Work with analysts, the Senior Data Engineer, plant and business stakeholders, and vendors on design, implementation and knowledge transfer. * Mentor peers through design and code reviews, and lead demos and office hours that build practical adoption of data and AI. **What Success Looks Like:** First 6 months * A gold\-layer semantic model and Power BI solution in production on Fabric, adopted by its business users. * A first AI solution (RAG or agent) piloted with defined evaluation metrics and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Documented development, testing and deployment standards for the team’s Fabric and AI work. First 12 months * Governed data products in use across Cerrowire’s plant sites. * At least one AI solution in production with monitored quality, cost and adoption. * A library of reusable components and patterns used by the Reporting \& Analytics team. **Requirements:** * **Work Authorization Requirement:** Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. jobs.title: City Engineer
jobs.description: CITY OF SHELBYVILLE **DEFINITION** The City of Shelbyville, Tennessee is seeking a highly motivated professional for the position of City Engineer. This position must demonstrate an exemplary customer service approach to internal and external stakeholders and have a strong commitment to public service. This is a skilled, full\-time position under the general supervision of the City Manager or designee. This employee participates in the review of land development (residential, and non\-residential) projects, infrastructure projects, and provides general engineering support to the Planning and Community Development Department, Public Works, Building and Codes, and other departments. Duties and responsibilities include providing technical expertise in areas of construction problems, floodplain and drainage issues, Traffic Impact Studies; overseeing new development work; performing site inspections and estimating project costs; project management; and providing information to the public. **WAGE \& BENEFITS** Salary Range: Starting $88,000\.00 per year This is a full\-time, exempt position with the City of Shelbyville. The role offers a competitive salary, along with comprehensive benefits including: · 100% City paid individual medical, dental \& vision insurance · Long\-term disability insurance (City paid) · Life insurance coverage (City paid) · Paid leave: vacation, personal, sick, bereavement \& 13 paid holidays · City contributions to a 401(k) **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** *The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, repeated or a logical assignment to this classification. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current position, the city reserves the right to revise the job. Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary.* * Performs site inspections of infrastructure systems for compliance with municipal regulations. * Coordinates new development construction with existing developments. * Coordinates construction activities with departmental maintenance activities and with other governmental agencies. * Provides project management services for Capital Improvement Projects, and coordinates with other departments and agencies as necessary. * Receives various documentation (project plans/documents/studies, site plans/plats, drainage calculations, water/sewer capacity calculations, architectural drawings, grading permits, excavation permits, Traffic Studies, etc.). for review, comments and approval. * Responds to citizen/customer complaints and requests, to include providing information, researching problems, implementing solutions, etc. * Responds to routine requests for information from officials, employees, members of the staff, the public or other individuals. * Communicates via telephone, email, and text messaging, to respond and provide needed information, and updates to City staff, Department Directors, developers, residents, landowners, business owners, and other agencies as necessary. * Prepares and/or generates routine correspondence, letters, memoranda, forms, reports and other documents via computer or tablet. * Copies and distributes correspondence, letters, memoranda and other related materials. * Uses knowledge of various software programs to operate a computer in an effective and efficient manner. * Attends and provides as directed commentary at Mayor and City Council, Planning Commission (P/C), Pre\-Planning Committee meetings, and as necessary Board of Zoning Appeals (BZA) meetings. * Provides support and guidance for the formation, planning, permitting, design, construction, and inspection of city infrastructure projects. * Prepares, reviews, and presents reports, various management and information updates, and reports on special projects as directed to the Mayor \& City Council, as well as various boards and committees. * Makes recommendations regarding expenditures, revenues, and purchases; researches and reviews outside funding opportunities to support the budget and provide additional resources for the City projects. * Prepares Request for Proposals (RFPs) for technical and professional services. * Will consult and collaborate with various personnel on proposed developments within the City. * May review plans and offer Engineering solutions to complex technical issues. * Establish and maintain effective work relationships with those contacted in the performance of required duties. * Performs other duties as assigned. *Must possess practical and verifiable knowledge of Civil Engineering principles, practices, and construction management. Will interface with Federal, State, and local agencies as well as contractors and other surrounding municipalities.* **REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES** * Ability to interpret and apply federal, state, and local policies, procedures, laws and regulations. * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects; ability to work independently and collaborative in nature. * Ability to independently operate standard office equipment, computers, etc. * Ability to take oral and written instructions. * Ability to respond to inquiries from the public and members of the business community both effectively and professionally, while providing excellence in customer service. * Working knowledge of modern office practices and procedures. * Ability to read and interpret simple plans and maps, including tax maps, traffic studies, etc. * Knowledge of and experience in municipal procedures relating to finance, personnel, purchasing, office operations, risk management and public relations. * Knowledge and experience in long term planning. * Knowledge of construction techniques involving streets, sewers, etc. * Knowledge and experience in executing operations management principles. * Knowledge of the policies, procedures, and activities of relevant City and Public Works Department practices. * Knowledge of Development Services Department and design/construction practices as necessary in the completion of daily responsibilities. * Ability to effectively communicate and interact with supervisors, members of the public and all other groups involved in the activities of the department. * Knowledge of Civil engineering principles and practices as applied to municipal public works, including planning and development, design and construction, and operation and maintenance. * Knowledge of the methods of preparing designs, plans, specifications, estimates, reports, and recommendations relating to a variety of public works projects. Knowledge of the principles and practices of management and supervision. * Knowledge of GIS software. **WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL DEMANDS** While performing this job, the employee is occasionally required to sit and frequently talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to walk, stand, with occasional climbing, balancing, stooping. The employee must also frequently use hands to operate, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. Work is mostly performed indoors in a comfortable, climate\- controlled office environment. However, this employee will also frequently work in the field, which may include inclement weather conditions. The noise level is moderate to high with a fast\-paced schedule that requires interaction with the general public, elected officials, and other department heads. **MINIMUM QUALFICATIONS** · Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or related field required, with two to four years of experience in the practice of municipal civil engineering, general construction, water and sewer system construction, stormwater drainage, roadway construction, estimating, and development plans review; or any equivalent combination of education, training, and experience which provides the requisite knowledge, skills, and abilities for this job. · Valid Tennessee licensure as a Professional Engineer required. · Must possess a valid driver’s license through the State of Tennessee. · Successful completion of pre\-employment physical, drug test, and background check. Pay: From $88,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Front-end Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Millions of people interact with the City of Boston digitally each year to do everything from finding information on City services to paying a parking ticket. On the Digital Services team, we believe these experiences should be easy to navigate, dignified, and even delightful. The Digital Services team within DoIT is focused on partnering with City departments to improve service delivery across the City. We’re a cross\-functional team with a mission to improve the user experience of existing digital services, better engage and communicate with our residents, and build new systems to improve how the City delivers services online. The Department of Innovation and Technology (DoIT) provides and maintains mission\-critical technologies for the City’s more than 18,000 employees and the hundreds of thousands of constituents they serve. As a front\-end engineer, you will work on small teams to build scalable infrastructure for the City – designing, implementing, and delivering services that City residents depend on. You care deeply about working on technology that improves people’s lives, but don’t think technology is always the answer. You are passionate about building large\-scale systems that are inclusive, well\-designed, fast, scalable, and secure, and you’ll help set high standards for our teams in terms of simplicity, empathy, and accessibility. The full\-stack engineer in this role will be responsible for developing end\-to\-end systems, modernizing existing legacy enterprise platforms to improve the City department’s public\-facing processes and experiences which will enable users to have more access to the programs and services they need, in real\-time, in a more user\-friendly and uncomplicated way. This individual will be involved in everything, from strategy and planning through post\-production testing and support. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Works with fellow engineers to design, review, and build well\-crafted software. * Collaborates with stakeholders (technical and non\-technical) to understand their needs, clarify possible options, make technical recommendations, and architect, implement, and deploy new systems and improvements to existing systems. * Works in an agile manner to efficiently ship new features that meet user needs. * Creates tools and processes to automate our development, testing, and production workflows. * Acts as a technical leader in the development of high\-quality, well\-tested, documented, CI/CD\-enabled, and high\-performance software solutions. * Writes and reviews technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, and performs code reviews. * Works closely with product designers, product managers, and engineers to implement solutions for end\-user and business needs. * Supports production systems and investigates issues when they occur. * Upholds and continuously improves the team’s coding standards and development workflows. * Pursues personal growth by maintaining an awareness of the state of technology, engineering techniques, and best practices. * Contributes to and advances “best practices” within the team and our organization. * Supports project planning, including requirements gathering, design, scoping, and estimates for upcoming work. * Manages your own time and works well both independently and as part of a team. * Provides exemplary peer reviews, enabling continuous learning and improvement opportunities for other team members. * Participates in daily standups and other agile (Scrum or Kanban) routines. * Performs related work as required. **Minimum Entrance Qualifications** ----------------------------------- * At least five (5\) years of experience working in an agile, multidisciplinary team environment, preferably designing and building medium\- to large\-scale web applications on Cloud Platforms. * At least five (5\) years of hands\-on professional work experience building web applications and systems using modern JavaScript with React. * Current and/or prior experience developing API endpoints. * Experience with AWS and SQL databases. * Experience mapping and driving systemic improvements within complex service environments. * Understanding of OWASP and other secure development methodologies. * Experience in languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Node. * Experience with tools such as Fleet, SASS, Docker, Behat, GitHub, TravisCI, Acquia Hosting, and AWS Lambda. * Experience with Drupal 9 is a plus. * Understanding of web and mobile user interface design best practices. * Demonstrated ability to design, build, and test semantic, accessible web applications. * Tenacity to dive into problems and iterate in working code. * Equal parts systems thinker and advocate for users. * Highly resourceful, reliable, and detail\-oriented. * Ability to exercise good judgment and focus on detail as required by the job. **BOSTON RESIDENCY REQUIRED** **Terms:** Union/Salary Plan/Grade: SENA/MM1\-10 Hours per week: 35 The City of Boston is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Engineer I
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- Under general supervision, is responsible for performing professional engineering work consisting of design and construction engineering management of principal public works projects. Working conditions are split between on\-site construction visits and an office environment. Exercises direct supervision over assigned staff. This position is an "unclassified" position and has no disciplinary appeal rights to the Municipal Civil Service Commission. This position is likewise subject to at\-will employment status and can be terminated at any time for any reason. **Work Location** City Tower \- 100 W Houston St, San Antonio, TX 78205 **Work Hours** 7:45 a.m. \- 4:30 p.m., Monday \- Friday **Essential Job Functions** --------------------------- * Works with professional, technical, and other employees in the development, design, construction and maintenance of principal public works projects. * Reviews design plans, project specifications, and cost estimates; attends review meetings; and identifies and solves design problems. * Approves plans and specifications for construction contracts. * Advises other City departments on matters related to technical engineering issues. * Requests and evaluates consultant fee proposals; monitors and approves compensation for professional engineering services. * Upgrades new installations involving traffic signs, pavement markings, traffic signals, and traffic counting. * Reviews bid packages prepared by consultants. * Attends pre\-bid conferences; analyzes bid results; makes recommendations on accepting/rejecting bids. * Assists with budget preparation. * Performs related duties and fulfills responsibilities as required. **Job Requirements** -------------------- * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from an accredited college, university, or engineering school approved by a State Board of Registration for Professional Engineers. * Four (4\) years' experience in engineering. * No substitution for education allowed. * Licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) in the State of Texas OR Licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) from another state with the ability to obtain a P.E. license in the State of Texas within 6 months of employment. Valid Class "C" Texas driver's License. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Proficiency in Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) software. * Knowledge of the City's Five\-Year Rolling Infrastructure Management Program (IMP) and Street Maintenance Program. * Strong knowledge of street and drainage engineering design, construction, and maintenance practices. * Knowledge of construction project engineering principles, practices, methods, and procedures. * Knowledge of construction materials, specifications, and installation methods. * Knowledge of concrete construction techniques, including sidewalks, drainage structures, and related roadway infrastructure. * Experience with construction management, project coordination, and contract administration. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage stakeholders, customers, residents, contractors, and project teams. * Experience in public relations, public outreach, and community engagement. **Applicant Information** * Unless otherwise stated, applicants are permitted to substitute two years of related full\-time experience for one year of higher education or one year of related higher education for two years of experience in order to meet the minimum requirements of the job. One year of full\-time experience is defined as 30 or more hours worked per week for 12 months. One year of higher education is defined as 30 credit hours completed at an accredited college or university. * Applicants selected for employment with the City of San Antonio in this position must receive satisfactory results from pre\-employment drug testing and background checks. If required for the position, a physical, motor vehicle record evaluation, and additional background checks may be conducted. * Please be advised that if selected for this position, information regarding employment history as it relates to the qualifications of the position will be needed for employment verification. Applicants claiming military service to meet the experience requirement for this position may attach a DD214 to the application. * If selected for this position, official transcripts, diplomas, certifications, and licenses must be submitted at the time of processing. Unofficial transcripts and copies of other relevant documents may be attached to the application for consideration in advance. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ------------------------------------ * Knowledge of civil engineering principles. * Knowledge of the laws and regulations related to engineering projects. * Knowledge of engineering related computer programs. * Knowledge of engineering mathematics. * Knowledge of budget preparation. * Ability to operate a computer keyboard and other basic office equipment. * Skill in utilizing a personal computer and associated software programs. * Ability to supervise, train, and evaluate assigned staff. * Ability to plan and program engineering work. * Ability to conduct engineering research and apply results to engineering problems. * Ability to communicate clearly and effectively. * Ability to establish and maintain good public relations. * Ability to prepare detailed technical reports. * Ability to interpret legal documents related to engineering.

jobs.description: **Job Title: Active Directory Engineer** **Location: Charlotte or Raleigh, NC (Weekly one day onsite)** **Duration: 12\+ months Contract** **Job Description:** **Active Directory Upgrades:** Execute and support enterprise\-scale Active Directory upgrades, coordinating production deployments, application testing, and phased implementation activities. **Authentication Protocol Management:** Diagnose and remediate authentication issues related to Kerberos and NTLM, including reducing reliance on legacy or less secure protocols in alignment with Microsoft security guidance. **LDAP Security:** Support initiatives to eliminate unsigned LDAP binds and enforce LDAP signing across enterprise systems and applications. **Active Directory Security Remediation:** Identify and remediation plans. **Technical Collaboration:** Partner with infrastructure, security, and application teams to coordinate remediation activities and minimize operational disruption. **Continuous Demonstrated experience engineering, upgrading, and supporting Active Directory environments in large enterprise organizations. * Strong, in\-depth knowledge of Kerberos authentication, including and supporting the retirement of weaker NTLM versions. * Working to advanced knowledge of LDAP and LDAP signing, including identifying unsigned bind dependencies and implementing secure configurations. * Proven experience identifying and remediating Active Directory security vulnerabilities and configuration issues. * Strong DNS knowledge, including troubleshooting DNS issues and stakeholders. * Ability to work independently, prioritize remediation activities, and deliver technical changes in a structured enterprise environment. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, (PKI), Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS), and Windows Server administration. * Experience implementing or deploying Active Directory domain controllers. * Exposure to enterprise security assessments, vulnerability remediation, and identity infrastructure hardening. **Professional Competencies:** * **Self\-directed execution:** Independently assesses technical issues, identifies collaboration, and the exchange of technical expertise. * **Growth mindset:** Demonstrates the ability and willingness to expand technical capabilities and assume increasing responsibility for Active Directory operations over time. **Role Expectations:** The successful candidate will be a hands\-on engineer who can contribute quickly to enterprise Active Directory upgrade and security remediation initiatives. The role is best suited to an engineer who can deliver independently within an established technical environment while building the expertise needed to support broader Active Directory service ownership. jobs.description: **Role Overview** Sr. HPC Deployment and Cable Validation Engineer to provide deployment services for high\-performance computing (HPC) and AI cluster infrastructure in support of a WWT customer. This role emphasizes physical build quality, cable validation, rack integration, and cluster readiness. It is suited to a senior, hands\-on operator who can turn physical deployment work into repeatable, auditable infrastructure quality. **Key Responsibilities** * Execute and coordinate rack\-level deployment of compute, network, and storage infrastructure for AI and HPC environments. * Validate rack elevations, port maps, cable maps, power distribution, labeling, and physical connectivity before cluster handoff. * Perform detailed cable validation across Ethernet, InfiniBand, management, and storage interconnects. * Detect and resolve cabling defects including polarity issues, incorrect port destinations, unsupported optics pairings, breakout errors, damaged media, and inconsistent labeling. * Support hardware bring\-up by validating BIOS baselines, BMC reachability, inventory accuracy, and initial connectivity tests. * Partner with network and Linux teams during cluster turn\-up to quickly isolate physical\-layer versus logical\-layer failures. * Create deployment checklists, as\-built documentation, and signoff criteria for production acceptance. * Drive structured remediation during expansion, re\-cabling, or failed build events. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years in data center deployment, HPC infrastructure installation, or large\-scale hardware integration. * Strong practical knowledge of structured cabling, optics, transceivers, breakout schemes, and rack\-level physical validation. * Experience reading and validating rack diagrams, patch plans, cable matrices, and topology documentation. * Strong troubleshooting skill for Layer 1 issues that manifest as network instability, missing hosts, degraded performance, or failed cluster readiness checks. * Experience with asset tracking, labeling discipline, and deployment quality control. * Ability to work across physical infrastructure, server hardware, and network operations teams without losing detail. Pay: $90\.00 \- $95\.00 per hour Experience: * HPC: 6 years (Required) * data center: 8 years (Required) Willingness to travel: * 25% (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer - Cincinnati
jobs.description: ### **About CoLab** At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life\-changing products to market years sooner. We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster. Proudly based in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018\. Since then we've raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi\-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250\+. ### **About the Role** This is a high\-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers in Aerospace and Defence. CoLab is a category\-creating product, which means adoption isn't just a rollout. It's a change in how the organization works. In this role, you'd act as a trusted advisor, leveraging people, process, and technology to help teams rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision\-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale. You'll work alongside a Customer Success Manager, and use what you learn on the front line to help shape product direction. This role isn't about selling or pitching. It's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer. We are looking for a candidate in Cincinatti to work regularly on\-site with a local CoLab customer. **Our Ideal Candidate** ----------------------- You're a mechanical engineer by trade and have worked as a designer in an A\&D company. You also understand the full product development life cycle: how design, manufacturing, quality, and engineering leadership depend on each other, and where collaboration breaks down. You can coach those teams toward working together better. You know how to improve that life cycle with technology. Maybe you've championed internal tools or created automation or scripts. You also know a process that makes sense on paper won't get adopted on its own. You can meet people where they are, including the stakeholders who don't want to change. You don't need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you can run a sprint and lead a cross\-functional project. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you. **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Mapping a customer's current\-state design review and engineering workflows, and defining the target\-state process their teams will actually adopt. * Deploying and tuning CoLab's AI capabilities against a customer's own standards, drawing checklists, and design guidelines, and diagnosing what's working and what isn't. * Providing mechanical engineering expertise to validate AI\-generated results and ensure engineering rigor. * Investigating and solving complex engineering data and integration challenges across PLM, ERP, QMS, and traditional design feedback tools. * Expanding adoption into new teams, programs, and sites within the account, partnering with the Customer Success Manager on where the next opportunity sits. * Collaborating with product teams to identify feature gaps, improve capabilities, and refine AutoReview. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Must\-haves:** * Background in mechanical design engineering, ideally in a medium\- to large\-sized organization. * Strong understanding of PLM \& ERP systems and enterprise engineering data architecture. * Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and cross\-functional collaborations. * Experience working directly with customers or internal stakeholders to solve technical problems. * Comfort working in fast\-changing, ambiguous environments. * Strong written communication and documentation skills. * Working knowledge of high\-level AI architecture, specifically LLMs. * Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, and enterprise architecture concepts. **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation. * Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows. * Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale. **Travel Expectations** ----------------------- While this is a fully remote role, travel is a consistent part of the job. There are two primary types of travel you can expect: * **Team Weeks:** Once per quarter, the sales team or entire company gets together in person. These typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning on a Thursday or Friday. Two of these each year are held at our headquarters in St. John's, Newfoundland, and the others take place in more central locations that evolve as the team grows. * **On\-sites:** This role will work closely with a local customer with expectations to be on site with that customer, so there will likely be far less travel than our typical MFDE roll. That being said, in the event the local customer were to no longer work with us, the following is our standard MFDE travel expectations: "For most of our large deployment customers, we will visit on\-site during kick\-off and key expansion opportunities. Most on\-sites involve 2\-3 days with the customer, with travel on either side. Travel is primarily within North America, and you can expect 4 customer on\-sites per quarter." **Extra Details** ----------------- * This is a full\-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options. * Unlimited paid vacation, extended health benefits, and 401k matching. **Equity Note** --------------- Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Your potential is what matters most to us.

Just as importantly, you need the judgment and coaching ability to help an early\-career fellow navigate the people, communication, and organizational challenges that determine whether their work succeeds. This role is built for someone who gets energy from helping other people succeed. You may come from engineering, consulting, implementation, technical program management, AI enablement, education, or another client\-facing technical environment. author lane\- or pod\-specific content when they commission it because you have seen the gap from closer in * Coac u consistently identify recurring technical, professional, and organizational patterns across your pods and surface them to the right program owner * Every Day 30 review is done and documented, handed up to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, with a plan for any fellow whose work is at risk or ready for the next challenge **Qualifications** **Required** * 2–5 years of previous professional experience in software engineering, IT, data, technical program management, implementation, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, technical consulting, AI operations, or another technically adjacent role * Hands\-on, current experience using modern AI tools and workflows. jobs.description: The Colorado School Districts Self Insurance Pool (CSDSIP) seeks an experienced and resourceful Business Systems \& Data Engineer to become the second member of our Business \& Data Intelligence team, complementing the skills or our existing Business Data Analyst. The Business Systems \& Data Engineer is primarily responsible for developing and maintaining CSDSIP's data infrastructure, system integrations, automation, and technical data architecture. This position partners closely with the Business Data Analyst and departments across CSDSIP to connect systems, improve data quality and accessibility, automate business processes, and support the organization's current and future technology initiatives, including Risk Management Information System (RMIS) implementation. Our current systems are antiquated, isolated, and lacking integration. We will implement a new RMIS in the next couple of years but don’t want to wait to see improvements until then. We want to better connect and leverage our existing data, improve our current posture, and position ourselves to get the most possible out of a new system when it arrives. We need someone who can help with band\-aids today, stitches tomorrow, and surgery next year, all while laying the foundation for an entirely new and much better integrated system that supports the full spectrum of our business needs. **Role and Responsibilities:** *Data Engineering \& Architecture* * Design, develop, and maintain CSDSIP's centralized data environment in the form of a data warehouse or appropriate equivalent * Develop ETL/ELT processes to collect, transform, validate, and integrate data from internal and external systems * Document data sources, transformations, integrations, and dependencies * Establish data models, data structures, and data governance standards * Identify and assist with data cleanup opportunities and design sustainable/scalable processes which ensure data quality *System Integration* * Design, develop, and maintain integrations between CSDSIP's RMIS and other business systems * Design, develop, and maintain API, database, file\-based, and other system integrations * Establish schedule and automated processes for transferring and synchronizing data across systems * Monitor integrations and troubleshoot data\-transfer and system issues *RMIS \& Systems Implementation* * Serve as technical lead for data migration, integration, and technical implementation of the new RMIS and other major system projects * Develop data mapping and transformations of historical data * Support system testing, data validation, conversion, data reconciliation and implementation * Work with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues * Own post\-go\-live system integrations *Process Automations and Reporting Infrastructure* * Assist in automating internal processes to reduce manual data entry and repetitive administrative work * Proactively identify opportunities to improve, enhance and strengthen reporting infrastructure for stakeholder consideration * Assist in building and maintaining technical solutions supporting internal business processes * Develop and maintain data models and reporting datasets * Translate business requirements into functional programming routines and/or processes to meet project objectives * Set up data connections and automated refresh schedules * Provide reliable, centralized data for use in analysis *Data Governance* * Establish and maintain technical data documentation and data practices, data dictionaries, and master data management processes **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, business partners and outside departments using a customer\-focused mindset. * Experience developing and maintaining data integrations, data pipelines, and automated data transfer processes using APIs, SQL, scripting, or other integration tools * Experience with data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL/ELT), data mapping, and data validation across multiple systems * Experience jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **SALARY RANGE (Grade 15\) CSA216: $89,993\.11/yr. \- $134,991\.01/yr.****(Commensurate with experience)** **GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES:** The Senior AI Engineer designs the architecture for, builds, and deploys AI\-enabled applications in OSA's Microsoft GCC environment. Working with the Innovation Assistant Director and Cloud Engineering, the role shapes OSA's AI reference architecture and turns it into production Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, agent workflows, the data pipelines that feed them, and cost\- and performance\-aware model deployments. The role builds applications on existing foundation models accessed through approved platforms such as Azure AI Foundry; it does not train or develop LLMs. The primary focus is the Audit division, delivering AI services that measurably improve audit planning, research, and analysis across OSA's statewide audit portfolio. The role also builds AI\-enabled programs for OSA's administrative and operational units, including Human Resources, Administration \& Finance (A\&F), Occupational Schools, the Division of Local Mandates (DLM), and the Bureau of Special Investigations (BSI). OSA does not expect candidates to know every tool named in this description. Solid architecture and engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience delivering LLM applications matter most. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED:** Reports to the Innovation Assistant Director and works within OSA's IT Innovation group. Collaborates closely with the Manager, System and Process Improvements, Cloud Engineering (e.g., platform security, IaC, APIM/Entra), Enterprise IT, the Data Analytics Unit, data engineering staff, contractors, and business stakeholders across Audit and OSA's operational units. The Manager, System and Process Improvements maintains the backlog of Audit process\-improvement opportunities, designs and measures pilots of AI\-assisted audit process steps and recommends adoption; Audit and agency leadership decide whether to adopt changes to audit processes. The Innovation Assistant Director runs intake for OSA's other units, sets IT Innovation work priorities in line with the IT Governance Council, manages staff and contractors, and decides technology and build\-versus\-buy choices. This role owns the technical design and engineering of the solutions and does not supervise staff. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **AI Solution Architecture** ---------------------------- * Design solution architectures for AI applications — components, integrations, data flows, security boundaries, and deployment topology — and document them in diagrams and architecture decision records. * Lead the definition and maintenance of OSA's AI reference architecture, including standard patterns for RAG, agents, API exposure, logging, and evaluation, with review and approval by the Innovation Assistant Director. * Work with Cloud Engineering to extend Azure Landing Zone patterns (CAF/WAF) for AI workloads: subscriptions, Azure Policy, VNets/NSGs, private endpoints, Key Vault, and managed identities. * Define microservice and API boundaries (REST, APIM) so AI capabilities are reused across audit and operational applications rather than rebuilt for each one. * Lead technical design reviews, and provide technical assessments of new Azure AI services, vendor tools, and build\-versus\-buy options to inform technology decisions by the Innovation Assistant Director. * Design for cost from the start: model and hosting choices, budgets, and tagging so AI consumption is visible and attributable by project. **Software Development** ------------------------ * Write, test, and maintain production Python and TypeScript/JavaScript code for AI\-enabled applications, services, and user interfaces. * Build REST APIs and backend services that connect LLMs to OSA documents, data sources, and business systems. * Write automated unit, integration, and evaluation tests; set code review and Git/GitHub branching standards for AI projects. * Build the automated tests, evaluation harnesses, and quality metrics used in OSA's software quality assurance process for AI applications (distinct from the audit Quality Assurance function), which data engineering staff and testers use to carry out testing. * Use AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot responsibly, reviewing generated code for correctness and security. * Troubleshoot and improve the AI components of applications running in production. **AI Application Engineering** ------------------------------ * Own retrieval design for RAG applications — hierarchical/semantic chunking, embedding choices, hybrid (keyword \+ vector) search, cross\-encoder reranking, and citation fidelity checks — working with data engineering staff who build ingestion, schema, and embedding pipelines. * Engineer agent and tool\-calling workflows with Microsoft Agent Framework; lead migration of existing Prompt Flow orchestration and evaluation into supported pathways. * Define and instrume sful candidate will possess and/or demonstrate:* * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building production applications that use LLMs (e.g., RAG, agents, or tool\-calling features). * Demonstrated design ownership of the architecture for at least one production system, including documentation of design decisions. * Strong Python; working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL. * Hands\-on building RAG systems with hybrid search and reranking; experience with embeddings and vector stores (e.g., Azure AI Search, pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate). * Experience designing and deploying applications on Azure (or AWS/GCP with a willingness to work in Azure), including identity, private networking, and secrets management. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience designing REST APIs and service boundaries, and writing automated tests. * Experience handling sensitive data (PII/PHI) under least\-privilege access and encryption controls. * Clear written communication, including architecture documentation, and the ability to explain technical trade\-offs. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Azure Government/Microsoft GCC experience, including Azure Landing Zones and Cloud Adoption Framework implementation. * Microsoft Azure certifications at the associate or expert level (e.g., AI engineering or solutions architecture). * Microsoft Agent Framework and Prompt Flow migration; LangChain/LangGraph; structured outputs and function/tool calling across providers. * Deeper Kubernetes experience on AKS: Helm charts, ingress, autoscaling, and workload identity. * Knowledge graphs, taxonomies, or ontologies (e.g., RDF, SPARQL); familiarity with Synaptica Graphite. * Data engineering with Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake) or Microsoft Fabric; data governance frameworks (e.g., DMBOK), metadata and lineage management, and MDM. * RBAC/ABAC design, Purview classification, DLP labels, Defender for Cloud, and policy\-as\-code. * Understanding of LLM serving trade\-offs: quantization (FP8/INT4\), KV\-cache strategies, MoE models and expert parallelism, and open\-weight serving stacks (vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, SGLang). * Experience in government, healthcare, or financial services, including shared platform or data standards across multiple agencies or business units. * Experience integrating TeamMate\+ and external sources into AI\-driven research workflows. * Experience mentoring developers or serving as technical lead on a project. * Exposure to AWS or GCP data and AI services (e.g., Vertex AI). Salary is commensurate with experience. The Office of the State Auditor is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment actions such as recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting individuals are based upon a policy of non\-discrimination. jobs.description: We are hiring an **Engineering Manager** in our **New York** office to lead the **Agent Builder** team behind **Alwin**, our Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance. **About the role:** ------------------- Agent Builder is where firms turn their methodology and knowledge into agents, and manage those agents for their whole life: from definition to retirement. A generic agent knows nothing about how a firm audits. The firm's methodology, guidance, templates and past work are what make an Alwin agent behave like one of their own people, and that **knowledge and context layer** is our key differentiator. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, *this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.* **The Scope** ------------- Your team owns the full agent lifecycle, with knowledge at its core. * **Knowledge \& context**: the firm's methodology, guidance, templates, prior\-year workpapers and engagement context, curated, permissioned and served to agents at the moment they need it. * **Define**: the authoring experience and definition model that turn a procedure into a multi\-step agent: steps, tools, knowledge sources, thresholds and human\-in\-the\-loop gates. * **Test \& publish**: evaluating an agent against real cases before it ships, with review and approval before it reaches the Agent Library. * **Run \& observe**: launching agents on engagements, and tracing what they did, which knowledge they used and why. * **Govern, version \& sunset**: permissions, change history and approvals; rolling out new versions without breaking in\-flight work; deprecating and retiring agents and outdated knowledge cleanly. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * **Lead through outcomes, not tasks.** Set clear goals and trust the team to find the how. * **Build the team.** Hire, grow and retain senior engineers in New York, and make the team measurably better every quarter. * **Own the technical direction** of Agent Builder end\-to\-end, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard calls credibly. * **Make knowledge the differentiator.** Build the context layer that grounds agents in a firm's own methodology: how knowledge is captured, kept current, permissioned and retrieved, and how we prove it improved the result. * **Get the abstraction right.** Decide how much power builders get and where the guardrails sit, so agents are flexible enough to encode real methodology and consistent enough to trust. * **Treat lifecycle as product.** Versioning, approvals, rollout and sunsetting are what make firms trust agents at scale. Design them in from day one. * **Ship agents firms can rely on.** Make evaluation, observability and auditability part of the product, not an afterthought. * **Work across Alwin.** Partner with Agent Runtime, Evals, Document Intelligence, Product, Design and audit methodology experts, many of them in Amsterdam, to deliver one coherent platform. * **Set the bar for AI\-assisted engineering.** Not just shipping faster, but taking on harder problems, and shaping how DataSnipper engineering uses AI. * Working closely with **Forward Deployed Engineers, Solution Architects and GTM teams**, turning what they learn on enterprise rollouts into platform capabilities rather than one\-offs **What You Bring** ------------------ * **3\+ years leading engineering teams**, on top of **5\+ years** as a a lifecycle**: versioning, permissions, release and deprecation for things customers build on * Strong fundamentals in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs and cloud\-native development * Strong product aptitude: you challenge framing, make roadmap trade\-offs, and care about whether customers succeed with what you ship * Hands\-on fluency with **AI coding tools and agentic harnesses**, and a team that is measurably better for using them * Comfortable leading across time zones and offices, with clear written communication **Nice to Have** ---------------- * **Knowledge We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** Release Engineering builds cost\-efficient AI platforms for product teams and internal developers. We operate traditional ML and generative AI models at scale on GCP/GKE, automate model delivery, and manage usage across self\-hosted and external providers. We partner with ML Engineering on model quality and training, and AI Engineering on application behavior. You will troubleshoot serving and pipeline issues with teammates; maintain tests and runbooks. * **What makes you successful:** * You have python, Git, and automated testing skills demonstrated through projects, internships, or professional work. * You have foundational knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, and GCP. * You have understanding of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and model\-delivery workflows; exposure to Terraform, Pulumi, or equivalent tools is helpful. * You have interest in AI usage accounting, cloud cost efficiency, and multi\-provider APIs; LiteLLM or model\-serving exposure is helpful. You have systematic troubleshooting, clear communication, and a willingness to learn. * **What you’ll get:** · A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. jobs.title: Senior AI Mobile Engineer- Tulip Platform
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun\-loving, mind\-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time. **Position Overview:** Dutch Bros is investing in enterprise AI capabilities to accelerate delivery, enable self\-service technology, and help teams solve meaningful business problems faster. Tulip is a strategic AI platform that provides reusable patterns, tools, and services to make AI\-enabled solution delivery easier, safer, and more scalable across the organization. Increasingly, Tulip reaches the business through mobile experiences used by shop crews, field leaders, and operators who are rarely at a desk. The Senior AI Mobile Engineer \- Tulip Platform is a hands\-on role responsible for designing, building, and shipping the mobile and field\-facing experiences that sit on top of Tulip. The focus is user experience and workflow automation: turning manual, paper\-based, and desktop\-bound processes into fast, intuitive mobile workflows, and integrating Tulip's AI services into the apps and devices field teams use every day. The role also contributes to platform architecture, integration patterns, and engineering standards, and mentors peers through design discussion and code review. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic builder and strong technical partner who obsesses over the end\-user experience, designs for real shop and field conditions including intermittent connectivity and one\-handed use, navigates ambiguity, and consistently delivers high\-quality, AI\-enabled mobile solutions aligned to business priorities. **Job Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands\-on experience building and shipping production mobile applications (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform such as React Native or Flutter). * Demonstrated focus on user experience: partnering with design, prototyping and testing with real users, and shipping interfaces that are fast, accessible, and intuitive for non\-technical frontline staff. * Experience automating manual and paper\-based workflows into mobile\-first digital processes, including offline\-first data capture, sync and conflict resolution, push notifications, camera and barcode scanning, and location\-aware features. * Experience integrating AI\-enabled services into end\-user applications, including large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent or workflow orchestration, conversational and voice interfaces, and responsible AI guardrails at the point of use. * Strong API and integration skills: consuming and shaping REST, GraphQL, and event\-driven services, and working with backend and platform engineers to make mobile clients performant and resilient. * Experience with mobile release and quality practices: app store and enterprise distribution, MDM\-managed devices, CI/CD for mobile builds, crash and performance monitoring, automated UI testing, and phased rollouts. * Working proficiency in Python or a comparable backend language, with enough platform and cloud fluency (Azure, AWS, or GCP; containers; CI/CD; observability) to extend Tulip services where the mobile experience requires it. * Experience securing mobile and enterprise integrations, including OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect, SSO on shared and personal devices, on\-device data protection, and secrets management. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with field and operations teams to observe how work actually gets done and translate that into technical designs and executable engineering work. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience. * **Location Requirement:** This role is located in Tempe, Arizona. This position is required to be in office 4 days per week (Mon\-Thurs); Fridays are optional remote work days. **Key Result Areas (KRAs):** * **Mobile Experience and Product Delivery:** Design, build, and ship mobile experiences on Tulip that field and shop teams find fast, intuitive, and worth using every shift. * **Workflow Automation in the Field:** Replace manual, paper\-based, and desktop\-bound steps with automated mobile workflows, using AI capabilities such as orchestration, RAG, agents, and conversational interfaces where they add real value. * **Integration and Platform Contribution:** Integrate mobile experiences with Tulip services and enterprise systems, and extend platform capabilities where the experience requires it. * **Engineering Excellence:** Apply and improve practices for secure, maintainable, testable, and observable mobile and service engineering, including release management and phased rollouts. * **Engineering Practices and Knowledge Sharing:** Contribute to documentation, design reviews, and shared UI and integration patterns that strengthen how the team builds mobile AI solutions. * **Business Alignment and Value Realization:** Spend time in shops and with field leaders, translate what you observe into product decisions, and tie delivered experiences to measurable business value. **Skills:** * Mobile application engineering (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform) and hands\-on delivery * User experience design partnership, prototyping, usability testing, and accessibility * Workflow automation and digitization of manual, paper\-based, and field processes * Offline\-first design, device capabilities, push notifications, and mobile performance tuning * API, integration, and eventing patterns across enterprise and AI services * LLM, RAG, agentic workflows, and AI evaluation applied to end\-user experiences * Python, SQL, cloud\-native engineering, and secure service design * Mobile CI/CD, release management, crash and performance monitoring, and automated testing * Field discovery, stakeholder communication, and translating operational needs into product Peer mentorship, engineering standards, design reviews, and code quality * **Physical Requirements:** * **In\-Office Environment:** Must be able to work in a busy, crowded, and loud office with frequent distractions and interruptions * Must be able to collaborate in\-person with occasional impromptu in\-person meetings * **Office Conditions:** Adaptability to typical office conditions, which may include exposure to air conditioning, heating, artificial lighting, and varying noise levels * **Mobility** : Ability to sit, stand, reach, twist, stretch, and work at a desk for long stretches. Must be able to occasionally move or lift office items up to 25 pounds * **Hearing Requirements:** Hearing must be sufficient or correctable to ensure clear understanding of spoken information, including participating in virtual meetings and phone calls. Use of hearing aids or other assistive devices is acceptable if needed. * **Reading and Writing Proficiency:** Ability to read and write in English is essential for processing documents, drafting reports, and following up on necessary actions. Proficiency in written communication is required to handle job\-related tasks effectively. * **Vision Requirements:** Vision must be adequate or correctable to perform essential job duties, such as reading documents on a computer screen and using other visual tools. Use of corrective lenses or other measures to meet visual requirements is expected if needed. * **Technology Proficiency:** Must be proficient in operating a computer and other office productivity tools such as printers, scanners, and collaboration software. * **Effective Communication:** Must possess strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with team members, clients, and other stakeholders via email, video conferencing, and other in office communication tools. **Compensation:** DOE If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

* Process transformation: can map a business process, find where agents fit, and redesign the operating model around them, rather than bolting a chatbot onto the old process * Enterprise architecture Python or TypeScript * Curiosity and speed: keeps pace with a fast\-moving platform and is energized, not overwhelmed, by monthly product releases **Nice to have** * Anthropic platform: built with Claude models through the Claude API, Claude Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent Skills, and Claude Code; has rolled out Claude Enterprise * Cloud channels: has deployed Claude through Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, or Microsoft Foundry * Competitive fluency: knows other agent frameworks and model providers well enough to position Claude credibly against them * AI governance: working knowledge of the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and the rules of regulated industries * LLMOps: experience with evaluation, observability, and cost management for agents in production * Industry depth in one or more of EPAM's core sectors: financial services, insurance, life sciences and healthcare, retail and consumer, software and hi\-tech, or travel and hospitality * jobs.title: Gen AI - Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Generative AI Engineer Lead to drive the design, development, and deployment of enterprise\-grade Generative AI solutions. The candidate will also establish engineering best practices around prompt governance, model guardrails, benchmarking, and performance optimization. **Responsibilities: Generative AI Solution Design** rapid solution development. * Translate business problems into scalable AI workflows and production\-ready proof\-of\-concepts. * Drive AI platform modernization through adoption of emerging GenAI technologies and best practices. **Prompt Engineering \& LLM Governance** * Develop and maintain sophisticated prompt engineering frameworks for controlled and reliable LLM outputs. * Implement prompt versioning, prompt lifecycle management, and testing strategies. * Design AI guardrails to mitigate hallucinations, bias, security risks, and compliance concerns. * Establish best practices for prompt optimization, response consistency, and output quality management. **AI Workflow Orchestration \& Automation** * Design and build scalable orchestration pipelines using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent. * Develop reusable AI components, tools, agents, and workflow templates for enterprise adoption. * Implement multi\-agent systems and autonomous workflows to support complex business use cases. **Prototyping \& Business Enablement** * Partner with business stakeholders to identify high\-value AI opportunities. * Rapidly develop AI prototypes and MVP solutions using synthetic and enterprise datasets. * Convert prototypes into production\-ready applications adhering to scalability, security, and reliability standards. **Cloud \& Data Engineering** * Build scalable GenAI architectures across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake platforms. * Leverage cloud\-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex AI, and related ecosystems. * Design robust RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures incorporating vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search. * Optimize model deployment, inference performance, and infrastructure cost efficiency. **Evaluation \& Performance Optimization** * Establish AI evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, latency, safety, and business impact. * Develop benchmarking methodologies for comparing prompts, models, and workflows. * Define KPIs, observability frameworks, and monitoring strategies for GenAI applications. * Continuously improve model performance through prompt tuning, retrieval optimization, and workflow enhancements. * Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 8\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning, data engineering, or AI solution development. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and foundation models. * Strong experience designing enterprise GenAI solutions utilizing advanced LLM architectures and prompt frameworks. * Expertise in building scalable AI workflows, orchestration pipelines, and reusable AI components. * Proven ability to translate business requirements into production\-ready AI solutions and prototypes using synthetic data. * Deep understanding of prompt versioning, prompt governance, guardrails, and controlled LLM outputs. * Strong knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, benchmarking methodologies, and optimization techniques. * Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and RAG architectures. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development frameworks.
