jobs.title: Software Engineer III — Evaluation
jobs.description: **GENERAL OVERVIEW:** Education Advanced, Inc. is a rapidly growing educational technology (Ed\-Tech) company in the K\-12 industry. Our goal is to create operational software that empowers educators to work more efficiently in specific areas. Evaluation is our teacher and staff observation and evaluation product. It is a Ruby on Rails application hosted on AWS, and it includes AI\-powered features that help educators do their best work. We are hiring a Software Engineer III to own significant parts of the product. This is a small, tight\-knit team, so the role carries real breadth: you will work across the Rails application, our AI\-powered features, the data integrations that connect Evaluation to other systems, and the cloud infrastructure it all runs on. You will also help others understand how the system works, so documentation and mentoring are part of the job, not something you get to after the sprint. You will start with a structured onboarding period, then help shape where the product and its architecture go next. This is a remote role with core availability during US Central Time business hours. We foster a supportive, inclusive, and innovation\-driven culture where every voice matters and your work directly empowers teachers and students. Join us to grow, collaborate, and build solutions that transform K–12 education. **QUALIFICATIONS:** **Roles and Responsibilities** * Design, build, ship, and support features across the Evaluation application, from the first product conversation through release and production support. * Build and improve AI\-powered product features: integrate large language models (LLMs) into real user workflows, and help design the prompts, safeguards, and quality checks that keep AI output accurate, safe, and useful for educators. * Build and maintain data integrations between Evaluation and other systems, with a focus on reliability and data quality. * Lead technical improvements on the roadmap, such as simplifying configuration, reducing technical debt, and modernizing parts of the application, and sequence that work so delivery keeps moving. * Write clean, high\-quality, testable, secure, and maintainable code, and help strengthen our automated testing practices. * Build and operate in AWS using CI/CD and infrastructure as code, and troubleshoot production issues end to end across the application and infrastructure. * Meet FERPA, state student\-privacy, and WCAG accessibility requirements as part of normal delivery. * Use AI\-assisted development tools as a core part of how you work (planning, coding, testing, code review, and documentation) while checking everything they produce and standing behind every line you ship. * Help shape how the team uses AI in the development lifecycle, including shared conventions, reusable prompts and instructions, and guardrails for safe use. * Partner with Product Management to refine requirements, take part in backlog refinement and sprint planning, and turn specifications into scalable, secure implementations. * Mentor teammates through code review, pairing, and technical planning, and write clear documentation that helps others work confidently in the system. * Other duties as assigned. **Qualifications and Education Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years building and operating production web applications, including recent, hands\-on Ruby on Rails experience (Ruby, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS). * Strong relational database skills (MySQL or similar): schema design, indexing, query performance, and safe migrations in a multi\-tenant application. * Hands\-on experience writing automated tests in Rails (for example, RSpec) at the unit and integration level. * Hands\-on experience deploying, running, and debugging applications in AWS, including containers, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code. * Solid grasp of secure web development (for example, OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorization, input validation, and secrets management). * Daily, hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development tools in professional work (for example, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or OpenAI Codex), beyond autocomplete to multi\-step work such as building features, refactoring, writing tests, and exploring unfamiliar code. * Skill at directing AI tools: giving clear specs and context, breaking work into small, checkable steps, and using tests and code review to catch output that is wrong, insecure, or made up. * Sound judgment about AI and data safety, including what code and data should never be shared with an AI tool, especially student and educator data. * A track record of owning ambiguous work end to end, from design through delivery and support, without needing it broken down for you. * Comfort working productively in a mature codebase and improving it without stalling delivery. * Excellent written and verbal communication for async, cross\-time\-zone teamwork, including explaining technical tradeoffs to non\-engineers. * Experience working in an Agile team (backlog refinement, sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives). * Core availability during US Central Time business hours. * Authorized to work in the United States. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building LLM\-powered features in production: prompt design, testing and evaluating AI output, cost and latency tradeoffs, and safeguards against unsafe or low\-quality results. * Experience with managed AI services from a major cloud provider. * Experience building AI tools into a team's development process, such as shared repo instructions, reusable prompts, or custom agents that help AI tools follow team standards. * Experience introducing or expanding automated testing in an existing codebase. * Frontend modernization experience in a server\-rendered Rails application (for example, Hotwire, Stimulus, or a component\-based approach). * Accessibility remediation experience against WCAG 2\.1 AA. * K\-12 or public\-sector software background, or experience with student information system (SIS) data and student data privacy. * Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their career. **How We Work** * Small teams with real ownership: feature branches, a release branch model, frequent deploys, and feature flags for controlled rollout. * AI across the whole lifecycle: We use AI tools throughout R\&D, and we keep building them into how we plan, build, test, review, and release software. How we do that is still changing, and you'll help shape it. * You own what you ship: if you can't explain code you submitted, it isn't ready, no matter what wrote it. * Privacy first: student and educator data is handled with care in every tool and every environment.

jobs.title: Distinguished AI Engineer

This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace. Ideal candidates will be able to report to our Pulse Point location in Indianapolis, IN. Alternate locations may be considered if candidates reside within a commuting distance from an office. The **Distinguished AI Engineer** is a highly experienced, hands\-on AI individual contributor to design, build, and scale enterprise AI solutions across machine learning, generative AI, and AI agents. This role is for a senior technical expert who can directly develop production\-grade AI capabilities while also influencing architecture, delivery models, and engineering practices across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and has a proven track record of building reusable AI services at scale. This is not a pure research or management role; we are looking for a hands\-on builder who thrives in complex enterprise environments and can help modernize how AI solutions are developed and deployed. The ideal candidate can also make sound buy, build, and integrate decisions across commercial and open\-source AI solutions, selecting the right approach based on business need, regulatory requirements, speed to value, and long\-term maintainability. **How you will make an impact:** * Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI solutions spanning traditional machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI systems. * Architect and deliver scalable, resilient AI solutions leveraging technologies such as agentic systems, large language models (LLMs), distributed systems, and event\-driven architectures. * Serve as a senior hands\-on contributor, technical leader, and subject matter expert across the AI development lifecycle. * Build reusable AI services, frameworks, accelerators, and reference architectures leveraged across multiple teams and use cases. * Partner with business domain SMEs, product, engineering, architecture, security, data, and business teams to translate business opportunities into scalable AI solutions. * Lead, buy, build, and integrate decisions across commercial and open\-source AI solutions, balancing speed, cost, risk, security, scalability, and strategic differentiation. * Use modern AI\-assisted development tooling to improve speed, quality, and efficiency of solution delivery. * Guide implementation teams through architecture, design, model selection, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization of AI solutions. * Mentor junior AI engineers and elevate the broader organization's AI engineering capabilities. * Influence technical direction across teams through expertise, credibility, and collaboration rather than formal authority * Ensure solutions are designed for enterprise requirements including scalability, security, observability, governance, and maintainability. * Define enterprise\-wide technical direction, including architecture patterns, integration standards, and reusable platform capabilities. * Lead AI\-driven modernization of legacy systems through automated code transformation, service decomposition, and continuous optimization. * Design and implement AI\-enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices to improve engineering velocity and quality. * Establish technical standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for AI systems, including monitoring, evaluation, and responsible AI. * Partner with engineering teams and stakeholders to enable adoption of AI\-assisted development and drive continuous improvement in system performance and productivity. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship while influencing enterprise technology decisions through deep expertise and hands\-on engineering. **Minimum Requirements:** * Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field and a minimum of 15 years of experience in software engineering, deep expertise in distributed systems and large\-scale architecture, or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background. * Experience delivering production\-grade AI/ML systems at scale, building agentic systems or complex LLM\-based applications, modernizing large, complex legacy systems, and delivering high\-quality systems also required. * Strong programming expertise in Python, Java, or similar required. matter expert in machine learning, GenAI, and AI agents preferred. * Experience working in a Fortune 100 regulated company, startup, and/or top\-tier technology firm preferred. * Proven success at building and deploying reusable AI services at scale preferred. * Experience operationalizing AI in production with MLOps, LLMOps, observability, and governance practices preferred. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer/Tech Lead
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Senior Software Engineer/Tech Lead At Lilly, we're at an inflection point where 150 years of pharmaceutical excellence meets the transformative power of artificial intelligence. Our mission to create medicines that make life better has never been more achievable than it is today. AI is fundamentally reshaping how we discover, develop, and deliver life\-saving treatments to patients around the world. Tech@Lilly is building the digital and AI foundation of a modern pharmaceutical company, one where scalable platforms, trusted data, and intelligent automation help our scientists, clinicians, and business teams move faster and make better decisions. The solutions we build directly shorten the path from scientific discovery to patient impact. If you are passionate about engineering excellence and want your work to matter to patients, we invite you to join us and help shape how medicines are made and delivered for the next 150 years. **Role Overview:** The Senior Software Engineer/Tech Lead is accountable for the technical success of AI agents, systems of agents, and AI products. For this role, you will operate as a hands\-on tech lead: personally design, code, and deliver critical components (primarily in Python) while overseeing development teams through design reviews, technical guidance, and quality gates to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and delivered with a bias for action. This role provides technical leadership while driving architectural and engineering decisions, ensures high\-quality delivery, and serves as the primary technical counterpart to delivery teams and business users. The Technical Lead balances business objectives, user experience, scalability, security, and maintainability to deliver sustainable technology solutions, while enabling domain teams within Lilly's federated delivery model. Success in this role is measured by the quality and reliability of delivered solutions, the speed and predictability of technical delivery, reduction of technical debt and operational issues, adoption of engineering standards and best practices, and the technical capability and overall health of the product and team. **Primary Responsibilities:** Technical Direction \& Leadership * Own the overall technical direction, ensuring alignment with business strategy and product objectives * Translate business requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans * Lead technical design engineering standards, security requirements, and architectural principles SWE Responsibilities * Drive technical decisions and tradeoffs between speed, cost, quality, maintainability, and scalability learning, innovation, and engineering excellence Stakeholder Collaboration * Partner with business to create solutions with high accuracy and usage rates * Communicate technical risks, dependencies, and solution approaches to stakeholders * Act as the primary escalation point for technical issues * Align technology decisions with business strategy and product objectives **Basic Requirements:** * jobs.title: Senior AI Deployment Manager, Cyber
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ We are a technology services company dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting\-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real\-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands\-on client collaboration to solve high\-impact problems. **Job Summary** =============== The Senior AI Deployment Manager leads complex AI product and delivery work in Eliza's Cyber vertical. You will serve as the product counterpart to client leaders and business development, translating cybersecurity needs into feasible AI opportunities and owning delivery alignment from discovery through launch. You will work closely with forward\-deployed engineers, owning product decisions while engineering partners own implementation decisions in their lane. This is a founding role in the Cyber vertical. You will operate independently through ambiguity, set direction for client work and teammates, and stay close enough to delivery to keep commitments and outcomes credible. Engagements may include cyber\-domain discovery and, when the work calls for it, training on AI governance and Codex setup. Eliza is AI\-native and expects leaders to use AI tools in discovery, product definition, and client communication. The technology and client context evolve quickly; sound judgment means knowing where AI is useful, where it is not, and when to bring engineering or domain expertise into a decision. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **1\. Scope cyber opportunities and prioritize use cases** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Run structured discovery with cyber stakeholders to understand workflows, risk, data readiness, and business outcomes. * Assess use\-case fit, feasibility, sequencing, and the path to production; make clear recommendations on what is ready for AI and what is not. * Build and maintain a prioritized use\-case backlog grounded in feasibility, readiness, and measurable impact. **2\. Own product definition and delivery alignment** ----------------------------------------------------- * Translate client needs into product requirements, acceptance evidence, delivery plans, and product roadmaps engineers can act on. * Partner with forward\-deployed engineers through design, evaluation, iteration, launch, and handoff; surface edge cases and risks early. * Manage the gap between prototype and production, including data quality, security, compliance, and scalability concerns. **3\. Own outcomes and stakeholder trust** ------------------------------------------ * Align client executives, subject\-matter experts, business development, and technical teams on scope, tradeoffs, timing, and measurable value. * Define success criteria with client experts for AI systems whose performance requires ongoing evaluation. * Communicate progress and risks plainly, challenge unsuitable requests constructively, and escalate decisions at the right time. **4\. Build Cyber delivery capability** --------------------------------------- * Contribute AI governance and ChatGPT and Codex setup training when required by an engagement. * Turn proven Cyber delivery methods into reusable playbooks, evaluations, and production\-readiness practices. * Coach Associates and help shape how enterprises move from AI experimentation to production in cyber contexts. * Support pre\-sales of cyber client engagements, including drafting and reviewing SOWs, work plans, and playbooks. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * Deep cybersecurity experience and sound judgment about the operating context behind client problems. * A record of independently leading complex client or product work through ambiguity and measurable outcomes. * Strong AI fluency: practical use of current AI tools and a clear understanding of where models help, fail, and require evaluation. * Product judgment that connects user needs, business impact, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and technical constraints. * Credible partnership with engineers; know which decisions belong to product and when to bring in engineering expertise. * Clear executive communication, concise written materials, and confidence facilitating difficult tradeoff conversations. * Experience setting direction for others or coaching less\-experienced delivery teammates. **Preferred** ------------- * AI governance, cyber risk, Codex setup, or responsible AI training experience. * Consulting or client\-service experience with executive stakeholders. * Experience building reusable delivery methods, evaluations, or workflow assets. **What We Offer** ================= * Competitive compensation (base salary \+ performance incentives tied to client outcomes). * Equity options in a growing AI services company. * Exposure to a wide range of industries and high\-impact AI problems. * Travel opportunities for on\-site client engagements (if desired). * Work at the intersection of enterprise AI delivery and a substantive cybersecurity domain. * Own client outcomes and work directly with senior stakeholders. * Partner closely with forward\-deployed engineers building and deploying real systems. * Help shape how Eliza's Cyber practice delivers AI work. * Compensation and benefits details will be shared during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Licensed MEP Engineer In U.S.A
jobs.description: **Overview** We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented MEP Engineer to join our innovative engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and overseeing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems within various projects. Your expertise will drive the development of efficient, sustainable, and compliant MEP solutions that meet project specifications and industry standards. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting\-edge projects while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver exceptional results. **Responsibilities** * Develop comprehensive mechanical, electrical, and plumbing system designs using CAD software. * Conduct system design analysis utilizing MATLAB, Simulink, LabVIEW, and FEA techniques to optimize performance and reliability. * Perform root cause analysis on system failures or inefficiencies to implement corrective actions that enhance system integrity. * Prepare project schedules and coordinate timelines to ensure timely delivery of design milestones and project completion. * Apply knowledge of ASME codes \& standards, GD\&T (Geometric Dimensioning \& Tolerancing), and other relevant industry standards to ensure compliance across all designs. * Utilize programmable logic controllers (PLCs), Arduino platforms, and system design principles for automation and control solutions within mechanical systems. * Collaborate with manufacturing teams to develop mechanical designs compatible with CNC machining, 3D printing, or other fabrication processes. * Review technical schematics, drawings, and CAD models for accuracy; perform drafting updates as needed. * Engage in manufacturing process improvements by integrating FEA simulations and CAD\-based analyses to enhance product performance. * Support project scheduling by tracking progress, identifying potential delays early, and implementing corrective measures proactively. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; advanced certifications in CAD (SolidWorks, Creo) are preferred. * Proven experience with mechanical design, system modeling, and drafting using CAD tools such as SolidWorks or Creo. * Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, including thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and material science. * Familiarity with industry standards such as ASME codes \& standards for pressure vessels, piping systems, or mechanical components. * Experience with system design software like MATLAB/Simulink or LabVIEW for simulation and control applications. * Knowledge of manufacturing processes including CNC machining and additive manufacturing techniques. * Ability to perform root cause analysis using data\-driven approaches; experience with FEA software is a plus. * Proficiency in project scheduling tools and methodologies to manage multiple tasks effectively. * Excellent communication skills for collaborating across multidisciplinary teams; detail\-oriented with strong drafting capabilities. Join us as an MEP Engineer where your innovative ideas will shape the future of engineering solutions! We are committed to fostering a vibrant work environment that values your expertise while supporting your professional growth through challenging projects and continuous learning opportunities. Pay: $10,000\.00 \- $20,000\.00 per month Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: Evolve Transporters is a high\-end custom fabrication company with locations in the greater Indianapolis, Indiana and Cleveland, Ohio areas. We partner with some of the largest motorsports teams and brands in the world, designing and fabricating premium race transporters and mobile workspaces. Our success is built on craftsmanship, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction. We are seeking a highly motivated **Design Engineer** who thrives in a fast\-paced, innovative environment and enjoys taking products from concept to completion. This role will play a key part in developing innovative, high\-performance transporter and trailer solutions while partnering closely with Creative, Engineering, and Production teams. As a member of the Engineering team, you will help transform ideas into manufacturable products while balancing functionality, aesthetics, structural integrity, quality, and customer experience. **About Evolve Transporters** Evolve Transporters is a high\-end custom fabrication company with locations in the greater Indianapolis, Indiana and Cleveland, Ohio areas. We partner with some of the largest motorsports teams and brands in the world, designing and fabricating premium race transporters and mobile workspaces. Evolve operates using the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS), a business operating framework that establishes clear expectations, accountability, measurable performance, and alignment around company goals. We are committed to placing people in roles where they can succeed and contribute at a high level. Employees are expected to understand the responsibilities and outcomes associated with their role, take ownership of commitments, communicate obstacles proactively, and consistently deliver results. **Primary Accountabilities** **Design Engineering \& Product Development** * Create detailed 3D models, CAD drawings, engineering schematics, and production documentation. * Design innovative transporter and trailer components, systems, and assemblies. * Ensure designs meet customer requirements, manufacturability standards, and structural performance expectations. * Balance functionality, user experience, aesthetics, and production efficiency throughout the design process. **Material Selection \& Engineering Analysis** * Select and specify appropriate materials, components, and fabrication methods. * Evaluate structural integrity, durability, and product performance. * Support engineering calculations, testing, and validation efforts. * Analyze design alternatives and recommend optimal solutions. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Work closely with Creative, Production, Project Management, and Engineering teams. * Ensure design intent is effectively communicated to manufacturing. * Support project execution from concept through final production. * Participate in design reviews and problem\-solving activities. **Manufacturing Support \& Continuous Improvement** * Provide technical support to fabrication and production teams. * Resolve design, manufacturing, and assembly issues. * Assist with BOM creation, maintenance, and revision control. * Identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, and product performance. **Innovation \& Product Excellence** * Support development of new products and platform improvements. * Research emerging technologies, materials, and industry trends. * Contribute innovative ideas that improve Evolve's products and customer experience. * Champion continuous improvement and engineering best practices. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 3\+ years of design engineering experience. * Proficiency in SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and/or related CAD platforms. * Experience creating detailed engineering drawings and production documentation. * Strong understanding of structural mechanics, manufacturing processes, and material properties. * Experience managing and maintaining Bills of Material (BOMs). * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical requirements. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills. * Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in motorsports, transportation equipment, aerospace, naval, or related industries. * Experience supporting custom fabrication environments. * Knowledge of sheet metal, welding, and manufacturing processes. * Experience with FEA, testing, and validation methods. * Experience designing products from concept through production launch. * Familiarity with ERP systems and engineering change management processes. **Why Join Evolve?** At Evolve, you'll play an important role in keeping our operation running smoothly. The work you do directly supports the production of world\-class motorsports transporters and mobile workspaces. If you're dependable, take pride in your work, and enjoy staying active throughout the day, we'd love to talk with you.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Agentic AI Engineer — Layla AI
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Location** **:** Seattle preferred; other locations and employment arrangement to be confirmed **About Layla AI** Layla is an AI\-native travel\-planning and booking company within Expedia Group’s Product organization. The team is building conversational experiences that help travelers move from inspiration to a complete, bookable itinerary across flights, hotels, activities, and day\-by\-day plans. The team is small, senior, and startup\-paced. Engineers are expected to take meaningful ownership, move from ambiguous problem to production, and use data, experimentation, and AI\-assisted development practices to improve the traveler experience. **THE OPPORTUNITY** We are looking for a **Senior Full Stack Agentic AI Engineer** to help build the next generation of proactive travel\-planning experiences at Layla. You will work across agent orchestration, backend services, data and retrieval systems, and user\-facing product experiences. You will help turn emerging agentic capabilities into reliable, understandable, and useful traveler workflows — not simply prototypes or chat interfaces. This is a high\-autonomy, broad\-scope senior individual contributor role — often described as a **“** ***Super IC*** **”** profile — with the opportunity to connect product intent, agent architecture, full\-stack implementation, and production outcomes. The role has shared ownership: you will help shape direction and own meaningful work while partnering closely across Product, Design, Data, and Engineering rather than working in isolation. At Layla, engineers can influence a product used by travelers around the world. We are looking for someone energized by the opportunity to bring ideas forward, explore possibilities, and turn them into reliable experiences at global travel scale. You do not need to arrive with every answer or every technology; curiosity, sound judgment, initiative, and a willingness to learn are essential. **WHAT WE VALUE BEYOND THE CHECKLIST** The scope of this role is intentionally broad, but it is not a request for one person to be an expert in everything. We value engineers who can connect disciplines, identify where they can contribute most, collaborate generously, and bring in the right partners when deeper expertise is needed. Strong candidates may have different paths through full\-stack engineering, applied AI, product development, or startup environments; what matters is the ability to learn, make sound tradeoffs, and turn ideas into outcomes. **In this role, you will:** * Design, build, and operate agentic AI experiences that support travel discovery, itinerary planning, personalization, and booking\-related workflows. * Develop reliable agent orchestration patterns, including planning, tool use, routing, state management, memory, retries, guardrails, and human confirmation where appropriate. * Build and evolve backend services, APIs, data models, integrations, and event\-driven workflows that connect agent experiences to Expedia Group and Layla capabilities. * Build user\-facing experiences that make AI behavior clear, useful, and actionable across web and other relevant product surfaces. * Integrate retrieval, knowledge, and recommendation capabilities using appropriate data contracts, embeddings, search, ranking, and grounding strategies. * Establish evaluation and observability practices for agentic systems, including quality, task completion, latency, cost, safety, failure modes, and user impact. * Take shared ownership of a meaningful product surface, from framing the problem and exploring solutions through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration. * Translate ambiguous product opportunities into thin, testable increments and ship quickly while preserving operational and architectural quality. * Partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering to shape product direction, define success metrics, and connect technical decisions to traveler outcomes. * Apply strong software engineering practices across testing, CI/CD, observability, security, incident response, and production support. * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to explore designs, accelerate implementation, improve test coverage, and investigate production behavior — whil cture, and cloud\-native systems. * Experience designing agent evaluation frameworks, offline test sets, online monitoring, quality rubrics, or experimentation programs. * Experience building systems with strong safety, privacy, security, reliability, and responsible\-AI considerations. * Experience in travel, commerce, marketplace, recommendations, search, personalization, or other high\-scale consumer products. * Experience using AI coding assistants or software\-engineering agents in day\-to\-day development, including examples of validating, correcting, and hardening generated output. Experience working in a startup, incubation, or rapidly evolving product environment where priorities and requirements change quickly. * Expedia Group is proud to offer a wide range of benefits to support employees and their families, including medical/dental/vision, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program. To fuel each employee’s passion for travel, we offer a wellness \& travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and an International Airlines Travel Agent (IATAN) membership. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa;The total cash range for this position in Austin is $184,500\.00 to $258,000\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. **Benefits and perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun. **About the team** Our Enterprise Security Architecture team is a group of detail\-oriented specialists who help FIS grow safely and confidently. We work closely with our security and technology peers to review enterprise infrastructure, products, and solutions before they’re introduced across the business. Every review focuses on secure design, making sure each proposal meets FIS security policies and aligns with industry best practices. By combining deep technical knowledge with practical, collaborative guidance, we help teams find the right balance between innovation and risk. Together, we play a key role in protecting our clients, our data, and the trust that sits at the heart of everything we do. **What you will be doing** As a Principal Architect within the Enterprise Security Architecture team, you’ll focus on how FIS builds and uses AI agents safely. You’ll review the security compliance for agents built into our products and the corporate agents our colleagues use every day. Working closely with security engineering, technology, product and risk teams, you’ll make sure innovation moves quickly without putting our clients, data, or reputation at risk. * Design secure architectures and reference patterns for enterprise infrastructure, products, and solutions which incorporate AI agents. * Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for AI features, identifying risks and recommending practical fixes before launch. * Review how agents authenticate, what data and tools they can access, and how their actions are approved, monitored, and logged. * Create secure\-by\-design security standards and reusable controls that engineering teams can easily adopt. * Stay ahead of emerging AI threats and industry frameworks, and mentor architects and engineers across the Cybersecurity organization. **What you bring** * Deep security architecture experience. You have 10\+ years in cybersecurity, including several years as a senior or principal architect designing secure systems for large, complex organizations and hold Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, or a cloud security architecture certification. * Hands\-on expertise securing AI and LLM systems. You understand the risks that come with AI agents, such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive permissions, and unsafe tool use, and you know how to design guardrails against them. * Strong grasp of identity, access, and data protection for autonomous agents. You can design how enterprise product agents and personal agents authenticate, what they’re allowed to access, how actions are authorized and logged, and how sensitive data stays protected. * Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols. jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- The Software Development Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and enhancing applications across all layers of the software stack, from database development through front\-end functionality. Working within an Agile development environment, this role partners with business and technical teams to gather requirements, prototype solutions, implement enhancements, and perform unit testing to support application quality, reliability, and performance. The Software Development Engineer II works across multiple projects and technical environments while collaborating with Product, UX, Engineering, and Architecture teams throughout the software development lifecycle. This position requires strong technical and problem\-solving skills, adaptability to changing business and technology needs, and the ability to develop effective solutions to business and client challenges. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- The essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: * Design, develop, maintain, and enhance applications across multiple tiers of the software architecture. * Support complex and highly visible development initiatives across multiple projects and technical environments. * Gather and evaluate business and technical requirements to develop effective application solutions. * Prototype, develop, test, and implement software solutions that address business and client needs. * Design, develop, and extend back\-end web services using JSON, .NET web services, SQL, and related technologies. * Create, consume, maintain, and enhance RESTful APIs. * Develop and execute unit tests to support application quality, reliability, and performance. * Support application releases and development activities using Agile software development practices. * Apply Test Driven Development (TDD) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices throughout the development lifecycle. * Collaborate with Product, UX, and Engineering teams throughout requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and implementation. * Work closely with architects to ensure applications and technical solutions align with Fleet Response IT's long\-term strategy and architectural standards. * Participate in solution scoping by identifying technical requirements and developing solutions to business and client challenges. * Apply knowledge across multiple technical environments and business areas when developing and supporting applications. * Troubleshoot application issues and identify appropriate technical solutions. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to development standards and best practices. * Maintain technical documentation related to applications, enhancements, and development activities. * Manage multiple development priorities while adapting to changing business requirements, technologies, and project needs. * Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned. *The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Employees may be required to perform duties outside their normal responsibilities as business needs dictate.* **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required Qualifications** * Three to five years of software development experience. * Proficiency with API and web application development technologies. * Proficiency with C\#, Angular 10\+, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, LESS, Node.js, or similar development technologies. * Experience creating and consuming RESTful APIs. * Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes. * Experience using Azure DevOps, Git, or other source control and code repository tools. * Experience working within a predominantly .NET\-based codebase. * Ability to work effectively within a predominantly Windows\-based development environment. * Experience writing T\-SQL and working with Microsoft SQL Server. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS, with Microsoft Azure preferred. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** ---------------------------------- * Strong knowledge of full\-stack application development across database, back\-end, API, and front\-end technologies. * Strong understanding of API and web development concepts and practices. * Knowledge of Agile software development methodologies and the software development lifecycle. * Understanding of Test Driven Development (TDD) and CI/CD practices. * Ability to gather and evaluate business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. * Ability to design and develop solutions across multiple technical environments. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to develop, test, implement, and support reliable software applications. * Ability to identify technical solutions to complex business and client challenges. * Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, UX, Engineering, Architecture, business partners, clients, and vendors. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a development team. * Ability to adapt to changing technologies, business priorities, and technical requirements. * Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and commitment to continuous improvement. **Physical Demands \& Work Environment** ---------------------------------------- * Work is performed primarily in a professional indoor office or home\-office environment. * Requires prolonged periods of sitting, typing, computer use, reading, and technical analysis. * Requires close visual attention when reviewing code, technical documentation, data, and computer screens. * Must be able to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, through video conferencing, and through electronic communication. * Regular use of wrists, hands, and fingers is required for computer and office\-related tasks. * This is primarily a sedentary position with occasional walking and standing. * Must occasionally be able to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects weighing up to 10 pounds. * Work is performed in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment requiring adaptability to changing business and technical requirements. **Work Schedule** ----------------- Flexible scheduling options and work arrangements are available based on departmental needs, business requirements, and performance expectations. Employees may be eligible to work from home as part of their regularly scheduled work arrangement.

jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description: **Organization Overview:** *The Florida Panthers are in their 33rd season in 2026\-27 as one of the National Hockey League's premier franchises. As back\-to\-back Stanley Cup Champions in 2024 and 2025, the Panthers have won 11 of their past 12 postseason series and captured four Eastern Conference Championships. The organization is led by President of Hockey Operations \& General Manager Bill Zito, entering his seventh season, and President of Business Operations Michael White, beginning his first full season.* *Anchored by a championship culture on the ice, the Panthers are equally committed to building a world\-class sports and entertainment platform off of it. The organization focuses on delivering an elite guest experience across all venues, deepening the connection between the team and the South Florida community and continuing to grow the sport for the next generation. The Panthers operate four facilities in Broward County: Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise which is home of Panthers home games, concerts and events, Panthers IceDen in Coral Springs, the state\-of\-the\-art Baptist Health IcePlex in Fort Lauderdale and renovated War Memorial Auditorium which hosts concerts and events year\-round.* *The Panthers are owned by Vincent J. Viola, a graduate of the United States Military Academy at West Point and a veteran of the U.S. Army. That foundation of selfless service shapes the organization's identity at every level. The Panthers' pillar program, "Heroes Among Us," honors a U.S. military veteran at every home game, and the Florida Panthers Foundation directs its efforts across four core pillars: veterans' affairs, children's health and education, raising awareness for the endangered Florida Panther and growing youth hockey throughout the region. The organization remains deeply committed to empowering and strengthening the diverse communities of South Florida and the tri\-county area.* **Ice Den Building Engineer** ----------------------------- * **Organization:** Florida Panthers Ice Den * **Department:** Facilities / Engineering * **Reports To:** Operations Manager * **FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt (Hourly) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time * **Location:** Florida Panthers Ice Den, Coral Springs, FL — On\-Site * **Schedule:** Flexibility required for evenings, weekends, and holidays around the event and program schedule **Position Summary** -------------------- We are seeking a reliable, hands\-on Ice Den Building Engineer to join the Engineering/Facilities team supporting the Ice Den in Coral Springs on a full\-time basis. This role is responsible for the general maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of building systems — including HVAC, plumbing, mechanical, and ice plant/refrigeration equipment — to keep the facility running safely and reliably for programming, events, and daily operations. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Perform routine rounds and inspections of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems throughout the facility * Monitor and support the ice plant/refrigeration system, including compressors, pumps, and related controls, escalating issues to senior engineering staff as needed * Respond to basic HVAC, plumbing, and mechanical service calls and perform minor repairs and preventive maintenance * Complete assigned work orders and document completed maintenance tasks accurately * Assist with setup and breakdown of building systems and equipment for scheduled events, public skate sessions, and hockey programs * Monitor building automation/control systems and report anomalies or alarms to the appropriate supervisor * Support other trades (electrical, painting, general maintenance) with basic tasks as directed * Follow all safety protocols and lockout/tagout procedures when working on mechanical or electrical equipment * Maintain a clean, organized, and safe mechanical/engineering work environment * Respond to urgent facility issues during scheduled shifts, including evenings, weekends, and event\-driven schedules **Qualifications** ------------------ * 1–3\+ years of experience in building/facility engineering, maintenance, or a related mechanical trade; venue, arena, or ice rink experience a plus * Basic working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, and general mechanical systems * Familiarity with refrigeration or ice plant systems a plus, but not required * Ability to read basic work orders, equipment manuals, and safety data sheets (SDS) * Comfortable working with hand and power tools, ladders, and basic diagnostic equipment * Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn facility\-specific systems * Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays around the event/program schedule * Physical ability to stand, climb, bend, kneel, and lift up to 50 lbs regularly * High school diploma or equivalent; trade coursework or certification a plus * Must be able to pass a background check **Work Environment** -------------------- Fast\-paced venue environment with a schedule tied to public skate sessions, hockey programs, concerts, and other live events. Exposure to cold temperatures (rink areas), mechanical/equipment rooms, and varying conditions across interior and exterior work locations. **Position Type / Expected Hours of Work** ------------------------------------------ This is a full\-time, year\-round, non\-exempt (hourly) position. Must be able to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed around the event and program schedule. *At the Florida Panthers Hockey Club, Arena Operating Company, Panthers IceDen, Sanza Food Service, War Memorial Benefit Corporation, and FLA Team Shop, we strive to make every employee feel valued and respected for who they are and the unique contributions they make. jobs.title: CAD Engineer
jobs.description: CAD Design / Mechanical Engineer – Flexible Part\-Time Opportunity **Company:** Fluid Focus, LLC **Location:** San Marcos, CA **Job Type:** Contract / Part\-Time / As Needed **Schedule:** Flexible **Work Location:** In Person About Fluid Focus Fluid Focus is a specialized suspension engineering, tuning, and manufacturing company serving the mountain bike and motorsports industries. We design, develop, test, and manufacture precision components in\-house, including suspension pistons, damping components, and other high\-performance mechanical products. Our facility includes Haas CNC milling and turning equipment, manual machines, and advanced suspension dynamometers for product development and testing. We're looking to expand our engineering and manufacturing capabilities by establishing a **precision design, prototyping, and CNC job shop specializing in one\-off projects, custom components, and small production runs** for customers across multiple industries. Position Overview Fluid Focus is seeking an experienced **CAD Design / Mechanical Engineer** to assist with mechanical design, product development, and precision manufacturing projects on an as\-needed basis. This position is ideal for someone who currently has full\-time or part\-time employment and is looking for additional work with flexible scheduling. We're looking for someone capable of taking a concept from initial design through detailed CAD modeling, engineering drawings, prototyping, and production\-ready documentation. Beyond our existing product development needs, **we're seeking the right individual to help us establish and grow our engineering and CNC job shop services.** The ideal candidate will have strong mechanical aptitude, an understanding of manufacturing processes, and the ability to design components that are both functional and practical to manufacture. This position offers the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities and potentially grow into a more consistent part\-time or full\-time role as our engineering and manufacturing operations expand. Responsibilities * Create detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, and technical drawings for mechanical components and systems. * Develop new products and improve existing designs from initial concept through production. * Design precision machined components for CNC milling and turning. * Apply design for manufacturing (DFM) principles to optimize components for cost, efficiency, and manufacturability. * Generate production\-ready engineering drawings with appropriate dimensions, tolerances, and GD\&T. * Perform engineering calculations related to mechanical loads, stresses, material selection, and component performance. * Develop prototypes and collaborate with machinists to evaluate and refine designs. * Reverse engineer existing components using physical measurements and available technical documentation. * Create bills of materials (BOMs), assembly documentation, and manufacturing specifications. * Evaluate design alternatives to improve performance, durability, and production efficiency. * Assist with material selection, component sourcing, and manufacturing feasibility. * Collaborate on customer projects involving custom mechanical design, prototyping, and small\-batch manufacturing. * Help establish efficient engineering workflows, documentation standards, and design processes. * Contribute ideas and expertise toward expanding our engineering services and job shop capabilities. Required Qualifications * **Proven experience with mechanical CAD design and product development.** * **Proficiency in Autodesk Fusion 360 or Solidworks**, including parametric modeling, assemblies, and technical drawings. * Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, tolerances, fits, and GD\&T. * Experience designing components for CNC machining and other manufacturing processes. * Ability to independently take a project from concept through production\-ready design. * Understanding of material properties, mechanical loads, and manufacturing limitations. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and customer requirements. * Strong problem\-solving skills and mechanical aptitude. * Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. * Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects. * Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate with machinists and other team members. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Autodesk and/or SolidWorks, or other professional CAD software. * Hands\-on experience with CNC machining, manual machining, or fabrication. * Familiarity with Fusion 360 CAM and CNC manufacturing workflows. * Experience with finite element analysis (FEA), stress calculations, and mechanical simulation. * Background in suspension systems, hydraulics, fluid dynamics, or mechanical damping systems. * Experience designing components for motorsports, automotive, aerospace, cycling, or industrial applications. * Experience with reverse engineering and prototype development. * Familiarity with product testing, validation, and design iteration. * Experience estimating engineering projects and manufacturing costs. * Interest in helping grow a small engineering and manufacturing business. Growth Opportunity Our long\-term vision is to expand Fluid Focus's existing engineering and manufacturing capabilities into a successful **mechanical design, prototyping, and precision CNC job shop** serving customers across multiple industries. We already have CNC equipment, manufacturing infrastructure, and product development experience. Our next step is expanding our engineering services and taking on outside customer projects. We're looking for someone who enjoys technical challenges, values independence, and wants to contribute to the development of a growing engineering and manufacturing operation. As the business expands, there may be opportunities for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and a more permanent position. Schedule \& Compensation * Flexible scheduling based on project workload and availability. * Initially part\-time, contract, or project\-based work. * Compensation based on experience, technical capabilities, and project responsibilities. * Opportunity for increased hours and responsibilities as the business grows. Why Work With Fluid Focus? * Work directly with a company developing and manufacturing high\-performance mechanical components. * Access to an established CNC machine shop and suspension testing equipment. * Opportunity to see your designs manufactured, tested, and refined in\-house. * Flexible hours that can complement existing employment. * Diverse engineering projects rather than repetitive design work. * Direct involvement in product development, engineering decisions, and business growth. * Opportunity to help establish and expand a precision engineering and manufacturing job shop. * Potential to grow into a larger, long\-term role. How to Apply Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your CAD design experience, mechanical engineering background, and familiarity with CNC manufacturing. **A portfolio or examples of mechanical components, assemblies, or products you've designed is strongly encouraged.** We're particularly interested in candidates who can independently develop practical, manufacturable solutions and are excited about helping grow a precision engineering and manufacturing business. **Job Type:** Contract / Part\-Time **Work Location:** In Person – San Marcos, California Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to make Foley’s go\-to\-market engine truly AI\-native. Not someone who can talk about AI agents for outbound, but someone who has built them, put them in front of real buyers, and can show us what they did to pipeline, conversion, or cost per lead. Foley helps companies hire, screen, and monitor drivers through DOT and FMCSA compliance, MVRs, drug and alcohol testing, background checks, and the Clearinghouse. Our customers range from a five\-truck owner\-operator buying online at night to national fleets with procurement teams, and we sell to both. You’ll be the growth engineer for our entire go\-to\-market team: marketing, product marketing, and sales. Behind you is a live AI platform, a governed path to production, and a small team of builders already shipping. This is a generator role, not a coordinator role. You take a hypothesis, turn it into an experiment, build what it needs, ship it, and read the result. Take away the agency, the vendors, and the ticket queue, and you can still move pipeline with a laptop, an API key, and access to the CRM. **What You’ll Do** ================== ### **Run the Growth Experiment Engine** * Turn marketing, product marketing, and sales hypotheses into experiments across messaging, channels, targeting, offers, pricing pages, and sales plays * Design experiments with a control, a metric chosen in advance, and enough volume to trust the result * Run a high volume of tests, kill losers fast, scale winners, and maintain a learning log so no test runs twice ### **Build the Agents That Do the Work** * Build research and enrichment agents that know an account before a rep does * Build signal and trigger detection for events like new DOT authority, fleet growth, safety events, and upcoming renewals * Own lead scoring, qualification, and routing so every lead is worked by the right person or agent * Run personalized outbound and lifecycle programs at scale, with deliverability you own * Instrument tracking and attribution so we can see what’s working ### **Support Product Marketing** * Test positioning and messaging against real buyers * Launch with targeting, pages, and follow\-up already wired * Turn sales calls, win/loss data, and competitor moves into insight product marketing can use * Build content and SEO/GEO tooling so our compliance expertise shows up where buyers are looking ### **Support Sales** * Deliver prospect research and account prep reps don’t have time for * Surface signals that tell reps who to call and why now * Build tools that cut admin time and give reps more time to sell * Make sure smaller deals get worked by systems built to work them well ### **Build on the Platform, Not Around It** * Build go\-to\-market agents on Foley’s AI platform and shared ontology rather than a separate growth stack * Contribute connectors, skills, and signals other teams can reuse * Add go\-to\-market concepts to the ontology so marketing, sales, customer success, and product describe every account the same way ### **Operate with Judgment \& Guardrails** * Ship everything through our review and release gates * Handle consent, PII, and email/SMS/calling rules from day one * Build systems that are still running and trusted six months from now ### **Contribute to the Team** * Participate in marketing, product marketing, and sales meetings as part of the team; their leaders set the priorities * Partner with RevOps, the data team, and other builders across Foley * Share what you build and help the people around you move faster **Who You Are** =============== We’re looking for builders with proven results. When we ask what your work did to the number, your answer is a number. You might come from: * GTM Engineer: You built the outbound and enrichment machine at a startup or scale\-up, owned deliverability, and can tell us exactly what it did to pipeline, including how you handled a bad week * Growth Engineer: You ran experimentation, instrumentation, and attribution for a product or funnel, and want to apply it to a sales\-led and self\-serve motion at the same time * Founder or Operator Turned Builder: You stood up a go\-to\-market motion from zero, built the agents and landing pages yourself, and grew a number **Must\-haves** * You have driven measurable growth results with AI and agents (pipeline, meetings, conversion, cost per lead or acquisition, or revenue) and can explain how you measured them * You have designed and run many experiments, understand what control groups and sample sizes are for, and can walk us through tests that failed * You build it yourself, using Python, SQL, APIs, webhooks, LLMs, agents, and Claude Code or similar * You have hands\-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar), plus enrichment and sequencing tools * You understand how B2B demand is created and converted, and what a good lead, message, and sales play look like * You have contributed to a shared platform, data model, or internal tooling other teams relied on * Marketers, product marketers, reps, and sales leaders trust what you build and like working with you **Strong Signals** * You’ve stood up a motion, product, or company from zero * You’ve worked on small business and self\-serve funnels alongside a sales\-led motion * You have product marketing experience in positioning, launches, competitive intel, or win/loss * You have a current point of view on SEO and generative engine optimization * You’ve turned Gong or call data into signals or content * You’ve built evals or observability for an AI system * You’ve done ontology, knowledge graph, or semantic layer work modeling accounts, entities, or GTM concepts * You’ve worked in transportation, compliance, regtech, or another regulated market **Location:** This role is primarily remote (US based), with the expectation of occasional visits to our offices for team collaboration, training, or company events. This role may be based remotely out of the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin **About us** ============ At Foley, we’re reimagining how safety\-sensitive industries hire, stay compliant, and manage risk. We’ve evolved into a modern SaaS company with an all\-in\-one, AI\-ready platform that helps transportation, construction, distribution, and utility businesses operate faster, smarter, and safer. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for curious, strategic thinkers who thrive in complexity, are motivated by making an impact, and want to join a team that’s passionate about building great products and supporting customers. Our core values — **Teammateship, Grit, and Innovation** — guide everything we do. Whether we’re collaborating internally or helping customers, we approach every challenge with optimism, humor, and a shared commitment to success. **Benefits** Foley offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off and holidays, wellness programs, and an employee assistance program. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Foley is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. **Reasonable Accommodations** If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at **careers@foley.io** **Employment Status** Employment with Foley is on an at\-will basis. Nothing in this job posting or in future communications should be construed as a contract of employment. **Massachusetts Applicants:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. **Privacy Policy:** Please see our Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how Foley processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters. **Manufacturing Engineering** **In This Position…** As part of our Powertrain Manufacturing Engineering (PTME) team, you’ll help build the world\-class powertrains we're known for. In our plants around the world, we’re constantly developing new technologies, processes, and testing methods to further increase our quality and efficiency. In this role, the candidate will function as both an engineer and project manager, working cross\-functionally within manufacturing and across the enterprise to deliver new engine programs and ensure that the quality of powertrains are industry\-leading. Leveraging data analytics and machine learning tools, engine manufacturing test engineers consider assembly processes, cost efficiencies, and quality standards to deliver these fresh new customer products. This role offers high visibility with Ford manufacturing leadership and cross\-functional senior executives, requiring deep collaboration across the entire manufacturing value chain to ensure the best possible return on investment (ROI). The engine manufacturing test engineer position is based in the Powertrain Manufacturing Engineering (PTME) office in Dearborn, Michigan. Depending on project assignments, some travel to appropriate equipment OEMs and Ford powertrain plants is to be expected. **What you'll do...** * Support the specification, procurement, build, installation and launch of Powertrain Production Test Systems for engine powertrain projects * Deliver standardized test processes and equipment in line with global powertrain strategies * Support all test processes (e.g. Leak Test, In\-Process Test, Cold Test, Hot Run) * Collaborate with Product Engineering to achieve a working Product design that meets Manufacturing Design Specifications with feasible expectations in the Test Engineering Specification (ES) * Work with Prototype Engineering to determine feasible test solutions and methodology during the early stages of new programs * Work with a multi\-functional engineering team from Assembly, Machining, Quality and Plant Operations to ensure proper integration of test processes into powertrain manufacturing systems * Develop production test sequences and monitor product function through a test software interface * Troubleshoot production issues impacting FTT and warranty, determine corrective actions to the part, assembly, and machining processes and/or test equipment * Implement test stand modifications as required for new models and corrective actions * Implement test sequence (software) updates for new models and corrective actions * Conduct equipment acceptance activities for test machines at both the OEM and Mfg. Plant to validate capability, robustness, and safety * Review component/assembly quality indicators and evaluate potential test improvements to address issues, reduce warranty claims and improve customer satisfaction on new programs * Use Lessons Learned to develop program studies and improve standard Bill of Processes **You'll have...** * Bachelors / Masters in Engineering * Strong analytical ability * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills * Data driven mentality and decision\-making process **Even better, you may have...** * Experience in Manufacturing Engineering * Base knowledge of various test processes (Leak Test, In\-Process Test, etc.) * Knowledge of engines * Mechanical and Controls Engineering aptitude * Project management experience * Programming experience in test software such as WMA, InspeXion software * Electronic controls systems experience with Siemens PLCs and VFDs * Vibration/NVH analysis a plus You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: * Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage * Paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more * Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * Generous vacation time, sick/personal time, and paid holidays, including between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day This position is a salary grade 6 and ranges from $74,300\-$124,500\., This position is a salary grade 7 and ranges from $86,600\-$144,900\. This position is a salary grade 8 and ranges from $99,100\-$166,200\. Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. For more information on salary and benefits, click here: Visa sponsorship is available for this position. Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1\-888\-336\-0660\. This position is hybrid with a requirement to be onsite four or more days per week. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-VO1

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer - Entry Level
jobs.description: Do you want to change how the world creates? At Formlabs, we're building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting\-edge products to life\-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we're helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. We're a team of hands\-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you're ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. Our software is integral to ensuring exceptional experiences with our products as it bridges the transition from digital models to beautiful physical form in 3D printing. We are looking for a **Embedded Software Engineer** for our Embedded team with a user focused mindset and strong technical background. Our embedded team is the essential component that ties software, hardware and electronics together that pushes the limits of 3D printing. They are responsible for designing and implementing our firmware. **The tech stack:** C\+\+, Python, Embedded Linux, and the occasional dip into Javascript. **You:** * Have experience writing code that lives on hardware products in the consumer, medical, defense, or industrial space * Program with modern languages used for embedded software stacks, ideally in C, C\+\+, and/or Python * Easily implement common embedded software architecture patterns for things like filtering, control loops, and remote procedure calls * Architect code that your fellow software engineers are excited to use and re\-use * Have familiarity and comfort debugging complex hardware and software interactions. * Distill complex things simply when communicating with non\-software stakeholders. **The Job:** * Design, build, test, and ship development tools and prototype code for your fellow R\&D engineers working on new, unlaunched Formlabs products. * Design, build, test and ship code for new printer features to the tens of thousands of Formlabs devices in the field * Ensure code re\-use with a strong focus on maintainability, testing and CI * Collaborate with different stakeholders (product managers, designers) to ensure we build the right features for our customers, existing and future. * Work in a product\-focused, agile environment onsite in our Somerville, MA office. **Our Perks \& Benefits:** * Unlimited 3D printing with any Formlabs material on any Formlabs printer * An equity program that will let you build wealth through RSUs * Healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision) that includes a totally free employee\-only plan, effective starting on your first day on the job * 401K matching with no vesting or tenure requirement * Generous parental leave (fully paid up to 16 weeks) * Flexible time off so you can take time when you need it * Six\-week fully paid sabbatical after hitting tenure milestones (with the option to take an additional six weeks after that) * Free on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits * Free on\-site lunch, snacks, beverages, treats, beer kegs, and employee\-favorite local coffee and espresso * Self\-driven professional development opportunities like conferences, trade shows, and hackathons * One\-of\-a\-kind activities and events like monthly socials, the annual weekend summer camp, a can't\-miss company hackathon, and lots of other social opportunities **You don't need to check every box to apply for a role.
