jobs.title: Software Engineer – FortiSIEM Threat Detection & Integration
jobs.description: We are seeking a software engineer to join the FortiSIEM Advanced Threat Integration engineering team. This role combines hands\-on software development with security detection engineering. The engineer will work close to the data path: ingesting and normalizing security telemetry, building parsers and integrations, modeling detections, and developing the supporting code and tooling required to deliver reliable FortiSIEM content. Responsibilities * Analyze raw security and audit logs from Fortinet and third\-party products to understand their structure and important fields. * Build and maintain FortiSIEM log parsers that extract and normalize data into standard event attributes. * Create and update FortiSIEM security rules, reports, dashboards, and related detection content. * Research vendor documentation, advisories, and sample logs to support new integrations and detections. * Develop and maintain lightweight integrations and supporting tools using Python, regex, APIs, and basic scripting. * Test and troubleshoot parsers, rules, and integrations using representative log samples and expected results. * Work in Linux environments and use Git/GitLab for source control, code review, and team development. Collaborate with developers, QA, support, and security researchers to review, validate, and release FortiSIEM content. * Required Qualifications * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of software engineering experience for candidates with a BS, or 2\+ years with an MS. * Strong Python programming skills, including data structures, file and network I/O, error handling, testing, and debugging. * Strong regular\-expression skills and the ability to reason about correctness and performance when parsing untrusted or irregular log data. * Solid understanding of core programming concepts including algorithms, data structures, complexity, object\-oriented design, and concurrent or asynchronous execution where applicable. * Good working knowledge of Linux, including processes, files, permissions, networking basics, command\-line troubleshooting, and shell scripting. * Working knowledge of Git/GitLab and collaborative code\-review workflows. * Ability to read unfamiliar logs, APIs, schemas, and vendor documentation and convert them into deterministic software and detection logic. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving ability, with attention to edge cases and reproducible testing. Ability to work effectively in a distributed engineering team and to communicate technical reasoning clearly. * Security / SIEM Knowledge * Experience with SIEM, security analytics, log management, EDR, firewall, identity, cloud, or other security telemetry is strongly preferred. * Understanding of common security event concepts such as source/destination identity, authentication events, process execution, network activity, vulnerabilities, and security\-product actions. * Familiarity with detection engineering concepts such as false positives, detection coverage, correlation, baselining, thresholds, and MITRE ATT\&CK is a plus. Prior experience developing SIEM parsers, correlation rules, Sigma\-style detections, or security\-content packages is a strong plus. * Preferred / Nice to Have * Working knowledge of C\+\+ for lower\-level or performance\-sensitive components. * Experience with REST APIs, JSON, XML, syslog, TLS, sockets, and common authentication mechanisms. * Experience with distributed or high\-throughput event\-processing systems. * Experience with at least one public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Experience building developer tooling, automated test harnesses, or CI/CD checks for data/content pipelines. * What This Role Is This is not a pure security\-analyst role and not a generic application\-development role. The engineer is expected to write production code and tooling while also understanding how security telemetry should be normalized and converted into reliable detections. The role sits at the boundary between software engineering, data parsing/integration, and detection engineering. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $123,000\-$151,000\. Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time, as well as a comprehensive leave program. Wage ranges are based on various factors, including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at the time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion. Why Join Us: We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well\-being. Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 890,000\+ customers around the globe.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer | Power
jobs.description: **What We Do** ============== Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall\-climbing robots, industry\-leading sensors, and an AI\-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real\-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a **Solutions Engineer, Power** to lead customer deployments from kickoff through go\-live. You will combine plant systems knowledge with hands\-on software configuration, asset data validation, and customer coordination to ensure the platform accurately reflects each facility. Our software gives industrial operators an accurate operating picture of their facility. You will help customers trust and use it by ensuring each site is set up correctly, explaining the engineering reasoning behind configuration decisions, and training users. This role is based in our **New York City or Pittsburgh office**, with **25% to 50% travel to customer sites**. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Serve as the technical point of contact across a portfolio of customer sites, leading configuration, deployment, and user training. * Ensure every deployment meets customer expectations and agreed product requirements. Define and track success metrics and support adoption. * Resolve configuration and deployment issues, keeping customers informed and involving Engineering or the commercial team when appropriate. * Deliver product demonstrations, user training, and structured feedback sessions. * Launch new customer sites from kickoff through go\-live, coordinating requirements, timelines, and risks while improving deployment playbooks. * Configure the software and build and validate each site’s asset data against plant engineering documentation so the platform accurately reflects the facility. * Apply and refine tagging conventions, naming standards, and asset data taxonomy, resolving inconsistencies so every site is built consistently. * Test configurations and workflows across development and production environments, report software issues with clear reproduction steps, and verify deployment quality before customer milestones. * Use plant systems knowledge to validate software outputs, investigate incorrect or misleading results, and explain the reasoning behind configuration choices. * Turn field learnings into clear, prioritized feedback and serve as a resource on plant systems and operations for the software engineering team. **About You / Required Skills** ------------------------------- * 5\+ years in industrial operations, maintenance, or plant systems work, including experience where data accuracy was non\-negotiable. * Fluency in reading engineering drawings and explaining system function, design intent, and operating considerations to guide accurate software configuration. * Experience building or maintaining accuracy\-critical plant data: CMMS or EAM master data (SAP PM, Maximo, JDE, or similar), DCS\-to\-historian tag mapping, loop\-check or instrument index verification. * Experience integrating large\-scale industrial software: SCADA/HMI platforms, data historians, or plant information systems. * Strong attention to detail when checking equipment tags, asset relationships, and software configurations against plant documentation. * A thorough approach to investigating discrepancies, understanding their causes, and correcting them or involving the right team. * Strong organization across multiple customer deployments, including tracking requirements, milestones, follow\-ups, and risks through completion. * Sound judgment when working with incomplete information, asking focused questions, and explaining the reasoning behind configuration decisions. * Clear communication with plant operators, engineers, and corporate leaders, including knowing when to involve Engineering or the commercial team. * Willingness to use AI tools to support daily work and verify their outputs for accuracy. * Ability to travel 25% to 50% of the time to customer sites. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Background working directly with industrial customers through deployment, field service, applications engineering, account management, or technical training. * Hands\-on field experience in equipment maintenance, troubleshooting, or system walkdowns using P\&IDs and electrical one\-lines. * Ability to write code or control logic and explain how components interact within complex systems and where problems can arise. **Who We Are** ============== At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender\-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off. Gecko values collaboration, innovation, and partnership, and we believe we do our best work when we're together in person. We’re an office\-first culture but understand that sometimes you may need to work from home. Many people are in the office five days a week, others need a bit more flexibility. Ultimately, we care about the outcomes we achieve \- and creating a culture of autonomy and trust that enables that impact. Gecko is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission to protect today’s infrastructure and give form to tomorrow’s. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our critical mission, we’d love to hear from you. Compensation Range: $225K \- $290K

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Supervisor
jobs.description: #### **About GenScript** Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well\-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions. **Position Overview:** We are seeking a results\-driven and people\-focused **Continuous Improvement Supervisor** to oversee our **manufacturing floor**. In this role, you will manage a dedicated team of technicians and production personnel, drive daily execution while fostering a high\-retention, supportive team culture. The primary focus of this position is **direct, manufacturing team management** and field management rather than project\-heavy initiatives. The ideal candidate blends experience in field management, manufacturing experience, exceptional people management skills with practical Lean experience—keeping the floor running smoothly, maintaining high team morale, and leveraging Lean methodologies to drive continuous process improvements across our laboratory operations. As a core driver of lean management, the Lean Supervisor is responsible for enhancing production operational efficiency, reducing waste, and optimizing processes through systematic metrics control, project implementation, lean training, and activity planning. This role requires aligning with company strategy to implement the lean management system, coordinating cross\-departmental resources, and achieving continuous improvement in key areas such as cost, quality, and delivery. The estimated salary range is $80,000 \- $100,000, depending on experience. ### **Qualifications \& Requirements** * **Experience:** + **Direct On\-Site Team Management:** Minimum of **3\+ years** of hands\-on floor team management experience in a manufacturing or production setting. * **Leadership Track Record:** Demonstrated success managing teams of 10\+ associates with a strong record of staff retention, conflict resolution, and driving a positive team culture. * **Lean Expertise:** Solid understanding and practical application of continuous improvement manufacturing principles applied directly to daily shop\-floor production operations. * **Communication:** Strong communication skills with the ability to manage up to factory leaders and support hands\-on floor personnel effectively. **On\-Site Team Leadership \& Retention (Primary Focus)** * Direct, mentor, and manage a team of 10–12 technicians and floor specialists on the production floor. * Cultivate an engaging, supportive workplace culture that minimizes turnover and drives high employee retention. * Conduct regular performance reviews, feedback sessions, and skill matrix development for floor staff. * Balance workload distribution, shift handovers, and resource management to keep the team engaged and working effectively. **Floor Operations \& Factory Alignment** * Supervise daily molecular biology production lines, ensuring output targets, safety guidelines, and quality compliance (ISO/GMP) are consistently met. * Act as the key operational bridge between floor technicians, cross\-functional teams, and factory management. * Troubleshoot daily operational bottlenecks, equipment availability, and material supply to prevent downtime on the floor. **Lean \& Continuous Improvement (Secondary Focus)** * Utilize Lean tools and methodologies (5S, Gemba walks, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis) to streamline workflow efficiency and reduce waste on the floor. * Facilitate continuous improvement initiatives directly on the floor alongside technicians and factory managers without disrupting active production output. **Requirements:** **Professional Background:** * Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in Industrial Engineering (IE), Mechanical Engineering, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Manufacturing, or related fields. * Certification in lean production, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above preferred). * Leading or assisting in cross\-departmental lean improvement projects (e.g., 5S, TPM, VSM, SMED, standardized work). **Core Competencies:** * Data Analysis: Proficient in using Excel and other data analysis tools to identify improvement opportunities. * Project Management: Experienced in cross\-departmental collaboration and adept at driving project implementation. * Communication and Training: Clear logic and structured expression skills. * Tool Application: Proficient in using lean tools like A3 reports, standardized work, ECRS. \#LI\-EB1 \#GS **Benefits:** Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as a 401(k) retirement plan with a company match that vests fully on day one. We offer paid parental leave after just three (3\) months of employment, and a paid time off policy that includes vacation time, personal time, sick time, floating holidays, and company holidays. Additional benefits include flexible spending and health savings accounts, life and AD\&D insurance, short\- and long\-term disability coverage, legal assistance, and supplemental plans such as pet, critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance. We also provide commuter benefits, well\-being initiatives, and peer\-to\-peer recognition programs; demonstrating our ongoing commitment to building a culture where our people feel empowered, supported, and inspired to do their best work. GenScript USA Inc/ProBio Inc. is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to attracting, retaining, and maximizing the performance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the Company's policy to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status, uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description: **We believe power is a promise \- a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.** ===================================================================================================== For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future. Develop OT disaster recovery and business continuity plans. * **Minimum Job Requirements:** **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Industrial Technology, or related technical field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant manufacturing OT experience may be considered. * **Work Experience** * 5\+ years of experience supporting Operational Technology (OT), Cloud Infrastructure, Manufacturing Systems, or Industrial IoT environments. * Experience with industrial control systems including PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, and machine communications. * Experience supporting manufacturing networks and industrial connectivity solutions. * Experience building and supporting secure cloud compute for OT environments. * Experience integrating equipment, sensors, and manufacturing systems using industrial communication protocols. Experience collaborating across Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, IT, and Cybersecurity teams. * **Knowledge / Skills / Abilities** * Experience with AWS IoT, AWS SiteWise, Greengrass, S3, Lambda, or similar cloud platforms. * Knowledge of OT cybersecurity frameworks such as ISA/IEC\-62443 or NIST. * Knowledge of predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, or reliability engineering programs. Knowledge of MES, ERP, historian, or industrial data platform integrations. * **Working knowledge of** * PLC\-based manufacturing systems * Industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCP) * OPC\-UA and/or MQTT communications Manufacturing data collection systems * **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. jobs.title: AI enabled Device Modeling Engineer
jobs.description: About GlobalFoundries GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com. Career Opportunity This role offers the opportunity to apply advanced AI/ML methods to semiconductor device\-modeling challenges within a cross\-functional technology\-development environment. The engineer will work with device physicists, compact\-modeling experts, characterization engineers, PDK developers, and circuit designers to create scalable, production\-relevant modeling solutions. Summary of Role GlobalFoundries is seeking a Level 6 AI\-Enabled Device Modeling Engineer with strong artificial intelligence, machine\-learning, and scientific\-computing skills. The engineer will independently develop and deploy AI\-enabled methods that combine device physics, measured silicon data, compact\-model simulations, and TCAD results to accelerate model extraction, improve predictive accuracy, and create scalable modeling workflows for CMOS, cryogenic, photonic, superconducting, and other emerging devices. **Essential Responsibilities** Develop, optimize, and validate machine\-learning methods for semiconductor device modeling, including parameter extraction, surrogate modeling, model calibration, inverse modeling, and prediction of device characteristics. Build reproducible data pipelines that combine measured device data, compact\-model simulations, TCAD results, and relevant process or test metadata. Train, validate, and compare AI/ML models using appropriate baselines, holdout datasets, error metrics, uncertainty analysis, and physics\-based constraints. Apply methods such as neural networks, Gaussian processes, optimization, sensitivity analysis, and physics\-informed machine learning to device\-modeling problems. Automate model fitting, feature extraction, hyperparameter optimization, regression testing, visualization, and reporting using Python\-based workflows. Work with device, characterization, compact\-modeling, PDK, EDA, and circuit\-design teams to translate technical requirements into usable AI\-enabled modeling solutions. Document datasets, assumptions, model architecture, training methods, validation results, limitations, and recommended usage to support traceability and knowledge transfer. Lead focused proof\-of\-concept demonstrations and transition successful AI/ML methods into maintainable device\-modeling and design\-enablement workflows with appropriate testing, documentation, and stakeholder review. **Other Responsibilities** Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety \& Security requirements and programs. Work and collaborate on other projects and/or assignments as needed. **Required Qualifications** Education \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Physics, Physics, or a related field. Experience \- Typically 3\-5\+ years of relevant experience in machine learning, scientific computing, semiconductor device modeling, computational physics, or a related field. Final experience requirements will be aligned with GF Level 6 scoping guidelines. Strong Python programming skills and experience with common scientific and machine\-learning libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. Understanding of supervised learning, regression, neural networks, model validation, overfitting, uncertainty, and quantitative performance evaluation. Working knowledge of semiconductor device physics and transistor electrical behavior, with demonstrated ability to apply AI methods to scientific or engineering modeling problems. Experience developing reproducible workflows for structured scientific or engineering datasets, including data preparation, visualization, feature engineering, model training, validation, and performance monitoring. Ability to independently execute technical assignments, communicate results clearly, and collaborate across AI, device, modeling, characterization, PDK, and design teams. Travel \- Up to 10%. Fluency in English \- written and verbal. **Preferred Qualifications** Industry, research, or advanced academic experience applying AI/ML to semiconductor devices, electronic design automation, scientific machine learning, or computational physics. Experience with physics\-informed neural networks, differentiable programming, Bayesian optimization, Gaussian processes, active learning, or uncertainty quantification. Exposure to compact transistor models, SPICE simulation, parameter extraction, TCAD, cryogenic device behavior, photonic devices, superconducting devices, or quantum hardware. Experience using experiment tracking, version control, testing, or reproducibility tools such as Git, MLflow, Weights \& Biases, containers, or automated workflows. Experience with Linux environments, high\-performance computing, GPU acceleration, cloud computing, or large\-scale simulation and training datasets. Ability to balance predictive performance with physical consistency, interpretability, robustness, and computational efficiency. Demonstrated technical contribution through deployed software, patents, publications, conference presentations, open\-source work, or interdisciplinary engineering projects. Project management skills, including the ability to innovate, execute solutions that matter, and navigate ambiguity. Strong written and verbal communication skills and strong planning and organizational skills. **Expected Salary Range** $69,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location. jobs.description: About GlobalFoundries GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. The engineer will work closely with technical experts in PDK development who will provide domain expertise across LVS, DRC, PEX, OPC, and Design Manual development. The role will apply Python, machine learning, large language models, code generation, natural\-language processing, and software\-development practices to improve efficiency and quality for advanced CMOS, cryogenic, quantum, photonic, and heterogeneous\-integration technologies. Semiconductor or prior PDK experience is beneficial but not required. **Essential Responsibilities** Develop, implement, test, maintain, and support PDK code and rule content for layout\-versus\-schematic (LVS), design\-rule checking (DRC), parasitic extraction (PEX), optical proximity correction (OPC), and associated Design Manual requirements. Apply AI\-guided methods to generate, translate, review, debug, optimize, and regression\-test rule\-deck code under established expert review, traceability, and release controls. Implement, test, and support automated pipelines that convert approved process and design requirements into structured rules, test cases, documentation, and quality evidence. Contribute to the development and maintenance of representative positive and negative test layouts, golden reference results, coverage metrics, and regression suites for physical\-verification and extraction deliverables. Use machine learning, natural\-language processing, code\-generation techniques, and data analytics to identify rule gaps, inconsistencies, duplicate content, likely failure modes, and opportunities for development acceleration. Analyze and correlate PEX and OPC outputs with silicon, process, metrology, electromagnetic, and simulation data as applicable, and contribute improvements to model and rule fidelity across relevant operating conditions. Implement, test, document, and support deliverables within commercial EDA environments and PDK release flows, using version control, continuous integration, issue tracking, change management, and release documentation. Collaborate with process integration, device, modeling, mask, lithography, design enablement, PDK, EDA, and circuit\-design teams to translate technology requirements into accurate, maintainable, and customer\-usable design collateral. **Other Responsibilities** Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety \& Security requirements and programs. Work and collaborate on other projects and/or assignments as needed. **Required Qualifications** Education \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Microelectronics, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. Experience \- Relevant experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, software engineering, data science, automation, or a closely related field. jobs.title: Manufacturing Documentation Engineer
jobs.description: Join HARTING! A leader in connectivity products and custom solutions….. The **Manufacturing Documentation Engineer** creates, maintains, controls, and continuously improves technical documentation supporting manufacturing operations. The role works directly with Manufacturing Engineering, Production, Quality, Maintenance, Automation, technicians, and operators to convert technical knowledge and shop\-floor processes into clear, standardized, and easy\-to\-follow work instructions, procedures, and records. A key responsibility is ensuring manufacturing documentation is accurate, properly approved, revision\-controlled, readily available at the point of use, and updated when processes, equipment, or requirements change. **To succeed in this role, you will be highly driven to:*** Create, maintain, and revise manufacturing work instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs), setup instructions, process guides, troubleshooting guides, checklists, forms, and related technical documentation. * Observe manufacturing processes directly on the shop floor and work with engineers, technicians, operators, supervisors, and other subject\-matter experts to capture the actual process and translate technical knowledge into clear instructions. * Create practical visual instructions using photographs, diagrams, screenshots, tables, drawings, and other technical information to improve usability for production and technical personnel. * Maintain document revision control, revision history, approval status, release status, distribution, and archival; ensure obsolete or superseded versions are removed from active use or clearly controlled. * Ensure current approved documentation is available at the point of use and maintain consistent document naming, numbering, templates, formatting, and storage conventions. * Maintain and organize manufacturing and engineering records such as equipment manuals, technical drawings, machine and tooling documentation, preventive\-maintenance instructions, troubleshooting guides, training materials, and engineering standards. * Review existing documentation for accuracy, completeness, usability, and alignment with the current manufacturing process; identify missing, outdated, duplicate, or conflicting documents and coordinate corrections with the responsible subject\-matter expert. * Perform periodic documentation audits and shop\-floor checks, track identified gaps or corrective actions to closure, and support retrieval of controlled documentation for internal or external audits. * Support new machines, tooling, automation, process changes, continuous\-improvement activities, and production transfers by creating or updating required manufacturing documentation before production release. * Partner with process owners to standardize documentation across Manufacturing Engineering and support operator and technician training or onboarding materials when documentation changes. * Maintain effective electronic document repositories and support document\-change workflows using company\-approved systems such as Microsoft SharePoint or other document\-management platforms. * Drive documentation tasks to completion while ensuring technical process content is reviewed and approved by the appropriate Engineer, Quality representative, Technician, or designated subject\-matter expert. **Skills and experience to thrive in this role:*** Engineering Degree or similar background * 2\+ years of experience in manufacturing, technical documentation, document control, engineering support, production, maintenance, quality, or a related technical environment preferred. * Experience creating or maintaining work instructions, SOPs, technical procedures, process documentation, or training materials strongly preferred. * Working knowledge of revision control, document lifecycle practices, controlled\-document repositories, and change/approval workflows. * Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint or comparable document\-management systems. * Ability to understand manufacturing processes, equipment, technical drawings, manuals, and other production\-related technical information. * Experience in injection molding, automated assembly, industrial automation, maintenance, or other discrete manufacturing environments is a plus. * Equivalent relevant experience and demonstrated expertise may substitute for preferred education. *HARTING Americas is a subsidiary of HARTING Technology Group, a German\-based global leader in industrial connectivity solutions. We develop, manufacture, and sell the world's most durable and reliable products and solutions for use in Machinery \& Robotics, Automation Devices, Rail \& Transportation, Intralogistics \& Conveyor Systems, Energy, and Datacenter market segments.**As a third generation, family\-owned company, with over 75 years of history, we continue to create value and shape the future with technologies for people. You will discover that we work hard – to fulfill our personal, company, and customer goals, and in our commitment to our community with our holiday drives and our paid VTO (Voluntary Time Off). You will also discover that we like to have fun – like when we celebrate the holidays, host theme days and sweater parties, prost to Oktoberfest, and much more!* *Visit us on LinkedIn!* HARTING USA offers an attractive total compensation package and employee benefits, including: Compensation:* HARTING's Total Compensation Structure includes a Base Salary and Bonus Percentage. * Competitive salary: $70,000 \- $80,000 (commensurate with experience) * This role is eligible for a 5% discretionary annual bonus. Benefits:* 21 days PTO (Paid Time Off) to start – quickly earn more PTO as you stick with us (36 days max). * Medical, dental, and vision Insurance – several Blue Cross Blue Shield plan options to choose from. * Company\-sponsored life, AD\&D, and short\- and long\-term disability – at no cost to employee. * Paid parental leave, tuition and fitness reimbursement. * 401(k) with a 4% dollar\-for\-dollar match – fully vested upon eligibility!

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $230K – $340K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus *Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in our equity plan and benefits program. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.* **Why Harvey** ============== At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= As a Member of Technical Staff, Data \& Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post\-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts. We recently post\-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post\-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high\-bar team of hands\-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work. We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements. Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research. **What You'll Do** ================== * Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows. * Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail. * Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product\-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows. * Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation. * Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination. * Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most. * Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions. **What You Have** ================= * Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production\-quality code. * A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead. * The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria. * Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LLM work. We are hiring for this role across multiple levels. **Compensation** ================ $230,000 \- $340,000 USD ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices** **here****.** \#LI\-DZ1 *Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.* We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

jobs.title: Director of AI Strategy & Adoption
jobs.description: Hazen is hiring a Director of AI Strategy \& Adoption to make AI a routine part of how we design, deliver and run water projects. You will build and lead a team that works with scientists and engineers to develop strategic AI solutions for some of the most challenging problems in the water industry. Hazen and Sawyer is a privately held, employee\-owned engineering firm of roughly 2,500 people, focused exclusively on the water industry. Our work is technical, regulated and high\-stakes, so AI here has to be accurate, defensible and useful to licensed engineers, not just impressive in a demo. This is a senior leadership role. You will work with management to develop the direction for AI across the firm, build and lead the team and governance around it, and turn pilots into daily practice for thousands of people across technical practices, project delivery and corporate functions. **Work Setting:** In\-office position with a hybrid schedule and periodic travel to other offices and client sites. **Why Hazen and Sawyer:** * Founded in 1951 by the son of Allen Hazen (developer of the Hazen\-Williams equation), we are an employee\-owned company with a singular focus on ***"all things water."*** * Our work includes planning, design, and oversight of construction of environmental infrastructure – for water, wastewater, and stormwater management. * We foster a work environment that encourages creativity and professional development by minimizing bureaucracy. * We recruit talented professionals, provide them with challenging, interesting, and creative assignments, and furnish them with the tools they need to succeed. * We currently have over 2,000 employees in 70\+ offices throughout the United States, Latin America, Canada, and the UK. **Key Responsibilities:** *Strategy and roadmap** Develop Hazen's multi\-year AI vision and roadmap, tied to firm strategy, client value and employee\-ownership goals. This will require coordinating across groups and soliciting input from technical and business user groups and the Board. * Prioritize use cases by value, risk and effort, and make recommendations as to what to build, buy or partner on. * Track the fast\-moving AI landscape and brief executives and the Board on what matters for Hazen. This includes tracking and reporting on developments in the: legal, procurement, ethical and public acceptance realms. *Adoption and change management* * Lead firm\-wide adoption of AI tools, with practice\-level champions, training, and clear guidance on when and how to use them. Collaborate with Communications to develop relevant campaigns * Work with practice leaders, corporate service directors and project managers to embed AI in proposals, design, QA/QC, reporting and project controls. * Gather feedback and real examples from practitioners, and act on what you learn. *Implementation and platforms* * Direct the selection, configuration and further rollout of enterprise AI platforms (such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude) and the integrations that connect them to Hazen's data and systems, partnering with Legal and IT to ensure AI tools access only data and systems they are permitted to use. * Partner with IT, cybersecurity and enterprise software teams on architecture, identity, data access and cost management. * Oversee custom AI solutions and agents for engineering and business workflows, from prototype to supported production service. *Governance, risk and responsible use* * Recommend refinements to AI policy, and develop an approved\-use framework and an intake process for new tools and use cases. * Identify and escalate AI\-related confidentiality, client data, intellectual property, professional liability and contractualrisks, in partnership with Legal, Risk and the Director of Information Technology. * Set standards for human review of AI output, so licensed engineers remain accountable for sealed work. *Team and partners* * Build and lead a small, high\-caliber AI team, and extend it through vendors, academia and industry peers. * Represent Hazen externally on AI with clients, regulators and professional bodies. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, data science or a related field; advanced degree preferred. * 10\+ years of experience in technology, data or digital leadership, including leading enterprise AI or machine learning programs from strategy through deployment. * A record of driving adoption at scale: you have changed how a large, professional workforce works, not only built tools. * Working knowledge of generative AI, large language models, agents, retrieval and evaluation methods, and enterprise AI platforms. * Experience with AI governance, data security and responsible\-use frameworks in a regulated or professional\-services setting, including data access controls and client data restrictions. * Strong executive communication: you can explain trade\-offs to the Board and to a skeptical senior engineer in the same day. * Experience hiring, leading and developing technical teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Background in engineering, architecture or other professional services. * Deep familiarity with engineering practice and professional liability. * Experience with Microsoft 365 and Azure, and with BIM, GIS or hydraulic and process modeling tools. * Familiarity with the economics of an employee\-owned or partnership\-style firm. * Experience integrating AI with data platforms, document\-heavy workflows and project controls systems. **What We Offer:** * Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, and prescription plans) * Pre\-tax flexible spending plans for medical, dependent care, and transportation * Short and long\-term disability, and employer paid life insurance * Paid holidays, floating holidays, and paid time off (PTO) * Employer\-contributed 401(k) plan and additional financial planning support * Professional growth opportunities, including tuition reimbursement, in\-house training, and incentives for professional registration and professional organization memberships * Starting pay range for this position depends on skills, experience, education and geographical location \#li\-hybrid

jobs.title: Planner II
jobs.description: About Us: HBK Engineering, LLC is a fully licensed, professional engineering design firm headquartered in Chicago, IL with a staff approaching 700 individuals. HBK provides civil, environmental, structural, electrical, subsurface utility, construction support services and permitting facilitation. Since our founding in 1998, we have earned a reputation for delivering outstanding, accurate services in extremely time\-sensitive, multilayered environments. That "industry\-recognized" performance has propelled our expansion and the ability to provide engineering services in all 50 states. With 25 offices nationwide, including concentrations in the Midwest and on the Coasts, HBK brings together a dedicated team whose main focus is the design and protection of utilities and utility networks. We have successfully performed engineering work for a complete spectrum of utility infrastructure projects providing solutions and construction support from Coast to Coast in areas ranging from complex urban city centers, to rural greenfields, to limited access rights\-of\-way. In July 2020, HBK Engineering was acquired by Quanta Services. Quanta Services provides infrastructure services for electric power, pipeline, and communications industries and employees over 50,000 people. Quanta’s focus on the utility industry and HBK’s focus on constructability in our designs has made our integration into the Quanta family of companies seamless. About this Role: The position is a mid\-level experienced planning role requiring technical knowledge, project leadership, and cross\-functional collaboration. The role encompasses the management and production of overhead and underground distribution infrastructure projects. It requires an understanding of Distribution Design concepts, project types, and requirements for coordination with permitting, environmental, customer relations, governmental bodies, and various external organizations. This individual is considered knowledgeable and able to execute designs with little to no supervision. The individual is an execution on deliverables part of the planning team and is responsible for the accurate completion of multiple concurrent projects. jobs.title: Lead Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Hamilton Beach** Hamilton Beach Brands is a leading designer, marketer, and distributor of innovative household and commercial appliances trusted by consumers around the world. Founded in 1910 and headquartered in Glen Allen, Virginia, we develop and market a broad portfolio of products under well\-known brands including **Hamilton Beach®, Weston®, Lotus®, and Hamilton Beach Professional®**. For more than a century, our products have helped simplify everyday life – from preparing meals and beverages at home to supporting foodservice professionals in restaurants, hotels, and commercial kitchens. Our culture is guided by a shared set of values that shape how we work and make decisions every day: Customer Obsession, People, Good Thinking, Ethics, Passion for Quality, Embrace Change, Teamwork, and commitment to Our Environment and Community. At Hamilton Beach Brands, we look for people who are collaborative, curious, and motivated to make meaningful impact. **About the Role** We are seeking a **Lead Data Platform Engineer** to serve as the technical leader for our Data Analytics, Reporting \& AI Implementation team. You will own the Microsoft Fabric architecture build\-out as we modernize our legacy SQL Server environment using Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric. This is a role for an experienced data / platform engineer who builds hands\-on while mentoring and developing team members. The role leads the technical side of the Data Warehouse Modernization program alongside consulting partners, owns the reliability of existing production pipelines, and works AI\-first, using Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and MCP\-based tooling to multiply team output. This full\-time, hybrid position is based at our corporate headquarters in Glen Allen, Virginia, and reports to the Manager, Data Analytics, Reporting and AI Enablement. **Salary Range**: $116,000 \- $140,000 Annually **What You’ll Do*** **Lead data warehouse modernization.** direct contractor teams through converting legacy SSIS packages to T\-SQL and migrating workloads to Azure SQL and Azure Data Factory. Validate results with business teams before retiring existing processes. * **Build reliable data pipelines.** Develop solutions with T\-SQL, Python/PySpark, Azure Data Factory, and Microsoft Fabric. Use Azure Databricks for the most complex workloads. * **Shape HBB’s data architecture.** Build and govern Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers in Fabric and OneLake, including Azure SQL mirroring and repeatable ingestion patterns. Create a Gold Enterprise Data Warehouse with shared customer, item, and vendor dimensions to support trusted reporting and Master Data Management. * **Optimize platform performance and cost.** Choose the right processing tools for each workload, plan Fabric capacity, and protect reporting performance by separating heavy ETL processing. * **Lead and develop people.** Manage and mentor two Data Analysts through technical guidance, code reviews, and development plans. Strengthen the broader analytics team through shared standards, design reviews, and reusable solutions. * **Put AI into everyday engineering.** Use Claude and Claude Code for development, SSIS reverse\-engineering, troubleshooting, and documentation. Own HBB’s internal Claude access layer and build secure MCP servers and agentic workflows that connect AI tools to enterprise platforms. * **Keep business\-critical reporting running.** Own production pipelines supporting FP\&A, forecasting, supply chain, and sales across domestic and international operations, with dependable scheduled loads, monitoring, and alerting. * **Partner across IT and the business.** Work with Infrastructure, ERP, and Security teams to integrate ERP, WMS, planning, and third\-party data. Set priorities and acceptance criteria for consulting partners, review deliverables, and resolve technical blockers. * **Build governance into the platform.** Maintain architecture documentation, data lineage, runbooks, and data dictionaries. Establish access controls, Microsoft Entra ID security, certification, and consistent environment promotion standards. **What We’re Looking For*** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. Master’s degree preferred. * 7\+ years in data engineering, including at least 2 years in a lead, mentoring, or people management role. Consumer products, manufacturing, or supply chain experience preferred. * Expert T\-SQL skills, including views, stored procedures, and performance tuning, plus strong Python/PySpark skills and experience building and supporting production data pipelines. * Hands\-on experience with Azure SQL or SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, and Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Dataflow Gen2, OneLake, and Mirroring. Azure Databricks experience strongly preferred. * Strong experience with dimensional modeling and medallion Lakehouse architecture, including star schemas, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, and Delta tables. * Extensive hands\-on use of generative AI in engineering, experience building or operating MCP servers, and experience with Microsoft Copilot. Claude and Claude Code experience strongly preferred. **What We Offer** Hamilton Beach Brands offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your well\-being and long\-term success. Other offerings include: * Hybrid work schedule * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Company HSA contributions * 401(k) plan with immediate vesting * Profit sharing program * Paid vacation, holidays, and a paid charitable day * Summer hours to support work\-life balance * Employee discounts on Hamilton Beach products *Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.* Hamilton Beach Brands, Inc. is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **WHY HILLPOINTE?** *Hillpointe is a fully integrated real estate development and investment management firm focused on developing market\-rate workforce housing across the Sun Belt. Ranked at the top of NMHC's list of Builders and Developers, our team ensures best\-in\-class execution.* *Built on its long and proven track record of real estate development, the firm's investment approach is centered around its in\-house general contracting expertise, enabling direct control of cost and delivery timeframe. For each project, Hillpointe directly controls land acquisition, land development, construction, procurement of building materials, asset management, and capital markets. This is more than just a job \- it's a career\-defining opportunity! At Hillpointe, you'll be part of a dynamic, innovative team that has tangible impacts on day\-to\-day operations and contributes directly to overall success.* **Full Stack Developer** Hillpointe is hiring a Full Stack Developer to help build HPOS, the property management platform for our vertically integrated multifamily real estate business, from scratch. This is a greenfield engineering role. You will help establish the architecture, design the data model, ship the first services, and set the patterns the rest of the platform will inherit. Expect a zero\-to\-one cadence. Design an API contract in the morning, ship a Postgres migration before lunch, push a Bicep change to staging by end of day. We optimize for engineers who can hold the full stack in their head, make sound architectural decisions, and ship working software at pace. **The Role at a Glance:** * *Scope*: Schema to UI: Database design, API contracts, frontend components, infrastructure. No tier is off\-limits. * *Surface*: Greenfield build: Property management platform built from scratch. Multi\-tenant from day one. Operator tooling, leasing, accounting, capital markets. * *Cadence*: Zero to one: Trunk\-based development, short\-lived branches, feature flags, working software in staging on a daily rhythm. * *Impact*: Foundational: What you ship in the first year becomes how the platform works for the next ten. **Key Responsibilities:** * **React surfaces**: First\-generation operator and resident\-facing applications. React 18 with TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query v5, React Hook Form, Zod. Component composition against the PDS Foundation design system. The patterns set here will be inherited by every surface that follows. * **Service layer**: TypeScript services on Node 20 LTS with NestJS or Express. OpenAPI contracts shared with the front end through code generation. JWT and OAuth flows, RBAC enforcement, structured audit logs, request\-scoped tracing. The shared libraries that every future service will depend on. * **Postgres data model**: Multi\-tenant schema design on Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Tenant isolation strategy, normalization tradeoffs, index strategy from day one, audit trails baked into the data model. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Summary: As the Automation Engineer, you will be the onsite owner of the performance, reliability, and safety of the autonomous equipment at your assigned location, starting with the Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) fleet and expanding to other autonomous and automated systems as they are deployed. You will keep the fleet running during production, troubleshoot and resolve issues on the shop floor, manage fleet KPIs, and drive root cause corrective actions that increase productivity and equipment effectiveness. Working closely with equipment suppliers, maintenance, operations, and our customer, this role is the technical link between autonomous technology and day\-to\-day warehouse performance. Essential Duties:Essential job duties for this position include the following items. Other duties must be performed as assigned or required. Fleet Performance Monitoring and KPIs: Monitor daily performance of the AMR fleet and other autonomous equipment. Manage, measure, and report fleet KPIs such as availability, uptime, mission completion, error frequency, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE). Use performance data to identify trends, prioritize issues, and drive data\-driven improvements. Production Support and Recovery: Serve as the first line of technical support during production. Clear and recover robot emergency stops (e\-stops) and error states quickly and safely to minimize downtime and keep material flowing. Troubleshooting and Programming: Troubleshoot autonomous equipment issues on the shop floor, including but not limited to extracting and analyzing error logs, working with equipment suppliers to resolve technical issues, remapping, changing mission planning, and general robot programming. Software Upgrades and Site Map Management: Enable ongoing software upgrades across the robot fleet to ensure the most efficient and safest operation. Support site map updates as layouts, routes, and operational needs change. Coordinate with suppliers and operations to schedule and validate changes with minimal disruption to production. Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Action: Document the root cause of equipment failures and implement automation corrective actions for repeat failure modes. Drive continuous improvement in fleet productivity and OEE. Maintenance Coordination: Submit maintenance work orders for robot repairs and partner with the maintenance team to ensure timely resolution. Track repair history to inform root cause analysis and preventative maintenance needs. Training and Knowledge Transfer: Train shop floor support personnel on basic autonomous equipment troubleshooting and recovery. Develop and maintain work instructions and troubleshooting guides to build site capability. Safety and Compliance: Ensure a safe working environment by upholding safety protocols and promoting a safety\-first culture among all employees. Work with the production team to quickly address any safety incidents involving autonomous equipment and support engineered corrective actions. Partner with the safety team to stay up to date with industry regulations, compliance requirements, and mobile robot safety standards. Demonstrate HODGE Values: Model HODGE core values of Family, Integrity, Ambition, Respect, and Balance. Uphold, support, and promote all company policies and procedures. Demonstrate that success comes from treating people like family. Requirements: Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, the Automation Engineer must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The following requirements are representative of the minimum knowledge, skill and ability required. Education/Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Robotics, Automation, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering field required. 2\+ years of experience supporting automated equipment, robotics, AMRs/AGVs, or controls in a manufacturing, warehouse, or distribution environment. Experience with robot fleet management software, mission planning, and site mapping is a plus. Ability to read and interpret error logs, system diagnostics, and electrical/mechanical documentation. Basic understanding of industrial networking and wireless communications (Wi\-Fi, IP addressing) as they relate to autonomous equipment. Familiarity with mobile robot safety standards (e.g., ANSI/RIA R15\.08\) is a plus. Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with the ability to stay calm and act quickly in a live production environment. Knowledge of OEE and root cause analysis methodologies is a plus. Basic programming or scripting experience is a plus. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to train others and work effectively with suppliers, customers, and cross\-functional teams. Flexibility to support production outside of normal hours as needed. Commitment to promoting a positive workplace and safety\-first culture.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Minnesota \- ML Engineer #### **Hollstadt Overview** Hollstadt Consulting is a management and technology consulting firm dedicated to placing professionals at engagements where they will excel. When you work with us, you'll work with a refreshingly real company led and staffed by seasoned experts who are also down\-to\-earth, good people. We're committed to treating you with respect and helping you achieve your career aspirations. Since 1990, Hollstadt has been a trusted partner to more than 150 domestic and global companies and has successfully completed over 3,000 projects. Our continued growth has created challenging and rewarding opportunities for accomplished IT and Business Consultants. Hollstadt Consulting is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran. *By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI\-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Hollstadt Consulting and its affiliates, and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. You can reply STOP to cancel at any time.* **Job Description** **Role**: Senior Consultant, AI/ML Engineer **Location**: Remote **Duration**: 6 months to start **Rate**: $79\-$88/hour W2 **Description of work / project:** The AI CoE builds AI products and the shared platform that powers them. We're looking for a **Senior ML / AI Engineer** who is equally comfortable building models and building the platform around them: someone who can train and evaluate an ML model, ship a production LLM/GenAI application, and extend shared AI infrastructure and tooling that the wider team depends on. This is a senior builder role at the intersection of applied data science, GenAI application engineering, and AI platform engineering. Our work spans predictive modeling, LLM\-based systems, and the platform underneath them; you'll take problems from data and prototype through to governed, monitored production services, and set the technical patterns other engineers build on. Projects vary over time — we value engineers who can move across the stack rather than stay in one lane **Performance expectations:** * **Build ML models** — frame problems, engineer features, train and evaluate models (ranking, scoring, survival/time\-to\-event, classification, forecasting), and reason rigorously about metrics (AUC, C\-index, calibration), validation strategy, subgroup performance, and failure modes. * **Integrate models into decision systems** — combine model output with business/domain rules and LLM reasoning to produce explainable, trustworthy recommendations. * **Ship GenAI applications** — design and deploy LLM\-powered features: RAG pipelines, agents, structured extraction, summarization, decision\-reasoning trails, and evaluation harnesses using Claude/Bedrock and other models. * **Engineer the AI platform** — extend the shared AI gateway (unified multi\-model access, API keys, per\-team budgets, failover, observability) and reusable libraries/SDKs that other teams build on. * **Own the RAG/data layer** — embeddings, vector stores, retrieval quality, chunking, and grounding strategies; measure and improve retrieval and answer quality. * **Build evaluation \& quality tooling** — offline/online eval, LLM\-as\-judge, regression suites, statistical validation, and guardrails so model and prompt changes ship safely. * **Productionize** — wrap models and pipelines as tested, observable services (Python, containers, AWS Lambda/SageMaker/EKS), with monitoring for quality, cost, latency, and drift. * **Lead technically** — set patterns and standards, review designs and code, mentor engineers, and partner with data scientists, MLOps, clinical/domain experts, and product owners to move prototypes to production. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years building and shipping ML / AI systems in production (not just notebooks/POCs), including technical leadership of non\-trivial projects. * Strong **data science / ML fundamentals** — feature engineering, model training and evaluation, metrics (AUC, C\-index, calibration, precision/recall), gradient\-boosted trees (XGBoost), and sound experimental methodology (validation strategy, subgroup analysis). * Experience building **ranking, scoring, or survival/time\-to\-event models**, and integrating model output into a larger decision system. * Hands\-on **GenAI / LLM engineering** — RAG, prompt engineering, function/tool calling, embeddings and vector search, and LLM evaluation. * Excellent **Python** — production\-grade, tested, well\-structured code; comfortable building APIs/services and shared libraries. * **AWS** experience — Bedrock and/or SageMaker, Lambda, S3, plus containers (Docker) and Git\-based workflows. * Solid software engineering practice: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD; ability to reason about cost, latency, and reliability of AI systems in production. **Preferred Qualifications** * **AI platform engineering** — building shared gateways/proxies, model routing, multi\-tenancy, quota/budget enforcement, or internal AI SDKs. * Experience with agent frameworks, real\-time/voice AI, or streaming inference. * Vector databases (Qdrant, OpenSearch, pgvector) and retrieval\-quality tuning at scale. * IaC (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry/CloudWatch), and FinOps for AI workloads. * **Healthcare / clinical ML** — survival analysis, outcome prediction, or working with clinical/scientific datasets alongside domain experts. * Serving models as endpoints (SageMaker), cross\-account inference, and train/serve parity. * Experience in a regulated / PHI\-handling environment (HIPAA) — data governance, PII handling, auditability. ### **Benefits \+ Perks** Comprehensive Benefit Plan Hollstadt offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, paid sick leave, and retirement benefits to eligible employees. With three different medical plans to choose from, you can enroll in the coverage you need from individual to family, or anywhere in between! Remarketing Process Hollstadt is based on retention and relationships. We get to know your strengths and career wishes throughout your assignment and then start remarket discussions 6\-8 weeks prior to your end date. By being proactive, we are able to keep your down time between assignments as short as possible, unless you choose otherwise. Professional Development Hollstadt offers on\-demand training through our consultant portal. Trainings give our consultants the continuing education they need to excel on their projects. Many of our courses apply towards continuing education credits and we have an entire training hub dedicated to upskilling in Artificial Intelligence (AI). 401k \+ Matching One popular benefit is our 401(k) match on the first 4% of your contributions. Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long\-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor. Bonus Opportunities We appreciate and reward loyalty. Join Hollstadt, stay for 5 years, and we’ll give you a $5,000 Longevity Award bonus! Additionally, we know great talent knows other great talent. If you are on contract with Hollstadt and refer one of your connections who gets placed, we’ll pay you $1,000! Ongoing Support \& Networking We have made a significant investment in building a support program for our consultant team \- so you never have to feel like you are going it alone. We also have a Consultant Coach program which acts like a 'work buddy' to provide a safe ear for questions or concerns at your client site.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Device Security
jobs.description: Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially\-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 \- our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments \- and we’re growing the team to take it even further. **About the Role** ================== We’re looking for a **Software Engineer II** to join our Platform Infrastructure team in San Diego. You’ll help build the software and tools that enable our robots to run trusted software on trusted hardware, working with security, firmware, and platform engineers across the device lifecycle. **What You'll Do** ================== * Build and maintain software and tools for trusted boot and device provisioning, working with NVIDIA secure boot and UEFI. For example, you might help bring up a secure boot flow on a new device or build tooling to provision and verify device credentials. * Contribute to device trust and key protection using hardware roots of trust, including Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs), and security technologies such as ARM TrustZone. * Contribute to device key management though the use of Hardware Security Modules (HSMs). * Write, test, and debug software and scripts in Linux, and investigate issues across software and hardware. * Identify and reduce attack surfaces across device software, boot flows, and supporting tools. * Collaborate with security, firmware, cloud, manufacturing, and other engineering teams through design discussions, code reviews, and documentation; own well\-scoped projects from design through implementation and testing, with input from experienced teammates. **What You Bring** ================== You’re a curious, collaborative engineer who takes ownership, works through unfamiliar problems, and wants to deepen your skills in device security. You’ll bring: * **Software engineering experience** — Typically 1–3 years of full\-time experience building, testing, and maintaining production\-quality software, or equivalent experience. + You have a strong foundation in object\-oriented programming and software design. + You can read and reason about code, identify logic errors, and learn to contribute across C\+\+, Python, and Rust codebases + Prior experience in all three languages is not required. B.S. or M.S. in CS, CE, EE, or a related field. * **AI\-assisted development** — You’re comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools and can understand, review, and validate the code they produce. * **Security fundamentals** — Familiarity with authentication, encryption, cryptographic keys, and trust boundaries, and an interest in applying them to hardware devices. * **Linux and tooling** — Comfort working in Linux and using scripting languages such as Python or Bash to automate tasks, build tools, and investigate problems. * **Problem\-solving and collaboration** — A thoughtful approach to unfamiliar problems, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate clearly, seek feedback, and follow work through. * Experience with **key management** and/or NVIDIA platforms, such as Jetson, is a plus * Ability to work on\-site at our San Diego office. **What We Offer** ================= * Comprehensive health coverage for US‑based employees, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance, with virtual care and employee assistance resources. * Meaningful time off to rest and recharge: 23 days of PTO (accrued), separate sick leave, and paid company holidays. * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. * Equity included–we believe builders should share in what they build. * Free daily catered lunch, snacks, and drinks in‑office. * Collaboration with top‑tier engineers, researchers, and product experts in AI and robotics. * Freedom to influence the product and own key initiatives. *For this role in California, the expected base salary range is $123,000\-$154,000 USD per year; your placement in that range depends on how your experience maps to our internal leveling.*
