jobs.description: **Job Summary** At IGS Energy, we leverage Agile principles to rapidly deliver high quality software via close collaboration with stakeholders and iterative development. As a Software Engineering Lead on the Solar team, you will be involved in all phases of software development, from requirements definition through production releases and production support. You will be embedded in a cross\-functional team of analysts, product managers, and testing staff, collectively striving to quickly deliver high\-quality, high\-value software. We work in an environment that encourages individual initiative, leadership at all levels, and team\-based continuous improvement. In this role, you will balance hands\-on development with leading a team of engineers. You will have direct reports, you will stay in the code, and you will own what your team ships and how it runs in production. However, your most important responsibility will be building a team that emphasizes a culture of excellence, high performance, and continuous improvement. We are looking for someone who wants to grow other people's careers, drive technical change instead of waiting for it, bring new patterns into a mature codebase, and help our engineering organization embrace AI to deliver business value. **Responsibilities** * Guide and mentor a team of software engineers. Hold regular forward\-looking, big picture conversations with direct reports to facilitate career growth, give feedback, provide professional development opportunities, and help each person align their career goals with organizational objectives. * Provide strategic leadership for a product team, fostering team morale and soft\-skills development and collecting feedback from peers. * Grow the next lead and invest in junior engineers and interns. Delegate to develop people, then follow up. * Give direct feedback and have hard conversations. Avoidance is not an option. * Drive the hiring and onboarding of new software engineers. * Maintain the technical competence of at least a senior software engineer, continuing to design, code, review, test, and ship. As a lead, your leverage moves from volume of code to the hardest problems and the most consequential decisions. * Drive the architecture and technical direction of your product. Follow and help shape IGS patterns and standards, keep tech debt low, and push new patterns and technology when they solve real problems. * Ensure that quality standards and project milestones are met by the engineering team. * Own your monitoring and production support. Know your apps well enough to see problems before the business reports them, and when a bug does get out, own the fix and make sure it does not happen again. * Manage releases and hotfixes for your repos, including change management and rollback plans. * Be very close with your Product Manager. Partner on priorities, work breakdown, estimates, tech debt, and prod support, and give the team one clear message. * Leverage AI to deliver value and expect your team to do the same. Help build the shared tooling, context, and guardrails that turn individual gains into team gains. * Demonstrate the capacity to solve problems and empower team members to become problem solvers themselves. * Foster a collaborative culture based on IGS values, emphasizing "Goal over Role", and cultivate and uphold trust with team members, peers, and the organization as a whole. * Lead continuous improvement programs for sustainable long\-term growth. * Commitment beyond the standard work week is expected, for example, but not limited to, meeting deadlines, release nights, and the production support rotation. **Qualifications and Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience * 7\+ years of experience as a software engineer * Outstanding leadership, teamwork, mentorship, and development abilities, with experience leading, mentoring, or coaching engineers. A formal lead title is a plus, not a requirement, and strong senior engineers ready for the lead track are encouraged to apply. * A track record of shipping and supporting production systems, and of driving at least one meaningful technical change (a migration, a platform upgrade, or a new pattern the team adopted) * Enthusiastic self\-starter capable of quickly taking ownership of features, applications, and systems * Curious and humble, willing to dig in until you understand and to say "I was wrong" * Comfortable with shifting priorities and able to re\-plan without losing the team * Decisiveness, good judgment, analytical/math/strategic aptitude, and problem\-solving skills to act with authority and take risks in an environment with little direction from others * Thinks in systems, building signals for the things you cannot watch yourself * Excellent written and oral communication skills necessary to interface with and influence all levels of the organization * Knowledge of business analysis methodologies, procedures, and development tools * Very strong technical skills, specifically an in\-depth knowledge of C\#, SQL, and web frameworks * Deep understanding of application development, database design, and system design * Experience with messaging and event\-driven patterns (RabbitMQ) * Automated testing experience, including unit, integration/acceptance, and Playwright end\-to\-end tests * Experience with Git, Azure DevOps pipelines, and Octopus Deploy or similar * Experience with Application Insights and KQL, or comparable observability tooling * Experience working in React with TypeScript .NET, .NET Framework, Entity Framework, and SQL Server **Work Authorization:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the US on a full\-time basis. Unfortunately, a current or future need for sponsorship is not supported or available for this position. **Salary Range:** $110,850\.00 \- $177,360\.00* *This range reflects base pay only. Incentive earnings, like commissions or bonuses, are not included.* This role is also eligible for an annual incentive plan based on company performance.**How We Support Your Wellbeing:** ================================== Our employees are our most valuable asset. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to develop innovative, scalable digital solutions that enhance quality management and drive continuous improvement in a manufacturing environment. jobs.title: Sr. AI Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: The Sr. AI Software Engineer reports to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department, and has no direct reports. Be a part of a growing team that is directly impacting the way our business operates. In this role you embed with business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering. You are a consultant at the edge of our internal teams, helping to identify AI opportunities, define requirements, build prototypes, and ship governed, measurable AI agents into production. The primary duties include finding and scoping AI\-suited business problems; building and shipping production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms; baselining processes and measuring and reporting ROI before and after deployment; applying AI governance and compliance controls to every build; and converting repeat work into reusable patterns while raising AI fluency across the business teams this role supports. You bring information back to the CoE and deliver value to our business partners. If you love finding new challenges, showing people new was to solve problems, and to build and tinker while delivering critical business value continuously, this role is a perfect fit. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Embed within business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering to identify work that is repetitive, automatable, or bottlenecked. * Translate and communicate a business need into a written solution statement, success criteria, data requirements, and a documented recommendation on whether AI is the appropriate solution. * Build working prototypes to validate feasibility before committing to a full build. * Scope each opportunity appropriately, determining whether the right solution is a single\-purpose agent, an automated workflow, a multi\-tier agent system, or an existing approved vendor capability. * Build production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms, including assistant and agent frameworks, low\-code workflow automation, document intelligence, conversational and agent\-assist capabilities, and natural language analytics. * Design multi\-tier agent systems where an orchestration layer routes to specialized agents with scoped tools, defined boundaries, and a clean handoff to a human. * Integrate with business systems through approved connectors and MCP servers and support the approval process for new connectors when a use case requires one. * Hand off completed builds with documentation, a runbook, a named owner, and a business user able to operate the solution independently. * Baseline process performance prior to each build, capturing cycle time, volume, error and rework rates, handle time, and cost per unit as applicable. * Instrument deployed agents so that value is measured continuously rather than asserted once at launch. * Report outcomes honestly, including builds that did not deliver value and the resulting lessons learned. * Apply an ISO/IEC 42001 governance mindset to every build, including defined purpose, risk classification, data handling, human oversight, and evidence that controls operated as intended. * Define and implement governance, security, and compliance telemetry for each agent, covering tool calls, scope adherence, escalation and override rates, data access, output quality, and cost. * Build monitoring and alerting so drift, boundary violations, and unexpected spend are surfaced to an owner. * Operate within the AI Governance Committee process and the AI Acceptable Use Policy. * Report business team needs, governance friction points, recurring patterns, and tooling gaps back to the AI Center of Excellence. * Convert repeat builds into reusable patterns, templates, and starter kits for use by other consultants and delivery teams. * Run enablement sessions and working labs to raise AI fluency within the business teams this role supports. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science * AI Continuous learning certifications are a plus * 3\-6 six years of software engineering experience shipping and supporting production systems. * 2 \+years of hands\-on experience building AI solutions across assistants, agents, workflow automation, retrieval, and document processing. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership, taking a business idea from initial concept through requirements, prototype, and production use. * Ability to define and measure business value, including constructing a baseline, defending a measurement method, and communicating cost and benefit independently. * Working knowledge of at least one AI governance or management framework, such as ISO/IEC 42001 or NIST AI RMF, and the ability to convert it into implemented controls. * Experience instrumenting telemetry as part of the build process rather than after an incident. * Ability to work effectively within unfamiliar business functions, build credibility quickly, and influence stakeholders while building relationships. * Ability to learn and adapt to a changing AI platform and tooling landscape. * Financial services, healthcare, benefits administration, or other regulated industry experience preferred, particularly environments handling PII, PHI, or fiduciary data. * Process improvement experience preferred, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or process mining. * Fluency in low\-code automation platforms alongside code\-first development preferred. * Experience with contact center, claims, or back\-office operations technology preferred. * Experience developing internal enablement materials, documentation, or practitioner communities preferred. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Inspira provides industry\-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program. Compensation: $100,200\- $140,000 per year Additional Details : **Take the next step in your journey at Inspira Financial.** Guided by our mission to enable better health and greater wealth, we help businesses and individuals thrive today, tomorrow, and into retirement by strengthening and simplifying the health and wealth journey. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. Our growth and culture haven't gone unnoticed; we've been recognized on Crain's Fast 50 and Inc. 5000 for remarkable growth, and named to Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work and Gallagher's 2022 Best\-In\-Class Employer for our workplace culture and benefits. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI Solutions
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The AI Solutions \& Transformation team builds the engineering backbone that turns Intuit's commercial strategy into production AI systems — the agentic pipelines, creative tooling, and automation that let the business move at the speed AI now demands. As Principal, you own the engineering organization behind that work: you lead the broader product development team, and you're accountable for the technical direction, delivery quality, and growth of everyone building inside this team. This is not a maintain\-the\-roadmap role. The AI landscape this team builds against changes every quarter — sometimes every month — and the job is to build a team that treats that as normal rather than disruptive: ship something real, learn fast from what the model, the tooling, or the business actually needs, pivot without drama, and build again. You'll be the person who decides what's worth doubling down on, what gets killed, and how a group of engineers and engineering leads keeps shipping enterprise\-grade AI solutions while the ground underneath them keeps moving. You'll report into GBSG Commercial organization, and you'll work in close, daily partnership with the AI Solutions product management team, who own the product bets this engineering organization builds against. That means part of the job is translating between two worlds: you need enough technical depth to set direction, make build\-vs\-pivot calls, and earn credibility with your engineers — and enough business fluency to turn product management's priorities into a technical roadmap, and explain what the team is building, and why it matters, in terms a commercial, brand\-first audience immediately understands. **Responsibilities** ### **Lead the engineering organization** * Manage and grow a team of engineering contractors and FTEs to leading the product development squads building the team's AI systems. * Set the technical direction and engineering quality bar across the full AI Solutions \& Transformation portfolio. * Own the build\-pivot\-kill calls: decide where the team doubles down, where it cuts losses, and where it re\-architects as new models, tools, and business priorities emerge. * Build the org's structure and capacity plan so it can run multiple concurrent AI initiatives without you being the bottleneck. ### **Own delivery and impact** * Be accountable for the delivery, reliability, and quality of the AI systems your organization ships into production for the commercial business. * Turn ambiguity into an execution plan: take loosely defined, fast\-changing product priorities from the AI Solutions product management team and convert them into a staffed, sequenced build plan for your team. * Establish the operating cadence — planning, prioritization, and review — that keeps a fast\-iterating AI team shipping rather than thrashing. * Serve as the escalation point for technical, delivery, or resourcing issues that need a group manager's judgment and authority to unblock. ### **Partner across the business** * Partner day\-to\-day with the AI Solutions product management team as your primary counterpart — translating product priorities into a staffed technical roadmap, and surfacing technical tradeoffs, risk, and pivots back to them in terms they can act on. * Represent engineering to brand and other cross\-functional partners on progress, risk, and the pivots the team is making and why. * Build trust with non\-technical stakeholders by communicating clearly, not just correctly. ### **Build the practice** * Establish engineering practices suited to rapid AI iteration: fast experimentation, clear criteria for scaling or killing a bet, and reusable infrastructure so each new capability ships faster than the last. * Set the hiring bar and run the interview loop for engineers and engineering leads joining the team during a period of rapid growth and change. * Coach and develop the managers and leads on your team, including Ashton and Jaga, and own their performance and career growth. **Qualifications** **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time leading engineering managers or leads (Group Manager / Senior Manager level), not just individual contributors. * Hands\-on technical depth in modern AI and agentic systems — LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration and tool use, prompt engineering * A track record of shipping production AI systems, not demos or proofs of concept, under real delivery pressure. * Demonstrated comfort with fast, repeated iteration: building something, learning it's wrong, pivoting without losing the team's momentum, and building again. * Experience managing engineering within or adjacent to a commercial, brand, or marketing organization, with the ability to translate business and brand goals into technical execution. * Strong stakeholder management and the judgment to partner with senior, non\-technical executive leadership. * Experience scaling a technical practice: hiring, leveling, interview loops, and engineering standards. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience building enterprise\-grade AI solutions: RAG pipelines, multi\-agent systems, content generation, compliance/QA automation, or similar agentic tooling. * Background in fintech, SaaS, or brand/creative technology. * Experience leading a team through a significant strategic or organizational pivot. * Experience managing managers specifically, rather than only a team of individual contributors. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Come join the QuickBooks Workforce Solutions engineering team at Intuit as a Staff Software Engineer. Our platforms power payroll and workforce experiences for millions of small businesses and the people who work for them, and they have to be fast, reliable, and correct at every scale. We are looking for an engineer who has designed and operated large\-scale, highly available distributed systems, and who has built real AI/ML and agentic experiences in production, not just experimented with them. You will shape the technical direction of how our platform scales and how AI agents safely automate workflows for customers and internal teams, and you will help expose our capabilities to Intuit's AI assistants and partner agent platforms. accurately scope effort, identify risks, and communicate trade\-offs. * Act as the technical go\-to person for your area; diagnose and resolve complex, cross\-system production issues. * Mentor engineers on technology, design, and operational excellence, and raise the team's skill in distributed systems and applied AI. * Influence product and technology direction with data; Our voice, SMS and workflow agents collect payments, answer borrower questions and qualify loan inquiries, working on top of the systems lenders already run, such as ICE MSP, rather than replacing them. We're a San Francisco team backed by Insight Partners, Y Combinator, Commerce Ventures and Fifth Wall, and we closed a $24M Series A in September 2026\. You'll report to the CEO and own every customer deployment end to end. You'll lead forward deployed engineers, deployment PMs and process specialists who embed with lending operations teams, scope workflows, integrate with core systems and get agents into production safely. As we scale across banks and financial institutions globally, you'll turn bespoke rollouts into a repeatable deployment engine. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and scale the deployments org.** Hire, develop and retain forward deployed engineers, deployment PMs and lending process specialists. Set the hiring bar and team structure as we grow from a handful of deployments to dozens running at once. * **Own delivery for every customer.** Be accountable for time\-to\-live, quality and adoption at each bank, credit union, lender and servicer. Run kickoffs, scoping, integration, UAT and go\-live, and step in personally on the hardest accounts. * **Make deployments repeatable.** Turn one\-off rollouts into playbooks, reusable integration patterns (servicing cores, LOS, dialers, CRMs) and tooling that cut deployment time with each customer. * **Get compliance right from day one.** Partner with customers' risk, compliance and InfoSec teams on vendor reviews, model risk management and consumer protection rules (TCPA, FDCPA/Reg F, UDAAP) so agents launch safely and audit\-ready. * **Feed the product roadmap.** Turn what you learn in the field into clear product requirements. Work closely with Engineering and Product on what becomes platform versus what stays custom. * **Partner with Sales and Customer Success.** Join late\-stage deals to scope solutions credibly, define clean handoffs from sale to deployment to ongoing success, and help expand accounts after launch. * **Bring operational rigor.** Define engagement models and deployment pricing, plan capacity for a scarce team, track deployment metrics, and report customer outcomes to leadership and in customer QBRs. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 8\+ years in technical, customer\-facing roles, with 4\+ years leading deployment, solutions engineering, professional services or implementation teams * A track record of building a team or service line from early stage and scaling it through rapid growth * Hands\-on experience deploying enterprise software into regulated environments, ideally banks, lenders, mortgage servicers or other financial institutions * Strong technical depth: APIs, system integrations, data pipelines and the SDLC, enough to unblock engineers and earn trust from customer IT teams * Working knowledge of LLMs, AI agents or conversational AI, and sound judgment on where they work in production and where they don't * Commercial instincts: you've scoped and priced services work and supported complex enterprise sales cycles * Clear communicator who can run a room with a bank COO one day and debug an integration with an engineer the next **Nice to have** * Domain knowledge of consumer lending operations: servicing, collections, loss mitigation or originations * Experience with servicing and lending systems such as ICE MSP, Black Knight, Encompass or similar cores * Background with voice or contact\-center technology * Prior early\-stage startup experience We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **Kiavi is one of the nation's largest private lenders to residential real estate investors (REIs). We harness the power of data \& technology to offer our customers a simpler, more reliable, and faster way to access the capital they need to scale their businesses.** Formerly known as LendingHome, we're committed to helping REIs revitalize the approximately $25 trillion worth of aged U.S. housing stock to provide move\-in ready homes and rental housing for millions of Americans across the country. Combining our technology and industry expertise, Kiavi has grown to a team of over 500 and has won many awards over the years including Forbes Fintech 50, Finovate Awards, Best Digital Mortgage Platform, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and many more. * **Loans Funded:** $30 billion in loans funded * **Homes financed:** 100,000\+ projects funded for our customers across the country * **Geography:** 49 states \+ D.C. where we lend to REIs so they can revitalize neighborhoods * **Employees:** Over 500 employees with competitive benefits and perks **This position can be based remotely in any of our approved hiring regions. Our hybrid distributed workforce philosophy allows us to find the best talent in the country and build diverse teams, while allowing our colleagues to work from the location that works best for them.** **Identity Verification Notice:**To ensure the security and integrity of our hiring process, all candidates are required to complete a secure identity verification. This process uses biometric and device validation to confirm identity and liveness. All data is handled securely in accordance with our privacy policy. We're looking for a Product Manager to own the systems that keep Kiavi's loans running after they close: servicing, payments and money movement, valuations, and the vendor integrations behind them. Our internal teams (Servicing, Treasury, Capital Markets, and Operations) are your customers, and the borrowers they serve feel every improvement you ship. You'll own end\-to\-end execution across several products at once, work independently day to day, and partner with product leadership on the broader roadmap. #### **You get to:** * Own the back office: Drive products that move real money and real loans: borrower payments, bank account verification, appraisals and inspections, and the data feeds our capital and servicing partners depend on. * Execute end\-to\-end: Take projects from early conception through design, development, launch, and post\-launch measurement. * Automate with AI and modern tooling: Find where automation and AI can take manual work off our operations teams, and where a simpler software fix is the better answer. * Collaborate \& facilitate: Collaborate with a dedicated engineering team, driving requirements and engineering prioritization. * Scale impact: Manage multiple products in different phases of their lifecycle in parallel, from new integrations to keep\-the\-lights\-on improvements. #### **What you would do:** * Roadmap \& backlog: Turn internal and borrower pain points into a prioritized roadmap. Balance new initiatives with production support and operational improvements, and keep a live, refined backlog. * Money movement \& integrations: Partner with Treasury and engineering on bank and payment integrations (ACH, wires, account verification), and with vendors on appraisal, inspection, insurance, and servicing data feeds. Attention to detail is critical as a small mistake means a bounced payment or money movement issue. * Operational excellence: Triage production support issues to tell real bugs from expected behavior, find the root cause, and turn recurring manual workarounds into product improvements. * AI product development: Identify where AI meaningfully beats traditional software for our operations teams, and navigate edge cases, accuracy, and adoption. * Data \& metrics: Use data to size problems, model ROI, and define and track success metrics for your areas, including operational metrics such as automation rates, error rates, and time saved. * Cross\-functional leadership: Lead Servicing, Treasury, Capital Markets, Compliance, and Operations stakeholders toward a shared roadmap, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly. #### **What you bring:** * Experience: 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product management or a related field. You've completed multiple release cycles and product lifecycles as a PM. * Domain knowledge: A good understanding of lending, real estate, and industry dynamics. Experience with loan servicing, payments, or financial operations is a strong plus. * Technical fluency: Comfortable working closely with engineers on integrations, data models, and APIs, and able to read data well enough to answer your own questions. * AI awareness: A solid grasp of foundational AI concepts, and the judgment to know when (and when not) to apply them. * Analytical skills: Strong strategic thinking, data analysis, and prioritization. You weigh tradeoffs well, especially between new work and operational risk. * Communication \& leadership: Excellent communication and stakeholder management, including with non\-technical operations teams. * Autonomy: Able to work fully independently on most day\-to\-day responsibilities, while taking guidance on high\-level strategic roadmaps. #### **Bonus points:** * Experience with loan servicing systems, payment rails (ACH/wire), bank APIs, or vendor integrations. * Experience working at a fast\-growing startup, especially in FinTech or PropTech. * Experience defining success metrics for automation, machine learning, or generative AI features. * Experience vibe coding your own projects or for work. * A technical degree (CS, EE, etc.) or equivalent work experience in a product development\-driven environment. Kiavi takes a market\-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The expected annualized base pay range for this full\-time role to be performed remotely is $140K \- $200K. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries. Within the range, the successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Your recruiter can share more about the specific base pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the pay range listed above reflects the base salary only, and does not include the target value of bonus or benefits. **Protect yourself from recruitment scams:** * If you are offered an interview or a role with Kiavi, this will be communicated with you through email, via an official email address ending in @kiavi.com or @lendinghome.com. * You will never be asked for payments of any kind during the process. * We also never communicate with candidates via Whatsapp at any point during the recruitment process. * We won't ask for personal information or data via text message. If you have any concerns regarding how genuine a text message is, please contact your recruiter. * You can find our official Kiavi careers page here. We advise you to check that the page details and website addresses match if you have any concerns. ##### **Kiavi is an Equal Opportunity Employer** **San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance Police Code, Article 49** ##### **We use** **E\-Verify** **to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.**

jobs.title: Project Engineer/Field Engineer
jobs.description: Kokosing (www.kokosing.biz) is one of America's 50 largest General Contractors and services a broad spectrum of clients in both the private and public business sectors. leadership skills, a passion for excellence, and taking initiative * Strong work ethic, willing to do what it takes to get the job done right the first time * Demonstrated commitment to ethics and integrity * Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills * Team player with the ability to work independently to meet deadlines, goals, and objectives * Ability to balance multiple responsibilities and prioritize tasks effectively * Ability to effectively identify and resolve problems in a constantly changing environment * Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail ### **Other Requirements** * Regular, reliable attendance * Work productively and meet deadlines timely * Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment * Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies * Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that’s among the best in our industry, including top\-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off. Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Kokosing is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action federal and state contractor. Must understand Object Oriented design principles. + Relational databases including data modeling and implementation + Application Security Design and implementation + DevSecOps and ITSM + Unit testing, system integration testing, performance'load, \& regression testing. + Demonstrated experience designing and implementing automated testing frameworks. + Working in an Agile development environment \- continuous integration \& continuous development. ***Skills and Abilities:**** Superior project management, time management, and organization management skills * Excellent documentation skills – includes enhancing or creating new standards * Experience working both independently and, in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment. * Excellent collaboration skills \- ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally as appropriate for the needs of the audience. * Strong customer service focus and sense of urgency * Ability to balance the long\-term (‘big picture’) and short\-term implications of individual decisions and organizational goals * Professional: Ability to follow Kuder’s culture and values: + **Attitude is Everything** – We believe we have more potential to accomplish goals, develop resiliency, and make improvements when we choose to lead with a positive attitude. + **Create Partnerships** – We create genuine, flexible, and long\-term partnerships that cultivate collaboration and support for achieving common goals. + **Deliver Success** – We drive results and reach our goals with passion, urgency, and a commitment to excellence. jobs.title: Senior Automation & Digital Plant Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Automation \& Digital Plant Engineer** **Industry:** Pharmaceutical / Biopharmaceutical **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – Remote within the USA **Location:** Anywhere in the United States (Travel to Indiana Required) **Travel Requirements:** 2 weeks per month during the first 6 months, followed by 1 week per month for the remainder of the project. **Position Overview** We are seeking an experienced **Lab Scale Digital Plant Engineer** to support a major pharmaceutical automation project. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineering professional with a strong background in **Pharmaceutical Automation, Operational Technology (OT), Digital Plant Solutions, and Process Control Systems**. In this role, you will work closely with Automation Project Teams, Process Engineering, Technical Operations, and other key stakeholders to ensure digital solutions align with manufacturing processes, facility design, and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements. You will play an important role in connecting laboratory\-scale equipment, automation systems, and digital infrastructure to establish reliable data flows and support manufacturing and process\-related decisions. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with **DeltaV Batch DCS, laboratory system connectivity, chromatography software, and pharmaceutical manufacturing automation projects.** Key Responsibilities * **Digital Plant Strategy:** Contribute to the development and implementation of Digital Plant strategies and project\-specific digital use cases. * **Automation \& Digital Integration:** Bridge business requirements, technology solutions, automation systems, and data architecture. * **Data Architecture \& Flow Mapping:** Lead data flow mapping activities and contribute to the overall project data architecture. * **Historian \& Data Infrastructure:** Support the implementation and delivery of site\-level data infrastructure, including **AVEVA PI and Logmate**. * **Process Control \& Automation:** Contribute to the overall automation philosophy and ensure digital solutions support manufacturing and operational requirements. * **Laboratory Systems Integration:** Support the integration of laboratory\-scale equipment and systems into the broader plant data architecture. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Automation, Process Engineering, Process Technical Transfer, Program Technical Office (PTO), and end users. * **Technical Consultation:** Provide technical guidance and automation support throughout project execution. * **Project Communication:** Communicate project progress, technical challenges, resource requirements, and deliverables to the Automation Project Manager. * **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure project activities align with applicable GMP, regulatory, data integrity, and training requirements. Required Qualifications \& Technical Skills Candidates should possess experience in the following areas: **Education \& Industry Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent relevant professional experience. * 7\+ years of experience in the **pharmaceutical industry**, particularly API or bulk drug manufacturing. * Experience delivering large\-scale pharmaceutical automation projects. **Automation \& Process Control** * Strong background in Industrial Automation and Operational Technology (OT). * Hands\-on experience with **Distributed Control Systems (DCS)** and batch manufacturing environments. * Experience with **Emerson DeltaV Batch DCS**. * Understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and process control requirements. **Digital Plant \& Data Integration** * Experience with Digital Plant solutions and digital transformation initiatives. * Strong understanding of data architecture and data flow mapping. * Experience integrating laboratory systems and benchtop equipment into digital infrastructure. * Familiarity with process historians and data infrastructure. **Laboratory Systems \& Software** * Experience with laboratory system connectivity and integration. * Experience with benchtop chromatography software, particularly **UNICORN**. **Pharmaceutical Compliance \& Validation** * Strong understanding of GMP requirements, regulatory standards, data integrity, and Computer System Validation (CSV) principles. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with **AVEVA PI System / PI Historian**. * Experience with Logmate or similar industrial data infrastructure platforms. * Experience working across Process Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, IT/OT, and Automation teams. Professional Competencies * Excellent cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to translate manufacturing and operational requirements into practical digital and automation solutions. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary project team. Pay: $79\.42 \- $81\.43 per hour Work Location: Hybrid remote in Indianapolis, IN 46227

jobs.title: Technical Leader in OSS
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. We are always moving forward — pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. In our AI Led Application Modernization team this is especially true. We’re a relatively new part of Kyndryl and operate with a startup mentality. We know that the way that software is created, maintained, modernized, and deployed is changing and we have the opportunity to build a team that’s aligned to the future. We are leveraging AI and new partnerships to help companies our clients sprint towards the future. **The Role and Responsibilities** Kyndryl is seeking a hands\-on Technical Leader in OSS (Architect) to help build and execute on some new services. We’ve recently created a strategic partnership with an Open Source Software (OSS) provider and are looking for an architect to help us expand our joint offerings. You will work with our new partner, consult leadership, existing consult practices, and clients to identify and develop the services that will bring this partnership to life. Among your responsibilities will be: * Get to know the technology of our partner and the applicable service offerings to identify places where synergy can benefit our clients. * Work on a very technical level to define and harden those offerings with our consulting practice and our partner’s software engineers. * Work with our alliance and industry leadership teams to craft the value statements of these offerings and ensure that Kyndryl customer partners and consult partners know how to articulate this value to their clients. Work with clients both before and after the sale to ensure the offerings create value. * This role is both hands\-on and leadership\-oriented. You will roll up your sleaves on implementation projects, mentor other consultants, participate in pre\-sales activities, and help drive change in our business. **Who You Are** You are passionate about open source software, customer success, and collaboration. You have a history of not only understanding the technical details, but being able to explain them to the business. You know how to write software, but you also know how to figure out where it should run. You have experience with cloud, containers, orchestration, and the edge. You are excited by the changes coming to software development. You have a growth mindset, actively experiment with AI\-assisted development tools, and are interested in creating practical agents, workflows, and engineering practices that help teams build, understand, modernize, and operate software more effectively. Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID\-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. **Who You Are** **Why Kyndryl:** We’re a purpose\-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities. **Your Future at Kyndryl** Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. **Required Technical and Professional Experience** **Re her new application development, application modernization, or both * Practical experience using AI\-assisted development tools to support coding, refactoring, testing, documentation, debugging, code comprehension, and architecture exploration * Strong understanding of software architecture and engineering fundamentals, including APIs, data models, integration patterns, automated testing, version control, CI/CD, secure coding, observability, and operational support * Growth mindset and enthusiasm for how AI will reshape the software development profession * This is a remote position but you need to travel 25 % of the time for client visits Prior consulting experience is highly preferred * **Preferred Technical and Professional Experience** * Experience as an OSS Contributor * Experience leading consulting engagements * Experience in sales and pre\-sales Experience building consulting practices * The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is \- $143,640 to $273,000 based on a full\-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job\-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area): $172,440 to $327,600 California (All Other): $158,040 to $300,360 Colorado: $143,640 to $273,000 Massachusetts $143,640 to $300,360 New York City: $172,440 to $327,600 Washington: $158,040 to $300,360 Washington DC: $158,040 to $300,360 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Fullstack (AI)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Denver, CO; New York, NY **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering **Deadline to Apply** --------------------- December 31, 2026 at 1:00 AM CST **We require people to be on\-site, 4 days/week at our NYC or Denver office and are unable to offer relocation support.** **LG Ad Solutions** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- LG Ad Solutions is a global leader in connected TV (CTV) and cross\-screen advertising. jobs.title: AVP, IAM AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Where Ambition Meets Innovation** Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals. **Job Overview:** We are looking for an AVP, IAM AI Engineer to design, operationalize, and automate the identity controls that govern both human and non\-human actors across our environment — with a specific focus on AI agents and the emerging class of agentic and non\-human identities (NHI). This is a hands\-on engineering and technical leadership role: you will build the runtime controls, secrets workflows, and governance guardrails that let the organization adopt AI safely, while standing up and growing a team to sustain and scale that work. You will be embedded in new AI application development from the earliest design stages, ensuring identity, authentication, and authorization are built in rather than bolted on. **Responsibilities**: * **Identity runtime controls.** Operationalize and automate identity runtime controls across human and non\-human identities, including real\-time authentication, authorization, and policy enforcement. * **NHI \& agentic governance.** Design, build, and automate governance controls for AI agents and non\-human identities — covering the full lifecycle: provisioning, entitlement, rotation, certification/attestation, and deprovisioning. * **Secrets management for AI.** Develop and automate secrets\-manager workflows for AI systems and agents, including secret rotation, just\-in\-time and ephemeral credentials, and secure secret delivery to workloads. * **Least privilege \& policy\-as\-code.** Define and enforce fine\-grained, least\-privilege authorization models for agents and workloads, expressed as policy\-as\-code wherever possible. * **Reference architecture \& standards.** Establish standards and reference patterns for how identity flows through agentic systems — user\-to\-agent, agent\-to\-agent (A2A), and workload\-to\-service authentication and authorization. * **Embedded in AI development.** Partner with engineering and data science teams on all new AI application development, ensuring identity, AuthN/AuthZ, and secrets handling are designed in from the start. * **End\-user IAM deployment.** Support the deployment and adoption of IAM controls for end users where required. * **Monitoring \& response.** Integrate identity telemetry with SIEM/SOC tooling; build monitoring and anomaly detection for NHI/agent behavior; support incident response for compromised or misused credentials. * **Governance, risk \& compliance.** Partner with GRC, risk, and audit stakeholders to ensure controls satisfy regulatory and internal requirements, and to produce audit evidence. * **Team building \& leadership.** Recruit, build, mentor, and lead a team to support these workstreams; set technical direction and roadmap for NHI and agentic IAM. **What are we looking for?** We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness, act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work. **Requirements:** * 5\+ years in identity \& access management or information security, including hands\-on engineering. * Demonstrated experience building and/or leading technical teams. * 5\+ years with Ping Identity (PingFederate / PingOne / PingAccess) or a comparable access\-management / federation platform. * 5\+ years with SailPoint (IdentityIQ / Identity Security Cloud) or a comparable identity governance \& administration (IGA) platform. * 3\+ years with Idira (CyberArk, formerly Conjur) / HashiCorp Vault or a comparable secrets\-management platform. **Core Competencies:** * Working knowledge of identity and authorization for both users and agents: user\-to\-agent and agent\-to\-agent (A2A) patterns, OIDC and OAuth 2\.0/2\.1 tokens, and API keys, across both authentication (AuthN) and authorization (AuthZ). * Strong automation and engineering skills: proficiency in a scripting/programming language (e.g., Python), infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and REST API integration. * Experience applying IAM in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and in containerized / Kubernetes workloads. **Preferences:** * Familiarity with workload\-identity and machine\-identity standards: SPIFFE/SPIRE, OAuth token exchange (RFC 8693\), mTLS, and cloud workload\-identity federation. * Working understanding of AI/agentic systems: LLMs, agent frameworks, tool\-calling, and emerging authentication patterns such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, etc.) and with associated compliance regimes. * Relevant certifications, e.g., CISSP, CyberArk (Defender/Sentry), SailPoint, Ping, or a major cloud security certification. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. \#LI\-Hybrid **Pay Range:** $122,570\.00 \- $204,249\.00### Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer! **Company Overview:** LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor\-mediated marketplace(6\) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2\.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. jobs.title: Founding Lead Recruiter
jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE** ============== Lantern is building the AI\-native operating system for the $9T wholesale distribution industry. Billions of dollars sit tied up in stock, yet most distributors still buy on gut feel and spreadsheets. We partner with leading distributors to deliver precise, AI\-powered purchasing recommendations that drive 30% leaner inventory, 10% higher sales, and 20\+ hours saved per week per user. We've gone from $0 to $5M ARR in 8 months, raised $7M from top VCs, and are hitting hypergrowth. ### **About the Role** Lantern is hiring a Founding Lead Recruiter to own and scale hiring across the company. As our first dedicated recruiting hire, you'll play a critical role in building our Engineering and ML team alongside the GTM team taking our product to market, while shaping the recruiting strategy, processes, and tools that will support our next stage of growth. This role will report directly to our Co\-founder \& CEO and work closely with our founders on every hire. As hiring grows, you'll help hire and lead the recruiting team that comes next. *Must be based in San Francisco (in\-office).* ### **What You'll Do** * Own full life\-cycle recruiting across Engineering, ML, and GTM, playing a critical role in building the teams that will shape Lantern's next stage of growth * Build and execute creative, targeted sourcing strategies to reach exceptional talent where they actually spend time, and deliver a thoughtful, high\-quality candidate experience * Act as a strategic talent partner to our founders and hiring managers to define and run best\-in\-class interview processes, including structured loops, scorecards, and calibration * Build Lantern's recruiting foundation from the ground up, including Ashby, scalable processes, AI\-powered workflows, and reporting that make hiring smarter, faster, and more effective * Own recruiting metrics and pipeline visibility, using data to identify bottlenecks, improve hiring velocity, and keep leadership informed * Build a closing plan for every candidate and partner with the founders on the last mile * Be a champion of Lantern's mission and culture, owning our employer brand across our careers page, LinkedIn, events, and founder networks * Partner with the founders on headcount planning and leveling, then hire and lead the recruiters who come next ### **What You Bring** * 6\+ years of full life\-cycle recruiting experience, with deep experience hiring engineers (ML or data a plus) and the range to run strong GTM searches * Prior experience recruiting inside an early\-stage, high\-growth startup that scaled quickly * A track record of closing top technical talent in the SF market against competing offers * Recruiting workflows or tools you've built with AI that you and others rely on, and you can show us * Experience building recruiting process and tooling, not just operating inside an existing one * Confidence with founders: you influence decisions, manage expectations, and protect the hiring bar * A bias for speed without sacrificing candidate experience or hiring bar ### **Nice to Haves** * Founding or first\-recruiter experience at a seed to Series B company * Experience mentoring or leading other recruiters * A Bay Area network in AI, ML, or data * Experience hiring forward\-deployed engineers * Experience partnering with a VC's talent team or an embedded recruiter on a search * Exposure to supply chain, distribution, or vertical software ### **What You'll Get** * An opportunity to join an early\-stage company at the start of a period of rapid growth * The opportunity to be Lantern's founding recruiter, with the ownership and autonomy to build the recruiting function, and team, from the ground up * A direct partnership with our founders on every hire that shapes the company * A clear path to Head of Talent as the team scales * Competitive salary and meaningful equity * An office in San Francisco with a tight\-knit, in\-person team **WHAT WE VALUE** ================= We hire operators who own outcomes, combining sharp judgment with pragmatic execution and a willingness to do the unglamorous work. Hard work, humility, customer obsession, and pride in a job well done: the values our customers live by, and the values we hire for. Compensation Range: $200K

We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. Public data sources are plateauing, so model quality increasingly depends on purpose\-built datasets and on knowing which data changes actually help. We treat data as a research problem, not an infrastructure problem. You'll work alongside our pre\-training researchers on a small team, run the experiments that settle data questions, and build the pipelines that carry the answers into training runs. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We need someone who: * **Thinks like a researcher, ships like an engineer:** You build the pipelines and you make the model\-facing calls about what goes into them. You don't hand off either half. * **Leads with a hypothesis:** Before changing a dataset, you can say what it should do to the model, what you'll measure, and what could fool you, such as contamination or a noisy benchmark. You hold views on pre\-training pitfalls, and you test them. * **Owns problems end to end:** You take ambiguous work from open question to shipped result with little direction or process, do the unglamorous parts that get it there, and don't care whose job it was. **The Work** ------------ * Source web\-scale and public datasets, and build the pipelines that filter, deduplicate, and decontaminate them * Design data mixtures and curricula for pre\-training and midtraining, and decide what goes into each run * Build synthetic data generation systems using LLMs, structured prompting, and distillation to cover what web data can't * Run proxy experiments and ablations to measure what each data change does to model quality, and decide what scales up * Build evaluation sets you can trust, and keep data lineage clear enough that any training run can be traced and reproduced **Experience \& Capabilities** ------------------------------ **What you'll need:** * Deep, hands\-on pre\-training data work you did yourself: web\-scale sourcing and curation, synthetic data generation, mixing and curriculum design, deduplication and decontamination. This is where depth matters most. * The ability to reason from a data decision to its effect on training: how data interacts with model size, architecture, and training dynamics, why more data can hurt, and which changes matter as models scale * Experiments you designed to test data changes, such as baselines, scaling ladders, small\-scale proxies, and held\-out loss, with a clear account of what a change did and why * Production data pipelines you built and owned, not only research prototypes * Solid ML fundamentals: you've trained, evaluated, and iterated on models in Python (PyTorch preferred) * 3\+ years of relevant experience with an M.S., 1\+ year with a Ph.D., or 5\+ years with a B.S. **Helpful, not required:** * Distillation, long\-context, or architecture\-specific data strategy * Designing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for pretrained models * Data work across both pre\-training and post\-training * Small, efficient models or on\-device deployment * Startup experience, or a track record of connecting model work to product needs **What Success Looks Like (Year One)** -------------------------------------- * You own a critical pre\-training data pipeline end to end * Data systems you built or improved have measurably moved model performance * You've identified and integrated at least one external dataset that moved the needle **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Upstream of every model:** Pre\-training data shapes every Liquid Foundation Model. On a small team, the mixtures, filters, and synthetic data you build go straight into the models we ship. * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location. * **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company\-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location. * **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

jobs.title: Senior Process Engineer
jobs.description: Lithium Americas is a North American resource and materials company focused on developing, building, and operating lithium deposits and chemical processing facilities. The company’s flagship asset, Thacker Pass, is located in Humboldt County in northern Nevada and is the world’s largest known measured lithium source and reserve. We are focused on safely and responsibly developing Thacker Pass to production to help strengthen national security and enable cleaner energy sources. We are committed to minimizing environmental impact, creating family\-supporting jobs, and maximizing sustainable value for our stakeholders. **Senior****Process Engineer** **Company Overview** Lithium Americas is a North American resource and materials company focused on developing, building and operating lithium deposits and chemical processing facilities. The company’s flagship asset, Thacker Pass, is located in Humboldt County in northern Nevada and is the world’s largest known measured lithium source and reserve. We are focused on safely and responsibly developing Thacker Pass to production to help strengthen national security and enable cleaner energy sources. We are committed to minimizing environmental impact, creating family\-supporting jobs and maximizing sustainable value for our stakeholders. Lithium Americas is headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia and operates in the U.S., with offices in Reno, NV and Winnemucca, NV. The Company’s shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) and New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the symbol LAC. **Our Purpose,****Vision****and Values** Our purpose, vision and values are the guiding principles that will serve as the cornerstone of our company’s future direction and operations, aligning our team and organization towards our common goals. **Our Purpose** is to safely and sustainably produce lithium from Thacker Pass to enable North America to reduce dependence on foreign critical minerals and drive value for our stakeholders. **Our Vision** is to be North America’s leading lithium producer to enable cleaner energy sources. **Our Values** include Act with Integrity, Be Responsible and Act with Care, Commit to Excellence and Drive Innovation, and Be a Collaborative Partner. **Role****Overview** We are seeking a **Senior Process Engineer** to join our Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and supporting Lithium Americas’ efforts in safely and effectively building, commissioning, and operating the sulfuric acid plant and lithium processing facilities at Thacker Pass. This position plays a critical role in providing advanced technical leadership and process engineering expertise to plant operations, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient performance across chemical processing systems and unit operations associated with sulfuric acid production and lithium processing. The Senior Process Engineer will serve as a key technical authority for our processing facilities, leading troubleshooting efforts, guiding process optimization, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership and communication skills, a proven track record of solving complex process challenges, and deep familiarity with sulfuric acid production and chemical processing systems. This role is instrumental in establishing and advancing operating practices that support stewardship, safety, quality, and overall plant performance. The role is based at Thacker Pass and reports to the Site Engineering Manager. Occasional travel to other Lithium Americas offices, business units, engineering partners, or vendor locations may be required. **Responsibilities** * Provide leadership of and promote Lithium Nevada’s safety\-first culture. Ensure strict compliance with OSHA and MSHA regulations as well as Lithium Nevada’s site\-specific safety program. Perform all engineering activities with a safety\-first mindset. Promote and foster employee “stop work” authority. Identify, report and mitigate safety hazards and observations as part of daily activities and safety walks. Champion safety standards and promote communication and accountability within all production areas. Support pre\-commissioning, commissioning, and start\-up activities for the Thacker Pass Mine and Lithium Processing Facility in close coordination with Mining, Commissioning, and Start\-Up teams. * Lead pre\-commissioning, commissioning, and start\-up activities for the Thacker Pass Sulfuric Acid Plant and Lithium Processing Facility in coordination with the Commissioning and Start\-Up team * Provide advanced technical leadership and day\-to\-day process engineering support to Operations, including complex troubleshooting and process optimization * Analyze and interpret process data and trends from DCS historians to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions * Lead and manage capital projects focused on improving safety, throughput, and operational efficiency * Oversee contractors and cross\-functional teams executing maintenance and sustaining projects, ensuring alignment with safety and operational standards * Provide technical mentorship and guidance to engineers, operators, contractors, and consultants * Champion and drive a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements * Develop and implement systems to track, measure, and improve plant performance, productivity, and asset utilization * Build and maintain strong cross\-functional relationships while reinforcing Lithium Americas’ Purpose, Vision, and Values * Support development and continuous improvement of operating procedures, standards, and best practices * Other duties as assigned **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field * 10–15\+ years of experience in process engineering within a chemical processing or similar industrial environment * Demonstrated experience supporting or leading plant commissioning, start\-up, and operations * Strong expertise in chemical process engineering principles, unit operations, and process optimization * Familiarity with OSHA Process Safety Management (PSM) and/or MSHA regulations preferred * Proven leadership experience, including mentoring engineers and influencing cross\-functional teams * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage complex technical challenges * Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage stakeholders at all levels * Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, Project, Teams, etc.) * Experience with DCS control systems and data historian platforms * Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently and drive initiatives forward * Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative mindset * Personal commitment to Lithium Americas’ Purpose, Vision, and Values **Working at Lithium Americas** At Lithium Americas, we believe our people are our most valuable asset.
