jobs.title: Software Engineer (Time & Billing)
jobs.description: **About Us** At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI\-native Platform of Action. Over 55K legal professionals and 450\+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud\-based technology, configurable AI\-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest\-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need. **About the Team** Lawyers bill in six\-minute increments, and every one of them counts. Litify Time \& Billing turns that time into revenue: time entry, billing rules and rates, pre\-bills and invoices, payments, e\-billing, and a two\-way sync with Accounting Seed. If you like problems where a rounding rule matters and an invoice has to be right every time, this is your team. **About the Role** Litify is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Time \& Billing team. The code you ship decides how firms capture their time, bill their clients, and get paid. We recently integrated with an AI time\-capture partner, so the work lawyers do during the day becomes time entries that flow straight into billing. That is the kind of work this team takes on, and on a small team, your part in it is visible. We want a strong, versatile engineer who works across the stack and is eager to dig into new technologies. Our product runs on Salesforce. Prior Salesforce experience isn't required: if you come from Java, C\#, TypeScript, or a similar stack, senior engineers on the team will help you learn the platform. **AI\-assisted development is how this team works.** We use AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code. We want someone who already builds this way, knows how to check what the assistant produces, works within solid guardrails, and helps teammates do the same. AI makes each of us faster, but the team still designs, reviews, and decides together. **How we work:** We value speed and follow\-through. If you like shipping steadily and seeing your impact in the numbers, you will fit in here. * We are a team of four engineers, part of a team of nine with an engineering manager, a product manager, a UX designer, and two QA engineers * We work in two\-week agile sprints, where engineers and Product refine the work together and we estimate story points as a team * We track what we complete each week and look at how AI helps us deliver more * Features start from Figma designs and go through full QA and a package regression pass before each release * We ship three major releases a year as Salesforce managed packages, plus patch releases, on a set schedule rather than through continuous deployment * We keep meetings to a minimum and work through Jira and Slack **In this role, you will:** * Design and build features for time capture, billing, and invoicing, from the data model to the UI * Help lead how the team builds with AI, from agent workflows and shared prompts to review practices * Build and maintain integrations, from our Accounting Seed sync to AI time\-capture partners * Help build, test, and ship our releases * Go beyond the code: help shape requirements with Product, test your work end to end with QA, and refine UI details with UX * Contribute to project documentation and knowledge bases **To be successful in this role, you have (required):** * 4\+ years of experience with a typed back\-end language (for example Java, C\#, TypeScript) * Front\-end experience with modern JavaScript, a component framework such as React, and CSS styling * Solid data modeling and SQL skills, including working with large data sets and designing code that scales * A habit of writing tests * Daily, hands\-on experience building software with AI coding assistants * An ability to communicate clearly with Engineering and Product, including teammates in other time zones **Nice\-to\-have:** * Prior experience developing on Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL), or Salesforce Administrator or Platform Developer certifications * Experience at a Salesforce ISV, such as releasing managed packages and passing security review * Legal billing knowledge, such as fee arrangements, rates, write\-downs, and LEDES e\-billing * Experience with Accounting Seed or another finance or ERP product * Experience building AI tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers, or shared prompt libraries **Where you can grow:** * Learn the Salesforce platform with support from senior engineers * Use professional development funds for courses, conferences, and certifications, including Salesforce certifications * Grow into owning an area of the product, from design through release * Help shape the team's AI practices and grow into leading them * Build toward a senior role at a company that likes to promote from within **Disclosure:** This job is fully remote, with the exception of employees living in New York City and New Jersey. Our NYC/NJ employees adhere to our hybrid schedule, which involves working in our Manhattan office 6 days a month. The estimated base salary for this role is $115\-120k. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide. Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Luna Innovations, we measure and manage light in optical fiber. Our Optics/Polarization product line, based in Chino, CA, specializes in industry\-leading components, modules, and test equipment for the characterization and control of optical polarization. Our instruments, ranging from dynamic optical delay/phase management and high\-speed polarization state management to full\-function polarization light analyzers, are critical for optical communications, silicon photonics testing, and fiber optic sensing. At Luna, you will work with some of the most curious, forward\-thinking engineers and scientists in the industry to shape the future of fiber optic measurement. **Role Overview** We are seeking a Software Engineer II, with flexibility to hire at the Senior level for the right candidate, to join the software development team for our photonics instrumentation. Final level and pay will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications. You will build the applications that control precision optical instruments, process high\-speed measurement data, and visualize complex optical behavior in real time. You will develop software for Linux and Windows platforms, including embedded Linux devices, and support the remote control interfaces customers use to integrate our instruments into their own test systems. If you are passionate about hardware\-software integration and want to build the software behind state\-of\-the\-art optical test equipment, we want you on our team. **Key Responsibilities** * **Application Development:** Design, develop, and maintain reliable C/C\+\+ and Python applications for Linux and Windows, including user\-facing applications and GUIs. * **Software Architecture:** Design maintainable, modular software components and interfaces for hardware\-integrated products; evaluate performance, reliability, and lifecycle trade\-offs. * **Embedded Linux:** Develop and integrate software on embedded and headless Linux platforms, including cross\-compilation and system integration. * **Software Infrastructure \& Lifecycle:** Improve build and release processes, automated testing, packaging, deployment, Linux updates, security patch management, and long\-term maintenance. * **Remote Control \& SDKs:** Develop and support APIs, SDKs, and remote control interfaces that enable customers to integrate our instruments into automated manufacturing and test systems. * **Software Quality \& Documentation:** Apply code review, testing, debugging, validation, versioning, and technical documentation practices throughout development and release. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work with optical, electrical, firmware, and systems engineers, as well as manufacturing and support teams, to define instrument capabilities, troubleshoot prototypes, and bring new products to market. **Required Qualifications: Software Engineer II** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field. * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ and Python. * Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software on Linux. * Experience with multithreading, memory management, and optimizing code for performance. * Experience with Git/GitHub workflows, version control, collaborative development, and code review. * Familiarity with software build systems, debugging tools, unit testing, and validation. * Strong analytical troubleshooting skills and ability to work across software/hardware boundaries. * Effective technical communication and documentation skills. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented, Agile environment. **Additional Required Qualifications: Senior Software Engineer** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Demonstrated ability to design and maintain complex C/C\+\+ software systems. * Experience designing software architecture for embedded, hardware\-integrated, or other equipment products. * Experience setting up or owning build, test, and release processes for a software product. * Strong Linux development experience, including system\-level debugging and deployment. * Hands\-on experience in at least one of the following: cross\-compilation and system integration; embedded Linux jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineer
jobs.description: **Hardware Test Engineer \- Reliability** Hardware Test Engineers at Lunar Energy play a critical role in helping our engineering team decide whether our home energy products are ready to ship, and own the evidence behind that call. You'll design and automate the test stands that collect critical product performance data and analyze that data to work out the "so what." An ideal candidate is curious, hands\-on, and comfortable working across electrical, mechanical, thermal, and software disciplines. Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We're a fast\-growing, global company building the world's best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants. **On a given day at Lunar, you'll likely…** * Be a critical part of validating Lunar's power converters (inverters, DC\-DC converters, solar optimizers) and battery systems end to end: test planning, test stand development, execution, data analysis, failure analysis, and reporting. * Help develop test specifications from the ground up that reflect representative field conditions. Translate field data, product behavior, and known failure modes into stress profiles that target the product's physics of failure. * Develop detailed functional test plans that cover a complex product's many functions, balancing thoroughness against scalability across large sample sizes. * Design and develop custom test stands for electrical, thermal, and mechanical testing. * + Define test stand architecture, specify equipment and instrumentation, and work with technicians to design and fabricate the stands. + Write Python test software to automate testing and process large datasets. + Continuously improve test infrastructure, from software tools to custom test equipment, to help us get more data and insight with less effort. * Help drive failure analysis for test failures, and support root cause analysis for field failures. * Analyze test data and FA results for root cause analysis, and help determine the next critical piece of data or experiment to prove or disprove a failure hypothesis. * Document and communicate test results to cross\-functional teams with conclusions, test limitations/caveats, confidence levels, and engineering recommendations. Treat testing as a learning process to understand the physics behind product performance. * Work alongside a cross\-functional team and learn across disciplines (electrical, mechanical, firmware, manufacturing, and more) to work out how different design and process changes affect reliability, and subsequently our validation strategy. **Desired Skills:** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or engineering physics required; mechatronics/robotics concentration is a plus * Strong sense of curiosity and ownership, ability to work in a dynamic and fast paced environment * Strong engineering fundamentals in one or more of the following disciplines: electronics/circuit analysis, heat and mass transfer, and statics/mechanics of materials * Experience with electrical test equipment (power supplies, data acquisition systems) and standard diagnostic tools (multimeters, oscilloscopes) required * Python or equivalent programming experience required; experience with object\-oriented programming, state machines, and test automation is a plus * Basic mechanical design or CAD experience is a plus * Experience testing power electronics or battery systems is a plus **Benefits:** We're dedicated to creating a remarkable employee experience. We are committed to attracting, developing and retaining diverse talent by supporting an inclusive workplace. jobs.title: Freelancer Senior Value Engineering Consultant
jobs.description: **1\. Background and Objectives** --------------------------------- MJV Technology \& Innovation is seeking a Senior Value Engineering Consultant to support the transformation of its commercial approach to selling technology services and solutions. Traditionally, a significant portion of the technology services market relies on engagement models based on resource allocation, billable hours, or estimated effort (Time \& Materials). With the rapid evolution of Artificial Intelligence, automation, and technology delivery models, MJV aims to develop commercial approaches that prioritize the actual business value delivered to clients, including productivity improvements, operational efficiency, cost reduction, risk mitigation, and measurable business outcomes. The primary objective of this engagement is to develop and implement a commercial methodology that enables MJV to structure, price, and sell technology projects based on the value and business outcomes delivered to clients, reducing its dependence on traditional effort\-based pricing models. **2\. Key Responsibilities** ---------------------------- ### **Value Engineering Strategy** * Assess MJV’s current commercial model and identify opportunities to transition toward value\-driven engagement models. * Develop a structured methodology for identifying, quantifying, and communicating the economic and strategic value of technology solutions. * Translate technical benefits into financial and operational indicators relevant to clients. * Identify the categories of projects and services best suited for value\-based and outcome\-based commercial models. ### **Financial Modeling and Pricing** * Develop methodologies and financial models for calculating ROI, TCO, payback periods, and economic benefits. * Define Value\-Based Pricing and Outcome\-Based Pricing approaches applicable to technology services and solutions. * Evaluate alternative commercial structures, including value\-based fixed pricing, outcome\-based compensation, gainsharing arrangements, and hybrid models. * Establish guidelines for financial risk assessment, margin protection, and long\-term commercial sustainability. ### **Business Outcome Measurement** * Define methodologies for establishing performance indicators, baselines, and measurable business targets. * Develop mechanisms to measure, validate, and demonstrate the business benefits delivered by technology projects. * Identify client dependencies and external factors that may affect outcome measurement or attribution. * Support the definition of commercial acceptance criteria and mechanisms for validating achieved results. ### **Commercial Enablement** * Develop reusable tools and templates for building business cases and value\-driven commercial proposals. * Support the evolution of MJV’s commercial narrative, shifting discussions from resource allocation and effort estimation toward measurable business benefits. * Participate in structuring pilot commercial proposals using the newly developed methodology. * Transfer knowledge and methodologies to MJV’s sales and technical teams. **3\. Required Experience and Qualifications** ---------------------------------------------- ### **Essential Requirements** * Proven experience in Value Engineering, Value Consulting, Value\-Based Selling, or Outcome\-Based Pricing strategies. * Professional background in technology consulting, digital transformation, enterprise software, or complex B2B technology services. * Hands\-on experience developing business cases and financial models to justify technology investments. * Strong understanding of pricing strategies for technology services and solutions. * Demonstrated ability to translate operational improvements and productivity gains into measurable economic value. * Experience designing or transforming commercial models, preferably including transitions from Time \& Materials to value\-based or outcome\-based engagements. * Ability to engage effectively with executive stakeholders across Sales, Finance, and Technology. * Experience developing reusable methodologies, frameworks, tools, and commercial processes. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience with global technology consulting firms or enterprise software companies. * Understanding of how Generative AI and automation are transforming technology service delivery and pricing models. * Experience with process automation, software engineering, digital transformation, or AI agent solutions. * Familiarity with commercial negotiations involving shared risks, performance\-based compensation, and gainsharing arrangements. * Knowledge of Value Realization methodologies and post\-implementation business outcome measurement. **4\. Expected Deliverables** ----------------------------- Considering an initial engagement of approximately 80 hours over two months, the consultant is expected to deliver the following: ### **Deliverable 1 — Assessment and Strategic Direction** Assessment of MJV’s current commercial model, identifying key opportunities for adopting value\-based approaches and prioritizing offerings with the highest implementation potential. ### **Deliverable 2 — Value Engineering Framework** Development of a structured, reusable methodology for identifying, quantifying, communicating, and measuring the business value generated by technology projects. ### **Deliverable 3 — Commercial and Pricing Models** Definition of alternative commercial structures applicable to different types of projects, including pricing methodologies, outcome measurement criteria, gainsharing mechanisms, and guidelines for managing financial risks and protecting margins. ### **Deliverable 4 — Commercial Enablement Tools** Development of practical tools and templates, including ROI financial models, business case frameworks, and value\-driven proposal structures. ### **Deliverable 5 — Practical Implementation** Application of the methodology to up to two real MJV commercial opportunities, supporting the development of concrete proposals using the new approach. ### **Deliverable 6 — Knowledge Transfer** Delivery of training and knowledge\-transfer sessions to relevant teams, ensuring that MJV can independently apply and evolve the methodology after the consulting engagement. **5\. Professional Profile** ---------------------------- We are looking for a business\-oriented professional with strong analytical capabilities and a hands\-on approach to execution. The ideal candidate should be comfortable navigating financial, commercial, and technological discussions, with a clear understanding of how technology solutions translate into measurable business outcomes. Strong consulting skills, executive communication abilities, pragmatism, and the capacity to develop methodologies that can be effectively applied within the organization are essential. We are not looking for a purely theoretical or academic consultant. Proven hands\-on experience designing and implementing value\-based commercial models is essential. **6\. Engagement Model** ------------------------ The initial engagement will consist of approximately 80 hours of specialized consulting services, to be consumed flexibly over an estimated two\-month period. The consultant will collaborate closely with representatives from MJV’s Sales, Technology, and Operations teams. The expected outcome is a set of practical, reusable methodologies, frameworks, and tools that will enable MJV to progressively incorporate value\-based and outcome\-based approaches into its commercial processes. **7\. Candidate Evaluation Criteria** ------------------------------------- Candidates should be able to present at least one real\-world example in which they actively participated in designing or implementing a value\-based or outcome\-based commercial model. The example should demonstrate: * How the business value was identified and quantified. * How the pricing model was structured. * How business outcomes and success criteria were established. * How commercial and financial risks were allocated between the service provider and the client. * What measurable results were achieved.

jobs.title: Software Developer – ColdFusion
jobs.description: **Project Overview** We are seeking an experienced Software Developer to design and develop a voice\-activated data entry program. The system will allow field staff to speak into their mobile phones or desktop computers to automatically populate specific fields in our legacy database and trigger automatic notifications. **Technical Environment** * **Database:** Adobe ColdFusion (CFML) / associated relational database (e.g., MS SQL Server / MySQL) * **Notifications:** Custom SMS infrastructure is already built into our software platform and accessible via API/endpoints. * **Target Interface:** Mobile phone web application or dedicated mobile interface. **Scope of Work \& Key Deliverables** **1\. Voice\-to\-Data Processing Pipeline (AI Front\-End)** * Integrate a modern Conversational AI or Speech\-to\-Text API (such as OpenAI Realtime API, Vapi, Retell AI, or AWS Transcribe) capable of natural language understanding. * The system must not just transcribe text, but dynamically extract structured entities out of unstructured speech (e.g., identifying a location, description of an incident, and names from a single spoken phrase). **2\. ColdFusion Database Integration (The Backend)** * Develop secure backend handlers (ColdFusion Components / CFCs) or custom APIs to receive the structured data payloads from the voice interface. * Map and securely insert the extracted voice data into our existing database schemas. * **Target Workflows to Implement:** * **CMMS Work Orders:** Creating maintenance requests, mapping fields like *Location*, *Asset ID*, and *Issue Description*. * **Emergency Incidents:** Quick\-logging critical safety hazards or active emergencies. * **Safety Reports:** Formulating structured records for reporting injuries, site accidents, or sudden worker illnesses. **3\. Automated Notification Dispatch** * Program automated system triggers upon successful database insertion. * Hook into our existing, platform\-native SMS capabilities to send instant alerts. * Configure conditional routing logic: * *Internal routing:* Auto\-dispatching incident summaries via SMS to the internal **Safety Officer**. * *External routing:* Auto\-dispatching urgent details to designated **outside agencies** depending on the severity and type of incident reported. **Required Developer Qualifications** * **ColdFusion Expertise:** Strong, proven experience working with legacy and modern Adobe ColdFusion (CFML) environments, database connections, and CFCs. * **Speech Recognition \& AI Integration:** Experience working with Speech\-to\-Text APIs, Large Language Models (LLMs) for entity extraction, or AI voice platforms. * **API \& Webhook Development:** Proficient in building and consuming RESTful APIs, JSON parsing, and handling webhook events securely. * **Mobile Web Optimization:** Experience formatting user interfaces that operate reliably on field mobile browsers (iOS \& Android). **Project Timeline \& Milestones (To Be Finalized upon Hire)** * **Milestone 1:** Architecture Design \& Choice of Voice Extraction Pipeline * **Milestone 2:** ColdFusion API Endpoint Creation \& Successful Database Insertion Tests * **Milestone 3:** Core Workflow Deployment (CMMS, Emergencies, Safety Reporting) * **Milestone 4:** SMS Notification Testing, Edge\-Case Debugging, and Final Handover **What We're Looking For** We are looking for someone who can **step into an existing software environment, quickly understand how it works, and contribute immediately**. This is not simply a greenfield development position. The ability to work with established ColdFusion applications, troubleshoot existing functionality, and build reliable integrations is particularly important. **Position:** Software Developer – ColdFusion **Employment Type:** Contract **Location:** Remote **Compensation:** Per Project **To Apply:** Please submit a résumé highlighting your ColdFusion development experience, and examples of relevant software projects. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: #### **Who We Are** MAP \| WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. **About WPP** MAP is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. We're hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to bridge marketing strategy and technical execution, building the architectures that power modern customer experiences. As the technical lead on client engagements, you'll own end\-to\-end delivery from discovery and solution design to hands\-on build and QA across Adobe Target, AEP, Real\-Time CDP, CJA, and tag management platforms. We're looking for someone who loves solving complex MarTech challenges, takes pride in the precision of what they build, and collaborates effortlessly with clients and teams. **What will your day look like?** --------------------------------- As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will serve as the technical lead across client engagements, bridging business strategy with hands\-on technical architecture, implementation, and quality assurance. You will own complex technical workstreams end\-to\-end leading discovery, translating measurement and business requirements into scalable architectures across Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Real\-Time CDP, Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), and modern tag management platforms. * **Technical Discovery \& Solution Design:** Lead technical discovery and requirements\-gathering sessions with developers, analysts, marketers, and product teams. Document comprehensive solution designs, technical requirements, implementation approaches, and system dependencies while proactively identifying risks and limitations. * **Adobe Target \& Experimentation Engineering:** Build, implement, and QA A/B and multivariate tests in Adobe Target using the Visual Experience Composer (VEC), form\-based activities, and custom code. Implement profile scripts, audience qualification logic, and Target Recommendations. Design measurement frameworks covering success metrics, guardrail metrics, sample size, test duration, and statistical significance. * **Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) \& Real\-Time CDP Architecture:** Architect and work with XDM schemas and dataset ingestion pipelines. Configure streaming, edge, and batch segmentation, audience evaluation, and downstream activation. Configure the AEP Identity Service, identity namespaces, and ECIDs to ensure accurate customer profile stitching. * **AEP Web SDK Implementation:** Lead hands\-on implementation and configuration of Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK, datastreams, edge decisioning, and personalization. Monitor and debug network payloads and server responses to ensure accurate data flow into AEP datasets and downstream tools. * **Tag Management \& Data Layer Architecture:** Architect, evaluate, and implement data layer designs across Adobe Launch/Tags and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Manage and troubleshoot rule conditions, custom extensions, data elements, and tag firing. * **Full\-Stack Client\-Side Debugging:** Trace data from the browser through the data layer, tag management, Adobe Edge/AEP, datasets, and downstream reporting or activation. Diagnose and fix complex issues involving JavaScript errors, cookies, local/session storage, identity stitching, event duplication, data loss, and reporting discrepancies. * **Client Advisory \& Technical Leadership:** Act as a trusted technical lead on engagements. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, present architectural recommendations, and constructively challenge requirements to balance business goals with technical feasibility and maintainability. **Who are you going to work with?** ----------------------------------- * **Direct Leadership:** Reports to the Engineering Director or Practice Lead, Marketing Technology \& Personalization. * **Internal Capabilities:** Partner closely with developers, analysts, data architects, QA engineers, and client engagement teams to deliver robust growth systems. * **Clients \& Stakeholders:** Interface directly with client\-side developers, digital analysts, product managers, marketing leads, and technical n marketing technology, web analytics, personalization, experimentation, or related technical consulting/engineering roles. * Consulting \& Agency Background: Prior client\-facing, consulting, or agency experience preferred, with proven ability to lead discovery sessions, present solutions, and manage technical communication. * Adobe Target \& Experimentation: * Deep experience building, implementing, and QA'ing A/B and multivariate tests. * Hands\-on proficiency with VEC, form\-based activities, custom code activities, Target Recommendations, and profile scripts. * Understanding of experimentation methodology (testable hypotheses, success/guardrail metrics, sample size, test duration, and statistical significance). * Implementation familiarity via Adobe Launch/Tags, at.js, and/or AEP Web SDK. * Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) \& Real\-Time CDP: * Strong working knowledge of XDM schemas, dataset ingestion, and source/destination connections. * Experience with streaming, edge, and batch segmentation, audience evaluation, and activation. * In\-depth understanding of the AEP Identity Service, identity namespaces, ECID, customer identifiers, and their impact on profile stitching. * Clear understanding of event data vs. profile attributes and when each should be applied. * **AEP Web SDK Fluency:** * Hands\-on implementation and troubleshooting of AEP Web SDK, datastreams, identity, decisioning, and personalization. * Expertise troubleshooting event payloads and network requests using browser DevTools. * **Tag Management \& Data Layer Design:** * Hands\-on experience with Adobe Launch/Tags and Google Tag Manager (GTM). * Deep understanding of data layer design, rule conditions, extensions, and data elements. * Proven ability to trace data flow from the data layer through tag management into downstream analytics and marketing platforms. * **Technical \& Coding Skills:** * **JavaScript:** Strong proficiency reading, writing, and debugging custom JavaScript. * **HTML/CSS:** Comfortable building test variations and troubleshooting rendering and styling issues. * **Browser Debugging:** Deep expertise troubleshooting console errors, network requests, cookies, local/session storage, and cross\-browser behavior. * **End\-to\-End Diagnostics:** Proven ability to diagnose identity issues, event duplication, data loss, audience qualification bugs, and inconsistent reporting. **A leader in personalized customer experiences** ------------------------------------------------- VML MAP is a world\-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer\-centric. Together, we are 1000 \+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55\+ nationalities. **A global network** -------------------- We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150\+ offices in 60\+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. \#LI\-EMEA WPP (MAP/VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. When you click "Apply now" below, your information is sent to MAP/VML. To learn more about how we process your personal data during when you apply for a role with us, on how you can update your information or have the information removed please read our Privacy policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not\-for\-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high\-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. **Job Summary** The Opportunity Mass General Brigham is seeking an Information Security Engineer III to serve as a senior leader within the Digital Information Security Architecture team. In this role, you will evaluate a wide variety of technologies, business initiatives, operational processes, and strategic projects to identify security risks and provide practical, risk\-based guidance. Working closely with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and security professionals, you will help ensure that security considerations are incorporated into decision making throughout the organization. Bring your cybersecurity expertise to a role where you can help shape strategy, influence technology decisions, and strengthen security across the enterprise. We’re looking for a strategic thinker who can quickly assess unfamiliar technologies and business challenges, identify meaningful cybersecurity risks, and translate complex issues into clear, actionable recommendations. As a senior member of the team, you’ll: Shape cybersecurity strategy and standards. Advise leaders on technology and security risk. Evaluate emerging technologies and enterprise initiatives. Recommend practical, business\-focused security solutions. Partner with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Mentor team members and foster collaboration and continuous learning. What You'll Do * Analyze technologies, business initiatives, operational processes, and proposed solutions to identify security risks and provide practical, risk\-based guidance that supports informed decision making. * Quickly assess unfamiliar technologies, platforms, and business challenges, develop an understanding of their security implications, and translate that understanding into actionable recommendations. * Apply cybersecurity principles, industry frameworks, organizational standards, and professional analyses to evaluate complex situations and recommend appropriate security controls, safeguards, or courses of action. * Collaborate with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, project leaders, and security professionals to address security concerns and help ensure that security considerations are incorporated into decision\-making processes. * Research emerging technologies, evolving threats, regulatory requirements, and industry practices to determine their relevance and potential impact on the organization. * Perform security reviews, architectural evaluations, and other analytical activities to identify weaknesses, opportunities for improvement, and areas requiring additional safeguards or oversight. * Develop clear, concise, and well\-reasoned security guidance, recommendations, assessments, standards, reports, and other written deliverables that enable stakeholders to make informed business and technology decisions. * Communicate complex technical concepts, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations effectively to audiences ranging from engineers and project teams to business leaders and executive stakeholders. * Present findings, facilitate discussions, answer questions, and build consensus among stakeholders by explaining security concerns and recommended approaches in a clear, practical, and persuasive manner. * Serve as a trusted advisor by helping stakeholders understand cybersecurity risks, evaluate available options, and make balanced decisions that align with organizational objectives and risk tolerance. * Exercise independent judgment in situations that may involve incomplete information, competing priorities, evolving technologies, or ambiguous requirements. * Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of security standards, methodologies, assessment approaches, and best practices that strengthen the organization's overall security posture * Mentor junior and mid\-level team members by sharing technical knowledge, analytical approaches, communication skills, and professional expertise. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field required; equivalent experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree. * 5\-7 years of experience as a systems engineer, security engineer, security architect, cybersecurity consultant, or in a related role required. * Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, risk management concepts, and industry\-standard security frameworks. This role requires demonstrated ability to rapidly understand new technologies, business processes, and operational envir ncluding familiarity with cloud platforms, identity and access management, networking, applications, infrastructure, security operations, and emerging technologies. * Understanding of security concepts such as Zero Trust, least privilege, defense\-in\-depth, data protection, secure software development, threat modeling, and vulnerability management. **Skills For Success** * Exceptional communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts, influence stakeholders, and facilitate productive discussions. * Analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in complex and ambiguous environments. * Ability to mentor junior engineers and lead cross\-functional technical initiatives. **Additional Job Details (if applicable)** **Working Model Required** * Hybrid role with onsite work required; candidates must be flexible based on weekly or monthly business needs. * Monday\-Friday schedule during Eastern business hours. * On remote workdays, employees must work from a stable, secure, and compliant workstation in a quiet environment. Teams video is required and must be accessed using Mass General Brigham\-provided equipment. **Remote Type** Hybrid **Work Location** 399 Revolution Drive **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 **Employee Type** Regular **Work Shift** Day (United States of America) **Pay Range** $93,953\.60 \- $136,739\.20/Annual **Grade** 7 At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. We invite you to apply, and our Talent Acquisition team will provide an overview of your potential compensation and benefits package. **EEO Statement:** 0100 Mass General Brigham Incorporated is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. We will ensure that all individuals with a disability are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veteran’s Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact Human Resources at (857\)\-282\-7642\.**Mass General Brigham Competency Framework** --------------------------------------------- At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People\-Focused, half Performance\-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

jobs.title: Lead AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Lead AI Platform Engineer Who is Mastercard? Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we are helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support digital payment choices that make transactions secure, simple, smart, and accessible. Our technology, innovation, partnerships, and networks deliver products and services that help people, businesses, and governments realize their greatest potential. Overview The AI Platform Engineering team builds, operates, and evolves Mastercard's enterprise AI platforms. Our mission is to provide scalable, secure, and reliable AI infrastructure that enables teams across Mastercard to accelerate the development and deployment of AI\-powered solutions. As a Lead AI Engineer, you will provide technical leadership in designing, implementing, and operating the foundational platforms supporting AI and machine learning workloads across the enterprise. Working at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, MLOps, and AI operations, you will deliver capabilities that enable teams to safely develop, deploy, observe, and scale AI solutions across public and private cloud environments. You will help shape the platforms, tooling, operational practices, and infrastructure supporting the next generation of AI capabilities at Mastercard. You will address complex challenges involving scalability, reliability, observability, governance, automation, and customer enablement while influencing stakeholders and contributing to Mastercard's long\-term AI platform direction. About the Role As a Lead AI Engineer, AI Platform Engineering, you will serve as a developing subject matter expert responsible for advancing the architecture, engineering, automation, and operational excellence of Mastercard's AI platforms. You will lead the technical design and delivery of complex capabilities, improve existing products and processes, and influence decisions across engineering, infrastructure, security, architecture, and governance teams. The ideal candidate combines advanced software engineering and cloud platform expertise with experience supporting production AI and machine learning systems. You are passionate about technical leadership, automation, reliability, and building platforms that empower others to innovate. You are comfortable operating through influence, reviewing technical work, mentoring engineers, and translating complex requirements into scalable solutions. Responsibilities * Lead the design, development, and operation of enterprise platforms supporting machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI, and advanced analytics workloads. * Translate business, engineering, and operational requirements into scalable platform solutions and implementation approaches. * Design and maintain advanced AI and machine learning systems that meet enterprise requirements for security, reliability, availability, scalability, and performance. * Own technical delivery across public and private cloud environments, identifying dependencies, resolving complex challenges, and influencing cross\-functional decisions. * Build and optimize services and workflows that simplify onboarding, development, deployment, operations, and lifecycle management for AI solutions. * Develop infrastructure, tooling, and services supporting model training, evaluation, fine\-tuning, deployment, inference, monitoring, and governance. * Lead the implementation of repeatable, scalable, and secure MLOps capabilities and AI development workflows. * Build and optimize data ingestion, preprocessing, and feature engineering workflows supporting model training and inference. * Design observability capabilities including telemetry, performance monitoring, logging, alerting, operational analytics, model monitoring, and drift detection. * Ensure the operational stability and scalability of AI platforms, driving improvements to reliability, resilience, efficiency, security, and customer experience. * Lead troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and incident response for complex platform issues and translate lessons learned into sustainable improvements. * Influence platform architecture through design discussions, reviews, prototypes, tradeoff analysis, and technical recommendations. * Partner with engineering and product teams to understand requirements, guide solution design, enable adoption, and accelerat h enterprise generative AI platforms and large language model workloads. * Experience with model evaluation, fine\-tuning, guardrails, responsible AI controls, and model governance. * Experience with model observability, drift detection, telemetry, and operational analytics. * Experience with AI serving infrastructure, inference platforms, or AI gateways. * Experience supporting GPU\-based workloads and accelerated computing environments. * Experience with OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code. * Experience with enterprise platform engineering, developer enablement, and self\-service capabilities. * Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval\-augmented generation, AI gateways, agentic systems, and model routing. * Experience operating in regulated environments requiring strong security, governance, risk management, resiliency, and compliance controls. Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.**Corporate Security Responsibility** All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; * Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and * Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro\-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best\-in\-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on\-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on\-site fitness facilities in some locations. THIS POSTING RELECTS ONE OR MORE CURRENT VACANCIES ON OUR TEAM, AND MASTERCARD INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 01/26/2027\. If the fill date has passed, Mastercard intends to fill this position as soon as possible. **Pay Ranges** New York City, New York: $168,000 \- $277,000 USD Arlington, Virginia: $161,000 \- $266,000 USD Atlanta, Georgia: $140,000 \- $231,000 USD Austin, Texas: $140,000 \- $231,000 USD Boston, Massachusetts: $161,000 \- $266,000 USD O'Fallon, Missouri: $140,000 \- $231,000 USD Purchase, New York: $161,000 \- $266,000 USD

Agree acceptance criteria for quality, latency, cost and reliability, linking evaluation results to customer business goals and a decision on production deployment * \*\*Enterprise Trust \& Governance\*\* \- Address enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR). Gather technical feedback, identify common integration patterns, surface product gaps, and contribute field insights that shape the product roadmap and GTM strategy * \*\*Thought Leadership \& Enablement\*\* \- Create technical content including architecture guides, best\-practice documentation, and industry\-specific solution briefs. Enable the broader sales and partner ecosystem with technical training and reusable assets * \*\*Hands\-on Solutions\*\* \- Act as the primary technical owner for strategic accounts. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Mindex is looking for a Data Engineer to build the data pipelines, models, and warehouse structures behind SchoolTool’s interactive dashboards and analytics. You’ll work with the product team, customers, and fellow engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable data solutions and help shape technical design. The ideal candidate is analytical, communicates clearly, and is eager to take on new challenges and grow. **We welcome candidates from a variety of locations; however, all candidates should be open to occasional in\-person participation for business meetings, team events, or collaboration opportunities. Candidates located within approximately 35 miles of Rochester, NY may be asked to work from the office more frequently based on business or team needs.** ### **Compensation** $90,000 \- $140,000 ### **What You’ll Accomplish** * Build, test, scale, and maintain cloud\-native data pipelines, data models, and warehouse structures for SchoolTool’s dashboards and analytics. * Develop analytics solutions with Python, Apache Spark, Snowflake, SQL and NoSQL databases, and tools like Amazon QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI. * Contribute to large\-scale, complex data solutions, from data discovery and cleaning through model selection, validation, and deployment. * Engage directly with customer stakeholders, deliver work aligned with their roadmap and vision, and serve as their primary contact when needed. * Deliver well\-defined data solutions independently and contribute to technical design decisions. * Build technical and non\-technical connections within your team, across Mindex delivery teams, and with customer stakeholders. * Apply AI\-assisted engineering practices and the AI DLC across planning, design, development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. * Demonstrate an AI\-first mindset by effectively leveraging AI\-assisted tools and technologies to enhance productivity, accelerate problem\-solving, improve quality, automate routine tasks, and drive innovation in the delivery of solutions and services. **Requirements** * AS or BS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physical Science, Mathematics, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 3\-5 years of data engineering experience, including implementing a data pipeline for an enterprise application. * Experience with OLTP and OLAP databases, plus hands\-on experience with serverless platforms such as AWS Lambda and/or AWS Glue. * Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation and Terraform, and familiarity with DevOps tools like AWS CodePipeline, Azure DevOps, or GitLab. * Strong communication skills to explain complex information clearly to your team and customer stakeholders. * Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with a focus on exceptional customer service. * Highly organized and accurate, with strong initiative and follow\-through. * Comfortable working independently and in a collaborative, self\-organizing team, asking questions when needed and giving and accepting feedback. * Uses AI to augment expertise and decision\-making while maintaining ownership, accountability, and professional judgment for final work products and outcomes. * Identifies opportunities to use AI to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and increase business value. * Maintains awareness of emerging AI capabilities, tools, and best practices and proactively identifies opportunities to apply them in the workplace. * Demonstrates sound judgment in the ethical, secure, and compliant use of AI technologies while protecting confidential, customer, and company information. **Licenses \& Certifications:** * AWS Certification (Associate or Foundational) or applicable industry certifications are a plus. ### **Why Join Mindex?** For more than 30 years, Mindex has helped organizations solve complex business challenges through custom software, cloud, data, and AI solutions. We combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative culture that empowers our employees to innovate, grow, and make a meaningful impact for our clients. In our Product division, our teams have built platforms such as SchoolTool, Advanced Analytics, and our Integrations Platform from the ground up, while also supporting solutions like MTSS Edge and ClearTrack that help schools and organizations make smarter, data\-driven decisions. **Benefits** * Flexible Time Off * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) with Company Match * Company\-Paid Life and Disability Insurance * Professional Development Opportunities **Additional Information** Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Mindex is unable to sponsor employment visas at this time. **Physical Requirements/Conditions** * Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. * No heavy lifting is expected. Exertion of up to 10 lbs.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description: ### ***Build It From the Ground Up: Lead Engineering for Plano's New Boutique Hotel*** #### **Perks** Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, 401k Match, 11 Company Paid Holidays and Generous PTO package. **Position Summary** The **Chief Engineer** is responsible for the strategic leadership, administration, and daily operations of the Engineering Department. This hands\-on leader oversees hotel maintenance, building systems, preventive maintenance programs, energy management, life safety systems, and capital projects to ensure the property operates safely, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable regulations. The Chief Engineer leads the Engineering team, manages budgets, oversees vendors and contractors, and partners with hotel leadership to maintain the property's physical condition, operational performance, and commitment to exceptional guest experiences. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** **Department Leadership \& Team Management** * Provide strategic leadership and direction for all Engineering Department operations. * Recruit, interview, hire, train, coach, and develop Engineering team members, including Assistant Chief Engineers, Engineers, Technicians, and Maintenance personnel. * Establish departmental goals, performance expectations, and operational standards. * Create a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and continuous improvement. * Conduct performance evaluations, coaching sessions, and corrective action when appropriate. * Develop team members through cross\-training and professional development opportunities. * Lead daily engineering meetings and communicate priorities, projects, and operational needs. **Engineering Operations \& Maintenance** * Oversee daily maintenance operations to ensure the hotel remains safe, functional, and guest\-ready. * Manage preventive and corrective maintenance programs for guestrooms, public areas, restaurants, meeting spaces, back\-of\-house areas, and building systems. * Oversee HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, fire/life safety, elevators, pool/spa systems (if applicable), kitchen equipment, and other critical systems. * Ensure timely response to guest maintenance requests and operational issues. * Coordinate repairs and maintenance activities with hotel departments to minimize guest disruption. * Maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment logs, and service documentation. * Ensure guestrooms and public areas meet brand standards and operational expectations. **Preventive Maintenance \& Asset Management** * Develop and maintain comprehensive preventive maintenance schedules. * Monitor completion rates and ensure maintenance tasks are completed accurately and on time. * Conduct routine inspections of equipment, systems, and facilities. * Identify operational risks and recommend solutions to protect hotel assets. * Maintain equipment manuals, warranties, service agreements, and maintenance records. * Partner with ownership and leadership on capital improvement planning. **Budget \& Financial Management** * Develop and manage the Engineering Department operating budget. * Monitor expenses related to repairs, maintenance supplies, utilities, and contracted services. * Identify cost\-saving opportunities through energy conservation and operational efficiencies. * Manage vendor relationships and negotiate service agreements as needed. * Review invoices, purchase orders, and maintenance expenses for accuracy and compliance. * Assist with capital expenditure planning and project management. **Safety, Compliance \& Risk Management** * Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including OSHA, fire/life safety requirements, and environmental standards. * Maintain compliance with hotel safety policies and emergency procedures. * Manage inspections, permits, licenses, and regulatory requirements related to building systems. * Oversee workplace safety programs and ensure proper use of tools, equipment, and personal protective equipment (PPE). * Investigate maintenance\-related incidents, safety concerns, and property damage. * Participate in emergency response planning, drills, and crisis management procedures. **Energy Management \& Sustainability** * Implement energy conservation initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operating costs. * Monitor utility usage and identify opportunities for improvement. * Support sustainability initiatives and environmentally responsible practices. * Maintain compliance with applicable environmental standards and company sustainability goals. * Partner with leadership on green building initiatives and certifications, when applicable. **Vendor \& Contractor Management** * Manage relationships with outside contractors, service providers, and vendors. * Review contractors work to ensure quality, safety, and compliance. * Coordinate inspections, repairs, and specialized services. * Ensure vendors follow hotel policies and safety requirements. * Maintain documentation for vendor agreements and service history. **Administrative Responsibilities** * Prepare engineering reports, maintenance schedules, project updates, and operational summaries. * Maintain departmental SOPs, emergency procedures, and maintenance documentation. * Review payroll, schedules, attendance, and overtime for accuracy. * Participate in department head meetings. * Support hotel renovations, pre\-opening activities, equipment installation, and operational readiness. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** * High school diploma or GED equivalent required. * Minimum of **5–7 years of progressive engineering or facilities experience** in a hotel, resort, commercial building, or similar environment. * Minimum of **3 years of leadership or supervision experience** managing an engineering or maintenance team. * Strong knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical systems, building operations, and preventive maintenance. * Experience managing budgets, vendors, contractors, and capital projects. * Strong understanding of OSHA requirements, safety practices, and building compliance standards. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and maintenance management systems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and progressive engineering experience will be considered. * Previous experience in a full\-service, boutique, lifestyle, or luxury hotel. * Previous pre\-opening hotel experience. * Experience with hotel engineering systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and energy management platforms. * Certified Facilities Manager (CFM), Certified Maintenance \& Reliability Professional (CMRP), or similar certifications preferred. * Knowledge of sustainability practices and green building certifications such as LEED or similar programs. * HVAC, electrical, plumbing, or mechanical certifications preferred. **Physical Requirements** * Stand, walk, climb stairs, and move throughout the hotel for extended periods. * Inspect mechanical rooms, equipment areas, guestrooms, and back\-of\-house spaces. * Work in varying environmental conditions, including heat, cold, noise, and confined spaces. * Lift, carry, push, and pull up to **50 pounds**. * Use hand tools, equipment, and maintenance devices. * Respond quickly to emergency situations. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Work Environment** This position operates in a fast\-paced, 24\-hour hotel environment requiring professionalism, flexibility, adaptability, and strong leadership. The Chief Engineer must be comfortable balancing strategic department leadership with hands\-on involvement in daily maintenance operations while ensuring the hotel remains safe, functional, and guest\-ready. Availability to work a flexible schedule based on business needs, including days, evenings, weekends, holidays, and emergency situations, is required. **Miyako Hybrid Hotel Plano is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member is respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.** **Together, we'll build more than a hotel, we'll create an exceptional destination defined by heartfelt hospitality and the HEART values that inspire everything we do.**

jobs.title: Systems Designer
jobs.description: We're looking for an **Systems Designer** to join our team in **Irvine, CA, working on a hybrid schedule.** In this hands\-on role, you'll design, balance, and improve gameplay systems, features, and virtual economies across our casual free\-to\-play mobile games. You'll own features from initial concept through implementation, launch, and ongoing Live\-Ops improvements. This includes defining rules and interactions, modeling intended player behavior, considering UI and UX flows, and partnering with product and development teams to deliver clear, engaging player experiences. Economy design is a significant part of this role. You'll model player progression, resource earning and spending, and wallet growth over time, using those models to inform rewards, pricing, monetization, and feature balance. Your initial onboarding will include economy reviews and improvement work across multiple live titles. Working with cross\-functional teams, you'll translate player needs and business goals into practical designs, use data to evaluate performance, and continuously improve systems to support engaging player experiences and business objectives. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Own assigned features from concept and specification through development, testing, launch, and iteration. * Design interconnected gameplay and metagame systems, including progression, goals, collections, live events, and social and/or competitive features. * Define system rules, dependencies, edge cases, and tuning parameters, considering how changes affect the broader game. * Build spreadsheet models for player progression, intended behavior, resource consumption, and wallet balances over time. * Design and balance virtual economies, including currencies, rewards, boosters, lives, resource sources and sinks, and purchase value. * Develop and tune in\-app purchases, offers, bundles, and rewarded\-ad opportunities within the overall player experience. * Use prototypes, playtesting, player feedback, and performance data to test assumptions and improve designs. * Partner with Product and Analytics to define success metrics, support A/B tests, and evaluate results. * Maintain clear documentation and balancing tools, and work with development teams to verify that features function as intended. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 3\+ years of professional game design experience, including hands\-on systems and economy design for casual free\-to\-play mobile games. * Experience taking features through implementation and launch on at least one shipped or live mobile title. * Strong understanding of player motivation, progression, reward pacing, and how interconnected systems influence player behavior. * Experience designing or balancing virtual currencies, rewards, resource flows, and in\-app purchase systems. * Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including modeling progression, economic balance, and player scenarios. * Ability to communicate feature rules, player flows, and design reasoning clearly through documentation and visual examples. * Experience using player data, testing, and feedback to guide design decisions. * Ability to manage assigned features independently while collaborating across disciplines and incorporating feedback. **Key Qualifications:** * Experience with puzzle, card, solitaire, match, or other casual game genres. * Familiarity with hybrid monetization combining in\-app purchases and advertising. * Experience with Unity, prototyping tools, internal configuration tools, and/or live\-ops platforms. **A Little Bit About Us:** MobilityWare is one of the leading mobile game publishers of card and puzzle games. With our headquarters in the heart of Orange County and a growing studio in Utah, we're dedicated to our mission of bringing joy to others one game at a time. Ever since our flagship title Solitaire hit the Apple App Store on the day it opened in 2008, MobilityWare has been entertaining gamers around the world. With a product portfolio that includes beloved hits such as FreeCell, MONOPOLY Solitaire, Spades, Hearts, Mahjong, and Bubble Shooter Pop, our games have been downloaded over 600 MILLION times. MobilityWare was recently named one of Built in LA's Best Places to Work for the fifth year in a row and we've been recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in Orange County five times by the Orange County Business Journal and OC Register. While we're proud to be the company behind some of mobile gaming's most popular titles, our most important achievement is creating a work environment that encourages professional growth and prioritizes the wellness of all of our team members. **Do we have your attention yet? Here are just some of the perks of working with us:** * We offer medical (100% paid option), dental (100% paid), vision (100% paid), unlimited PTO/Vacation, life insurance (100% paid), and a 401K with competitive contribution. * Annual, all\-inclusive company trip for you and a guest. Previous destinations includeHawaii, a Mexican Riviera Cruise, Las Vegas and Los Cabos! * In the office we offer things like free lunch, free snacks, and free drinks. * Casual workplace that includes a relaxed dress code, plus a newly remodeled office in the heart of Irvine. * Growth, growth, growth \- we are growing, and we would love for you to join us on the ride. * Annual Game Jam to show off your creative chops! In compliance with local law, we are disclosing compensation for this role. The range listed is just one component of MobilityWare' s total compensation package for employees, which may include short\- and long\-term incentives and program\-specific awards. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job\-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, certifications, location, business needs, or market demands. This range is based on a full\-time position. This range may be modified in the future. The annual base salary pay range for this role is $85,000\- $105,000\.

jobs.description: Are you passionate about making a difference in people's lives? Do you enjoy working in a service\-oriented industry? If so, this opportunity may be the right fit for you! This position is responsible for the design, development and support of new software applications, works with business owners and IT support staff on assigned project(s) to create and implement software products, and takes responsibility for documenting functional and design specifications to ensure the product meets the users' needs. **This role…** * Develops new software including programming and scripting languages, business process tool sets, data modeling and reporting tools. * Develops and maintains business applications in client\-server or web\-based environments. * Codes new software, performs unit and functional testing of the code, and partners with Quality Assurance to test and fix bugs in the software. * Leads design meetings and work with software architects to develop overall design of new system modules and data layouts. * Writes functional and design documentation, user requirements, unit test plans, and user documentation. * Works with leadership to set coding, review, and design policy. * Works with the IT Network group and ensures software installation for end users. * Follows up with end users to ensure the application is working properly. * Assists the technical services team to resolve customer problems. * Works within an agile methodology and performs the role of scrum master. * Presents product demonstrations to leadership and product stakeholders. * Performs periodic technology overview and training sessions. * Mentors and coach junior engineers. * Researches and evaluates methods and techniques for solving problems. * Uses approved AI\-assisted tools to support coding/scripting, testing, debugging, troubleshooting, documentation, technical research, and related work to improve the quality and speed of deliverables. * Reviews and validates AI\-generated outputs to ensure they meet company standards for security, privacy, quality, accuracy, and responsible use. * Supports the adoption and expansion of AI technologies by evaluating tools, new uses and processes while providing constructive feedback. As AI technologies and business practices evolve, the scope of supported activities may expand. * Participates in other projects or duties as assigned. **We are interested in speaking with individuals with the following…** * **Education \& Experience:** + Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, MIS, or related technical discipline required. + Five (5\) plus years of related industry experience. + Previous employment in the healthcare or insurance industry preferred. + Or equivalent combination of education and/or experience. * **Technical Skills:** + Expert in React Native with a proven track record of building and maintaining mobile applications for both iOS and Android. + Proficient in React and familiar with AI\-assisted development tools and workflows (preferred). + Strong familiarity with backend services, REST APIs, and AWS cloud infrastructure. + Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control (Git), and branching strategies. + Solid understanding of testing frameworks, test\-driven development, and automated QA practices. + Knowledge of performance monitoring, mobile analytics, and observability tools. + Bonus: Exposure to HIPAA compliance, secure data exchange, and healthcare interoperability. + Proficient in enterprise relational databases (MS SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2\). + Strong familiarity with UI technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript. + Strong familiarity with Figma UX/UI design tool. * **Additional Skills:** + Strong problem\-solving and analytical capabilities. + Effective verbal and written communication skills. + Demonstrated success collaborating across departments. + High responsiveness to evolving business needs. + Recognized as a subject matter expert on software tools and release processes.
