jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Job** As a Sr. Data Engineer at Molex, you will be a vital contributor to our Enterprise Data Platform, responsible for designing and implementing data pipelines, optimizing data workflows, Managing Data Storage and ensuring data quality, reliability, and accessibility. Your work will be instrumental in empowering our organization to make data\-driven decisions and fueling innovation across the company. **Our Team** Joining our Enterprise Data Platform team means becoming a key player in a dynamic and innovative group of professionals dedicated to unlocking the power of data. Here, you'll find a diverse and collaborative environment where your ideas and expertise will shape the future of our data\-driven organization. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of continuous learning, creativity, and teamwork, and we're looking for individuals who are eager to contribute their skills and passion to our shared mission. **What You Will Do** * Collaborate closely with business partners and data scientists to align data engineering efforts with their specific needs and objectives, ensuring that data solutions contribute effectively to the organization's overall goals. * Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using tools such as Snowflake, AWS Glue, and Lambda. * Design and implement data modeling and ETL/ELT processes to ensure data quality, consistency, and availability. * Design and Organize databases such as Snowflake, AWS DynamoDB, or AWS S3\. * Assembling large, complex sets of data that meet non\-functional and functional business requirements. * Write validation checks to catch errors, remove duplicates, and normalize formats so downstream teams trust the data. * Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, resolving issues to ensure uninterrupted data flow. * Optimize and fine\-tune data pipelines for performance and efficiency. * Manage and maintain data warehouses and ensure data security and compliance with company policies and relevant regulations. * Perform data transformations, aggregations, and data cleansing to support analytics and reporting needs. * Implement data integration strategies for streaming and batch data sources. * Automate and orchestrate data workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention. * Document data engineering processes, pipelines, and architecture for knowledge sharing and compliance. * Stay up\-to\-date with industry best practices, emerging technologies, and trends in data engineering. **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * 10\-15\+ proven years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role, with a strong understanding of data engineering principles and best practices. * Proficiency in SQL and data modeling. * Experience with data warehouse technologies such as Snowflake. * Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala. * Familiarity with cloud computing platforms, particularly AWS. * Understanding of data integration concepts and tools like AWS Glue and Lambda. * Experience with DevOps practices and tools, such as continuous integration (CI) and continuous deployment (CD) pipelines, version control systems (e.g., Git). * Experience in using Agile project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) to track progress and manage work in an Agile environment. * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. **What Will Put You Ahead** * Certification in data engineering or related AWS certifications. * Knowledge of data orchestration and workflow management tools. * Knowledge of data governance and compliance best practices. * Ability to mentor junior team members and lead data engineering projects. * Strong project management and organizational skills. * Ability to collaborate closely with data scientists to deploy and operationalize AI empowered tools. For this role, we anticipate paying $150,000 \- $180,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. **Hiring Philosophy** All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . **Who We Are** At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. jobs.description: **About us** Musgrove Engineering, P.A. is seeking an Energy Modeler / Building Performance Analyst to join our team in Boise, Idaho. This position will support our engineering and commissioning teams by developing whole\-building energy models, performing energy\-code compliance analysis, evaluating HVAC and envelope alternatives, and helping project teams make practical, data\-driven decisions about building performance. Musgrove provides mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering as well as energy studies, audits, retrofits, energy modeling, commissioning, and LEED\-related services. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding how buildings actually use energy, can dig into HVAC systems and building envelopes, and can turn modeling results into useful recommendations for engineers, architects, owners, and contractors. **Job Activities:** * Develop whole\-building energy models for commercial and institutional projects. * Model HVAC systems, building envelopes, lighting, occupancy, controls, schedules, and other energy\-consuming systems. * Analyze design alternatives and identify opportunities to reduce annual energy consumption and operating costs. * Perform energy\-code compliance analysis using applicable editions of the IECC and ASHRAE Standard 90\.1\. * Prepare COMcheck documentation and related energy\-code compliance calculations. * Evaluate HVAC system alternatives, including equipment efficiencies, heat recovery, economizers, controls, and system configurations. * Analyze envelope alternatives including insulation levels, glazing performance, air leakage, and solar characteristics. * Assist engineers with energy\-efficiency decisions during schematic design, design development, and construction documents. * Support energy audits, retrofit studies, commissioning, and existing\-building performance evaluations. * Perform utility\-bill and energy\-use analysis when required. * Prepare clear reports, calculations, graphics, and summaries explaining modeling assumptions and results. * Coordinate with mechanical and electrical engineers, architects, owners, commissioning providers, and other members of the design team. * Review architectural and MEP drawings to obtain the information necessary to construct accurate energy models. * Maintain model documentation so assumptions and results can be readily reviewed by the project team. Preferred Education Bachelor's degree in: * Mechanical Engineering * Architectural Engineering * Building Science * Energy Engineering * Architecture or a related technical field. Candidates with strong HVAC, building\-energy, or modeling experience may also be considered. Preferred Experience * Building energy modeling or HVAC load/energy analysis * Commercial or institutional building design * Reading architectural and MEP construction documents * Understanding HVAC systems and controls * Building\-envelope fundamentals * Energy\-code compliance Experience in an MEP consulting environment is a plus. Software Experience Experience with one or more building\-energy modeling platforms is preferred, such as: * EnergyPlus / OpenStudio * eQUEST * Trane TRACE 3D Plus * IES Virtual Environment * EnergyPro * Carrier HAP * COMcheck We are not necessarily looking for someone who already knows every program. A strong understanding of HVAC systems, building physics, and energy\-modeling fundamentals is more important than expertise with a particular software package. Ideal Candidate The right person for this position is: * Analytical and naturally curious about how buildings perform * Comfortable working with detailed technical information * Able to troubleshoot results that don't initially make sense * Familiar with HVAC equipment and system operation * Detail\-oriented without losing sight of the overall design objective * Comfortable working directly with engineers and architects * Able to explain technical modeling results in straightforward language * Interested in energy efficiency, high\-performance buildings, and practical engineering solutions **We offer a competitive salary and benefits program that includes:** * Career Growth * Long Term Bonus Program * Health \& Dental Benefits * 401K Contributions and Matching * Fun work environment \& an awesome team to work with * Working on complex and high level projects. jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Neo.Tax helps companies automate complex tax and accounting workflows by connecting data across project management, payroll, identity, and financial systems. We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer to help prospective and existing customers understand how Neo.Tax can solve their problems and fit into their technical environments. This is a founding role—you will be the first solutions engineer ever hired at Neo.Tax! You’ll partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to lead technical discovery, design credible solutions, deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept, and guide technical evaluations toward successful adoption. You’ll translate customer workflows and constraints into clear solution plans, communicate trade\-offs honestly, and bring recurring needs back to the product team. This is a customer\-facing, technically grounded role focused on solution fit and adoption—not ownership of customer production deployments or core product engineering. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers: understand their workflows, systems, goals, constraints, and evaluation criteria. * Deliver tailored product demos and technical walkthroughs that connect Neo.Tax capabilities to customer outcomes. * Design and explain solution architectures, data flows, and integration approaches across systems such as project management, code repositories, HRIS, payroll, ERP, and data warehouses. * Validate technical feasibility, data readiness, access requirements, and security or networking constraints; surface risks and dependencies early. * Build lightweight prototypes, sample analyses, scripts, or proofs of concept when they help demonstrate value or de\-risk an evaluation. * Partner with Sales to qualify technical fit, scope proposed solutions, respond to technical questions, and set clear expectations. * Support customer technical evaluations, including architecture reviews, security and IT diligence, and implementation planning. * Coordinate effective handoffs to Customer Success, implementation, and Engineering, staying engaged as needed to support early adoption. * Share customer feedback and recurring requirements with Product and Engineering, helping distinguish one\-off requests from opportunities for reusable product capabilities. * Create and improve reusable demo assets, reference architectures, technical documentation, and playbooks. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- ### **Technical and solution\-design skills** * Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, technical consulting, implementation, or another customer\-facing technical role. * Strong technical fundamentals and the ability to reason about APIs, integrations, data flows, and enterprise software environments. * Comfort working with data\-heavy workflows and evaluating data quality, mapping, and integration requirements; SQL or scripting experience is helpful. * Ability to assess technical feasibility and explain architecture, security, and implementation trade\-offs without overpromising. * Ability to build clear, focused demos or lightweight proofs of concept; production software engineering experience is helpful but not required. ### **Customer\-facing and problem\-solving skills** * Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong discovery skills: you ask focused questions, clarify what success means, and turn ambiguous needs into a practical solution plan. * Product sense and judgment to identify when a customer request is specific to one account versus representative of a broader need. * High ownership, sound follow\-through, and comfort managing multiple evaluations and stakeholders. * Empathy for customer workflows and the ability to build trust through clear, accurate communication. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience supporting enterprise SaaS evaluations or complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles. * Familiarity with accounting, tax, finance, fintech, or R\&D workflows. * Experience with data integrations, ETL/ELT, SQL\-heavy systems, or common enterprise platforms. * Familiarity with AI/ML products and how to explain their capabilities, limitations, and data requirements. * Experience navigating enterprise security, privacy, compliance, or networking reviews, including SOC 2 environments or private\-network requirements. **How you’ll be evaluated** --------------------------- * Ability to quickly understand a customer’s domain, workflow, and technical environment. * Quality of technical discovery and the clarity and accuracy of proposed solutions. * Ability to deliver relevant demos and proofs of concept that help customers evaluate value and feasibility. * Judgment in setting expectations, surfacing risks, and moving evaluations toward clear next steps. * Execution under constrained timelines: deliver a clear, technically sound evaluation and proof of va ms. * Expect a mix of customer\-facing conversations, demo and evaluation preparation, and focused internal work. * You may occasionally travel for key customer engagements (frequency TBD). **Compensation \& benefits** ---------------------------- * Salary range: $170,000–$190,000 * Stock Option Plan (5–10 bps of equity) * Health Care Plans (Medical, Dental, Vision, Short\-term Disability) + 90% coverage for individual \+ family * Health \& Wellness subsidy * Retirement Plan (401k) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Work From Home (100% remote team) **Additional Details** ---------------------- Still interested? Here’s more about the opportunity and how this role can make an impact. ### **Why Join Now** * **A pivotal growth stage:** Join as Neo.Tax scales its enterprise business and builds repeatable ways to support complex customer evaluations. * **Meaningful customer impact:** Help companies modernize costly, manual tax and accounting workflows with software and AI. * **Enterprise customer exposure:** Work with customers including Adobe, Block, CapitalOne, Mercury, Whoop, and Thomson Reuters. * **Small team, big ownership:** Shape how we qualify technical fit, demonstrate value, and carry customer insight back into the product. * **Greenfield opportunity:** This is a founding role—you will be the first solutions engineer ever hired at Neo.Tax! Help develop the demos, proof points, and solution patterns that make a complex product easier to evaluate and adopt. ### **Who You Are** * **Ownership\-oriented:** You keep evaluations moving, follow through on commitments, and make the next step clear. * **A proactive communicator:** You summarize what you heard, surface risks early, and ask clarifying questions instead of making assumptions. * **Customer\- and business\-aware:** You connect technical choices to customer outcomes and commercial priorities. * **Pragmatic:** You explain trade\-offs and recommend a workable path rather than defaulting to a perfect\-on\-paper solution. * **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You can learn a customer’s environment quickly and make progress without a complete spec. ### **What It’s Like to Work Here** * You’ll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering, with a direct line from customer conversations to product feedback and go\-to\-market improvements. * We’re remote\-first and prefer time zones that can overlap with our San Francisco, CA headquarters. jobs.title: Support Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: **About Nebius:** Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D. ### **The role** We are looking for an L3 Support Engineering Lead to help grow a small team responsible for resolving Nebius' most complex customer issues. This is a hands\-on technical role that combines deep troubleshooting with day\-to\-day team leadership. You will provide technical direction, help organize the team's work and step into complex investigations when your expertise is needed. You will not be expected to personally own every difficult ticket or manage the team from a distance. The L3 team works closely with L2 Support, pre\-sales, post\-sales, customer engineering and product teams. It brings deeper subject\-matter expertise to issues that require advanced investigation or a broader understanding of the Nebius platform. This is a remote position in North America. **Your responsibilities will include:** * Lead and support a small, distributed team of L3 Support Engineers. * Help plan, prioritize and distribute work based on customer impact, technical complexity and team capacity. * Provide technical guidance and hands\-on support for complex or high\-impact customer issues. * Coach engineers, share knowledge and help the team become increasingly independent. * Build strong working relationships with L2 Support, pre\-sales, post\-sales, customer engineering, product and engineering teams. * Make sure escalations include the technical context, evidence and customer information needed by the receiving team. * Identify whether an issue belongs to the platform, a customer environment or another technical area, and involve the appropriate specialists. * Maintain high standards for troubleshooting, documentation, handoffs and customer communication * Identify recurring issues and gaps in tooling, documentation, processes or team knowledge, and help drive practical improvements. * Support team planning, coverage and forecasting as the organization grows. * Participate in scheduled operational or duty work when specialist expertise is required. This may occasionally include work outside standard business hours. * Contribute to hiring and onboarding additional engineers as the team expands. **We expect you to have:** * Strong hands\-on experience troubleshooting complex production, cloud or infrastructure\-related issues. * Experience leading technical work, mentoring engineers or coordinating a small team or task force. * Clear and confident communication with customers, engineers and cross\-functional stakeholders. * Strong working knowledge of Linux environments. * Experience with Kubernetes and container\-based platforms. * A practical understanding of infrastructure fundamentals, including networking and storage. * Familiarity with block, file and object storage and the ability to investigate issues across these technologies * Sound judgment when working through ambiguous or high\-impact technical problems. * The ability to organize work, set priorities and keep multiple stakeholders aligned. * You do not need to be an expert in every technical area. We are looking for someone with broad familiarity across the following domains and deeper expertise in at least one: + AI and ML operations, such as model deployment, fine\-tuning, inference or performance troubleshooting. + Workload scheduling in GPU or high\-performance computing environments, including tools such as Slurm. + Kubernetes and its supporting technology stack. + Cloud infrastructure, networking and storage. * Fluent written and spoken English. **It will be an added bonus if you have:** * Experience supporting GPU cloud infrastructure or AI/ML workloads. * Experience planning or troubleshooting model deployments. * Familiarity with Python or Bash scripting and technical automation. * Experience working in a technical support, SRE, production operations or customer engineering organization. * Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams that provide 24/7 customer coverage. **Key employee benefits in the US:** * **Health insurance:** 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families. * **401(k) plan:** Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting. * **Parental leave:** 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers. * **Remote work reimbursement:** Up to $85/month for mobile and internet. * **Disability \& life insurance**: Company\-paid short\-term, long\-term and life insurance coverage. **Benefits \& Perks:** * Competitive compensation * Career growth and learning opportunities * Flexibility and ownership * Collaborative and innovative culture * Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects * International environment and talented teams **What's it like to work at Nebius:** Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI **Equal Opportunity Statement:** Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior Principal Software Engineer to build a new Data Processing Unit (DPU) platform spanning networking and storage. You will address system\-level questions such as host\-versus\-DPU responsibilities, predictable tail latency under mixed workloads, and correct behavior across offload transitions, failures, and upgrades. You will own a major subsystem spanning components and teams. Depending on the assignment, that could include a storage I/O pipeline, packet processing pipeline, host\-to\-DPU data path, or infrastructure acceleration subsystem. You will define architectural boundaries, align component owners, and remain accountable for integration and subsystem outcomes. We welcome engineers with deep storage data path expertise and working familiarity with networking, or deep networking data path expertise and working familiarity with storage. Your primary ownership will draw on your strengths while requiring collaboration across both domains. **What you will do** Own subsystem architecture and outcomes. Turn ambiguous system requirements into an architecture, component contracts, and a phased delivery plan. Establish decision authority and resolve tradeoffs that individual component owners cannot settle independently. Shape foundational data path decisions. Evaluate partitioning across host, DPU software, firmware, and hardware. Validate choices about queueing, memory ownership, acceleration, and recovery through prototypes and representative workloads. Lead delivery across component owners. Decompose subsystem work, align technical dependencies, and resolve integration risks across teams. Guide implementation through other engineers while personally implementing or debugging critical paths. Set end\-to\-end performance expectations. Establish subsystem budgets and targets for throughput, tail latency, resource efficiency, and relevant storage I/O or packet processing metrics. Resolve bottlenecks that span component boundaries. Connect storage and networking architecture. Work with engineers in both domains to evaluate I/O processing, transport, ordering, buffering, backpressure, and recovery tradeoffs. Ensure local optimizations preserve end\-to\-end performance, availability, and data integrity. Own integration and production readiness. Lead subsystem qualification and technical readiness reviews. Establish compatible interfaces, observability, fault isolation, and safe upgrade behavior; resolve systemic risks during rollout and operation. Develop component owners. Mentor engineers in architectural judgment and systems debugging. Establish shared engineering practices and help component leaders make sound decisions independently. Establish reusable AI practices. Guide effective AI use across subsystem engineering work, with validation and clear accountability. Share approaches that improve quality and productivity, reduce repetitive debugging and documentation, and support employee well\-being. **Required qualifications** 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience in systems or infrastructure software, including substantial hands\-on experience building high\-performance storage data paths or networking data paths. Demonstrated technical ownership of a major subsystem spanning multiple components and engineering teams, from ambiguous requirements through production integration. Deep expertise in either storage data path architecture, implementation, and optimization, or networking data path architecture, implementation, and optimization. Relevant experience may include storage I/O pipelines, block storage or storage transport, or high\-performance packet processing and network virtualization. Strong hands\-on C or C\+\+ expertise and deep knowledge of Linux, synchronization, memory management, multicore architectures, and performance analysis. Working familiarity with the complementary domain: networking fundamentals and transport behavior for storage specialists, or storage I/O architecture and behavior for networking specialists. Ability to evaluate cross\-domain performance and failure interactions with partner engineers. Experience defining component boundaries and contracts, establishing performance budgets, and resolving cross\-component correctness and reliability issues. A record of driving technical alignment and delivery across teams while remaining actively involved in implementation and difficult debugging. Ability to explain complex architectural decisions and develop other engineers into effective component owners. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred qualifications** Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable. Experience with every listed technology is not required. DPU architecture \- DPUs, SmartNICs, AMD Pensando, NVIDIA BlueField/DOCA, P4, or comparable technologies; software, firmware, and hardware interface design. Packet processing \- Architecture or substantial extension of DPDK\-based systems or comparable user\-space packet processing frameworks. Storage data paths \- Storage I/O pipeline design or optimization, block storage, NVMe, NVMe over Fabrics, RDMA, or storage virtualization. Hardware and production \- Hardware co\-design, PCIe, DMA, SR\-IOV, IOMMU, zero\-copy techniques, fleet qualification, failure recovery, or upgrade compatibility. What success looks like You will establish a coherent subsystem architecture, align component owners, and deliver successful integration with measured end\-to\-end results. You will resolve systemic risks early, lead consequential cross\-team decisions, and strengthen the technical judgment of the engineers around you. Why join us Influence foundational architecture while remaining deeply involved in engineering. You will have ownership of how a substantial part of the platform fits together, performs, and reaches production, working with experienced networking, storage, and hardware partners.

jobs.description: **Data Integration Engineer** **Utility Operations \| Los Angeles, California** **Employment:** Full\-time **Work arrangement:** On\-site in Downtown Los Angeles, 5 days per week **Annual base salary:** $95,000–$118,000, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated capabilities **About Over J Consulting** Over J Consulting works with utility and infrastructure clients to connect engineering information, operational processes, data and technology. We help teams turn disconnected information and manual workflows into reliable, practical tools that support better decisions. We are looking for a hands\-on Data Integration Engineer who can understand how an existing process works, identify what needs to improve and personally build and support the solution. You will join a small delivery team, report to the CEO and work directly with analysts, engineers, operational users and clients. The role requires independent technical execution, clear communication and a collaborative approach. **What you will do** * Analyze existing spreadsheets, scripts, databases and workflows. Trace where information comes from, how it is transformed and how people use the output. * Diagnose inherited processes, identify dependencies and failure points, and make controlled improvements while preserving approved business rules. * Write and maintain Python scripts, SQL queries and Excel or Power Query transformations to combine, clean, map and reconcile data from different sources. * Connect approved systems using APIs, database connections or automated file transfers. Address authentication, changing data structures, retries, duplicate records and incomplete runs. * Identify missing, invalid, conflicting, stale or misidentified data. Document exceptions and work with the appropriate business or engineering owner to resolve them. * Test changes, reconcile inputs to outputs and use version control so work is repeatable and maintainable. * Document setup, dependencies, data definitions, operating steps, quality checks and recovery procedures so another colleague can run and support the workflow. * Explain findings, limitations and recommendations clearly. Lead focused client reviews to clarify questions, discuss tradeoffs and agree on next steps. * Coordinate with Engineering, Operations and IT. Raise unresolved business rules, delivery risks and capacity concerns early. Route engineering decisions to the appropriate technical authority. **What you must bring** * At least **five years of relevant professional experience** in data integration, workflow automation, data engineering or software delivery, including recent hands\-on development. * Practical Python experience, including the ability to read, debug, modify and test existing code written by someone else. * Strong SQL skills, including joins, data types, null handling, duplicate detection, validation and reconciliation. * Advanced Excel skills and experience creating repeatable transformations with Power Query or an equivalent tool. * Practical experience connecting systems or moving data through APIs, database connections or automated file transfers. * Personal delivery of at least **two operational integrations or automations**, including an inherited workflow you improved and supported. You should be able to explain your contribution, checks and results. * Experience using Git or equivalent version control, testing changes and documenting work for others. * Ability to independently execute scoped work, ask precise questions, communicate issues early and respond constructively to review. Current residence within a reasonable commuting distance of Downtown Los Angeles and the ability to meet the required in\-person schedule. * A relevant degree is useful. Equivalent demonstrated professional experience is also valued. The five\-year minimum applies to your overall relevant experience, not separately to each tool. **Experience that strengthens your application** IoT and telemetry experience is a valued differentiator. We welcome examples of connecting or supporting device data and handling asset identity, timestamps, units or data freshness. **Lack of IoT experience will not disqualify an otherwise qualified candidate.** Other useful experience includes utilities, infrastructure, manufacturing or regulated environments; asset, materials or supply\-chain data; SAP, Maximo or GIS; Power BI, Power Apps or SharePoint; PDF/OCR; and cloud or container environments. **What success looks like** * **First 30 days:** Independently operate one selected existing workflow using accepted checks and recovery instructions. * **By day 60:** Operate a second workflow and complete a tested handover. * **By day 90:** Demonstrate an approved, measurable operational improvement. Assignments will have defined scope, required access and reviewer support. **How to apply** Apply through Paycor with your résumé and be prepared to discuss two examples of work you personally delivered. Sanitized examples or descriptions are welcome; please do not share confidential employer or client information. Finalists will complete a paid, time\-limited exercise using fictional data and an existing workflow, followed by a live review. You will be asked to explain your changes, checks, limitations and recommendations. Reasonable adjustments to the selection process are available.

That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. **Job Summary** Are you ready to make a significant impact in the tech world? As a strategic technical leader on our team, you'll be at the helm of designing, developing, and deploying enterprise\-grade AI applications, real\-time agentic workflows, and complex data\-driven reasoning platforms that scale effortlessly across global workloads. You'll lead high\-stakes technical directions, establish enterprise\-wide AI design patterns, and mentor engineering teams across the organization. In our fast\-paced, high\-energy environment, cross\-functional leadership is paramount. You'll collaborate closely with executive leadership, product leaders, security directors, and cross\-functional engineering teams to turn ambitious AI initiatives into transformative, reliable products. **Your Impact** * **Architectural Leadership:** Define and execute the technical strategy for enterprise AI, LLM deployment architectures, and multi\-agent systems across the engineering organization. * **Agentic \& Reasoning Systems:** Design scalable multi\-agent systems, autonomous decisioning engines, tool\-use frameworks, and complex event\-driven agentic workflows. * **Data \& AI Infrastructure:** Architect end\-to\-end streaming and batch data/embedding pipelines, hybrid search/RAG architectures, and vector indexing systems powering enterprise LLM features. * **Production Guardrails \& Governance:** Set enterprise standards for AI evaluation, observability, cost\-performance optimization, safety guardrails, hallucination reduction, and security compliance. * **Technical Excellence:** Mentor Senior Staff and Senior Engineers, establish code quality standards, and foster a culture of continuous AI innovation and research\-to\-production execution. * **Cross\-Functional Influence:** Partner with Product, Security, and Cloud Architecture teams to align technology roadmaps with long\-term business goals. **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 9\+ years of software engineering experience with 4\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and delivering production\-grade AI/LLM features, RAG platforms, and agentic architectures. * **GCP \& Cloud Native:** Extensive hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, including Vertex AI, BigQuery, DataFlow, BigTable, and GKE. * **Agentic Orchestration \& AI Frameworks:** Deep expertise with modern agentic architectures (multi\-agent orchestration, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, task planning, state management, long\-term memory systems) using frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or custom agent engines. * **Data Engineering \& Vector Search:** Proven background in data engineering, building streaming/batch pipelines (DataFlow, Apache Beam, Spark), and fine\-tuning vector search architectures (Vertex AI Vector Search, Pinecone, PGVector, Milvus). * **Core Languages:** Mastery in Python and Java/Scala with a strong focus on high\-throughput, latency\-sensitive, and fault\-tolerant system design. * **Streaming \& Messaging:** Expert knowledge of distributed event streaming platforms (Google Pub/Sub, Kafka) and asynchronous event\-driven system architecture. * **DevOps, MLOps \& CI/CD:** Hands\-on experience with MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, continuous evaluation CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Vertex AI Pipelines), model monitoring, tracing (LangSmith, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry), and deployment patterns. * **Security \& Governance:** Deep understanding of data privacy, prompt injection prevention, access control, encryption, and governance in enterprise cloud AI environments. * **Containerization:** Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE), service meshes, and microservices architecture. * jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest\-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean\-energy, and infrastructure development across the country. Despite being a $1\.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de\-risk projects, and scale with confidence. As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization. We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top\-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber. **Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in\-office days per week). We prefer NYC\-based candidates or those open to relocation.** **Role Overview** ================= We’re hiring a Principal Engineer to own the evolution of our architecture and platform so it works for agents as well as people. Our goal is simple: double the output of our entire organization while raising the quality bar. The scope is the whole platform. You’ll work across infrastructure, shared services, and product code, and step in as a product engineer anywhere in the stack when that is the fastest way to move. The ideal candidate is deep in code architecture and platform engineering, already works agent\-first, and has built foundations that other teams adopted because they were better. This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering. **What You'll Do** ================== * Own the architecture of our codebase. Set the patterns, module boundaries, and domain abstractions across our monorepo, and lead the refactors and migrations that get us there. * Design the monorepo for agents. Structure packages, ownership, the build graph, and conventions so an agent can find the right context, make a scoped change, and verify it without reading the whole repo. * Build the platform substrate. Own the shared services, infrastructure, and paved paths (data access, background jobs, environments, observability) that product teams build on and agents can use safely. * Own the agentic SDLC. Define how work moves from ticket to production when agents do much of the writing, testing, and reviewing. Set the defaults every team builds on, and change them as models and tools improve. * Scale verification with volume. Build AI\-assisted code review, test generation, and CI gates so confidence to merge keeps pace as PR volume doubles. Decide where human review is required and where it is not. * Put agents to work in the background. Stand up agents that pick up well\-scoped tickets, triage flaky tests, run dependency upgrades and large migrations, and draft fixes from incidents and error reports. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * You've owned the architecture of a large, multi\-team codebase. You've set the module boundaries and patterns others build within, run monorepo tooling (Nx, Turborepo, Bazel, or similar), and led migrations that changed how a whole org works. * Strong platform and infrastructure depth: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, and services you've run in production through real incidents. * You can work across the stack as a product engineer, from data model to UI, and you're happy to do it. * You work agent\-first today. A large share of the code you ship comes from AI coding agents, and you have specific, earned opinions on where they break and how codebase structure fixes that. * Current knowledge of the agentic stack as it applies to software engineering: context engineering, agent instructions and skills, MCP, sandboxed execution, and how to evaluate a coding agent's output. * You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate. * 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including time setting technical direction across multiple teams. **What We Offer** ================= * Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high\-growth company * 100% company\-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees \+ healthcare FSA * 401(k) savings plan * Unlimited PTO and paid family leave * Home office \& equipment stipend * Daily in\-office lunch and dinner provided * Commuter benefits (pre\-tax transit and parking) *PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.* *We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.* Compensation Range: $250K \- $300K

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Data Collection Hardware
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Mechanical Engineer, Data Collection Hardware **Department:** Software Engineering **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Location:** Pensacola, FL **Travel:** 10% **Who We Are** Persona is building humanoid robots for the most demanding environments in heavy industry — shipyards, steel mills, fabrication facilities, and offshore platforms — performing welding, grinding, maintenance, inspection, and material\-handling work that is dangerous, physically demanding, and increasingly difficult to staff. Korea is the center of gravity for our early commercial strategy, anchored by relationships with the world’s leading shipbuilders and steelmakers. Our work spans both the robot platform itself and the systems, partners, and playbooks required to deploy it at scale. **Why Join Persona?** * We offer competitive compensation, a performance\-based bonus, 100% employer covered medical benefits for most healthcare plans, early\-stage equity, competitive PTO, and company\-wide paid winter break between December 24th and January 2nd. * You’ll shape technology that’s redefining the possibilities of robotics and human interaction. * Work alongside passionate teammates who value creativity, and continuous learning. **About the Role** As a Mechanical Engineer focused on Data Collection Hardware, you will bridge the gap between human operators and humanoid kinematics. Your time will be spent in fast\-paced rapid development of handheld UMI data\-collection tools capable of capturing delicate contact dynamics. Later, there will be the opportunity for rigorous, precision engineering as you architect and build a hand and human exoskeletons. To train robot foundation models at Persona, we will be relying on massive amounts of high\-quality, human\-demonstrated data, including rich force and tactile feedback. You will initially be responsible for rapidly iterating on agile, handheld Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices. **What You Will Be Doing** * **Force\-Aware UMI Hardware Design:** Design, rapid prototype, and assemble handheld UMI frames, grippers, and mounting rigs that accurately mimic our humanoid’s hand mechanics while integrating load cells and force\-torque sensors to capture contact forces. * **Sensor \& Actuator Integration:** Design precise, vibration\-resistant mounts for spatial tracking sensors, GoPros, embedded electronics, and force sensors in the UMI. Seamlessly integrate high\-resolution encoders and haptic\-feedback motors in the console to enable robust, force\-aware data collection corresponding with the robot’s senses. * **Rapid Prototyping \& Manufacturing:** Seamlessly shift between rapid in\-house 3D printing for UMI iterations and sourcing machined metal components (CNC, sheet metal) for the console structure. * **Design for Assembly and Design for Manufacturing:** Should be proficient in DFM, DFA, and GD\&T concepts. + Defining PCBA outlines when working with EE (mounting points, outline). + Choosing appropriate materials for housing. + Shock\-vibe considerations. + Experience with industrial design and the human experience. * **Workstation Ergonomics (Human Factors):** Apply human\-factors engineering to design seating and viewing angles that accommodate the 5th to 95th percentile of human operators during extended, fatigue\-free data collection sessions. * IP rating considerations for equipment used outdoors (water resistance). * Human ergonomics when designing for use with human hands. * Basic thermal analysis for components mounted with hardware. **What We Are Looking For:** * **Education:** B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related field. * **CAD Proficiency:** 4\+ years of advanced experience with 3D CAD modeling software (OnShape, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Siemens NX), managing both small parts and large, complex workstation assemblies. * **Precision Mechanism Design:** Proven experience designing multi\-axis kinematic systems, selecting bearings, and managing cable\-drive or low\-friction transmission systems. * **Force \& Tactile Sensing Integration:** Demonstrated experience integrating load cells, 6\-axis force\-torque (F/T) sensors, or tactile arrays into mechanical assemblies to capture physical interactions. * **Human\-Factors Experience:** Demonstrated understanding of ergonomic principles and designing hardware that physically interfaces with human users for long durations. * **Prototyping Expertise:** Deep hands\-on experience with both rapid prototyping (advanced 3D printing) and traditional manufacturing processes (machining, turning). * **Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop:** Experience designing enclosures and structural routing for delicate sensors, heavy optics/monitors, and cable management. **Bonus Skills:** * Previous experience in teleop and data collection devices, such as surgical robotics (e.g., designing consoles or master controllers for systems like Da Vinci, Monarch, or Ottava). * Experienced with implementing optics/cameras, such as: + Accommodating FOV estimates. + Choosing appropriate window materials. * Background in mechanical haptics, force\-feedback systems, and admittance/impedance control hardware. * Experience designing flight simulators, driving rigs, or high\-end VR hardware. * Familiarity with mechatronics and integrating smart servos into mechanical assemblies. * Experience with designing human wearables (watch/pedometer/glasses). ***Persona is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** ***All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.***

jobs.description: **About Positron AI** Positron AI specializes in developing custom hardware systems to accelerate AI inference. These inference systems offer significant performance and efficiency gains over traditional GPU\-based systems, delivering advantages in both performance per dollar and performance per watt. Positron exists to create the world's best AI inference systems. **About the role** As Emulation Test Engineer, you'll provide technical direction for pre\-silicon validation of Positron's next\-generation AI inference ASIC. You'll own the end\-to\-end emulation strategy on the Cadence Palladium platform, architecting complex model builds, managing multi\-rack partitioning, and driving the "left\-shift" of our software development. You'll collaborate across RTL, DV, and Software teams to build high\-performance virtual environments that prove out architectural functionality and accelerate firmware/OS bring\-up months before tape\-out. This role is critical to our silicon success: you'll set the emulation methodology, resolve hardware\-software bottlenecks at scale, and ensure our design is silicon\-ready. **What you'll do** * **Massive\-Scale Model Architecture:** Lead the partitioning and compilation of our design across a multi\-rack Palladium environment, optimizing for performance and debug visibility. * **Software Enablement (Left\-Shift):** Create and maintain the hybrid emulation and co\-simulation environments (using **SCE\-MI** or **DPI**) that allow our software teams to boot OS images and run AI workloads on pre\-silicon hardware. * **Full\-Stack Validation:** Design and execute comprehensive emulation test plans to verify high\-speed interfaces (**PCIe Gen 6/7, 112G\+VSR, Ethernet**) and complex AI memory hierarchies. * **Performance \& Power Analysis:** Utilize Palladium’s **Dynamic Power Analysis (DPA)** and throughput monitors to identify "true peaks" and performance bottlenecks that simulation cannot capture. * **Vendor Management:** Act as the primary technical point of contact with Cadence R\&D to troubleshoot tool issues and leverage the latest **Palladium Z3** capabilities. **You'll Be Successful Here if You Have** * **Deep Palladium Expertise:** Extensive hands\-on experience with **Cadence Palladium (Z1/Z2/Z3\)**, including advanced clocking, ICE (In\-Circuit Emulation), and Virtual Interface (VIF) flows * **Complex SoC Background:** A track record of emulating multi\-billion gate designs where partitioning, runtime predictability, and compile efficiency were critical success factors * **Automation Mastery:** Expert\-level **Python**, **Tcl**, and **Bash** skills to build and maintain the infrastructure for automated model releases and nightly regressions * **Hardware\-Software Debug Skills:** Proficiency in debugging low\-level firmware and kernel\-level issues using **Verdi**, **SimVision**, and hardware\-software co\-debug tools **Minimum Requirements** * **Education:** BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science. * **Experience:** 8\+ years in **ASIC Emulation** or Verification, with significant experience on large\-scale Palladium installations * **Technical Skills:** Mastery of **SystemVerilog**, **Verilog**, and **C/C\+\+** for transactor development and reference modeling. * **Protocol Knowledge:** Deep understanding of data center protocols including **PCIe**, **DDR** and **AMBA AXI/NoC** **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this role is $180,000 – $300,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the **base salary range only** and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, **we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range** for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future. **Health and wellness** * Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility** * Unlimited paid time off — we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future** * Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you’re excited about the role but don’t meet every bullet, we’d still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.description: ### **About the role:** At Provectus, you don’t prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude \+ AWS system into their real, regulated production — then you watch the business number move. We’re an Anthropic and AWS Partner with 150\+ certified architects. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter — without the layers, politics, and years\-to\-impact of a hundred\-thousand\-person firm. 350\+ builders, 100\+ customers in production, founder\-led since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA. **Why Provectus** ----------------- * **Frontier access** — Anthropic Preferred Partner: newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems. * **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. * **Embedded, not engaged.** You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff\-augmented. * **Autonomous.** You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. * **Your experience stays portable.** Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy\-maintenance grind, not a single stack. * **Craft \& growth** — build beside senior FDEs on a Claude\-certified team; a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name. * **We give you a stage:** Claude certification, conference talks, open\-source contributions, published work under your own name. ### **Requirements:** * Typically 7\+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands\-on today and intend to stay that way. * Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly. * Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works. * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non\-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why. * Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. * Cloud\-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits. * Pre\-sales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room. * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job. * Hands\-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses). ### **Nice to have** * Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production. * IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform. * Open\-source contributions or public writing on applied AI. ### **What you’ll do:** * Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive — and you are the one who builds it. * Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously. * You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. * Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare. * Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice. ### **What We Offer:** * Full\-time. * On\-site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC 1/week * Unlimited Vacation policy. * Generous health, vision, and dental insurance. * 401(K) matching plan. * Base salary $180k–$200k \+ bonuses; OTE up to $250k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data. * **No Visa sponsorship** ### **We’re real:** * **A person reads your application.** We filter out AI\-generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team. * **We may ask for a quick ID verification.** Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates. * **You’ll meet the people you’d work with.** We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We'd be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Co\-Founder \& CEO. ### **How we hire:** * Recruitment interview. * Tech interview with our FDE (30 min). * A live engineering building session (1\.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. ***Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI\-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows.*** 4\. Soft skills interview. 5\. Offer discussion. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Tier II Engineer - Second Shift
jobs.description: Description: We are seeking a driven, proactive, and customer\-focused Tier II Service Desk Engineer to join our Managed Network Services team on second shift (1:00 PM – 11:00 PM). In this role, you will provide intermediate\-level technical support, handle ticket escalations, drive client environment standardization, perform proactive system maintenance, and ensure our RMM and documentation tools remain up to date during non\-peak business hours. You will act as a critical escalation point for Tier I support, providing hands\-on coaching and mentorship to junior technicians, while occasionally dispatching on\-site or collaborating with Tier III engineers for high\-level issue resolution. This position is ideal for someone with strong troubleshooting skills, queue management discipline, a solid understanding of infrastructure, and a passion for delivering an exceptional client experience. **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide remote and occasional on\-site technical support for desktop, server, and network issues across diverse client environments. * Serve as a primary escalation point for Tier I support, actively coaching junior technicians on escalated resolutions, teaching new tools, and guiding appropriate escalation timing. * Manage individual and team ticket queues in ConnectWise, maintaining high daily accountability (\~7 hours of billable/accountable time, closing 6–8 tickets per day, and logging all correspondence in tickets). * Conduct proactive daily client communications, following up at least twice per day on open issues and adhering to strict ticket closure policies after 3 days of non\-response. * Perform proactive system maintenance, network backup checks, server administration updates, and environment standardization aligned with Proven IT best practices during second\-shift hours. * Assist in maintaining and updating core RMM/PSA platforms, diagnostic tooling, and client documentation in IT Glue and ConnectWise Knowledge Base. * Promptly identify and escalate critical issues (server outages, network downtime, wide\-impact disruptions) to Team Lead and Management. * Support new client transitions, attend training on new client software, and cross\-train team members on newly introduced technologies. * Participate in weekend and off\-hour rotation schedules to field escalations from third\-party or after\-hours support teams. * Maintain high operational standards regarding clocking in/out, shift punctuality, professional attire, and cell phone/Teams availability for escalation routing. * Support internal initiatives related to process improvement, service delivery best practices, and documentation hygiene. Perform other duties or projects as assigned. Requirements: **Required Skills \& Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Information Systems, MIS, or related field—or equivalent work experience. * 2–4 years of experience in an IT support role, including hands\-on Tier II responsibilities within an MSP or multi\-client environment. * Strong working knowledge of Windows OS (desktop and server), Office 365, Active Directory, and common networking protocols. * Familiarity with remote management tools and documentation platforms (ConnectWise, ScreenConnect, IT Glue, RMM platforms). * Experience supporting and troubleshooting firewalls, switches, VPNs, and wireless networks (Cisco, Meraki, SonicWall, Sophos, etc.). * Microsoft, CompTIA, or Cisco certifications (MCP, MCSA, Network\+, CCNA) strongly preferred. * Must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong self\-management, and a high level of professionalism. * Valid driver's license and reliable form of transportation for potential on\-site dispatches. * Strong attention to detail, multitasking ability, and a proactive attitude toward continuous learning. **Physical Requirements:** * Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. * Ability to work in confined spaces (e.g., under desks, server rooms). * Frequent walking, standing, bending, kneeling, and use of hands to operate tools and equipment. * Use of computer, phone, and other office and diagnostic equipment regularly. **Benefits** **GROUP HEALTH INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week) and their dependents, are eligible to enroll in health benefits utilizing the Cigna network. Health options include a choice of 2 PPO plans or a High Deductible Health Plan with employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA). In addition, Dental benefits are available as well as a Vision PPO plan utilizing the EyeMed network. Proven also offers voluntary worksite benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident coverage, short\-term disability insurance, supplemental life and pet insurance. Additional offerings include an employee discount program, home and auto insurance services and commuter/transit FSA. **EMPLOYER PROVIDED LIFE/AD\&D INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, Proven IT provides a flat $25,000 Life Insurance benefit to all full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week). Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) benefit payments are determined based on the type of loss incurred and are payable up to the full Life Insurance benefit amount. Life and AD\&D Insurance coverage amounts are reduced at ages 65, 70 and 75\. **EMPLOYER PROVIDED LTD:** Long\-Term Disability (LTD) insurance is an employer\-provided benefit and provides protection from loss of income in the event that an employee is unable to work due to illness, injury, or accident for a long period of time. The elimination period is 90\-days, and the maximum benefit is 60% of covered payroll up to $6000/month. This benefit is paid entirely by Proven IT and has no cost to the employee. **EMPLOYEE ASSISTANCE PROGRAM:** All employees may utilize the Disability Resource Services through Mutual of Omaha to assist themselves and their immediate family with convenient resources to help address emotional, legal and financial issues. Telephonic counseling and web\-based services are available as well as a limited number of geographically accessible face\-to\-face sessions. **401K PLAN:** All employees are eligible after 120 days of service to contribute on either a pre\-tax or post\-tax (Roth) basis to the 401K plan, administered by Principal Financial Services. Proven offers an employer match equal to 100% of the first 3% of deferrals plus 50% of the next 2% of deferrals. **FINANCIAL ADVISORY SERVICES:** Proven IT partners with Merrill Lynch to offer financial advisement to all employees. Merrill Lynch financial advisors are available to assist employees at no cost, with their 401k and retirement questions. **PERMISSIVE TIME OFF POLICY:** Proven provides a competitive paid time off policy for all full\-time regular employees after a 90\-day waiting period. Proven IT empowers their employees to work with their managers and team to coordinate all time off. Managers may impose a limit to requests for time off based on performance and tenure. **PARENTAL LEAVE:** Proven IT offers a generous parental leave policy for new parents. After 24\-months of employment, Proven provides full\-time regular employees with 90\-days of paid Maternity leave and 10\-days of paid Paternity leave. Employees with less than 24\-months of service may take the same amount of unpaid time off. **FITNESS CENTER:** Proven IT offers a free on\-site fitness center at the Tinley Park headquarters office location to all employees 24/7 Monday through Sunday. Employees utilize the gym equipment at their own risk. Proven IT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. If you need assistance or accommodation during the hiring process, please contact us. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** Title: Senior Mechanical Automation Engineer Department: Tech Center – Product R\&D Location: Houston, TX Supervisor: Director, Automation \& Robotics FLSA Status: Exempt Position Status: Permanent, Full Time Work Status (Remote/Hybrid/In\-Office): Hybrid SENIOR MECHANICAL AUTOMATION ENGINEER Hanwha Qcells USA Corp (Qcells USA), headquartered in Houston, TX, specializes in providing utility\-scale modules, solar photovoltaic (PV), and battery energy storage systems (BESS) project development, along with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services for solar and BESS projects nationwide. Qcells USA delivers comprehensive turnkey solutions encompassing the entire utility\-scale project lifecycle. By choosing Qcells USA for turnkey solutions, customers can reduce uncertainty and risk, leading to enhanced investment returns and contributing to a more sustainable future. Qcells USA’s complete turnkey solutions seamlessly integrate the expertise of our Development, Module, and EPC teams, while ensuring close coordination with other vital internal groups such as Project Finance, Systems Integration, and Legal. This collaborative approach ensures that Qcells USA projects deliver exceptional value and performance. With several multi\-billion\-dollar investments, Qcells is pioneering the establishment of the only complete module supply chain in the U.S., including the expansion of our Georgia module manufacturing facility, which stands as the largest in the Western Hemisphere. As an integral part of the global Qcells brand, Qcells USA benefits from a legacy of excellence in photovoltaic manufacturing. Qcells is renowned worldwide for its high\-performance, superior\-quality solar cells and modules. With dual headquarters in Seoul, South Korea (Global Executive HQ) and Thalheim, Germany (Technology \& Innovation HQ), Qcells operates under the umbrella of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 company and one of the top 8 business conglomerates in South Korea. Summary We are currently seeking a Senior Mechanical Automation Engineer to work with our cross\-functional business units to design and implement automated and robotic assembly systems for utility scale solar power plant construction. This position reports to the Director of Automation and Robotics or another management personnel that the CEO of the Company may designate. This position is hybrid for candidates living near a corporate office Houston, TX requiring up to four days per week on site. Candidates living outside the commuting distance of an office location will operate as fully remote with occasional travel. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8 am to 5 pm or from 9 am to 6 pm local time. This position is expected to travel up to 20%. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: * Lead mechanical design of new automation and related solar products from concept through commercialization, applying statics, dynamics, and mechanics principles to solve complex assembly and installation challenges. * Collaborate with controls engineers, system integrators, and cross\-functional and third\-party partners to integrate custom and commercial\-off\-the\-shelf (COTS) components (robots, conveyors, drives, sensors) into complex automation systems. * Develop 3D CAD models and detailed product drawings in SolidWorks. * Perform structural and stress (FEA) analysis and maintain FMEA, design\-verification, and calculation reports, establishing safety factors and ensuring traceability between requirements, design, testing, and compliance evidence. * Design and execute prototype, system\-integration, and validation testing (lab and field, including FAT/SAT); document findings, perform root\-cause analysis on failures, and recommend design or process changes. * Engage field teams and customers to gather prototype feedback, validate design solutions, and prepare installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting documentation. * Lead or support mechanical workstreams on development programs, tracking milestones, managing design reviews, and communicating technical risks, trade studies, and recommendations to project leadership and cross\-functional audiences. * Ensure designs meet applicable safety and design standards; coordinate third\-party certification with test labs and regulatory bodies. * Apply value engineering and design\-for\-manufacturing (DFM) practices with manufacturing and supply partners to optimize cost, manufacturability, and field reliability. * Develop and maintain economic models (cost, logistics, field performance, operations) to support investment and pricing decisions. * Convert market requirements and competitive/market analysis into mechanical design specifications and product strategy, aligning scope and targets with cross\-functional teams. * Doc lectromechanical systems, including designing and executing validation protocols. * Familiarity with relevant engineering standards and codes (e.g., OSHA 29 CFR 1910, ANSI B11, NFPA 79, UL 1740\) and experience supporting or managing third\-party certification processes. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to cross\-functional teams and senior leadership, in both written and verbal formats. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, meet schedules, escalate risks proactively, and work effectively in remote/distributed team settings. Preferred Qualifications * Solar or utility\-scale energy industry experience; familiarity with solar tracker systems, PV module assembly, field\-deployment equipment, and single\-axis solar tracking mechanics/control principles. * Design and development of robotic assembly systems or related automation. * Experience with mobile or field\-deployable equipment: understanding of logistics, field setup, transportation, and operational support requirements for equipment deployed across multiple sites. * Experience with design\-for\-manufacturing (DFM), lean manufacturing principles, or value\-stream mapping to optimize designs for cost and manufacturability. * Demonstrated ability to own a technical domain and serve as subject\-matter authority on cross\-disciplinary projects. * Experience managing vendor relationships and integrating COTS subsystems into larger products; comfort navigating supplier quality, lead times, and technical\-support constraints. EXAMPLES OF PHYSICAL DEMANDS * Stationary Position: frequently remains stationary up to 90% of the time and sitting up to 8 hours in a day * Move/Traverse: infrequently bend, stand, stoop and/or walk * Carry Weight: infrequently carry weight and/or lift objects (light to heavy) weighing up to 10 pounds * Hearing and Speech: frequently communicates with the ability to hear and talk on a regular basis with employees, coworkers, and all personnel matters; must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations * Sight: frequent use of sight to detect images on computer, office documents, and office objects near and far * Climb: occasionally ascends/descends on stairway to get to office upper and lower floors * Travel: up to 20% as needed EXAMPLES OF WORK ENVIRONMENT * Regular professional, office business setting * Noise level ranges from low to moderate (if in office setting) * Noise level ranges from moderate to high (if on construction worksite) * Under the Office Mobilization Plan (OMP) policy, the role may transition to an onsite or hybrid arrangement, as determined by business needs and the Head of Department Hanwha Qcells is proud to be an at\-will Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination against race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status and any other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice, reflecting our dynamic and evolving work environment. We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. Please contact us to request accommodations at hr\-usa@qcells.com.
