jobs.title: Staff Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Quizlet:** ================== At Quizlet, our mission is to help every learner achieve their outcomes in the most effective and delightful way. We’re a $1B\+ learning platform used by two\-thirds of U.S. high school students and half of college students, powering over 1 billion learning interactions each week. We blend cognitive science with machine learning to personalize and enhance the learning experience for students, professionals, and lifelong learners alike. We’re energized by the potential to power more learners through multiple approaches and various tools. **Let’s Build the Future of Learning** Join us to design and deliver AI\-powered learning tools that scale across the world and unlock human potential. **Why Join Quizlet?** --------------------- **Massive reach:** 60M\+ users, 1B\+ interactions per week **Cutting\-edge tech:** Generative AI, adaptive learning, cognitive science **Strong momentum:** Top\-tier investors, sustainable business, real traction **Mission\-first:** Work that makes a difference in people’s lives **Inclusive culture:** Committed to equity, diversity, and belonging **About the Team:** ------------------- Security Engineering protects Quizlet's learners, employees, and systems. We build practical safeguards that help teams deliver products securely and confidently. We partner with engineering, infrastructure, trust \& safety, and other teams to reduce risk while supporting a reliable experience for learners. **About the Role:** ------------------- As a Staff Cloud Security Engineer, you will set technical direction and deliver security improvements across our cloud infrastructure and public\-facing services. Your primary focus will be Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), workload identity, infrastructure as code, and remediation. You will also improve edge defenses and turn data\-protection requirements into technical controls, automated checks, and evidence that those controls work. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Lead cloud and Kubernetes security improvements, including workload identity, organization policies, and network protections. Partner with Infrastructure and identity colleagues on design, implementation, and tested rollouts. * Operate cloud security tooling, prioritize findings by risk, and work with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and harden container images. * Improve WAF rules, rate limits, bot defenses, and anomaly detection to catch malicious traffic while reducing disruption for legitimate users. * Build maintainable security automation and review infrastructure as code so secure configurations are easier to adopt and sustain. * Create self\-service patterns for securely exposing new services and connecting AI tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to approved data. * Partner with engineering to implement agreed data\-protection requirements through enforceable controls, CI checks, regression tests, and reliable evidence. * Guide cross\-team security decisions, mentor engineers, and support incident response and security on\-call responsibilities. **What you bring to the table:** -------------------------------- * As a rough guide, we’re looking for 8\+ years working with public\-cloud infrastructure, including 5\+ years in cloud security engineering. These are guidelines rather than hard cutoffs; equivalent experience demonstrating the depth and Staff\-level impact described here is welcome. * Experience securing GCP and GKE environments. * Deep hands\-on experience securing production cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes workloads, including identity and access, networking, Linux, and containers. * Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, and programming languages such as Python or Go to build security controls and automation. * Ability to translate security requirements into practical controls, automated tests, and evidence of effectiveness. * A record of leading complex technical work across teams, making and explaining sound risk tradeoffs, and communicating clearly and respectfully. **Bonus points if you have:** ----------------------------- * Experience designing and tuning WAF rules, rate limits, or bot defenses, with attention to detection quality and customer impact. * Experience with Cloudflare and HUMAN/PerimeterX or comparable edge and bot\-defense platforms. * Experience operating Wiz or similar cloud security platforms and improving workload and container\-image security. * Experience securing AI or MCP integrations, or automating controls that support data\-protection commitments and assurance frameworks. **Work Location** ----------------- We’re happy to share that this is a **hybrid position** in our **San Francisco** office. To support collaboration, we ask employees to be in the office at least **two days a week: Wednesday and Thursday**. **Compensation, Benefits \& Perks:** ------------------------------------ * Collaborate with your manager and team to create a healthy work\-life balance * 20 vacation days that we expect you to take! * Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance (100% employee and 75% dependent PPO, Dental, VSP Choice) * Employer\-sponsored 401k plan with company match * Access to LinkedIn Learning and other resources to support professional growth * Paid Family Leave, FSA, HSA, Commuter benefits, and Wellness benefits * 40 hours of annual paid time off to participate in volunteer programs of choice **We strive to make everyone feel comfortable and welcome!** We work to create a holistic interview process, where both Quizlet and candidates have an opportunity to view what it would be like to work together, in exploring a mutually beneficial partnership. We provide a transparent setting that gives a comprehensive view of who we are! **In Closing:** --------------- At Quizlet, we’re excited about passionate people joining our team—even if you don’t check every box on the requirements list. We value unique perspectives and believe everyone has something meaningful to contribute. Our culture is all about taking initiative, learning through challenges, and striving for high\-quality work while staying curious and open to new ideas. We believe in honest, respectful communication, thoughtful collaboration, and creating a supportive space where everyone can grow and succeed together.” Quizlet’s success as an online learning community depends on a strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer and a tech company committed to societal change, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Women, people of color, members of the LGBTQ\+ community, individuals with disabilities, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. \#LI\-Onsite **To All Recruiters and Placement Agencies** -------------------------------------------- At this time Quizlet does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and/or profiles. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website or to any Quizlet employee. Quizlet will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or firm nor will it be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. All unsolicited resumes received will be considered the property of Quizlet. Compensation Range: $200,479 \- $263,129

engineers in the U.S. and Cebu, Philippines, and with partner teams across Technology and Operations. * The incumbent works free from daily oversight, regularly exercising independent discretion and and transform data between our transportation management system and connected systems. * Own the technical design of assigned integrations: write solution designs, weigh trade\-offs, and propose technical needs, including onboarding and setup, troubleshooting, and escalated issues. * Contribute to AI\-enabled services that give AI tools safe, governed access to integration capabilities. * Use AI\-assisted development tools and automation to speed up delivery and remove repetitive setup and support work. **Quality \& Release*** Write automated tests and keep the team's CI pipelines healthy. * Review code and approve changes for promotion to staging, in line with team standards. * Mentor Integrations Engineer I team members through development, code review, and documentation. **Support \& Reliability*** Share ownership of the team's core production services with other engineers, so no service or approval depends on a single person. * Monitor the team's integrations and lead the triage of production incidents for the services you own: find the root cause, put fixes in place, and document what happened. * Act as a technical backup to the Engineering Manager for design decisions and release approvals when needed. * Help modernize legacy integrations by moving them onto the current platform. **Collaboration \& Documentation*** Work from business requirements documents (BRDs), and contribute technical requirements and estimates. * Partner with the teams that own connected platforms to validate new or changed interfaces, report defects, and confirm fixes. * Keep runbooks and API documentation current so the wider team and the Helpdesk can support integrations. * Handle customer and partner data securely, in line with company security practices. * Other duties as may be assigned by management. **Qualifications \& Skills** ---------------------------- **Required Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum 4 years' experience in backend software engineering or systems integration. * Strong backend development experience in **Node.js/TypeScript**. * Experience designing **REST APIs**, including authentication, versioning, and documentation. * Experience with **event\-driven architectures** and message streaming (e.g., Kafka). * Experience operating event\-streaming pipelines in production, including throughput, lag, and recovery. * Experience integrating enterprise systems (ERP, TMS, or similar), including data mapping. * Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases. * Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), containers, and CI/CD. * Track record of owning services in production, including monitoring, incident response, and root\-cause analysis. * Experience reviewing code and mentoring other engineers. * Strong written communication and the discipline for **asynchronous work across time zones** (U.S. Pacific Philippines). * Proficient in English communication (verbal and written). **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience integrating with **SAP TM** or other enterprise TMS/ERP platforms. * Experience building data pipelines or change\-data\-capture solutions. * Experience with observability tooling (logs, metrics, an r using AI\-assisted development tools. * Experience with test automation frameworks. * Exposure to EDI or file\-based data exchange. * Experience in the freight forwarding, logistics, or transportation industry is an asset. * Familiarity with Jira and Confluence. **Business Skills*** Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills in a team environment. * Accurate and detail\-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership for production systems. * Able to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. * Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Team cooperation and respect are required. **Work Schedule** ----------------- * Full\-time schedule of a minimum of 8 hours per day, with the flexibility to complete all required job duties and responsibilities. * Regular overlap with team members in the Philippines, and occasional after\-hours availability for production incidents. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** ----------------------------------------- While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods; use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and lift and/or move up to 15–25 pounds (e.g., files, supplies, or equipment). Specific vision abilities require close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The role operates in a professional climate\-controlled office environment with a usually moderate noise level.**Compensation** ---------------- **Base Pay Range:** $36\.50 \- $45\.70 per hour*The base pay range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for this specific location. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Rapsodo Operating System (ROS)
jobs.description: Rapsodo is a global sports technology company with offices in the United States, Singapore, Türkiye, Japan, and Malaysia. We build data\-driven, portable sports analytics products that help athletes understand and improve their performance. From Major League Baseball pitchers to professional golfers, our products are used globally across all levels of sport. We operate as a globally distributed team, enabled by ownership, clarity, collaboration, and disciplined execution. We are innovative, focused, and rapidly growing, and continuously looking for team players who will stop at nothing to deliver state\-of\-the\-art solutions as part of Team Rapsodo. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a curious, resourceful, and hands\-on **Software Engineer** to join our Rapsodo Operating System (ROS) team in St. Louis, Missouri. You will help build, maintain, and continuously improve the systems and tools that power how Rapsodo operates as a business. This includes developing internal software, integrating third\-party platforms, resolving technical issues, and creating automation solutions that make our operations simpler, faster, and more effective. Working closely with colleagues across our St. Louis, Singapore, and Türkiye offices, you will collaborate on shared systems, solve technical challenges, and deliver solutions that support our global operations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys figuring things out, solving real\-world problems, and exploring how technology, including AI, can improve the way people work. What matters most is your ability to think critically, learn quickly, take initiative, and turn problems into practical solutions. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, maintain, and enhance internal applications, systems, and tools that support Rapsodo's business operations. * Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable, sustainable solutions. * Build integrations between internal applications and third\-party business systems to improve connectivity and data flow. * Design and implement automation solutions to streamline workflows, reduce manual work, and improve operational efficiency. * Collaborate with colleagues across St. Louis, Singapore, and Türkiye to understand business challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and translate requirements into practical technical solutions. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, troubleshooting, testing, and solution development while ensuring quality and reliability. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code, applying sound software engineering practices. * Test, monitor, and continuously improve system reliability, performance, security, and usability. * Explore new technologies and challenge existing ways of working to deliver simpler, smarter, and more scalable solutions. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Sound understanding of programming concepts, software development, databases, APIs, and system integration. * Experience with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, Go, or similar, gained through professional work, academic projects, or personal initiatives. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted software development tools and the ability to learn and apply new technologies effectively. * Strong problem\-solving ability, with the curiosity to investigate issues, understand root causes, and find practical solutions. * Resourceful and proactive, with the initiative to explore solutions independently rather than wait for instructions. * Strong learning agility, with the willingness to experiment, adapt, seek feedback, and continuously develop new capabilities. * Ability to think beyond code, understand business needs, and consider how technology can improve processes and outcomes. * Effective communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate across geographically distributed teams. Turkish language proficiency is an added advantage for working with colleagues in our Türkiye office but is not required. * A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and commitment to seeing tasks through to completion. We value how you think, learn, and solve problems more than the programming languages you already know. We are looking for someone who is curious about how things work, willing to challenge existing approaches, comfortable using AI to work smarter, and motivated to build solutions that make a meaningful difference.

jobs.title: Mechanical Drafter
jobs.description: ### **About Re:Build** At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions. We operate an advanced, end\-to\-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full\-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)* **About Re:Build Optimation** ----------------------------- At Re:Build Optimation, we specialize in delivering custom\-engineered process equipment and automated systems to clients across the globe. With nearly 40 years of experience in complex chemical process systems, we have built a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation. Our multidisciplinary team of 70\+ engineers, designers, and programmers, combined with 150,000 square feet of fabrication space and over 70 skilled tradespeople, allows us to provide full turnkey solutions—from initial concept through fabrication, installation, and commissioning. As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we leverage the strength of a national industrial powerhouse while maintaining the agility and personalized service of a niche firm. We serve industries ranging from traditional and green energy to chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food \& beverage, glass, and advanced manufacturing, offering tailored solutions that optimize efficiency and performance. At Re:Build Optimation, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with our clients to develop solutions that align with their unique operational goals. Our deep industry expertise and end\-to\-end capabilities make us the ideal partner for companies seeking cutting\-edge automation, process control, and engineered systems. **Who We Are Looking For** We are looking for an early\-career Mechanical Drafter who enjoys turning engineering concepts and designer markups into accurate, fabrication\-ready drawings. You have a solid foundation in mechanical drafting, are comfortable in AutoCAD and SolidWorks, and take pride in clean, consistent drawing packages. Whether you are a recent graduate of a drafting or technical program or have built your CAD skills on the job, you are detail\-oriented, curious and eager to learn from experienced designers and engineers. You understand that the drawings you produce are what our fabricators build from. This is an opportunity to work on custom equipment, skid\-mounted and modular systems, and industrial process equipment, and to grow toward a mechanical or piping designer role. This position is based onsite in Rochester and/or Rush, NY, with occasional travel to customer and supplier locations. **What You Get To Do** * **Create** detailed 2D drawings, 3D models, and assembly documentation using CAD software. * **Support** the design of mechanical components, custom equipment, piping layouts, and industrial systems. * **Work** alongside experienced designers and engineers to turn technical concepts into accurate, fabrication\-ready drawings. * **Develop** and update bills of materials (BOMs), drawing packages, and engineering documentation. * **Collaborate** with engineering, manufacturing, and fabrication teams to ensure designs meet project requirements. * **Assist** with design changes, drawing revisions, and troubleshooting during equipment fabrication and assembly. * **Participate** in design reviews and learn industry standards for drafting, dimensioning, and manufacturing. * **Contribute** to improvements in drafting processes, design tools, and documentation standards. **What You Bring To The Team** **Required** * 2\+ years of mechanical drafting or CAD experience, **OR** an associate degree, bachelor's degree or technical certificate in Drafting, Mechanical Design, Engineering Technology or a related field. * Foundational experience with 2D or 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor, or similar programs through education, training, or professional experience. * Ability to read, interpret, and create basic mechanical drawings and technical documentation. * Strong attention to detail, problem\-solving skills, and willingness to learn. * Ability to work collaboratively, take direction from senior designers and engineers, and manage assigned tasks. * Ability to take direction from designers and engineers and manage assigned tasks to deadline. * Commitment to safety, quality and continuous improvement. * Ability to work onsite in Rochester and/or Rush, NY, with occasional travel. **Preferred** * Internship, co\-op or professional drafting experience in an industrial, manufacturing or engineering environment. * Experience creating 3D models, 2D drawings, or mechanical assemblies using SolidWorks or AutoCAD. * Familiarity with fabrication processes, equipment design, piping layouts, or industrial machinery. * Understanding of GD\&T, dimensioning standards, and bills of materials. * Experience with skid\-mounted equipment, modular systems, or industrial process equipment. * Exposure to engineering change documentation, ISO 9001, or continuous improvement practices. The hourly rate for this position is $22\.00\- $34\.00\. This range represents the Company's good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to hourly rate, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long\-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits **The BIG payoff** We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company! **We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate** Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason. Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations.ta@ReBuildmanufacturing.com or you may call us at 617\.909\.6275\.

jobs.description: **About Refold** Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it. Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white\-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real\-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves. Traction: 30\+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500\+ active users, 10M\+ API calls processed daily, seven\-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time\-to\-go\-live by 70% and recovered 8,000\+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5\-month builds to 90% faster delivery. Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30\. We've raised $6\.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb \& Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating. We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Own the technical win:** Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours * **Build the proof, don't slide it:** Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy * **Run crisp POCs:** Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4\-week POCs — help us prove value in days * **Speak both languages:** Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi\-tenancy, and in\-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on * **Clear security and procurement:** Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air\-gapped, in\-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it * **Hand off clean:** Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go\-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise * **Feed the platform:** You'll be one of our highest\-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap * **Build the SE motion:** Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents **Role Information:** * **Partners with:** The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery * **Average deal size:** $50–100K land / $200–300K expand * **Average deal cycle:** 3–6 months * **Technical buyers you'll face:** CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers * **Ideal customer:** Sales\-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors * **Competitive set:** iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in\-house build * **Current growth team:** 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post\-Sale, plus a 20\-person engineering and delivery org **Required Skills \& Abilities** * **Proven SE:** 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre\-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat * **Builder, not just a presenter:** Hands\-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend * **Enterprise systems fluency:** Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am * **Sales instinct:** You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user * **Room\-ready:** You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves * **High ownership in ambiguity:** No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once **Nice to Have** * Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic * Hands\-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts * Experience with air\-gapped, in\-tenant, or customer\-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them * Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes) * First\-SE or early\-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one * Worked day\-to\-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team **Why do you want to work here?** * **Impact**: Fast\-growing seed\-stage company ($6\.5M from Eniac Ventures \& Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500\-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes * **Speed:** A category to define and a narrative to own, with founder\-level access and no layers between you and the decision * **Ownership**: Cutting\-edge AI solving a high\-value enterprise problem nobody has cracked — backed by technical founders building a next\-generation infrastructure platform **Compensation:** * **$100,000\-$120,000 (annual)** **Equal Employment Opportunity** We're a small, fast\-growing team, and we're intentional about building an inclusive culture from day one. We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don't discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. If you're excited by our mission, you belong here. Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

jobs.title: AI Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **About REP:** REP designs world\-class, innovative gym equipment that is sold around the world, and we are now expanding into apparel, supplements, athletes, and events. REP was established in 2012 by two brothers who shared a deep passion for fitness. From our humble beginnings of selling bumper plates out of a small garage, REP has experienced remarkable growth, now occupying over 300,000\+ square feet of office and distribution space in the USA and internationally. With a dedicated team of over 200\+ fitness enthusiasts, our vision is to be the \#1 Strength Brand in the World. Our commitment to innovation, customer service, and value sets us apart. We believe in building a culture centered around fitness, so we specialize in outfitting home gyms, commercial gyms, and strength and conditioning facilities. Our dedication to excellence has been recognized multiple times when we were featured in the Inc. 5000 fastest growing private companies in 2018 and 2021 and then voted the best home strength product launch in 2022 by Garage Gym Experiment. Our team works out together, and we regularly invite fitness superstars to join us. We organize fun challenges to test our limits \- and the limits of our equipment. At REP, we continue to grow and bring new opportunities for those who want to be a part of a winning team. We firmly believe that being surrounded by like\-minded individuals fuels creative energy and fosters a fun and collaborative work environment. This role is based in our state\-of\-the\-art headquarters with a bright, spacious, shared workspace; scenic views of the Rocky Mountains; and a kitchen always stocked with healthy snacks, protein powder, and coffee. We offer a hybrid work environment with a minimum of three days in the office, but there's flexibility about which days and hours. **Our Core Values:** * **Think Like a Customer** \- We empathize with our customers; understand the '*why'* behind every decision we make * **Progress not Perfection** \- We don't let perfect get in the way of *good*; we are better today than we were yesterday * **Positive Attitude** \- Be a *glass half\-full* kind of person and remember to have fun * **Teamwork without Ego** \- We put the *team* above ourselves; we only win together * **Take Initiative** \- We *drive* momentum; if there is an opportunity to make us better, we want to hear it **About This Role:** We have already decided to put AI in front of our data. This role decides whether we can trust what it says. REP's analytics direction is MCP\-first: our internal agents, ChatDash (internally built, conversational BI platform), and Claude now query our Microsoft Fabric data platform and other sources directly. Agents are only as accurate as the definitions underneath them. In addition to building pipelines to model data from sources into Fabric, the AI\-Native Analytics Engineer builds the semantic models and context layers that let both people and AI agents get accurate, grounded answers from REP's enterprise data. Where a traditional analytics engineer stops at clean models for dashboards, this role extends the work into the agentic control plane: the certified metric definitions, data skills, evaluation suites, and guardrails that AI depends on to query data and act without hallucinating. And you will do it the AI\-native way — using AI coding assistants to take new data from bronze to gold, with generated tests and automated reconciliation, compressing work that traditionally took a data engineer, a QA tester, and rounds of business UAT into one seat. What AI cannot do is the judgment: the spec, the review, and the call on whether the answer is correct. That is the job. Just as important: at REP, the business builds first. Our end users create working versions of the analytics they need on their own — in Claude or directly in ChatDash — often before certified data or clear semantics exist for that domain. You will not be writing requirements documents and building from scratch. The requirements are the thing the business has already built and is already using. Where certified data and semantics exist, your job is to make sure they are readily accessible through Claude, ChatDash, and other development approaches, so people build on trusted ground from the start. Where they do not, your job is to take the working version and figure out how to get its data flowing systemically, with clear semantics and guardrails, without breaking what the business made. This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You will own REP's metric definitions of record, develop data pipelines according to a medallion architecture, direct our external data engineering partner as the technical owner, and work alongside our AI Solutions Engineer — they build the agents and tools; you build the governed data those agents rely on. **Essential Functions:** Include the following. Other duties may be assigned. **Business\-Built Solutions (Harden)** * Treat working ver ault and holding the line without supervision. **Productionizing Business\-Built Work** – Turning working prototypes into governed, systemic data products while keeping the builder in the loop. **Partner Direction** – Specifying, reviewing, and accepting or rejecting vendor work as REP's technical owner. **What's in it for You:** Our commitment to quality and transparency applies not only to our products, but to our people. We are focused on creating a fun, exciting, collaborative space that's centered around health and well\-being. We empower everyone on our team to take control of their careers and balance their work and life in a modern, fast\-paced environment. We offer an ***exceptional*** compensation package which includes: **Compensation base range****:** $120,0000 \- $140,000 annually with bonus potential **Day One Benefits!** * Medical, Dental, Vision (Competitive Benefits Packages Available) * Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options * LTD/STD, Life and AD\&D (100% premiums covered by REP) * 401k and Roth options with employer match up to 4% * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) **Recharge Yourself!** * 4 weeks of PTO accrued during your first year * 48 hours of sick leave annually * 7 paid company holidays with an additional floating holiday * Paid Parental leave day 1 * Birthday \- Paid day off **Pumped\-up Perks!** * Unique bonus structure that rewards exceptional individual performance as well as company\-wide performance * Full access to employee gym * Employee discount on REP equipment, apparel and nutrition * Daily snacks and drinks provided by REP (for onsite employees) * 'Fitness' casual attire * Company and team building events * Professional growth and development within the organization * LIFE\-WORK balance **Physical Requirements:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to sit and use hands to operate the telephone, type and operate the computer and mouse. The employee is frequently required to talk, hear, and bend and twist their necks. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 00 pounds and rarely lift and/or move up to 00 pounds assisted. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer — Conversational Agents (Senior/Staff)
jobs.description: **Senior/Staff Applied AI Engineer — Conversational Agents** ============================================================ Revin · Agents Platform · Flatiron, New York City **$225,000–$325,000 base salary \+ meaningful early equity** · Full\-time Four days per week in our Flatiron office, with one remote day and flexibility when life comes up. We’re hiring at Senior and Staff levels. Final compensation depends on level, based on your demonstrated experience, scope of ownership, and impact. **About Revin** --------------- Revin builds AI\-powered software for the businesses that keep our homes running: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, and more. We help these businesses respond to customers, book appointments, and manage the customer experience across voice, SMS, and email. Revin handles around half a million customer conversations a month. Businesses with hundreds of millions in annual revenue rely on our products for work that directly affects their customers and their bottom line. Our customers include Vertex Service Partners, a national roofing and exterior\-services platform with over $600M in revenue, and Del\-Air, a $300M\+ HVAC and plumbing business. See the impact of our work: we’ve helped Del\-Air book 11,000\+ membership appointments, while ImproveIt uses Revin to set 34% of its booked appointments. **The role** ------------ Make our conversational AI agents more capable, responsive, and natural through rigorous experimentation. You’ll join our Agents Platform team at the intersection of software engineering and data science, using real customer conversations to understand where agents fall short and ship improvements that hold up in production. You’ll own the full improvement cycle: identify a problem, form a hypothesis, design an experiment, implement a change, and validate its impact. Your work will span instruction following, tool use, task completion, latency, and conversational experience, with a substantial focus on voice. You’ll improve agents through model selection, prompting, context, orchestration, and real\-time voice behavior. We care most about your ability to learn from evidence and turn that learning into better customer experiences. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Find the problems worth solving.** Analyze production conversations, listen to calls, inspect traces, and work with customer\-facing teams to identify failure patterns and prioritize improvements. * **Build measurement you can trust.** Define quality dimensions and representative evaluation datasets. Combine human judgment, automated graders, and production metrics, and validate that they measure what customers actually experience. * **Develop and test hypotheses.** Design reproducible experiments, compare approaches, and use offline evaluations and controlled production rollouts to understand what works, where it works, and what tradeoffs it introduces. * **Improve the voice experience.** Investigate turn\-taking, interruptions, response latency, transcription errors, speech quality, and spoken naturalness. Use audio and system telemetry together to diagnose causes and validate changes. * **Ship improvements into the agent system.** Implement changes, monitor their effects in production, and take responsibility for reliability, cost, and regressions alongside quality gains. * **Make improvement repeatable.** Turn production failures and experimental findings into reusable datasets, evaluations, debugging tools, and release checks that help the team move faster. At Staff level, you’ll also shape our evaluation and experimentation strategy across agent capabilities, identify the highest\-impact opportunities, and raise the broader team’s ability to diagnose and improve agent behavior while remaining hands\-on. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * **A demonstrated track record improving substantial AI agent systems deployed to external customers.** You can explain the system’s scale and complexity, the problems you identified, your hypotheses and experiments, what you personally implemented, and how you established that it improved production outcomes. * **Strong experimental and analytical judgment.** You can define useful baselines, design informative comparisons, reason about noisy or confounded results, and learn from experiments that don’t support your hypothesis. * **Strong software engineering ability.** You can analyze conversational data with code and SQL, debug complex agent behavior, and turn an experimental improvement into maintainable production software. * **Practical understanding of agent systems.** You can reason about how models, instructions, context, tools, and orchestration interact, and weigh quality against latency, reliability, and cost. Specific frameworks matter less than your judgment and results. * **Ownership and clear communication.** You make progress through ambiguity, communicate findings and tradeoffs, and work closely with engineers and product to carry improvements through to customers. * **A desire to work in an early\-stage startup.** You’re energized by broad responsibility, rapid iteration, and high standards. We use AI programming tools heavily and expect you to use them effectively while owning the quality of your work. **Voice experience** -------------------- Hands\-on experience improving production voice agents is strongly preferred. We value experience diagnosing conversational timing, speech recognition and generation, audio quality, and end\-to\-end latency, across any provider or stack. We’re also open to engineers with an exceptional track record improving other customer\-facing agents who can demonstrate strong judgment on voice problems and are excited to develop deeper expertise. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience building simulation, replay, or evaluation tools for multi\-turn agents. * Experience developing human review workflows or calibrating automated evaluations against human judgment. * Experience at a strong startup or on a small team with substantial ownership. **Why join Revin** ------------------ You’ll work with a large, varied set of real customer interactions and a short path from an idea to measurable impact. Improvements you ship can reach hundreds of thousands of conversations, and what you learn will help shape the direction of our agent platform. We’re still early. You’ll join a small team of sharp, ambitious people, have substantial influence over how we build, and receive meaningful equity ownership with the opportunity to share substantially in the upside you help create. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * **$225,000–$325,000 base salary**, with final compensation dependent on level. * **Meaningful early equity** in the company you’re helping build. * **Excellent health coverage.** $0 employee premiums for individual medical coverage on most plans, plus dental and vision insurance. * **401(k) matching up to 4% of salary.** Contribute 5% to receive the full match. * Unlimited PTO. * Commuter benefits. * Free lunches and dinners in the office. * $100/month gym membership stipend. * Tech equipment of your choice. Compensation Range: $225K \- $325K

We build custom integrations with platforms including ServiceTitan, LeadPerfection, AccuLynx, Salesforce and i360, Builder Prime, and SalesRabbit. Each has its own data model, authentication, business rules, and failure modes. Our backend is primarily Python and PostgreSQL, with asynchronous services and event\-driven processing. We value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly. **What you’ll build** --------------------- * **The event pipelines that keep Revin in sync.** Ingest CRM changes through webhooks, event streams, and polling; maintain fresh, accurate state; and deliver the events that trigger the right agent workflows. * **The tools that let agents take action.** Build APIs and services for customer lookup, availability, appointment booking, and CRM updates, preserving each system’s business rules and returning clear, accurate results to agents. The hard problems live at the boundaries: a webhook arrives twice, a stream disconnects, two workers race, or a CRM accepts a booking but the request times out. You’ll design how the system detects, handles, and recovers from these cases, so customers can trust what our agents do. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Design reliable event processing.** Work through ordering, deduplication, retries, rate limits, concurrency, and backpressure. Build recovery and replay paths that preserve correctness as integrations grow. * **Make CRM actions dependable.** Design clear API contracts, validate inputs and results, and handle partial failures and uncertain write outcomes without creating duplicate or inconsistent records. * **Build and deepen integrations.** Understand partner APIs and customer workflows, add new capabilities, and develop shared components that make integrations easier to extend and maintain. * **Protect data integrity and customer boundaries.** Design sound data models, secure authentication and credential handling, and correct routing across customer accounts, brands, and locations. * **Own reliability in production.** Instrument data freshness, processing lag, and action success; make failures diagnosable; and build tests, alerts, reconciliation, and recovery tools that prevent recurring issues. * **Shape the platform with the team.** Partner with agents engineers, product, and forward\-deployed engineers to prioritize customer needs and make clear tradeoffs around correctness, latency, complexity, and cost. At Staff level, you’ll also guide architecture across the integrations platform, establish stronger patterns for event processing and external actions, and raise the broader team’s effectiveness while remaining hands\-on. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * **Substantial experience building and operating production backend systems.** You can explain the systems you owned, the design decisions you made, how they behaved under failure, and what you improved. * **Strong distributed systems judgment.** You’ve worked with asynchronous processing, queues or streams, concurrency, consistency, and retries, and understand how to preserve correctness when parts of a system fail. * **Experience working across system boundaries.** You can build reliable integrations with external APIs, reason about their constraints, and turn unfamiliar data models and business rules into maintainable software. * **Strong programming and SQL skills.** You’re comfortable with data modeling, transactions, and production debugging, and can work effectively in our Python backend. We care about depth of understanding and execution more than familiarity with a particular framework. * **Ownership and clear communication.** You investigate problems end to end, surface risks early, and explain technical tradeoffs in terms of what customers and the team need. * **A desire to work in an early\-stage startup.** You’re energized by broad responsibility, rapid iteration, and high standards. We use AI programming tools heavily and expect you to use them effectively while owning the quality of your work. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with CRM, scheduling, payments, or other operational systems where data correctness and reliable actions matter. * Experience with change data capture, synchronization, backfills, or reconciliation across external systems. * Experience building tools or APIs used by AI agents. * Experience at a strong startup or on a small team with substantial ownership. **Why join Revin** ------------------ Your work determines which businesses Revin can serve and what our agents can actually do for them. A new integration opens up a customer segment; a more reliable booking or data pipeline improves the experience of businesses using Revin every day. We’re still early. You’ll join a small team of sharp, ambitious people, have substantial influence over the architecture of a core part of the product, and receive meaningful equity ownership with the opportunity to share substantially in the upside you help create. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * **$225,000–$325,000 base salary**, with final compensation dependent on level * **Meaningful early equity** in the company you’re helping build * **Excellent health coverage.** $0 employee premiums for individual medical coverage on most plans, plus dental and vision insurance * **401(k) matching up to 4% of salary.** Contribute 5% to receive the full match * Unlimited PTO * Commuter benefits * Free lunches and dinners in the office * $100/month gym membership stipend * Tech equipment of your choice Compensation Range: $225K \- $325K

Algorithms (e.g., Convolutional Neural Networks) is a huge plus * Exhibits the right teamwork and leadership qualities backed up with references * Extensive physical design experiences at both the block level and subchip level, as well as full\-chip level is a plus. * Deep knowledge in physical design, including physical aware synthesis, floorplanning, clock tree implementation, routing, STA jobs.description: **Join us in building the future of finance.** ---------------------------------------------- Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. **About the team \+ role** -------------------------- We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem\-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high\-performing, fast\-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. The Observability team's mission is to build and own Robinhood's full\-stack observability platform — the foundation that keeps every product, service, and customer experience running reliably at scale. We design and operate the systems that give engineers deep visibility into how Robinhood's infrastructure behaves, ensuring that when something goes wrong, the right people know immediately and can act fast. Our work spans metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and alerting pipelines, and we partner closely with the Robinhood Command Center to ensure our observability systems meet or exceed 99\.9% uptime. We believe in monitoring our own monitors — the observability infrastructure is a product, not just a tool. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Observability team, you will be the technical lead shaping the roadmap for how Robinhood observes itself at scale. You will own the observability control plane end\-to\-end, making architectural decisions that directly impact the reliability and operational health of Robinhood's entire product surface. You'll lead a team of six engineers, drive the strategy for cost\-efficient telemetry ingestion, build in\-house solutions where off\-the\-shelf tooling falls short, and integrate AI\-driven approaches to accelerate progress toward full\-stack observability. This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role where your technical decisions set the direction for the entire organization! **This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in\-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.** At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in\-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high\-performing teams. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Define and execute the full\-stack observability roadmap, establishing a clear technical vision for metrics, logs, traces, and alerting infrastructure across Robinhood's engineering organization. * Own and evolve the observability control plane, including telemetry ingestion pipelines, cost management strategies, and the tooling that ensures observability components remain highly available. * Lead and collaborate with a team of six engineers to build scalable, self\-service observability solutions that enable product and infrastructure teams to move faster with greater confidence. * Establish and maintain SLOs for observability systems that meet or exceed Robinhood's 99\.9% uptime target, ensuring the observability platform is as reliable as the services it monitors. * Partner with the Robinhood Command Center and engineering teams across the organization to align on dependency mapping, incident response workflows, and observability standards. **What you bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of owning and delivering large\-scale observability or infrastructure platform initiatives. * Deep expertise in Kubernetes and public cloud environments (AWS preferred), with the ability to architect and operate distributed systems at scale regardless of specific vendor tooling. * Strong coding proficiency in one or more languages (Go, Python, or similar) with experience integrating observability agents, libraries, and instrumentation directly into production codebases. * Demonstrated experience owning an observability control plane or telemetry pipeline — including ingestion cost management, cardinality control, and signal routing — in a high\-traffic production environment. * Experience with the Vector data pipeline (or equivalent high\-throughput log/metrics routing tools) and familiarity with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Honeycomb, Humio, or Sentry is a plus. **What we offer** ----------------- * Challenging, high\-impact work to grow your career * Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching * Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents * Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill\-building for every employee, technical or not * Lifestyle wallet \- a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more * Employer\-paid life \& disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits * Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! * Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you're ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. **AI Usage Disclosure:** Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Sprout (www.Sproutup.com) is a rapidly growing IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) provider and electronics recycler. We are a growing GREEN company that has a customized ERP platform to manage our business. Sprout leverages data and analytics to make IT asset disposition flawless for the world’s leading enterprise. In the quest for smooth IT infrastructure refreshes, superior technology is only half the solution. The other half is uncompromising customer service. Our world\-class customer service teams’ partner with companies at every turn to deliver solutions that make life (and the world) better. Sprout is a certified Great Place to Work® Contract to Hire role The Datacenter Operations Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for the physical lifecycle of infrastructure in Sprout’s client data center environments — from suite build and equipment deployment, through day\-to\-day inventory and break/fix support, to decommission, data sanitization, and secure equipment removal. We are looking for a self\-starter who can own a queue of work and execute to a high standard with minimal supervision. The role reports to the Senior Manager – Field Services. Responsibilities: * Manage equipment and spares inventory, keeping asset records, serial numbers, and locationsaccurate and auditable. * Build out data center suites and deploy equipment — racking, stacking, power, and turn\-up todocumented standards. * Decommission suites and remove equipment under strict chain\-of\-custody, from de\-cabling andde\-racking through secure pack\-out. * Perform and document hard disk data sanitization (wipe, degauss, or destroy) to recognized standards such as NIST SP 800\-88\. Handle daily break/fix and remote\-hands requests, including component replacement, troubleshooting, and vendor RMAs. * Install, dress, and label copper and fiber cabling, and keep cabling and port documentation current. * Follow data center security, access, and change\-control procedures for all work on client sites. * Ability to work in a live workload environment and perform work without incidents. Qualifications: * 3\+ years’ hands\-on data center operations experience across inventory, suite builds,decommissions, data sanitization, break/fix, and cabling. * Solid knowledge of server, storage, and network hardware, plus structured cabling and power distribution. * Strong understanding of physical security practices and chain\-of\-custody for data\-bearing equipment. * Self\-starter who plans and executes work independently with little supervision. * Detail\-oriented, with clear written and verbal communication for clients, colleagues, and vendors. * Able to perform physically demanding work and pass a background check for client site access. * Preferred: industry certifications (e.g. CompTIA, BICSI) and ITAD or secure data destruction experience. **EEO – Equal Employment Opportunity** The Company is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender, ethnicity, religion, national origin, ancestry, nationality, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or on any other basis prohibited by law (except where an attribute is a bona fide occupational qualification).

They may be involved in assembling and submitting funding applications. They may have external\-facing roles, including interactions with collaborating research groups, commercial entities and other partner organizations. They will provide technical support to other researchers. They will also serve as a point of expertise throughout the organization in computer science and software engineering. They will be expected to generate peer\-reviewed scientific research, both as a lead and as a collaborator. They will work in a variety of statistical and programming environments. They will be expected to contribute actively to open\-source software development. They will set project milestones collaboratively with the PI, then manage themselves and other technical staff to meet them. This will involve close collaborations across the Institute, particularly with the Center for Data Science. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Architect, design and implement robust software This role may require domestic travel up to 20% of the time to support hands\-on work at data center locations. ### **About Us** Sauce Labs is the world's largest full\-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium. Trusted by 80% of the world's top ten largest financial institutions and over 300,000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and quality assurance. With a proprietary dataset of 8\.7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to bridge the gap between AI\-driven code generation and enterprise\-grade software quality. Learn more at http://saucelabs.com. **Release Assurance at the Speed of AI \|****Meet the new Sauce Labs** ### **The Role** We are seeking a Data Center Engineer to own day\-to\-day physical operations at our Atlanta data center. Sauce Labs runs one of the largest real\-device clouds in the world: over 8,000 physical iOS and Android devices, the host computers that drive them, and the servers and network behind them. This role keeps that fleet online and available for customers to book. This is an early\-career engineering role. You will bring solid data center fundamentals on day one: racking, power, cabling, hardware diagnostics, and working in a production environment. You will also start to build engineering skills on top of that: scripting repetitive work, reading metrics, writing procedures other people follow, and owning a problem from first alert to root cause. You will work on\-site as the hands, eyes, and first line of troubleshooting for the global infrastructure team. Remote engineers and other sites will depend on you to get things done right the first time. ### **Responsibilities** **Device Farm Operations** * Keep real iOS and Android devices online and bookable. Diagnose offline devices and bring them back into service. * Build, cable, and maintain device racks: host computers, managed USB hubs, and device trays. * Swap, provision, and decommission devices. Pull devices that show battery swelling, heat damage, or physical wear. * Device repair and battery swaps. * Support the macOS and Linux hosts that drive the devices. Gather logs and report patterns to engineering. **Physical Infrastructure** * Rack, stack, cable, and label servers, switches, and storage to our standards. * Plan rack builds against power capacity, not just physical space. Track power usage at the rack and PDU level. * Install, upgrade, and replace hardware. Run fiber and copper and test what you run. * Use out\-of\-band tools such as iDRAC and iLO to check, reboot, and recover servers. * Plan airflow and cooling plan for rack installed equipment. **Troubleshooting \& Incident Response** * Own hardware ,connectivity, power, cooling, and other physical issues from first alert to root cause, then escalate with clear findings when needed. * Monitor dashboards and alerts and act on them before customers notice. * Act as on\-site hands during incidents and maintenance windows for remote engineers. * Write up what failed, why, and what prevents a repeat. **Inventory, Logistics \& RMA** * Keep the asset inventory system accurate. Every device, host, and part is where the record says it is. * Receive shipments, check equipment in and out, and run regular inventory audits. * Process RMAs and coordinate returns with vendors. **Process, Documentation \& Access Control** * Write and maintain runbooks and build standards that other technicians can follow without help. * Find repetitive manual work and automate it with scripts or tooling. * Follow physical access and security procedures. Escort and log vendors and visitors. * Support compliance requirements for data center access, change, and asset handling. ### **Required Skills** * 2\+ years of hands\-on work in a production data center, colocation facility, or large lab environment. * Working knowledge of rack power: PDUs, circuits, amperage, and how to build a rack within its power budget. * Cabling standards and practice: fiber and copper types, optics, patching, labeling, and cable management. * Hardware diagnostics on servers and network gear: reading status lights, swapping components, and using out\-of\-band management. * Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, VLANs, DHCP, and DNS, enough to tell a cable problem from a configuration problem. * Comfortable on the Linux and macOS command line: navigating systems, reading logs, and running basic commands. * Experience with an asset inventory or ticketing system and the discipline to keep records accurate. * Clear written communication. You can document a fix so the next person can repeat it. ### **Nice to Haves** * Scripting in Bash or Python to automate routine tasks. * Hands\-on experience with iOS and Android devices at scale: provisioning, debugging with ADB or Xcode tools, or MDM. * Experience with managed USB hubs or large USB device deployments. * Experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana and Prometheus. * Exposure to Device42 or a similar DCIM or CMDB tool. * Exposure to Git, CI/CD, or infrastructure\-as\-code tools. * Industry certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Server\+, or CDCTP. * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Schedule \& Physical Requirements** ------------------------------------- * The standard schedule is Monday through Friday, on\-site. * Participate in a rotating on\-call schedule for after\-hours incidents. Occasional after\-hours and weekend work for scheduled maintenance windows. * Lift and move equipment up to 50 lbs, and work safely with team lifts and lifting equipment for heavier gear. * Stand, bend, kneel, and work on ladders for extended periods in a loud, temperature\-controlled environment. * Travel domestically up to 20% of the time to support builds and projects at other data centers. * Pass a background check required for data center access. Please note our Privacy Policy for Applicants when applying for a job at Sauce Labs. Sauce Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity/expression/status, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status. Security responsibilities at Sauce At Sauce, we will commit to supporting the health and safety of employees and properties, partnering with internal stakeholders to learn and act on ever\-evolving security protocols and procedures. You'll be expected to fully comply with all policies and procedures related to security at the department and org wide level and exercise a 'security first' approach to how we design, build \& run our products and services.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer I
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** This Manufacturing Engineering I position will entail development, maintenance, and troubleshooting the following: Routings, Rates, Standard Work, and Work Instructions. The job will provide technical support to Manufacturing, Systems, and Customer Care, to aid in providing a quality furniture product to our customers, in a Lean Manufacturing environment. The job will also include engineering of process improvements and support for developing operations processes for new products. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Responsible to work safely, maintain an orderly and safe work environment, and participate in safety initiatives * Assist in develop manufacturing processes in support of new product launches * Assist in creating cell layouts, which support one\-piece flow, optimal operator balance, and minimization of waste * Responsible for assisting with the conception, development and perfection of workstations, jigs and fixtures used to efficiently produce the components and assemblies for new products * Fabricate precision parts and fixtures using metalworking and woodworking machines and equipment * Provide training and instructions to production employees in support of new products, processes, and procedures * Analyze and recommend processes changes for effectiveness, flow, and seek root cause to eliminate process variation, and improve cycle times * Use technology tools to creates drawings and technical documentation needed to support engineering, purchasing and production * Develop and maintain bills of materials and routing information * Create and maintain clear, concise, consistent process documentation and SOPs * Provide technical support to Manufacturing and Customer Care for product and process questions * Troubleshoot production issues regarding quality, product, and process * Research, author, and implement process changes in operations * Specify, quote, and facilitate product modification requests, and provide necessary documentation and training for production * Responsible for actively contributing to the continuous improvement of products and processes, by reducing waste, reducing material costs, and investigating new methods and materials * contribute to LEAN initiatives * Assist with other manufacturing engineering tasks, as assigned **Experience and Knowledge Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field OR equivalent combination of education and experience required. * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously, accountability for meeting commitments and deadlines. * written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact, influence, and communicate with a diverse range of people at all levels across the company as well as with external suppliers. * Experience with MS Office, including Publisher, Excel, Word, and Outlook. * Experience with CAD – AutoCAD, SolidWorks and SolidWorks PDM is preferred * Experience with a business ERP system is preferred * Experience or education in Lean manufacturing principles, root\-cause analysis and A3 Problem solving * Able to demonstrate critical\-thinking skills, good writing skills, photo editing skills, and ability to write clear work instructions. * Experience in furniture manufacturing and/or knowledge of woodworking, upholstery, or fabric processes would be beneficial. **Key Attributes Required:** * Safety conscious with a concern for others' safety * Intelligent and fast learner, with a desire for continuous learning and self\-improvement. * Self\-starting, results\-oriented individual who takes personal accountability for performance. * Strong time and priority management skills coupled with the ability to use a logical and systematic approach to meet objectives. * Willing and able to work collaboratively in a team environment, supporting others at all levels of the organization. * Strong leadership and facilitation skills that effectively engage others. * Exceptional attention to details, and sound problem\-solving skills. * A desire to serve, both internal and external customers. * Must be able to operate in a manner consistent with the mission statement and governing values of the organization. **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear and frequently required to walk and sit. Use of hands and fingers will be required for writing, computer use, and phone use. Work in a manner consistent with standard Sauder safety practices and expectations. The employee will also be required to walk throughout the plant at various times during a typical day. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Work Environment:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Encompasses the full spectrum from factory floor to personal offices, to executive board rooms. The noise levels in these work environments are usually low to moderate. Personal protective equipment such as eye protection and ear protection may be required in the shop floor environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Sauder Manufacturing Co. is an equal opportunity employer and gives equal consideration for employment to all qualified applicants. We believe that all people are capable of great things. Because of this, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description. Sauder is a family company, so we believe in a healthy work\-life balance for our employees. We want employees to know their time here is more than just a job\-\-they can build a life\-long career at Sauder. We have a culture of continuous improvement and internal advancement. We provide 3 weeks of vacation and a full benefit package beginning at 30 days. Other perks include 401(k), a company\-funded health savings account, free counseling, furniture discounts, and tuition reimbursement. jobs.title: Junior Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** As a Junior Network Engineer, you’ll help keep network infrastructure reliable, secure, and ready for the people and systems that depend on it. You’ll support LAN and WAN environments, assist with network configuration and monitoring, and work alongside experienced engineers to troubleshoot issues and maintain IT infrastructure. This paid role is suited to someone building practical skills in computer networking and network engineering. **Duties** * Provide network support by investigating connectivity issues and assisting with equipment troubleshooting across Ethernet, Wi\-Fi, and IP networking environments. * Help configure and maintain network hardware, including Cisco routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs; exposure to Cisco ASA, Meraki, Juniper, or Cisco ISE is useful. * Monitor network performance and security using tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, or Splunk; escalate alerts and document findings. * Assist with routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP, and services including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, QoS, and VoIP. * Your impact: By resolving network issues promptly and escalating risks clearly, you help colleagues maintain access to the systems and services they need. **Requirements** * Foundational knowledge of computer networking, network protocols, network switching, routing, VPN configuration, firewall concepts, and network security. * Familiarity with Windows, Linux (such as Ubuntu, Debian, or CentOS), macOS, or UNIX; experience with system administration is helpful. * Exposure to authentication, Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, encryption, PKI, vulnerability assessment, or cloud security is preferred. * Scripting knowledge in Python, PowerShell, or Bash is a plus; familiarity with AWS, Azure, VMware, Ansible, Agile, or ITIL is also useful. * Associate or bachelor’s study in computer science, IT, or a related field is preferred; data center, SAN, load balancing, telecommunication, or network installation experience is an advantage. Pay: $68,300\.00 \- $82,300\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Mechanical/Robotics Engineering Technician I
jobs.description: SEL is looking for a people\-oriented Mechanical/Robotics Engineering Technician to join our Product Support and Development \- Mechanical team in our Manufacturing Division.
