jobs.description: **Requisition ID:** 277239 **Salary Range:** \- *Please note that the Salary Range shown is a guideline only. Salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.* Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture. **Purpose** As a Senior Data Enablement Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical enablement leader and strategic interface between enterprise data platforms and the teams that consume them. You will be responsible for driving scalable adoption, effective utilization, and measurable value realization of enterprise data platforms, services, and capabilities across the organization. This role is highly technical in orientation but is not primarily development focused. You will provide technical and functional leadership across complex data enablement initiatives, translating platform capabilities, architecture standards, governance requirements, and engineering practices into practical and scalable consumption patterns. You will work across platform engineering, architecture, data governance, security, infrastructure, and Line of Business teams to establish consistent approaches for onboarding, adoption, and utilization of enterprise data capabilities. You will identify systemic barriers to adoption, influence platform priorities, and create reusable standards and enablement models that allow teams to consume data capabilities efficiently, securely, and at scale. As a senior individual contributor, you will be expected to operate autonomously across complex initiatives, influence technical and business stakeholders, mentor other enablement resources, and help shape the evolution of the Data Enablement function. **What You’ll Do** **Enterprise Platform Enablement \& Customer Onboarding** * Lead technical enablement and onboarding for complex or strategic consumers of enterprise data platforms. * Design and evolve scalable onboarding frameworks covering platform capabilities, access models, workspace and environment strategies, supported service patterns, governance requirements, and operational responsibilities. * Establish reusable onboarding patterns that reduce complexity, improve consistency, increase self\-service, and accelerate time to value. * Lead discovery and intake activities for complex initiatives, translating business objectives and technical requirements into actionable platform adoption strategies. * Coordinate dependencies across platform engineering, architecture, governance, security, infrastructure, operations, and Line of Business teams. **Governance, Standards \& Responsible Data Usage** * Partner with data governance, architecture, security, privacy, risk, and platform teams to operationalize enterprise data requirements. * Translate expectations for metadata, lineage, data quality, classification, ownership, retention, and access into practical consumption and onboarding patterns. * Embed governance requirements into enablement processes rather than treating governance as a downstream checkpoint. * Define and promote consistent platform usage, data ownership, documentation, naming, and lifecycle\-management practices. **Technical Knowledge \& Enablement at Scale** * Establish and maintain enterprise\-grade enablement assets including reference patterns, decision frameworks, onboarding playbooks, implementation guidance, operating models, FAQs, and troubleshooting resources. * Define documentation and knowledge standards that can be adopted by platform and enablement teams. * Establish mechanisms that allow frequently requested guidance to transition from high\-touch enablement to repeatable self\-service. * Build and support communities of data champions, platform advocates, and subject\-matter experts that extend enablement capabilities across the organization. **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Complex Problem Solving** * Lead resolution of complex cross\-functional issues involving multiple platforms, teams, or organizational boundaries. * Facilitate technical and strategic discussions where requirements, ownership, responsibilities, or platform direction are ambiguous. * Develop clear recommendations and decision materials for complex platform or operating\-model questions. * Surface systemic risks, recurring dependencies, and organizational friction that could inhibit platform adoption. * Lead cross\-functional working groups or initiatives focused on improving the enterprise data consumption experience. **Functional Support \& Continuous Improvement** * Serve as a senior escalation point for complex platform adoption, onboarding, and functional issues. * Distinguish between enablement gaps, architectural challenges, platform defects, governance issues, and operational problems and route them toward sustainable resolution. * Lead functional validation and user acceptance activities for significant platform capabilities and c elf\-service, and increase adoption of standardized capabilities. * Establish mechanisms for measuring the effectiveness of enablement interventions and refining approaches based on real\-world outcomes. * Develop executive\-ready insights on adoption trends, customer experience, systemic barriers, and opportunities requiring leadership attention. * Capture successful implementations and convert them into reusable enterprise patterns that accelerate future initiatives. **What You’ll Bring** * Demonstrated experience leading data enablement, enterprise data platform adoption, data architecture, technical product ownership, data engineering, or large\-scale data transformation initiatives. * Strong experience with modern enterprise data environments and cloud technologies such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Google Cloud, or comparable platforms. * Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture and modern data platform concepts, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, processing, analytics, and data consumption. * Strong practical understanding of data governance disciplines including metadata, lineage, data quality, classification, ownership, access controls, and lifecycle management. * Demonstrated ability to translate complex platform, architecture, and governance concepts into actionable guidance and scalable consumption patterns. * Experience developing platform standards, reference patterns, decision frameworks, onboarding models, or enterprise technical documentation. * Experience leading complex technical discovery and requirements discussions involving multiple stakeholder groups. * Typically 7–10 years of relevant experience in roles such as Data Enablement Engineer, Data Platform Lead, Data Architect, Senior Data Engineer, Platform Enablement Lead, Technical Product Lead, or Data Platform Consultant. * Spanish fluency is considered an asset. **Interested?** If your experience is closely related but does not align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity at Scotiabank. At Scotiabank, every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and embraced for their differences. We are committed to growing and diversifying talent and engaging employees in a performance\-oriented culture. **What’s in It for You?** Scotiabank wants you to be able to bring your best self to work and life every day. With a focus on holistic well\-being, our flexible benefit programs are designed to support your unique family, financial, physical, mental, and social health needs. \#Dallas Location(s): United States : Texas : Dallas Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets. At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted. Scotiabank is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: AI-Assisted Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description: **About us** Search Miners is a white\-hat SEO and GEO agency with clients worldwide. We help businesses show up in Google and in AI search tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity. We also build our own software for clients and for internal use. **The role** We need a developer who ships fast using AI coding tools and actually understands the code those tools write. You'll take projects that are already well underway and get them finished, deployed, and working for real users. Then you'll keep building. This is a contract role. If the work is good, it becomes steady, ongoing work. **What you'll do** * Finish and deploy web apps that are mostly built * Build new features in an existing codebase * Fix bugs and clean up code that AI tools wrote badly * Connect third\-party tools like Stripe and Google APIs * Keep things secure, especially user data and API keys * Communicate clearly in writing about what's done, what's blocked, and how long things will take **Our stack** * Next.js and TypeScript * Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage) * Vercel * GitHub * Claude Code, Cursor, or whatever AI tools you're fastest with **What we're looking for** * You've built and deployed real web apps that people use * You use AI coding tools every day and can read and fix what they produce * Solid with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase or a similar Postgres setup * You understand auth, environment variables, and basic security * Comfortable with Git * Clear written English * Able to overlap 3 to 4 hours a day with US Eastern time **How we hire** We care more about your work than your resume. * Send us the application below * Shortlisted people get a small **paid** trial project * If the trial goes well, we get on a call * Then we start ongoing work **How to apply** Email **info@searchminers.com** with the subject line: **Builder: \[Your Full Name]** Include: * A link to a live app or site you built, plus your GitHub or a code sample. Tell us what you built yourself, where AI helped, and one thing that broke and how you fixed it. * Which AI coding tools you use, and how you check their output before you ship it. * Your hourly rate in USD and how many hours a week you're available. Optional but a big plus: a 2 to 3 minute screen recording (Loom or similar) walking through some code you wrote. **Applications without the subject line, or applications sent only through the job board, won't be reviewed.** Pay: $15\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: **Web Developer Job Information** **Field** **Details** **Position Title** Web Developer **FLSA Status** Contract **Wage Range** $75\-$110 per hour **Department/Team** Marketing **Reports to** Brand Director **Location** VA Remote **Travel Required** None **Position Type** Contract/1099 **Date Updated** October 2026 **Who We Are:** As an innovation hub, Seraphic develops and scales root\-cause solutions to positively impact human and planetary health. Our companies span the areas of health, energy, and ecology with many emergent projects in development. Founded by Dr. Zach Bush, we are committed to developing products and services that transform the world for better. Biomic Sciences, LLC is a subsidiary of the Seraphic Group and the manufacturer and seller of a revolutionary gut health supplement, ION\*Intelligence of Nature (ION\*). Sourced from 60\-million\-year\-old soil, the ION\* line of products naturally supports microbiome balance for your gut and skin. ION\* Intelligence of Nature is dedicated to advancing human health through science\-backed, nature\-derived solutions. Our products are designed to support the body’s natural systems, starting with gut health as a foundation for overall wellness. **Position Summary:** The Web Developer will build, maintain, and continuously improve the ION\* e\-commerce website in support of the brand's growth and customer acquisition objectives. This role is primarily responsible for developing and updating Shopify landing pages, executing A/B tests, and identifying opportunities to improve the user experience and drive conversion across the digital storefront. The role also maintains theme code and site performance standards, and reports on test outcomes to inform future campaign and merchandising decisions. As a member of the Marketing team, the Web Developer works under the direction of the Brand Director and will also partner with IT to ensure security compliance measures. **Measures of Success:** Success as the Web Developer requires initiative, disciplined execution, and sound judgment about where to focus testing effort, demonstrated through landing pages shipped without defects, A/B tests completed and documented, and measurable gains in conversion rate and site performance. This can be observed by the Brand Director through site analytics, test records, and the reliability of campaign launch execution. **Responsibilities:** **Website Development and Maintenance (Primary Focus)** * Build, update, and maintain landing pages within the Shopify storefront in support of product launches, campaigns, and seasonal promotions. * Develop and maintain theme code (Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to ensure the site remains stable, responsive, and consistent with brand standards. * Configure and manage Shopify functionality as required, including metafields, product and collection structures, navigation, and third\-party applications. * Monitor site performance, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals; identify and resolve issues affecting load speed or checkout completion. * Review the installed application stack and recommend consolidation or removal where tools duplicate function or degrade site performance. * Coordinate with external agency and platform partners on matters outside in\-house capability, including SEO, hosting, and application support. * Test all changes in a staging environment prior to publication and verify functionality following each release. **Conversion Optimization and Testing** * Identify opportunities to improve user experience and increase conversion through analysis of funnel behavior, session recordings, and customer feedback. * Define testing hypotheses, prioritize them against expected impact and effort, and maintain a documented testing roadmap. * Build and implement A/B and multivariate tests end to end, including variant development, audience configuration, and quality assurance. * Ensure tests are statistically valid, properly scoped, and free of conflicting instrumentation. * Interpret results and translate findings into recommendations for page structure, copy, merchandising, and checkout flow. * Partner with design and content colleagues on page layout, product storytelling, and creative assets required for testing. **Analytics, Reporting, and Documentation** * Maintain analytics and tag management implementation in GA4 or an equivalent platform, ensuring events, conversions, and e\-commerce tracking remain accurate as the site changes. * Produce regular reporting on site performance, test outcomes, and conversion trends for the Brand Director and Marketing team. * Maintain documentation of site architecture, test history, and configuration changes so that work is reproducible and transferable. * Present findings in plain language to colleagues without technical backgrounds. **Marketing Collaboration and Campaign Support** * Participate in marketing planning to advise on feasibility, timeline, and technical requirements for upcoming campaigns. * Support campaign launches as needed, including promotional page builds, discount configuration, and landing destinations for email and paid media. * Coordinate with the Operations and Production teams to keep product availability, inventory messaging, and site content aligned. * Support business continuity by responding to urgent site issues, including after\-hours escalation when a customer\-facing function is affected. * Maintain awareness of Shopify platform updates and emerging e\-commerce tools, recommending adoption where relevant. **Core Competencies:** Job Specific Knowledge, skills, and ability Effective communication Initiative Organization and time management Service\-oriented Teamwork Integrity Accountability Adaptability Innovation **Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:** * Extended periods of sitting and working at a computer monitor, with sustained visual focus and regular keyboard and mouse use. * Regular management of concurrent deadlines tied to campaign and launch calendars. **EEO Statement:** Seraphic Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer (E.O.E.). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without unlawful regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or other protected status under federal, state or local law. Neither the job postings or descriptions here, nor any submission of your resume, should be construed as an offer or guarantee of employment.

jobs.title: Data Engineer III, AI Platform
jobs.description: The Data Engineer III, AI Platform builds and operates reusable data pipelines and AI\-ready platform services for Hawaii Mobility. Reporting to the Manager, Data Engineering, within the Data Visualization, Analytics \& Automation function, this role builds, tests, releases, and observes production workloads on Databricks and Azure. This senior individual contributor engineers governed feature, context, and evaluation pipelines for predictive and generative AI, and implements the data and platform components of MLOps and LLMOps patterns designed with the Data \& AI Architect under the Director, Enterprise Architecture. The role owns reliability for the assets it ships and mentors engineers through review and pairing; the function is led by its Director and reports to the VP, Data \& AI. **KEY OUTCOMES:** **Production Pipelines and Frameworks** * Build and own reusable ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and serving patterns across batch and streaming workloads on Databricks. Develop connectors, recovery paths, schema evolution, and certified data sets for reporting, applications, and AI. Implement automated reconciliation, data quality, freshness, lineage, and access controls so production pipelines and AI context remain reliable and governed. * **AI Enablement Engineering** * Engineer feature, context, and retrieval pipelines \- document ingestion, metadata, embeddings, and indexes \- to solution designs agreed with the Data \& AI Architect. * Build versioned evaluation data, model and agent monitoring feeds, feedback capture, and identity\-aware feature tables, APIs, and event streams. Implement the data and platform components of MLOps and LLMOps delivery. * Maintain and develop the semantic/ontology layer that informs Servco's LLMs and extends our data understanding to LLM platforms such as OpenAI and Claude. * Tune Servco's LLMs for accuracy and review feedback via the Genie admin console. Assist with the implementation and maintenance of AI agents within our enterprise platforms to automate repetitive work and remove bottlenecks in the solution development lifecycle * **Infrastructure and Reliability** * Implement reproducible environments, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, alerting, and runbooks. Tune workload performance and cloud cost within approved architecture and security standards. Own reliability, incident response, and recovery for the assets you ship. Improve testing and release practices from production learning. * **Partnership and Mentorship** * Work with the Manager, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineers, architecture, and operators to translate customer and operating needs into dependable data products; support agreed shared capabilities. * Mentor newer engineers through code review and pairing, document reusable patterns, and retain critical know\-how in Servco\-controlled systems. Training and supporting forward deployed team members in implementing AI solutions in line with architecture, implementation and platform standards * **QUALIFICATIONS:** **Education:** Relevant degree or equivalent demonstrated experience. * **Work Experience:** * 6\-10 years building production data pipelines and platforms, with strong Python, SQL, Spark, and Databricks engineering on Azure or a comparable cloud. * Experience building reusable frameworks, automated tests, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observable production services. * Hands\-on AI\-ready pipelines for features, retrieval corpora, or evaluation data, with practical MLOps or LLMOps deployment and monitoring experience. Record of operating reliable data products, resolving incidents, tuning cost and performance, and mentoring engineers. * **Skills:** * Curiosity about unfamiliar systems and an ability to anticipate how changes in business workflows affect data and platform design. MLflow or comparable model lifecycle tools, Unity Catalog, vector search, event integration, and automotive or retail operations data. (Preferred) * **About Servco:** At Servco, we’re committed to providing valuable mobility solutions to empower people through the freedom of movement and opportunity. From Australia to California, and of course, Hawaii, Team Servco is a collective of over 2,000 like\-minded individuals guided by our four Core Values of Respect, Service, Teamwork, and Innovation. For over 100 years, we have been dedicated to superior service, to both our customers and team members. We look forward to helping you create Life:Moments that matter to you. **Interested?** Visit www.servco.com/careers to apply online or email us at careers@servco.com . *Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug\-Free Workplace* Pay Range: $93,900\.00 \- $142,700\.00 per year

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a seasoned technical leader who brings deep expertise, broad systems thinking, and the hands\-on drive to take complex ideas from design through delivery. You'll work at the intersection of architecture and execution \- shaping the technical direction of company\-wide initiatives while staying close enough to the code to make them real. We power thousands of home and commercial service businesses across the U.S. and beyond, helping them operate more efficiently through a platform that includes ML and AI\-driven scheduling, dispatch automation, and real\-time operational workflows. We're quality\-minded, embrace modern engineering practices, and believe the best solutions come from engineers who are as invested in the craft as they are in the outcome. If that's how you think about your work, we'd like to talk. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Own \& Deliver:** Define the technical vision for your domain, plan 18\+ months ahead, and see it through \- writing code, leading implementation, and taking end\-to\-end accountability for quality and outcomes. **Design \& Build:** Produce complete, production\-ready system designs and then help build them. You write code and lead others in writing high\-quality code. You drive and participate in major architectural decisions relating to scale, reliability, and security, and you're the person who makes those decisions real. Set the Standard: Be the reference point for engineering excellence. Your implementations, code reviews, and technical decisions serve as the model others learn from. You conduct architecture reviews, identify systemic risks, and introduce improvements that make the entire organization more effective at shipping. **Discover \& Generalize:** Proactively identify opportunities to extract shared systems, define reusable patterns, and establish approaches that eliminate duplication and inconsistency across teams. You prevent the organization from diverging technically and build the foundations others build on top of. Empower: Coach and mentor Staff and Senior engineers in technical design, architecture, and systems thinking. You create opportunities for others to grow, run cross\-team knowledge\-sharing sessions, and make the engineers around you demonstrably better. **Shape Strategy:** Partner with engineering leadership on roadmap and resource planning across company\-wide initiatives. Surface and advocate for non\-functional requirements \- scalability, resilience, security, performance \- and make sure they are reflected in how teams plan and execute. Align technical direction with ServiceTitan's business priorities. Recruit \& Grow the Team: Assess candidates for senior technical roles, design interview plans, and make hiring recommendations. You help define and uphold the engineering bar. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 15\+ years of industry experience in large\-scale enterprise web or SaaS applications, with 7\+ years in senior IC roles designing and building systems used by other engineers at scale * A proven track record of designing and shipping large\-scale distributed systems \- not just advising on them * Deep expertise in at least one primary technology stack (e.g. C\#/.NET, Java,C\+\+ or equivalent), with the ability to quickly ramp up on and contribute to any technology in ServiceTitan's stack * Strong command of distributed systems fundamentals: event\-driven architecture, asynchronous programming, concurrency, fault tolerance, and performance tuning * Hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including architecture, automation, and operational practices * Solid grounding in data architecture: relational, NoSQL, vector databases, and distributed persistence * Familiarity with AI/ML systems and LLM\-based architectures \- including orchestration, retrieval, and agentic patterns \- aligned with the direction of ServiceTitan's platform * Experience leading monolith\-to\-microservices or service\-oriented migrations through to completion * Strong command of modern engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), RESTful services, and observability tooling (e.g. Elasticsearch, DataDog, Prometheus) * B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field *Preferred* * A bias for execution: you are equally comfortable at the architecture whiteboard and in the codebase, and you hold yourself accountable for both * The communication skill to make complex technical decisions legible to any audience \- engineers, PMs, and leadership alike \- in writing and in person * A coaching mindset: you invest in the engineers around you and consistently leave teams, codebases, and architectures better than you found them * Breadth across the engineering landscape with deep mastery in at least one area, and the intellectual curiosity to quickly develop credibility in new domains * A habit of identifying risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities before they surface as problems \- and the ownership to address them * Strong empathy for end users and a consistent practice of grounding technical decisions in real customer impact **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $263,800 USD \- $395,600 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $246,500 USD \- $369,700 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Description: **Engineering Manager — Lead the team that keeps our water treatment plants engineered right and on schedule** Seven Seas Water Group is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Project, Process, and EI\&C Engineers who design the water treatment plants we build, own, and operate, primarily seawater and brackish water reverse osmosis (SWRO/BWRO) systems for municipal and industrial customers across the U.S. and international markets. You'll make sure engineering never holds up procurement or construction, and you'll build the team and capacity strategy that makes that possible. This is a hybrid role based in our Tampa office, with 10\-20% domestic and international travel. **Who we are** Seven Seas Water Group (SSWG) delivers more than 20 billion gallons of water a year to industrial, governmental, municipal, and hospitality customers across the U.S., Caribbean, and Latin America. Through our Water\-as\-a\-Service® (WaaS®) model, we design, build, own, and operate more than 200 water and wastewater treatment plants, taking on the capital and operational risk so our customers don't have to. SSWG is a portfolio company of EQT, a global investment firm with more than three decades of experience building essential infrastructure. **What you'll own** You'll own the engineering schedule on every project, planning drawings, Bills of Quantities, control system deliverables, and procurement packages backward from the project timeline so long\-lead items release early and construction never waits on engineering. You'll run the department on early warning, tracking deliverables against plan and bringing options, not surprises, when risk shows up. You'll also coordinate cross\-disciplinary checks among process, mechanical, and EI\&C engineering, partner with our 3D Plant Design group, and facilitate HAZOPs and design reviews early enough to shape the outcome. You'll be the quality gate for everything that leaves the department, in\-house or subcontracted, holding every deliverable to SSWG's engineering standards. That means owning the department's capacity plan: forecasting demand across projects and pursuits, and flexing a mix of core staff, lump\-sum engineering subcontracts, and contract engineers to absorb the inevitable lumpiness in workload without carrying dead headcount or burning out your team. Just as much, this is a people role. You'll mentor each engineer with real development plans, match people to projects deliberately, and build a team culture where problems surface early. You'll lead as a working manager, technically credible enough to jump into a P\&ID or a calculation review and make the call yourself when it matters. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline; Chemical or Mechanical Engineering preferred * 8 to 12 years of engineering experience in a project\-execution or system\-integration environment; water treatment experience strongly preferred, SWRO/BWRO experience a plus * A track record of delivering engineering scope on schedule in a project\-driven environment * 5\+ years managing engineers, with a demonstrable record of developing people * Experience managing engineering subcontracts and contract labor, including scoping lump\-sum packages and holding outside firms to a quality standard * Ability to read, check, and approve P\&IDs, PFDs, GAs, specifications, and calculations across process, mechanical, and EI\&C disciplines * Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our Tampa office, with 10\-20% domestic and international travel * A PE license and PMP certification are a plus, as is Spanish language ability and experience with ERP\-driven project execution (IFS Cloud or similar). **Why this role** You'd be the person who makes sure engineering is never the reason a plant is late, with real authority over how the department runs and real influence over how our engineers grow. If you want to lead a technical team that's shaping how we deliver water infrastructure, this is that seat. *Location: Tampa, FL (hybrid), with 10\-20% domestic and international travel.* We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. In accordance with applicable law, we make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as any mental health or physical disability needs. Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans. Applicant will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Seven Seas Water Group** Seven Seas Water Group (www.sevenseaswater.com) is a portfolio company owned by investment funds managed by EQT. Headquartered in Tampa, with operations across the U.S., Caribbean, and Latin America, Seven Seas Water Group (SSWG) delivers annually over 20 billion gallons of water to industrial, commercial, governmental, municipal, and hospitality customers. SSWG designs, builds, owns, and operates, delivers new facilities, or acquires and upgrades existing facilities, with the goal of optimizing project risk transfer between the public and private sectors. We have more than 200 water and wastewater treatment plants in operations throughout the United States, Caribbean, and Latin America. With an outstanding reputation for decentralized water and wastewater treatment solutions, the SSWG “Water\-as\-a\-Service®” approach seeks to help solve global water and wastewater infrastructure challenges. SSWG operates two businesses within the water infrastructure space. Seven Seas Water, which provides water treatment and desalination for governmental, hospitality and industrial customers in United States, Latin America and the Caribbean, and the AUC Group (www.aucgroup.net), which provides decentralized water and wastewater treatment plants for industrial and municipal customers in the United States. EQT is a purpose\-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of more than three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors, and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start\-up to maturity. EQT has EUR 273 billion in total assets under management (EUR 141 billion in fee\-generating assets under management) as of 30 June 2025, within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets. ***This role is remote, with a preference for candidates located in or near Tampa, FL or Houston, TX, where our team has a regional presence*** **Job Summary** The Senior Project Engineer is accountable for all aspects of engineering necessary to deliver water treatment systems (primarily Reverse Osmosis systems treating seawater and brackish water) to be operated by Seven Seas Water (Operations Group) on a long term basis delivering water to municipal and industrial customers. The Project Engineer has ownership of all engineering activities necessary to delivery turn key solutions on green field and brown field sites. This includes in house engineering, 3D design, I\&C engineering, full SCADA development, and 3rd party engineering subcontracts for civil, structural, building, permitting, etc. as needed to support the turn key project delivery. Requirements: **Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:** * Act as the lead engineer for assigned projects; support the project manager in execution of engineering project deliverables. Liaise with project team and customer in delivering the project. * Take ownership of the P\&ID’s and the Integration of the project across all disciplines to ensure a consistent design across all disciplines and documentation. * Prepare engineering documents within specified dates, such as P\&ID (Piping and Instrument Diagram), foundation loading charts, valves list, rotating equipment (pumps, blower etc.) data sheets, static equipment data sheets (storage tank, pressure vessels) heat exchanger data sheet, paint and lining matrix, piping and valve specs. * Prepare Material Purchase Specifications (MPS) for equipment, valves, instruments, vessels, piping, paint, lining, etc. along with review and release of technical bid evaluations (TBE’s) for the packages. This role represents the highest level of technical expertise within the Fortinet ecosystem and requires deep proficiency in secure network architecture, threat mitigation, and large\-scale infrastructure operations. The ideal candidate will serve as a subject matter expert (SME), providing strategic guidance, hands\-on engineering, and escalation support for mission\-critical security initiatives. **What you'll be doing.** * Communicating with colleagues and customers in a professional and respectful manner. * Architect, design, and implement advanced network security solutions leveraging Fortinet technologies, including FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiClient EMS, FortiSIEM, and FortiSOAR * Lead the deployment and optimization of secure network infrastructures, including SD\-WAN, ZTNA, SASE, IPS, SSL deep packet inspection, and advanced threat protection * Act as the highest\-level escalation point for complex security incidents, performance issues, and architectural jobs.title: VP of AI, Data and Data Science
jobs.description: Sims Metal (Sims) is a global leader in metal recycling. With facilities across the globe, Sims plays an intrinsic role in the circular economy by making resources available for future use. As a responsible corporate citizen, we continuously seek new ways to broaden our participation in the environmental sector, ensuring that our future is as bright, safe, and secure as at any time in our long history. **Job Description** This is the enterprise leader accountable for turning AI and data into measurable operational and commercial advantage across Sims. The role combines strategy, hands\-on delivery, data science, agent engineering, data platforms, architecture, governance, adoption, and talent leadership. It is not a reporting\-only or innovation\-lab role. The successful candidate must build production capability, scale practical solutions globally and contribute as a broad enterprise technology leader across the Technology function. **Position Summary** The Vice President, AI, Data and Data Science leads Sims Limited’s global AI, data, analytics and data\-science capability. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer and serving on the Technology Leadership Team, the role is accountable for defining the strategy, building the team and partner ecosystem, establishing the architecture and controls, and delivering solutions that improve safety, throughput, yield, quality, reliability, customer outcomes, working capital, cost and employee productivity. The role will bring deep operational technology and industrial data\-science experience. It will connect plant, yard, logistics, asset, commercial and enterprise data with advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, computer vision, optimization and intelligent automation. The leader will work directly with operations and business leaders to identify high\-value problems, prove value quickly, industrialize successful solutions, and embed new ways of working. This is a builder role. The leader will establish an enterprise AI and agent delivery model, including reusable patterns, secure development environments, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management. The portfolio will include Microsoft AI capabilities, custom\-built agents and applications, and fit\-for\-purpose use of advanced engineering tools such as Claude Code, where approved. Accountability includes outcomes, adoption, responsible use, architecture quality and sustainable support, not simply pilots or technology demonstrations. The position will manage and expand the existing enterprise data, certified reporting and business\-intelligence capability while building a broader AI, data\-science, data\-engineering and agent\-engineering team. This leader will materially influence AI and data architecture, data quality and master\-data direction. It will combine internal talent, strategic partners and specialist managed services, while retaining clear internal ownership of strategy, architecture, critical intellectual property and business outcomes. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Enterprise AI and Data Strategy** * Partner with the CTO, Executive Leadership Team and business leaders to define and execute a global AI, data and analytics strategy aligned with Sims’ enterprise, Metals and SLS priorities. * Create a value\-led roadmap that connects operational, commercial and functional opportunities to clear business owners, investment requirements, delivery milestones, adoption plans and measurable benefits. * Move the organization from experimentation to governed, repeatable delivery, with transparent decisions on what to build, buy, partner, scale, stop or retire. * Provide clear, decision\-ready updates to the CTO, ELT, Board and governance forums on value, delivery, risk, adoption and capability maturity. **2\. Operational Technology, Data Science and Industrial AI** * Build a portfolio of operational AI and data\-science solutions across yards, plants, logistics, maintenance, asset recovery and processing operations. * Apply advanced analytics, forecasting, optimization, machine learning, computer vision and generative AI to practical business problems such as safety, throughput, yield, quality, downtime, energy use, inventory, routing, pricing and material recovery. * Integrate OT, IoT, equipment, telemetry, edge and enterprise data safely and reliably, in partnership with operations, engineering, infrastructure and cybersecurity leaders. * Establish methods for site discovery, rapid proof of value, controlled pilots, industrialization, adoption and global replication of successful use cases. * Ensure models remain effective in real operating conditions through monitoring, retraining, exception management and accountable human oversight. **3\. AI Agents, Custom Solutions and Engineering** * Establish the enterprise capability to design, develop, test, deploy and operate AI agents, copilots and custom AI\-enabled applications. * Define reference patterns for agent orchestration,  of Claude Code or equivalent tools. * Master’s degree, MBA or advanced technical qualification relevant to AI, data science, engineering or business leadership. **Leadership Capabilities** * **Enterprise judgment:** Connects operational, commercial, workforce and technology choices to Sims’ strategy and risk appetite. * **Technical depth with pragmatism:** Can challenge architecture and engineering decisions while staying focused on usable outcomes. * **Operational credibility:** Builds trust with site and operations leaders by understanding real constraints and delivering in the field. * **Builder mindset:** Creates teams, platforms, patterns, and products, rather than depending on strategy decks or vendors. * **Value orientation:** Translates use cases into measurable outcomes and stops work that does not justify continued investment. * **Responsible innovation:** Moves quickly while protecting safety, security, privacy, data and reputation. * **Talent leadership:** Attracts outstanding people, develops successors and creates a high\-accountability culture. * **Executive presence:** Communicates complex choices clearly and earns confidence with senior executives and the Board. * **Partner leverage:** Gets more value, innovation and accountability from strategic technology partners. * **Technology leadership breadth:** Contributes credibly across enterprise applications, infrastructure, cyber, architecture, service delivery, transformation, investment and talent. **Measures of Success** * An enterprise AI and data roadmap is approved, funded, actively governed and visibly connected to business priorities. * Priority AI, data\-science and agent solutions progress from pilot to production and demonstrate agreed operational, financial, risk or productivity outcomes. * Sims has repeatable, secure and supportable patterns for developing and operating agents and custom AI solutions. * Priority operational and enterprise data domains have accountable owners, trusted datasets, common definitions, and improving data quality and master data. * Business adoption expands through practical training, self\-service analytics advocacy, embedded change and reusable solutions, not one\-off demonstrations. * The data and AI organization has clear roles, stronger technical depth, viable career paths and succession coverage. * Microsoft and other strategic partners deliver measurable innovation, engineering capacity and commercial value against an agreed agenda. * Executive and Board reporting clearly distinguishes facts, benefits, risks, decisions and required actions. * The VP plays a visible leadership role across the broader Technology agenda and can represent the CTO in agreed forums. We value the diversity of all of our employees and are committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone can contribute, advance on merit, and realize their full potential. This applies to any employment decision, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Qualified applicants with a disability in need of a reasonable accommodation may request such without fear of reprisal or discrimination. To find out more, please visit **www.simsltd.com** for more information on Sims and its commitment to sustainability. jobs.title: Sr Facility Analyst
jobs.description: **SitelogIQ** is a rapidly growing company focused on making buildings better. We provide planning, design, and management solutions for organizations that want efficient and sustainable building environments that are healthier and safer for their occupants. The **Senior Facility Analyst** leads large, complex Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) projects for clients nationwide. This role combines hands\-on building systems expertise with project leadership, field\-team coordination, and capital planning. You’ll evaluate facility conditions, identify deficiencies and capital improvement opportunities, develop preliminary scopes and budgets, and present recommendations to clients. You’ll also lead assessment teams and collaborate closely with Engineers, Architects, and Operations professionals. **Base Compensation:** 105K\-125K **Work Arrangement:** Remote when not at a client site **Travel:** Up to 50% nationwide travel #### **What You’ll Do** * Lead Facility Condition Assessment projects from planning and fieldwork through quality review and final deliverables. * Direct field assessment teams and ensure accurate, consistent documentation and data collection. * Evaluate HVAC, plumbing, electrical, life safety, security, building envelope, interiors, and site systems. * Assess system condition, deficiencies, remaining useful life, and capital replacement needs. * Review drawings, maintenance records, prior studies, and facility information to support assessment findings. * Develop capital improvement recommendations, preliminary scopes of work, priorities, and rough\-order\-of\-magnitude budgets. * Review assessment data, condition ratings, photos, and recommendations for quality and accuracy. * Collaborate with Engineers, Architects, and Operations teams to refine project recommendations. * Present assessment findings, facility needs, and budget assumptions to clients. #### **What We’re Looking For** * Relevant experience in **facility assessments, facilities management, engineering, architecture, construction, capital planning, or HVAC/building systems**. * Strong practical knowledge of building systems, maintenance needs, and capital replacement planning. * Experience independently leading complex projects and directing field teams. * Experience developing facility improvement recommendations, preliminary scopes, and budget estimates. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical findings to nontechnical clients. * Comfortable working with digital assessment platforms, spreadsheets, tablets, and field data collection tools. * Degree in engineering, architecture, facilities management, construction management, or a related technical field preferred. Equivalent education, training, and experience will be considered. * **K\-12, facilities management, capital planning, or large facility portfolio experience is a plus.** #### **Work Environment** This is a hands\-on role that may involve walking large facilities, climbing stairs or ladders, and accessing mechanical rooms, rooftops, attics, crawl spaces, and other building areas. Candidates should be comfortable working in active facility environments and occasionally lifting up to **40 lbs.** **No agencies please** **Benefits** We offer a highly competitive salary, and comprehensive benefits, including: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Disability and life insurance * 401K * Flex time off * 12 paid holidays * Tuition reimbursement * Opportunities to drive our DE\&I efforts by joining our affinity groups, Veterans and Allies Leadership Organization or Women Inspiring \& Strengthening Everyone * Opportunities to give back to our local communities through organized events or fundraisers **More About SitelogIQ** At SitelogIQ, we’re focused on creating a great environment for our team first so that it is more energizing and rewarding to focus on creating a great customer experience. That’s what we call a win\-win. We partner with clients in K\-12, higher ed, government, healthcare, multifamily housing, and industry to optimize energy efficiency, improve indoor air quality, address lighting, and improve the customer experience. With offices across the country, it’s rewarding to make a difference in the communities where our teammates live and work. **SitelogIQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-Verify.** Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

**Cloud Security \& Access Management** * Own infrastructure security controls across AWS and Kubernetes environments. * Manage IAM, workload identity, secrets management, and least\-privilege access. drift. * Maintain security boundaries between production, staging, development, and automation systems. * Support secure access and operational controls for AI tools and integrations. ### **Technical Leadership** * Partner directly with the SVP of Engineering to establish infrastructure priorities and technical direction. * Lead significant platform improvements and infrastructure migrations from design through production. * Make architectural decisions balancing scalability, reliability, security, and cost. * Collaborate with engineering teams and mentor developers on infrastructure best infrastructure. * Experience with Cloudflare, cloud security, and infrastructure access management. * Demonstrated experience managing on\-call rotations, troubleshooting production outages, and conducting root\-cause analysis. * Experience supporting highly scalable, high\-availability production platforms. * Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments. * Strong knowledge of AWS IAM, networking, infrastructure security, and monitoring. * Proven ability to independently own infrastructure projects and solve complex technical problems. * Strong communication skills and interest in growing into broader technical leadership responsibilities. **Technology Stack** -------------------- * **Cloud Infrastructure:** AWS, Multi\-Account AWS Environments * **Container Orchestration:** Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Karpenter, Helm * **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform, Terraform Cloud * **CI/CD:** Jenkins, Argo CD * **Edge \& Security:** Salary is competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience, while also considering internal equity. This position is represented by SIU Carbondale Faculty Association/IEA\-NEA. For more information regarding salary and other details please visit: https://laborrelations.siu.edu/labor\-contracts. **Examples of Duties** ---------------------- The selected candidate will teach undergraduate and graduate courses within the School, conduct high\-quality research, supervise graduate student theses and dissertations, and actively contribute to service at the School, College, and University levels. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Minimum Qualifications:** Applicants must have B.S. and Ph.D. degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related area. Ph.D. candidates may be considered if all degree requirements are met by August 10, 2027\. If all requirements for the Ph.D. degree are not completed by that date, a term, non\-tenure track appointment may be offered in accordance with the University policy (https://policies.siu.edu/personnel\-policies/chapter2/ch2\-faps/faculty\-contingent.php). **Preferred Qualifications:** The primary focus of this search will be Advanced Manufacturing, with areas of interest including, but not limited to, additive and biomanufacturing/biofabrication; advanced materials and manufacturing processes; smart and digital manufacturing; AI/ML, computational methods, and digital twins; industrial robotics and intelligent automation; and sustainable and resilient manufacturing. **Required Documents:** Please submit a complete application package consisting of a cover letter, CV, statements of teaching (1\-2 pages) and research (3 pages), and a list of three references with complete contact information. **Contact:** Jennifer Langin, jlangin@siu.edu **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- College of Engineering, Computing, Technology, and Mathematics/ School of Mechanical, Aerospace, and Materials Engineering Southern Illinois University Carbondale is an R1 Opportunity University with a statewide economic impact of $2\.7 billion dollars. We offer 200\+ undergraduate degrees, minors and specializations, 79 master’s degrees, and 40 doctoral degrees. Our main campus is 1,136 acres, with additional acreage in University Farms, Touch of Nature Outdoor Education Center, and other facilities. The university is an essential part of the city of Carbondale and an important contributor to the culture of the entire region. While Carbondale includes many of the amenities of urban life, it retains its small\-town flavor. Cost of living is considerably lower in the region than similar areas elsewhere, and many employees commute from nearby counties. The Southern Illinois region is distinct from the rest of the state, boasting considerable natural beauty including the Shawnee National Forest, many state parks, national wildlife areas, and several lakes beloved for recreation. Local foods are readily available in the area, with a variety of eateries and a growing specialized food truck presence. The area is home to the Shawnee Hills Wine Trail, an official wine appellation designation. The wineries extend the cultural reach of the community, hosting live music and continual art exhibits. The campus itself is a microcosm of the area, with a lake and forest on campus, as well as traditional collegiate architecture, quad, and residential halls. Students enjoy outdoor study areas as well as specialized computer labs scattered across campus, including in the three million volume Morris Library. To learn about employee benefits, employee tuition waivers, and find resources about Carbondale and the Southern Illinois region, visit: https://jobs.siu.edu/. Southern Illinois University Carbondale is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer dedicated to building a community of excellence, equity, and diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, order of protection status, genetic information, marital status, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation including gender identity, unfavorable discharge from the military or status as a protected veteran. The university will comply with all federal and state nondiscrimination, equal opportunity and affirmative action laws, orders, and regulations. **University employees may be eligible for a variety of State of Illinois benefits. These benefits are administered through the Illinois Department of Central Management Service (CMS). These benefits include: Health Insurance plans (HMOs, OAPs, QCHP and CDHP), Dental Insurance, Vision Plan, Life Insurance, Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D), Supplemental Long Term Disability (LTD), Flex Spending Accounts, MCAP and DCAP, and 457(b) Deferred Compensation Plan.** **Eligible employees are required to participate in the State Universities Retirement System (SURS). SURS is the retirement administrator for employees in public higher education in the State of Illinois.** **Other benefits available to eligible employees include: Generous paid time\-off, 403(b) Supplemental Retirement Plans, and Employee Assistance Program.** **SIUC also provides extensive tuition benefits for its employees and their families such as:** **tuition waiver/application fee waiver for the employee and their dependents****,** **a Legacy tuition rate for children of SIU Alumni****, and** **Civil Service Employee Counsel (CSEC) Education Assistance Program (EAP)****.** **For more information please visit:** **https://hr.siu.edu/benefits/**

jobs.title: Software Developer II
jobs.description: At **Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU)**, our members are at the heart of everything we do. Routes calls as needs for more non\-routine questions. Track tickets in an incident management system to properly identify problem and resolution for a shared knowledge base or escalate and assign as needed for higher level support. * Designs, develops, tests, and integrates moderately complex internal and external core and web applications, services, and sites, including maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting in order to fulfill business needs. With 67 branches spanning Florida’s east coast, we are the third\-largest credit union in the state. In 2025, we expanded into Orange County to better serve the growing East Orlando market. Unlike traditional banks, we return profits to our members through better rates, lower fees, and enhanced services. While we offer the same financial products—like checking, savings, and loans—our focus remains on empowering our members and supporting their financial well\-being.
