jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a motivated, analytical, and collaborative Software Engineer to design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain high\-quality software solutions. We welcome candidates with strong backgrounds in software engineering, software development, application troubleshooting, or technical problem\-solving. As a Software Engineer, you will participate in the full software development life cycle (SDLC), including gathering requirements, designing solutions, writing and testing code, troubleshooting existing applications, and deploying software enhancements. You will work with programming languages and technologies such as Java, Python, SQL, C\+\+, or other relevant development tools and frameworks. This role requires the ability to balance hands\-on software development and troubleshooting with a broader, solution\-oriented mindset. Successful candidates will look beyond immediate issue resolution to identify recurring problems, underlying root causes, and opportunities to develop scalable, maintainable solutions that improve system functionality, performance, and the overall client experience. You will work closely with internal team members, including other software engineers, technical solution analysts, data analysts, and nontechnical business stakeholders, to understand requirements, investigate complex challenges, and develop effective solutions. We value individuals who take ownership of their work, communicate effectively, and thrive in a collaborative, team\-oriented environment. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, OR equivalent professional experience in software engineering, software development, application troubleshooting, systems analysis, or technical solution development. * Demonstrated experience developing, maintaining, or troubleshooting software applications. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Java, Python, C\+\+, Ruby, .NET, or other relevant technologies. * Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL, and database design principles. * Familiarity with software development methodologies and the software development life cycle (SDLC), including design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues and identify underlying root causes. * Ability to recognize patterns across individual issues and contribute to broader, long\-term technical solutions. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in a team\-oriented environment. * Ability to work independently, prioritize competing responsibilities, and take ownership of development tasks and technical issues through resolution. * Familiarity with software engineering tools, debugging techniques, version control, and testing practices. * Ability to document technical requirements, system designs, troubleshooting findings, and solution specifications. * Willingness to learn new technologies, applications, and business workflows. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. **Job Type**: Full\-time **Job Location:** 5800 Foxridge Dr. Mission, KS Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $53,112\.42 \- $110,820\.08 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Are you located in the Kansas City metropolitan area? Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Mission, KS 66202 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Director, Business Solutions / Sales Engineering
jobs.description: **About SpectraMedix** SpectraMedix is a healthcare data analytics and value\-based performance platform that empowers health plans, ACOs, and health systems to manage provider network performance and accelerate their transition to value\-based care. Our platform integrates claims, clinical, and social data to deliver actionable insights, align incentives, and improve outcomes across the healthcare continuum. **Position Summary** SpectraMedix is seeking a Director of Business Solutions to lead technical pre\-sales across our sales team. Our deals turn on whether a prospect believes we can work with their data and deliver what we describe. This role makes that case, and then makes sure what we sold is what gets delivered. The role leads data and technical discovery, builds demonstrations and prospect\-specific mockups, designs proofs of concept and paid scoping engagements, and drafts the technical content within proposals and statements of work. It is the authority on what SpectraMedix can commit to, what it cannot, and what it would cost to build. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead data and technical discovery on every new opportunity; no demonstration is scheduled before technical discovery has taken place * Build and run product demonstrations and prospect\-specific mockups against the prospect’s own data environment * Design proofs of concept and paid scoping engagements end to end, including success criteria, data requirements, timeline, and go/no\-go structure * Draft the technical content within proposals, ROI models, and statements of work. * Determine what SpectraMedix commits to technically within a deal, and maintain the documented split between shipped, committed, and aspirational capability that all scoping is built against * Walk scoped engagements into implementation so that what was sold is what is delivered, and escalate scope drift early * Bring field and deal requirements into the monthly product roadmap process * Partner with sales leadership to maintain a standard discovery question set applied across all new opportunities **Qualifications** **Required:** * 10\+ years in healthcare technology, with direct experience at or selling to health plans; payer\-side experience strongly preferred. * Working knowledge of value\-based contracting, quality and risk adjustment, and how health plans and provider groups share financial risk. * Strong data literacy—comfort with claims, eligibility, clinical, and supplemental data, with the ability to assess a prospect’s data environment without escalating every question to engineering. * Demonstrated experience leading technical discovery, running demonstrations, and scoping proofs of concept within a live sales cycle. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage CIO, population health, and procurement audiences and be clear about current capability versus roadmap. * A track record of scoping work that was delivered as promised, and the judgment to decline a commitment that cannot be met. **Preferred:** * Time spent inside a health plan in data, EDI, or enterprise data warehouse functions. * Prior work with Blues plans, Medicaid plans, or regional health plans. * Familiarity with HEDIS, Stars, HCC risk adjustment, or CMS regulatory reporting. * Experience in solutions consulting, sales engineering, or product management for a platform that health plans used directly. **Why Join SpectraMedix** * Influence the evolution of a leading healthcare data and value\-based performance platform. * Work directly with national health plans and provider networks to drive measurable impact. * Join a mission\-driven team committed to transforming healthcare payment and performance models. * Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional growth opportunities. Pay: From $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off Experience: * Healthcare Technology: 10 years (Required) * Health Plans / Payer Organizations: 5 years (Required) * Sales Engineering / Technical Pre\-Sales: 5 years (Required) * Working with healthcare data: 5 years (Required) * Supporting VBC, Population Health, or Risk Adjustment: 3 years (Required) * Technical Discovery, Product Demonstrations, or POC Scoping: 3 years (Required) * Solutions Consulting, Business Solutions, or Solution Design: 3 years (Required) * Product management or Client Implementation Leadership: 3 years (Preferred) * Quality, Provider Performance, or Risk Adjustment Programs: 3 years (Preferred) * Blues, Medicare, Medicaid, or Regional Health Plans: 1 year (Preferred) * HEDIS, Stars, HCC Risk Adjustment, or CMS Reporting: 1 year (Preferred) * EDI, Enrollment, Claims, or Data Warehouse: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in East Windsor, NJ 08520

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Platform Core Services
jobs.description: **Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.** ------------------------------------------------------------ Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage. Our AI\-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self\-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners. As an AI\-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission. Reporting to Senior Engineering Manager, Platform Core Services, you will help build and maintain the shared platform services that our client engineering teams use to deliver solutions for their customers and end users. The Platform Core Services team owns foundational capabilities such as Auth, User Sync, Composer, and other shared services. This is high\-leverage work: when we get an abstraction right and manage it in one place, we lower the cost of software delivery, make systems more stable, and keep security consistent for every team that depends on it. Please note that this is a **hybrid role based in Seattle**, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week at our 255 S King St location. Candidates must be based in the Seattle metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on\-sites. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Write, review, and deliver production\-ready code with a focus on correctness, clarity, and maintainability. * Participate actively in code reviews—giving constructive feedback and leveraging review comments as a learning opportunity. * Use AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to explore implementation approaches, accelerate development, generate documentation, and augment code reviews—providing sufficient context to get high\-quality, system\-aware outputs, and always critically reviewing AI\-generated code before shipping. * Contribute to architectural discussions and tech debt prioritization within your team. * Proactively clarify requirements to remove ambiguity; identify and mitigate risks before they become blockers. * Deliver features independently on well\-scoped work; support larger multi\-person projects with consistent execution. * Collaborate with product managers and designers to break down complex requirements into manageable, shippable units. * Advocate for high engineering standards including test coverage, documentation, and observability. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to support system reliability and respond to production issues. * Identify and resolve root causes across code domains; add logging, alerting, and monitoring as a standard part of your work. * Build and evolve shared services (Auth, User Sync, Composer) and the infrastructure and APIs beneath them, so client teams integrate instead of rebuilding. * Own shared systems that fall between teams: learn, document, and stabilize them, and roll out changes safely through versioning, backward compatibility, and deprecation paths. * Partner with client teams to turn repeated patterns into shared components with clear contracts, and measure adoption to guide what we evolve next. **What success looks like in this role** ---------------------------------------- * **Delivery \& Quality –** Deliver projects on time, within scope, and with high stakeholder satisfaction. Maintain high system uptime and low defect rates through strong testing and observability practices. * **Independent Execution –** Complete well\-scoped tasks independently, resolve issues proactively, and accurately track your own work. Estimates are improving in accuracy sprint over sprint. * **AI\-Augmented Engineering –** Regularly use AI to assist with features, debugging, documentation, and test creation—iterating on prompts to improve output quality, and always validating results against team standards. * **Collaboration –** Partner effectively with product, design, data, and engineering teammates, contributing meaningfully to team goals and alignment. * **Engineering Excellence –** Contribute to improved team velocity through planning, estimation, and delivery best practices. Continuously seek out new techniques—including AI capabilities—to improve engineering outcomes. * **Code Quality –** Write code that is tested, secure, and easy for others to understand and maintain. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 3–5 years of professional software development experience * Proficiency with Ruby on Rails or Python, Postgres, GraphQL, React, and TypeScript, Datadog, RSpec Framework, * Experience building full stack applications * Actively uses AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to assist with features, debugging, and test creation—iterates on prompts to improve output quality and critically reviews all AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and standards compliance * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment * Experience working in cross\-functional Agile teams * Strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on clean, maintainable code and attention to detail * Embraces writing well\-designed tests that accompany all code **Note**: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in\-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria. * Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to **One Medical**accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type. * Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning * A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents. * We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays. * At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non\-birthing parents. * Access to **Noom****,** a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals. * Access to fertility care support through **Carrot**, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses. * Access to**Wellhub**, which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription * Access to **BrightHorizons**, which provides sponsored child care, back\-up care, and elder care * Up to $1,000 Professional Development Reimbursement a year. * $200 per year donation matching to support your favorite causes. **Not sure if you meet every requirement?** Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly\-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. ***Our privacy policy:*** ***https://springhealth.com/privacy\-policy/*** *Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $153K

jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The SystemsInfrastructure Engineer is a hands\-on technical resource responsible for both the organization's enterprise network and server infrastructure. This role engineers, administers, secures, monitors, and supports Cisco enterprise networking, Microsoft Windows Server environments, firewalls, wireless, virtualization, storage, backup, and related infrastructure platforms. Working with Information Technology staff, Major League Baseball, vendors, and business stakeholders, the engineer delivers approved infrastructure improvements and reliable support for daily operations, game days, and events. **Job Duties:** Network Infrastructure * Design, implement, administer, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including Cisco switching and routing, VLANs and network segmentation, VPNs, wireless networks, enterprise firewalls, and related network services. * Monitor network availability, capacity, performance, and security; troubleshoot complex connectivity and performance issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions. * Apply organizational standards, cybersecurity controls, lifecycle practices, and operational requirements while recommending improvements to network reliability, scalability, performance, and security. ServerSystems Infrastructure * Design, implement, administer, and maintain Microsoft Windows Server infrastructure and related enterprise systems, including server deployment and configuration, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, virtualization, storage, backup, monitoring, and core services. * Perform server upgrades, patching, migrations, performance troubleshooting, capacity management, and lifecycle activities across physical and virtual server environments. * Troubleshoot complex issues across Windows Server, virtualization, storage, backup, authentication, and related infrastructure; perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions. ProjectsChange Delivery * Execute approved infrastructure projects, including deployments, upgrades, migrations, hardware refreshes, disaster recovery improvements, and enterprise platform implementations; prepare implementation, testing, rollback, change, and documentation plans. * Coordinate technical activities with Information Technology staff, MLB, vendors, and external partners, and elevate material risks, dependencies, or decisions to Information Technology leadership. StadiumOperational Support * Administer and support Busch Stadium wireless infrastructure, including Extreme Networks technologies; analyze health, performance, capacity, and security trends and coordinate approved improvements. * Serve as an advanced escalation resource for network, server, and infrastructure incidents and support game days, special events, and planned after\-hours maintenance as business needs require. * Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, diagrams, configurations, standards, and operating procedures to support continuity and knowledge transfer. Technical Collaboration * Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to Information Technology staff and contribute engineering input to standards, capacity planning, and infrastructure roadmaps. * Evaluate relevant technologies and present recommendations, tradeoffs, and implementation considerations to Information Technology leadership. **Education/Experience Required:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Three or more years of progressively responsible, hands\-on experience supporting enterprise network and server infrastructure. Candidates should have substantive experience administering and troubleshooting both Cisco enterprise networking and Microsoft Windows Server environments. The depth and complexity of work performed will be considered alongside total years of experience. * Hands\-on experience administering Cisco enterprise switching and routing environments, including TCP/IP, VLANs, spanning tree, routing, QoS, network segmentation, VPNs, wireless networking, and related technologies. * Hands\-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments, including server deployment, configuration, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, patching, and troubleshooting. * Experience supporting virtualization, storage, backup, monitoring, logging, and performance analysis technologies. * Strong understanding of enterprise cybersecurity principles and secure infrastructure architecture. * Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills across networking, Windows Server, virtualization, storage, and security technologies. * Ability to independently work through infrastructure problems, understand dependencies across systems, and implement appropriate technical changes. * Ability to execute multiple infrastructure projects within approved priorities and maintain clear technical and change documentation. * Strong analytical, organizational, collaboration, and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to access equipment throughout office buildings, data centers, telecommunications rooms, and stadium facilities and to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and scheduled maintenance windows as business needs require. **Education/Experience Preferred:** * Five or more years of progressively responsible enterprise infrastructure experience, including independent responsibility for complex implementations, troubleshooting, upgrades, migrations, or other significant infrastructure work across network and server environments. * Advanced degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or additional directly relevant experience. * Hands\-on experience administering Palo Alto firewall platforms. * Experience serving as the technical lead for significant infrastructure implementations, migrations, upgrades, or hardware refreshes. * Experience administering Extreme Networks switching and wireless infrastructure in stadium, venue, or other high\-density environments. * Experience supporting technology in Major League Baseball or another professional sports organization. * Relevant industry certifications in networking, systems, virtualization, or security.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Want to help everyday Americans invest and build wealth? Financial inequality is increasing, and too many people are getting left behind. At Stash, we're passionate about democratizing wealth creation through education, advice, and products that help customers achieve greater financial freedom. We're looking for a **Senior Manager, Data Engineering** to lead and grow the team responsible for the data platform behind Stash's analytics, data science, operations, and business reporting. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You'll set the technical direction for our AWS\-based data platform, develop the engineers on your team, and strengthen how Data Engineering works with Backend Engineering, Infrastructure, SRE, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science. Your first mandate is practical: improve reliability, reduce manual operational work, modernize how we deploy and monitor pipelines, and create clear ownership for how new data enters the platform. You'll inherit meaningful systems and real constraints—not a blank slate. The right person will know when to modernize, when to simplify, and when the best architecture is the one the team can operate reliably. **This position operates on a hybrid schedule, requiring you to be on\-site in our New York office** **at least****three days per week to** **work with stakeholders and****foster team collaboration.** **What you'll do:** * Lead and grow the Data Engineering team. Coach engineers, set clear expectations, create development opportunities, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and technical excellence. * Own the Data Engineering roadmap. Translate company priorities and platform risks into a sequenced plan that balances reliability, automation, security, cost, and new capabilities. * Raise the operational bar. Improve observability, alerting, runbooks, incident response, service\-level expectations, and recovery practices so problems are found and resolved before downstream teams lose trust. * Reduce manual work. Identify repetitive and fragile operational processes, prioritize them by risk and effort, and automate the work that consumes engineering capacity. * Modernize how the platform ships. Establish CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, testing, code review, documentation, and rollback practices for data pipelines and supporting infrastructure. * Evolve our AWS data platform. Guide architecture and hands\-on design across ingestion, distributed processing, storage, and warehouse delivery. Improve performance and cost without introducing unnecessary complexity. * Establish clear ingestion ownership with Engineering. Partner with Backend, Infrastructure, SRE, and Security so new product systems ship with reliable data contracts, production\-ready ingestion, appropriate access controls, and named operational owners. * Protect data quality from source to warehouse. Define standards for schemas, keys, grain, semantics, validation, lineage, backfills, and cutovers. Ensure source changes do not silently alter downstream metrics or models. * Partner with Analytics Engineering and Data Science. Deliver reliable, well\-documented platform inputs and agree on clear boundaries between ingestion, source normalization, business\-facing marts, and analytical use cases. * Make sound architecture tradeoffs. Evaluate batch, higher\-frequency batch, and real\-time patterns based on the business requirement, operational cost, and team capacity—not novelty. * Communicate clearly. Give technical and business leaders a direct view of platform health, risks, priorities, tradeoffs, and progress. * Use AI tools with judgment. Apply AI\-assisted development and operational workflows where they improve quality and speed, while protecting sensitive data and owning the correctness of the output. **What we're looking for:** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, including experience leading or managing data engineers. * Experience leading a small team where you remained close enough to the work to review designs, guide incidents, and unblock difficult technical decisions. * Strong production experience building or supporting distributed data pipelines using tools such as EMR, Glue, Delta, Iceberg, Databricks and orchestration tools. * Hands\-on experience designing, deploying and operating data workloads in AWS cloud environment. * Strong programming(preferred python and scala) and SQL experience in your background. * Experience designing, implementing, and operating real\-time or streaming data pipelines. * A track record of operating business\-critical data systems, including observability, incident response, data quality, performance, and cost management. * Experience introducing or improving CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, code review, and secure deployment practices. * Strong architectural judgment. You can distinguish a real scaling requirement from a process or reliability problem, and you prefer maintainable  ackend Engineering, Infrastructure or SRE, Analytics Engineering, and downstream data consumers. * Strong people leadership. You can develop experienced engineers, delegate meaningful ownership, give direct feedback, and hire thoughtfully as the team grows. * Clear communication with both technical and non\-technical partners. You can explain an incident, an architecture decision, or a delayed commitment without hiding the tradeoff in jargon. * Sound judgment in a regulated environment, including secure data handling, least\-privilege access, audit\-ability, and change control. **Gold Stars:** * Experience working in fintech, financial services, brokerage, banking, or another regulated environment. * Experience supporting production data science or machine\-learning workflows. * Working knowledge of dbt and modern analytics engineering practices. * Experience evolving a platform from manual operations toward reliable self\-service and automation. * Experience with Datadog or similar observability platforms for pipelines and infrastructure. * Experience evaluating or implementing higher\-frequency or real\-time data patterns when the use case justified them. * Experience using AI coding assistants or agentic workflows in production engineering work, with appropriate validation and security judgment. \#LI\-Hybrid **Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion** We proudly celebrate the unique qualities that make you you, 365 days a year, and not just because it's the right thing to do or good for business. We embed the principles and practices of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) into all that we do to prioritize people, a Stash core value, and to ensure Stashers of all backgrounds and experiences can be their authentic selves. We are also proud to be the first and only venture\-backed fintech to join the CEO Action for Diversity \& Inclusion™, and as an Equal Opportunity Employer, Stash is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds. If you require any reasonable accommodations to make your application process more accessible, please reach out to recruiting@Stash.com. **Helping You Invest in Yourself** * Comprehensive total rewards package, comprising compensation (salary and equity) and health care benefits * Complimentary subscription to Stash\+ account * Flexible work policy – We offer a flexible work environment that blends working from home with in\-person collaboration at our NYC office to support productivity and team culture. * Flexible PTO * Annual learning and development reimbursement benefit * Work\-from\-home equipment stipends; home internet subsidy * Paid Parental Leave (offerings for birth giving and non\-birth giving parents) Primary \& Secondary * Enhanced health and wellness benefits through One Medical, Gympass, and Maven Health **External Recognition for Stash** * Benzinga's 2023 Best Brokerage for Beginners and Best Robo\-Advisor Awards * Qorus\-Accenture's 2023 Banking Innovation Awards * USA Today and Statista's 2023 Top 500 Best Financial Advisory Firms * Comparably's Best Company Awards: Best Places to Work, Best Company Outlook, and Best Engineering Team for Diversity, Women, Culture, and more! (2023\) * Fintech Breakthrough Award: Best Personal Finance App (2023\) * BuiltIn's Best Places to Work (2022, 2021, 2020, 2019\) * Forbes Fintech 50 (2021, 2020, 2019\) * Best Digital Bank, Finovate Awards (2020\) * Tearsheet Challenge Awards, Best Banking Card Product \- Stock\-Back® Card, 2020 * LendIt Fintech Innovator of the Year (2020, 2019\) **Salary Range:** $180,000 \- $220,000 The base salary range represents the reasonably anticipated low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience and competencies, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data for companies of our size and industry. **\*\*No recruiters, please\*\***

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. **HYBRID:** Hybrid Work Arrangement: A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in\-office time each month, beginning in late 2027\. **HUB LOCATIONS:** Bloomington, IL; Richardson, TX; Tempe, AZ; Dunwoody, GA **SPONSORSHIP: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.** Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: Our software engineering team builds and modernizes technology that supports our P\&C Claims teams. We develop and support capabilities that help claim professionals efficiently access information, navigate workflows, and manage activities throughout the claim process. Our engineers work across a diverse technology landscape, developing modern user experiences, APIs and integrations, data capabilities, and cloud\-based solutions. Our team is at the forefront of exploring, implementing, and supporting automation to improve efficient claim handling. This is an exciting time to join the team as we continue to evolve and modernize our technology landscape. Engineers will have opportunities to contribute to new capabilities, explore emerging technologies, and help shape technical solutions as we transform the claim experience. The work spans existing platforms and next\-generation capabilities, providing opportunities to solve meaningful problems across the full technology stack while applying modern software engineering and DevOps practices. Qualifications: * Modern full\-stack engineering Strong Java/Spring and Angular/TypeScript fundamentals, with the ability to work across APIs, user interfaces, data access, and enterprise integrations. * Cloud\-native delivery and operations Experience with AWS, OpenShift/Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, security controls, production support, and observability using tools such as Dynatrace. * Quality engineering and automation Ability to design and maintain reliable automated testing using tools such as JUnit, Playwright, and Jest, emphasizing regression prevention, maintainability, and dependable CI/CD pipelines. * Data, integration, and workflow design Comfort working with SQL/PostgreSQL, REST APIs, document processing, and complex business rules across interconnected systems. * Emerging AI and developer\-productivity practices Curiosity about how GenAI, coding assistants, retrieval, structured prompting, evaluation, and lightweight agent workflows could improve engineering efficiency, testing, documentation, or user experiences. End\-to\-end AI ownership is not required; the focus is identifying practical, well\-governed opportunities and validating them incrementally. Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $85,000 \- $125,000 * + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!**

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer – AWS & Identity
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. **HYBRID:** Qualified candidates (in or near hub locations listed below) should plan to spend time working from home and some time working in the office as part of our hybrid work environment. **HUB LOCATIONS: Bloomington, IL; Richardson, TX; Tempe, AZ; Dunwoody, GA** **SPONSORSHIP: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.** Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: The Federated Identity Team (FIT) exists to simplify the lives of users and developers by providing an easy, intuitive, and secure login experience — achieving one person, one identity. We own how applications across State Farm onboard to Microsoft Entra ID: app registration, single sign\-on, and choosing the right authentication pattern — client credentials (secrets, certificates, or workload identity) for service\-to\-service, authorization code flow with PKCE for client applications. We build FedHub (the Federation Hub) to do that. FedHub gives application owners a single, straightforward place to manage their Entra applications, and it enforces security controls around application configuration that cannot be enforced through the Entra UI. It also handles permission requests, admin\-consent workflows, and SAML/OIDC/SCIM configuration. The stack is React and TypeScript in the FedHub UI, a GraphQL API (Apollo Server) on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway, DynamoDB for state, and integrations into Microsoft Graph, ServiceNow, and ARTS. We ship through GitLab CI to AWS with infrastructure in Terraform, and we use AI\-assisted development tooling as a normal part of how we build. This is a small team with a large surface area. Individual contributions are highly visible, additional ownership is available immediately to anyone who wants it, and we are specifically looking for someone who wants it.**Responsibilities:*** Design, develop, integrate, deploy, and support enterprise applications across the full software stack. * Own significant portions of the migration from GitLab\-based provisioning to an event\-driven AWS architecture, including the design decisions — not just the implementation. * Build and refine consumer\-friendly interfaces for genuinely complex identity workflows: app registration, SAML and OIDC configuration, claims mapping, SCIM provisioning, permission requests. * Extend the GraphQL API and its integrations into Microsoft Graph and other enterprise systems. * Work within and strengthen our authorization model — Entra delegated tokens, an API Gateway token authorizer, and schema\-directive\-based RBAC with resource\-level ownership enforcement. * Contribute to Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and operational support of what you ship. * Partner directly with application teams across the enterprise, translating their integration needs into product capability. Qualifications: **Key Skills \& Abilities*** A track record of owning work end to end. You can take a loosely defined problem, ask the questions needed to scope it, and drive it into production without being assigned each next step. * Initiative and follow\-through. You notice the gap — the unclear requirement, the flaky test, the undocumented process, the thing nobody owns — and you close it rather than route around it. You see work through to done. * An appetite for more scope. You look for the next hard problem instead of waiting for it to be handed to you, and you are comfortable being accountable for a system running in production. * Ability to navigate and build relationships across multiple teams and levels of the organization. * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. * Ability to foster innovation, encourage diversity of thought, and incorporate new ideas. * Learning agility. Identity is a deep domain; you will not know all of it on day one, and you should be genuinely interested in learning it. * Experience or comfort working in an agile environment. * A strong drive for results. **Technical Competencies Primary Skills*** Design, develop, integrate, deploy, and support enterprise applications. * A track record of being able to deliver complex solutions with consumer friendly interfaces on AWS. * An understanding of State Farm application engineering practices, and either a track record of helping other software engineers improve their craft or a genuine interest in growing into that. * Strong JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals — not just framework familiarity. * Production experience building UIs with a modern component\-based framework, React strongly preferred. * Substantial back\-end experience building and operating server\-side services (Node.js preferred), including API design and working with a database. * Hands\-on AWS experience: Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, IAM, and event\-driven design patterns. This is central to the work ahead. * API development and usage (REST and/or GraphQL). * Automated testing as a normal part of development. * CI/CD experience (GitLab preferred) and comfortable Git\-based collaboration. Preferred Skills Depth in several of these is more valuable than passing familiarity with all of them. * UI frameworks: React — the framework the FedHub UI is built on. * GraphQL specifically — Apollo Client and/or Apollo Server. * Infrastructure as code (Terraform/OpenTofu). * Identity and access management: OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph. * Credential management: workload identity (federated credentials), AWS Secrets Manager. * Logging, tracing, and reporting (Dynatrace, AWS CloudWatch). * MUI or another comprehensive component library used at scale. * Accessibility standards and testing. * Prior experience on a platform team whose users are other engineers. Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $85,000 \- $130,000 * + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!**

jobs.title: AI Business Analyst
jobs.description: We are seeking an Artificial Intelligence Business Analyst to analyze data, develop algorithms, and research emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods. Candidates should have expertise in machine learning, deep learning, predictive modeling, and natural language processing, along with the ability to create AI solutions that support business objectives and improve operations. AI Business Analyst (AI BA) combines traditional business analysis skills with AI expertise to align AI initiatives with organizational goals. This position will act as the bridge between business leaders and technical AI teams, ensuring that AI projects are well scoped, feasible, and impactful. **Summary of Work** * AI Opportunity Identification aligned with business needs \- Discover and prioritize AI use cases that drive business value through workshops, workflow audits, and process analysis. * Requirements Gathering \& Translation \- Collect stakeholder needs, convert them into AI solution specifications, and ensure alignment with business strategy. * Feasibility \& Return on Investment Analysis \- Assess technical viability, cost benefit, and potential return on investment for AI projects. * Data Analysis \& Preparation \- Clean, validate, and prepare datasets for AI models, collaborating with data engineers to address gaps. * Model Selection \& Performance Monitoring \- Work with data scientists to choose appropriate AI models, track Key Performance Indicators (KPI)s, and adjust when performance drifts. * Risk Assessment \- Identify ethical, legal, operational, and security risks before deployment. * Stakeholder Communication \- Translate technical findings into clear business language for executives and non\-technical teams Design, implement, test, and maintain machine\-learning models and AI systems. * Integrate AI models into company platforms and services. * Monitor AI developments and apply relevant technologies. * Collaborate with data engineers, software developers, and IT staff. **Minimum Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a closely related field, plus five or more years of relevant experience; demonstrated experience as a business analyst or in a similar role; and established experience using AI tools. **Preferred Qualifications** * Troubleshoot complex implementation and performance issues. * Understand data structures, data modelling, and software architecture. * Support database and transaction\-management technologies, including deployment and usage standards. * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and contribute effectively to a team. Perform other duties as assigned. * **About Team ND** *"Far and away the best prize life offers is the chance to work hard at work worth doing." \- Theodore Roosevelt* More than 7,500 talented, hard\-working people across sixty\-three agencies have come together as Team North Dakota. At Team ND, we are driven to succeed through gratitude, humility, curiosity and courage. Our purpose is to empower people, improve lives, and inspire success. Join us in being legendary. **Total Rewards:** The State of North Dakota is committed to providing team members with a strong and competitive rewards package that support you, your health and your family. Considering a new position on Team ND? How does your current position stack up? Use our Total Rewards Calculator to estimate. **Application Procedures** Applications will only be accepted online through the ND PeopleSoft System. Application materials must be received by 11:59 PM Central Standard Time (CST) on the closing date. In addition to completing the online application, applicants should upload the following: Resume Cover letter Transcripts Your resume should include information to demonstrate how you meet the minimum qualifications as posted. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer 4
jobs.description: **THE COMPANY:** For over 50 years, Steelastic, based in Cuyahoga Falls, Northeast Ohio, is a leading manufacturer and innovator of specialist capital equipment to service the needs of the global tire industry. We have over 900 systems operating in more than 55 countries around the world. Our customers include all the multinational tire companies, and most of the top independent tire companies in the world. We pride ourselves on being customer focused, market driven with a culture that encourages creative thinking \& innovation. Our team is empowered to be responsible \& proactive in their everyday activities, strive for \& achieve excellence in all aspects. We never compromise on our EHS responsibilities. Great Culture \& Opportunity! **THE PARENT COMPANY:** Heico has a history of success. Since its founding over 40 years ago The Heico Companies has grown from a single business to over 80 separate companies through a strategic acquisition policy, and by reinvesting its earnings into internal growth and new prospects. Historically talented at restoring distressed companies, Heico now strategically targets acquisitions that will complement its ever\-growing portfolio of companies in manufacturing, construction, and industrial services. These four core operations are organized into groups: Metal Processing Group, Construction Solutions Group, Applied Solutions Group, and Industrial Technologies Group. Once acquired, new Heico companies are assigned to a group and run on a stand\-alone basis, allowing for great independence as well as the opportunity to share knowledge about markets, production processes, and management practices across other Heico groups and companies. Each Group has its own corporate team. Heico continues to seek out new opportunities and maintain its standard of success. The Heico Companies has remained a privately held company since its creation and maintains a majority ownership in each of its operations, which generates more than $3\.3 billion dollars in revenues. Many of our businesses are certified Woman\-owned Business Enterprises (WBE). More information about the holding company and overall organization can be found at www.heicocompanies.com (https://nam04\.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url\=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.heicocompanies.com%2F\&data\=05%7C02%7CAFlorman%40steelastic.com%7C011873afdd5d4a642ece08de7f87d1ef%7Cd453a2eceedf4329aaac02c877f3439b%7C0%7C0%7C639088418544614646%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C\&sdata\=8IKeIDjMtbaR%2BIk8NrIIStLLV10SPafJQwHhfsg3unI%3D\&reserved\=0\). **The Position (Summary):** The Mechanical Engineer 4 will perform mechanical machine design engineering duties, product design, product customizations, resolving design and documentation issues, with primary focus on capital equipment associated with the production of pneumatic tire components. * Candidates must be highly proficient in the following (Target 15\-20 years’, strict minimum of 10 years’ experience designing industrial capital equipment): * + Given production requirements in parts per minute or meters/minute, calculate the required machine element velocities/rpms + Sizing, application, and sourcing of industrial machine components, including power transmission (belts, chains, gearboxes, bearings, motors), pneumatics (actuators, valves, piping) + Design of steel and aluminum frameworks, brackets, shafts, rolls, pulleys etc. + Solidworks assembly, part, and drawing generation, as well as, liner static and dynamic analysis (FEA). control device lists, detail drawings, calculation sheets, functional specifications, purchase specifications, installation/operation instructions + Written and oral communication with internal and jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user\-friendly, cost\-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention. Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps \- the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile. **About the Role** We're growing our world\-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a **Principal Engineer, Agentic AI** to join our Core Platform Team Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100\-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architectof a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a **high\-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch**. We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic\-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI\-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today. We're looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are "all in" on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results. **Why Steer?** * **True Ownership:** You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high\-velocity teams. * **Hyper\-Growth \& Vision:** We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space * **Freedom to Innovate:** You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product. * **AI\-First \& Agentic Culture:** We are refactoring our teams to be agentic\-first. We prioritize high\-level problem\-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows. **What You'll Do** * **Technical Strategy \& Ownership:** Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools. * **Architectural Vision:** Lead the design of reusable full\-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance. * **Adaptive Development:** Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless. * **Customer\-Centric Engineering:** Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve. * **Code Excellence:** Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep\-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization. * **Modern DevOps \& Agentic Infrastructure:** Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI\-integrated, agentic\-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows. **What You Have** **Must Have:** * 7\+ years of professional experience building complex, web\-based SaaS products. * **The "All\-In" Mindset:** A deep commitment to Steer's mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast\-paced environment. * **AI \& LLM Integration:** Hands\-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development. * **AI in Production:** Proven experience deploying AI\-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production\-grade infrastructure. * **AI\-Driven CI/CD:** Hands\-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI\-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration). * **Database Expertise:** Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization. * **Exceptional Communication:** The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership. **Nice to Have:** * Familiarity with our current stack: **.NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.** * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). * Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early\-stage startup environment. * Experience building or integrating with **Claude marketplace plugins** (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations. **Interview Process** * **Initial Screen** — 30 min with Lead Recruiter * **Hiring Manager Interview** — 60 min with the Head of Engineering \& Product * **Technical Interview** — 60 min with a Principal Engineer * **Collaborative Interview** — 30 min with Lead Product Manager **What We Offer** * **Equity Options:** Own a piece of the company's success. * **100% Remote:** Work from anywhere in the US. * **100% Employer\-Paid Medical Insurance.** * **Flexible PTO:** With a 15\-day minimum. * **FSA, HSA, and 401k options.** * **Learning Stipend \& WFH Equipment:** Everything you need for a world\-class home office. * **Innovative Culture:** A seat at the table to influence the latest AI technology in a collaborative, agentic\-first environment. **Why Join Steer?** At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence. Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career\-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well\-being. Join Steer to be part of a forward\-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work. We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries. Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

jobs.title: Propulsion Base Software Sr Core Development Engineer
jobs.description: The Propulsion Base Software Core Development Engineer is responsible for contributing to the development of embedded software for EE/core and propulsion control modules. This role involves software requirements analysis, design, development, integration, and validation of base software components. The engineer will actively participate in technical reviews, collaborate across teams and suppliers, and ensure delivery of high\-quality, standards\-compliant software. Experience in low\-level driver development, AUTOSAR\-based systems, and virtualization methodologies is highly desirable. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and integrate embedded low\-level driver software for ICE propulsion and electrified powertrain control modules. * Implement and optimize hardware interface drivers for peripherals such as SPI, I2C, UART, ADCs, timers, PWM, and driver circuits (e.g., HSD/LSD, H\-Bridge). * Contribute to MCAL integration and development of complex device drivers aligned with AUTOSAR architecture. * Analyze software requirements and translate them into scalable design and robust implementation. * Perform hardware\-software integration including interpreting schematics, validating electrical interfaces, and supporting hardware bring\-up. * Debug and resolve complex embedded system issues using tools such as Lauterbach, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. * Optimize embedded software for real\-time performance, deterministic behavior, and efficient memory utilization on multicore microcontrollers. * Collaborate with Base Software Architecture teams to align with AUTOSAR, RTE integration, and system\-level design. * Conduct and participate in reviews of requirements, design documents, source code, and test plans. * Ensure compliance with automotive software standards and processes including MISRA\-C, ASPICE, and ISO 26262\. * Develop and execute software verification strategies including unit, integration, and system\-level validation (white box, black box, gray box). * Support virtualization and simulation\-based development methodologies within the software lifecycle. * Create and maintain technical documentation including design specifications, interface documentation, and test plans. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (systems, hardware, validation, calibration, and suppliers) to ensure seamless integration. * Drive defect resolution, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities. * Support vehicle integration, software bring\-up, and production readiness activities. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field * Minimum 5 years of related experience * Experience with embedded C/C\+\+ software development experience in a real\-time operating system (RTOS) environment. * Experience in Vector/ETAS/AUTOSAR Basic Software configuration (OS, MCAL, IOHWAB, FEE, WDG, etc.). * Hands\-on experience with low\-level driver development and microcontroller\-based systems. * Experience with multicore microprocessors and strong ability to interpret hardware schematics. * Understanding of Functional Safety concepts (ISO 26262\). * Experience with development tools including compilers, emulators, Lauterbach debuggers, and automation scripting. * Experience in software verification and validation including white box, black box, and gray box testing. * Familiarity with automotive software quality standards such as MISRA\-C. * Strong understanding of hardware interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, SENT, ADCs, timers, I/O, and communication peripherals. * Experience with hardware\-software integration and debugging using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills. * Ability to adapt to changing environments with minimal impact on productivity. * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, and ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Computer, or related discipline). * Academic or project experience in programs such as Formula SAE or SAE EcoCar. * Experience with automotive data acquisition and analysis tools such as ETAS, INCA, CANoe, or CANalyzer. * Hands\-on experience with automotive microcontrollers (e.g., Infineon AURIX, NXP, or similar). * Strong understanding of propulsion systems including internal combustion engines, hybrid systems, battery electric vehicles, and vehicle subsystems. * Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering teams. * Exposure to simulation, virtualization, SIL/HIL, or model\-based development environments. * Experience with Electrobit EB tresos Studio MCAL configuration. * Experience with advanced peripherals such as GTM, PWM, high\-speed timers, and ADC synchronization. * Experience supporting hardware bring\-up, early software enablement, and production software delivery. **Our Benefits \- Designed with You in Mind** **Comprehensive Health \& Well\-being Coverage** From your very first day, you'll have access to medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage \- ensuring you and your family stay healthy and protected. **Generous Paid Time Off** We believe in work\-life balance. That's why we offer: 17\+ paid holidays, including shut\-down from December 24th through New Years Day every year. Vacation, float \& wellbeing days, sick time and fully paid parental leave when your family needs you most. **Competitive Retirement Savings Plans** We help you plan for the future with: * An employer match on contributions to your 401k, Roth, and Catch\-Up plans * An employer contribution, even if you don't contribute **Income Protection \& Insurance Options** Benefit from included and optional disability, life, and other insurance programs \- because your peace of mind matters. **Company Vehicle Lease Program** Eligible employees and their immediate families can enjoy company vehicle lease options with included insurance, maintenance, and unlimited mileage. Plus, take advantage of exclusive discounts on Stellantis products. **Family Building Benefit** We proudly support all paths to parenthood\- including fertility and infertility treatments, adoption services, and gestational surrogacy. **Support for Your Growth and Giving Back** We believe in investing in your future and your passions: * Tuition reimbursement * Student loan refinancing programs * 18 paid volunteer hours each year to make a difference in your community **And so much more!** When you join us, you're not just building a career \- you're joining a company that supports you, inside and outside of work.

jobs.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Strategic ACI is seeking a Senior AI Platform Engineer to design, build, deploy, and operate production AI capabilities for NGA on a new Digital Ecosystem program. As a member of the Platform/Cloud team, this individual will develop the reusable services, integrations, agent harnesses, and operational practices that enable large language models (LLMs) and AI agents across the customer’s broader Digital Ecosystem. You will help develop an enterprise architecture digital twin, connecting UAF and SysML models with real\-time and near\-real\-time operational data. These capabilities will enable AI\-assisted analysis, data\-driven insights, and visualizations of enterprise capabilities, dependencies, risks, and mission impacts. The role combines architecture with direct implementation, including writing code, integrating models and tools, building deployment pipelines, evaluating AI performance, and troubleshooting production systems. Working alongside platform engineering, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and mission teams, this individual will turn emerging AI technologies into secure, reliable capabilities that support customer workflows. Salary will be commensurate within the advertised range, based on applicable qualifications. **Responsibilities:** **AI Platform Development:** Design and implement reusable AI services, APIs, components, and reference architectures that support multiple applications and mission workflows across the Digital Ecosystem. **LLM Integration and Engineering:** Build LLM\-enabled capabilities using model APIs, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, and inference services. Evaluate hosted, self\-hosted, and open\-weight models against security, performance, deployment, and cost requirements. **Agent Harnesses and Workflows:** Develop agent harnesses that manage model interactions, context, state, memory, tool access, workflow execution, and error handling. Implement bounded autonomy, human approval, execution limits, and recovery mechanisms for agents interacting with enterprise systems. **Production Deployment and Operations:** Build automated testing and deployment pipelines for AI services and agent workflows. Implement versioning, configuration management, monitoring, rollback, incident troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. Address reliability, latency, resource consumption, and operational cost. **AI Evaluation and Observability:** Develop representative evaluation datasets and automated tests for accuracy, groundedness, task completion, safety, and tool\-use behavior. Instrument AI services to trace model interactions and agent actions, support troubleshooting, and detect performance degradation. **AI Governance and Cybersecurity:** Implement controls for approved models and tools, identity, least\-privilege access, secrets management, sensitive data handling, audit logging, and third\-party dependencies. Address prompt injection, data leakage, insecure tool execution, and AI supply chain risks in coordination with cybersecurity and governance teams. **Enterprise Architecture Digital Twin:** Work with enterprise architects and digital engineering teams to build a digital twin that connects UAF and SysML models with enterprise applications, infrastructure, services, and operational information. Support an evolving view of enterprise capabilities, dependencies, and conditions. **Real\-Time Model Integration:** Build interfaces and event\-driven integrations that associate real\-time and near\-real\-time feeds with UAF and SysML model elements. Apply AI to correlate information, identify changes and inconsistencies, and propose validated model updates while preserving provenance, configuration control, and human oversight. **AI\-Enabled Insights and Visualizations:** Combine architecture models and operational data to identify patterns, anomalies, dependencies, risks, and potential mission impacts. Develop AI\-enabled dashboards, visualizations, natural language interfaces, and analytical services that make findings traceable to supporting information. **Data and Knowledge Integration:** Partner with data engineers and data owners to connect AI services with approved structured and unstructured sources. Implement retrieval, indexing, metadata, provenance, and access\-aware information delivery within established data governance practices. **Digital Ecosystem Integration:** Connect AI services with Digital Engineering, MBSE, modeling, simulation and analysis, software development, and mission workflows through governed APIs and tool interfaces. **Technical Collaboration:** Contribute code, design reviews, documentation, demonstrations, and delivery estimates. Work with customer stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams to prioritize use cases, resolve technical issues, and transition prototypes into supported production capabilities. **Qualifications:****Required:** Active TS clearance, with SCI eligibility ty to troubleshoot issues across AI applications, integrations, and supporting platform services. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with data, platform, cybersecurity, architecture, and mission teams. Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across mission and technical stakeholder groups. **Desired:** Experience operating self\-hosted or open\-weight LLMs, including inference optimization, GPU resource management, and capacity planning. Experience implementing LLMOps or MLOps practices, including model and prompt versioning, automated evaluation, deployment gates, monitoring, and rollback. Experience developing enterprise architecture digital twins or other model\-driven decision\-support capabilities. Familiarity with UAF, SysML v1 or v2, and integration of architecture models with external data, APIs, or analytical tools. Experience applying AI to correlate operational information with model elements, detect changes, or support controlled model maintenance. Experience building AI\-enabled dashboards, visualizations, natural language query interfaces, or analytical applications. Experience with vector search, knowledge graphs, semantic models, or access\-controlled enterprise retrieval. Experience with infrastructure as code, identity federation, secrets management, distributed tracing, and observability platforms. Experience conducting AI security testing, red teaming, or threat modeling for LLM applications and agent workflows. Experience supporting Intelligence Community, defense, or other regulated mission environments. Experience deploying AI capabilities in government cloud, restricted\-network, disconnected, or edge environments. Familiarity with Digital Engineering, MBSE, Digital Twins, or modeling, simulation and analysis workflows. Experience supporting security accreditation, controlled data handling, and evidence\-based compliance. Experience transitioning prototypes or research capabilities into sustained production operations. , About Strategic ACI Strategic ACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It has been and will continue to be a fundamental policy of Strategic ACI not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, partnership status, domestic violence victim status, sexual orientation, age, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, unemployment status or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state and/or local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, training, working conditions, transfer, job assignments, benefits, layoff, and termination.
