Our AI\-native platform helps more people get to “yes” at the moments that matter with personalized offers, transparent terms, and no added consumer fees. In stores, practices and service centers across the country, Sunbit provides a fast, fair pay\-over\-time option. For everything else, the Sunbit Credit Card delivers a modern, no\-fee credit experience managed in a powerful mobile app. We are guided by people\-centered values: Serve Others Before Self, Include Always, Connect Genuinely, Innovate for Good. These values shape how we build, how we support customers and merchants, and how we work with each other. What makes Sunbit different is an AI\-native infrastructure that runs through the full customer and merchant journey. Our interconnected AI systems power instant decisioning, streamline fraud checks with human\-in\-the\-loop safeguards, and enable highly personalized offers at scale. The result is a quick, fair, and simple experience for consumers and merchants. We pair this technology with inclusion and transparency. Sunbit delivers industry\-leading approval rates — 90%\+ in auto service and 85%\+ in dental — while maintaining zero consumer fee\-based revenue. It is a better way to serve people and merchants, proven at scale. Today, Sunbit is available across nationwide, in\-person merchant network of 30,000\+ locations spanning auto service centers, dental and optical practices, veterinary clinics, and other specialty services. We help teams say “yes” more often and help customers move forward with confidence. **The Role:** Sunbit is looking for an experienced, independent Senior DevOps Engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced environment. You will join our centralized DevOps team, serving as a pillar of reliability and innovation for the entire engineering organization. This is a 50/50 "Build vs. Run" role. Splitting your time between building modern automation and improving our developer experience and operational excellence, ensuring our production environments are rock\-solid, secure, and highly available while managing the live environment from server infrastructure all the way to the application. Requirements: **What You'll Own:** * Design and implement next\-generation CI/CD automation flows to streamline the path from "Code" to "Production." * Lead the evolution of our Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform) to make our systems more modular and self\-service for developers. * Collaborate with backend teams to architect scalable microservices and optimize datastore performance (RDS, MongoDB). * Embrace AI\-powered development tools (Cursor, Claude Code) to automate toil and accelerate infrastructure delivery. * Full ownership of our AWS accounts and multi\-cluster Kubernetes environments. * Manage and fine\-tune live production environments, ensuring 99\.9% uptime for our mission\-critical fintech services. * Drive our Observability strategy (Datadog/Grafana) to proactively catch issues before they impact our customers. * Participate in a weekly on\-call rotation, serving as the first line of defense for platform reliability. **What You 'll Bring:** * **5\+ years of experience** managing high\-scale production systems. * **Mastery of AWS:** Deep knowledge of AWS services, security best practices, and account management. * **Orchestration \& Containers:** Expert\-level experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker. * **Automation\-First Mindset:** Proficiency in Terraform and at least one high\-level language (Python, Go, or Bash). * **Database Ops:** Solid understanding of the DevOps aspects of MySQL/RDS and MongoDB (scaling, backups, performance tuning). * **SRE Discipline:** Strong experience with monitoring and logging stacks like Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. * **Team Player:** Strong communication skills and a "can\-do" attitude—you enjoy solving problems as part of a collaborative squad. **Nice to Have:** * **Security Knowledge:** Experience with FW, WAF, IPS/IDS, and SELinux. * **Data Infrastructure:** Familiarity with Data tools like Kafka, Spark, Snowflake or Data Lakes. * **Multi\-Cloud:** Familiarity with hybrid or multi\-cloud architectures. **﻿The Perks:** * Join one of LA’s fastest growing startups (2023\), A Most Loved Workplace, \#576 on the 2023 Inc 5000 list, and Forbes Fintech 50 (2024\) * Mission driven \+ empowered \+ collaborative * Competitive pay and stock options * Unlimited PTO * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, EAP, FSA, \& Parental Leave * Newly added HSA and Pet Insurance * 401K Plan with Matching * Cell Phone Stipend * Casual Dress * Team based strategic planning \+ Team owned deliverables **How We Pay:** * We believe in paying fairly and equitably based on a number of factors including but not limited to previous experience, relevant work history, interview performance, geographical location, internal equity, and expected level of ownership. * We are targeting a salary of $150,000\-195,000 per year for this role * This role will also be granted company equity via stock options *Sunbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to provide a professional \& welcoming workplace for all employees.* *﻿* **Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer** We’ve been made aware of fraudsters impersonating Sunbit employees during the hiring process. Please note that all official communication will come from an @sunbit.com email address, through our applicant tracking platform @sunbit.comeet\-notifications.com or directly via LinkedIn. We will never ask for your age, Social Security number, bank account details, payment of any kind, or other unrelated personal information during the application process. Our hiring process always includes interviews, either by phone, zoom, or in person, before any offer is made. If something feels suspicious, please contact us at hr@sunbit.com to confirm. We ask that you contact hr@sunbit.com only about potential instances of fraud. hr@sunbit.com does not reach our recruiting team directly. Your application directly through the posting is the best way to ensure that your candidacy is reviewed by our team. Due to the volume of applications, we will not respond to nor forward emails about your candidacy that are sent to hr@sunbit.com directly, and your email about your application will be deleted from our systems. \#SunbitHP

agent frameworks or MCP. * Supabase and vector search with pgvector. * n8n or another workflow automation platform. * Salesforce APIs and SOQL; Litify. * Voice AI or telephony (Retell, Twilio, Zoom). * Legal, insurance or healthcare data. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * **First month:** You ship a production improvement to one of our apps. * **90 days:** You own one feature area end to end, with tests, monitoring and a runbook. * **12 months:** Something you built is part of staff's daily routine, with its hours saved measured. **Our Stack** ------------- Python, TypeScript/Node, Next.js/React, Postgres and Supabase with pgvector, Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs, Azure Container Apps and Docker, n8n, MCP, Salesforce/Litify, Microsoft 365 and the Graph API, Zoom, Twilio, Retell, GitHub. **Benefits** ------------ * Benefits package: medical, dental, vision, and life insurance * FSA or HSA option, depending on the selected medical plan * 401(k) with 2% match after 90 days * Paid time off (PTO) policy and paid holidays * Ongoing mentorship, leadership support, and professional development and career advancement opportunities At Sweet James, we don't just offer jobs \- we build careers. Your job will be to own program execution across a portfolio of vision and robotics initiatives, bringing structure and visibility to priorities, schedules, releases, risks and cross\-functional dependencies while enabling engineering leaders to focus on technical delivery. **What we do** The Vision and Robotics team develops the technologies that enable Symbotic's robotic cells to perceive, interact with and manipulate the physical environment. The team works across computer vision, perception, robotics and software while partnering closely with controls, cell hardware and other engineering organizations to turn new capabilities into integrated, deployable solutions. Our work spans new product development, continuous improvement of deployed systems, integration and validation, and the coordination required to introduce new features into customer environments. As Symbotic's installed base and portfolio continue to grow, the team manages an increasing number of parallel initiatives and dependencies across engineering, Customer Success and deployment functions. **What you'll do** * Own end\-to\-end program planning and execution across a portfolio of Vision and Robotics initiatives, including scope, milestones, schedules, dependencies, risks and delivery commitments. * Build and maintain an integrated roadmap across vision, perception, robotics, software, controls and cell hardware workstreams, translating competing priorities into executable plans. * Proactively identify delivery risks, capacity constraints and gaps, driving decisions and escalation before they impact engineering or customer commitments. * Manage engineering execution through Jira, including backlogs, releases, dependencies, issue tracking and program\-health metrics, while continuously improving the processes used to manage work. * Partner with engineering managers and product stakeholders on prioritization, resource needs, change control and schedule trade\-offs, providing clear visibility to leadership. * Coordinate integration, validation and release readiness across development labs, testing environments and customer sites, including demonstrations, acceptance activities and deployment milestones. * Act as a connective point across Engineering, Customer Success, program teams and other stakeholders, ensuring new capabilities and continuous\-improvement work are coordinated from development through real\-world deployment. **What you'll need** * Minimum of 8 years of related experience or equivalent work experience * BS in Engineering, Robotics, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree is a plus. * Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross\-functional technical programs involving robotics, industrial automation, computer vision, perception, sensing, mechatronics, or similarly integrated systems. * Strong understanding of hardware, software, controls, systems integration and product\-development processes, with experience in NPD and/or NPI environments. * Proven ability to develop integrated schedules, manage cross\-team dependencies, assess risk and capacity, and drive scope and priority decisions across multidisciplinary engineering teams. * Hands\-on proficiency with Jira and experience using program plans, dashboards and metrics to provide clear visibility into delivery health; experience with Microsoft Project, PowerPoint and Excel is beneficial. * Strong communication and facilitation skills with the ability to operate autonomously, challenge priorities constructively and drive alignment across engineers, engineering leaders, executives, customers and external partners. **Our Environment** * Up to 20% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. * Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. \#LI\-GJ1 \#LI\-Onsite **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Synapse ITS builds SYO, an intelligent cloud ecosystem that helps cities and DOTs respond to faults faster and keep intersections running safely and efficiently. We're hiring a mid\-level DevOps Engineer to help run, automate and secure the platform behind SYO. You'll work with a distributed engineering team, and you'll play a key part in our SOC 2 compliance work. **Responsibilities:** * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, security scanning and deployment. * Provision and manage cloud infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt or similar). * Operate containerized workloads on Kubernetes or managed container services, including scaling, upgrades and cost tuning. * Set up and improve monitoring, logging, alerting and dashboards so you can track availability, latency and the health of device and data pipelines. * Respond quickly to production support issues and incidents, troubleshoot and fix problems, run root\-cause analysis and write blameless postmortems. * Implement SOC 2 controls, including access management, encryption, patching and audit evidence. * Manage backup, disaster recovery and high\-availability setups, and test them against RTO/RPO targets. * Help developers across time zones with environment setup, release coordination and troubleshooting. * Write and maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams and operational procedures. * Find manual toil and automate it. Requirements: * 3–5 years in DevOps, SRE or cloud infrastructure roles. * Hands\-on production experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP). * Strong skills with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Terragrunt. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE or self\-managed). * Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or Jenkins. * Scripting skills in Bash and Python, Go or PowerShell. * Solid Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, load balancing, VPC/VNet) and Git fundamentals. * Experience with observability tools such as Google Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging and Grafana. * Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working asynchronously with a distributed team. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar compliance programs. * Exposure to IoT, edge devices or real\-time data streaming (MQTT, Kafka, Pub/Sub). * Familiarity with GitOps (Argo CD, Flux) and Helm. * Background in traffic, smart city or mission\-critical systems. **What Success Looks (First 6\-12 Months):** * Deployments are fully automated with a documented rollback path. * Monitoring covers SYO's critical services, with actionable alerts and fewer false pages. * You own a defined set of SOC 2 controls and their evidence collection. * Incident response time and deployment frequency both improve measurably.

jobs.title: PMR Production Engineer
jobs.description: Synthomer is a leading supplier of high\-performance, highly specialised polymers and ingredients that play vital roles in key sectors such as coatings, construction, adhesives, and health and protection – growing markets that serve billions of end users worldwide. Headquartered in London, UK and publicly listed there since 1971, we employ c.3,500 employees across our 5 innovation centres of excellence and more than 28 manufacturing sites across Europe, North America and Asia. Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products. At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low\-carbon economy. **Job Description** The **Production Engineer** is accountable for the support of manufacturing units at Synthomer Jefferson Site, located in Jefferson Hills, PA (approximately 15 miles south of Pittsburgh, PA). The Production Engineer will also provide technical support as needed to assist in maintaining safe and reliable manufacturing operations. **Job Description:** * Primary job function to provide day\-to\-day support to manufacturing units to ensure safe, stable and reliable operations. * Additional Responsibilities Include: + Monitoring operating data for assigned areas and provide analyses and troubleshooting as needed to achieve the operating plan. + Identify and implement improvements to support business objectives (debottlenecking, plant trials, improved reliability) using the Management of Change process. + Develop and review procedures and provide operator training as needed. + Lead incident investigations into process and equipment failures as appropriate. + Serve as the Division Representative on capital projects to improve productivity and increase capacity in the manufacturing department. + Conduct Process Hazard Analyses and coordinate timely resolution plans to meet project deadlines. + Interface with HSES, Product Development, Maintenance, Process Improvement, and other supporting organizations to prioritize and initiate projects. **Qualifications:** * B. S. in Chemical Engineering * 2 \- 5 years of chemical engineering/relevant experience * Must be comfortable in a manufacturing environment with large, continuous chemical processing equipment * Must have the ability to easily interface with operations and maintenance personnel and lead cross\-functional teams * Must have good troubleshooting skills to analyze process data, understand equipment operations and determine root causes of failures * Experience with any of the following systems would be an advantage: + Distributed Control systems + PI Vision + Statistical Analysis tools + Lean Manufacturing/Six Sigma **Global Benefits Overview** * **Competitive,** market\-aligned compensation * **Discretionary** global bonus scheme * **Discretionary** Long\-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) – for senior positions * **Company** car or car allowance – varies by region and role * **Healthcare** – tailored to regional locations * **Parental leave and family support** – maternity, paternity, adoption (aligned with regional policies) * **Working options** – flexibility where it matters, based on role and business needs * **Learning \& development opportunities** – training, online platforms, buddy/mentorship programs, Internal Synthomer University with L\&D offers * **Wellbeing support** – employee assistance program (EAP), mental health resources, wellbeing initiatives * **Retirement / pension contributions** – plans vary by country * **Culture of Inclusion** – where everyone can thrive * **Performance culture,** global reward \& recognition programmes

As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi\-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. deployment, observability, and production support. * Design agentic workflows using orchestration, tool integration, retrieval\-based systems, structured outputs, context management, and appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to take control of complex or ambiguous problems, evaluate alternative approaches, and translate needs into scalable AI solutions. * Lead technical workstreams from rapid experimentation and validation through production adoption. * Establish evaluation and testing approaches for non\-deterministic AI systems, including quality metrics, regression testing, failure analysis, and production monitoring. * Make informed engineering trade\-offs across models, prompts, context, tools, latency, cost, reliability, security, and maintainability. * Contribute to reusable AI capabilities and shared engineering patterns that improve speed, quality, and consistency across teams. * Lead code and design reviews, mentor less\-experienced engineers, and help others solve complex technical problems. * Own technical debt and continuously improve the quality, reliability, and maintainability of the jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer [Tooling]
jobs.description: **AI Infrastructure Engineer \[Tooling]** ========================================= **About Tessera Labs** Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises adopt and operationalize Artificial Intelligence. Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world\-class founding team, we build multi\-agent AI systems that automate complex business workflows across platforms like SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, Databricks, and more. Our mission is simple but ambitious: bring real AI automation to the enterprise — with speed, precision, and measurable impact. We move fast, operate with extreme ownership, and build at the frontier of applied AI. **About the Team** ------------------ The AI Platform team builds and operates the foundational infrastructure that lets Tessera's multi\-agent systems run reliably, securely, and consistently across customer environments. That spans the portable cloud foundation (Kubernetes, networking, automation) and the AI\-specific layer on top of it: model serving, agent runtimes, evaluation and release tooling, and the internal CLIs and services our engineers use every day. The work directly enables us to onboard and operate enterprise customers under strict security and compliance constraints while preserving developer velocity. It reduces integration risk, standardizes operations across hyperscalers, and makes sure product teams can ship AI features safely without infrastructure becoming a bottleneck. **The Role** ------------ As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you'll design, build, and own the tooling and services that take Tessera's AI agents from a developer's laptop to production in customer clouds. You'll write real software in Python or Go — CLIs, controllers, and internal services — and run it on Kubernetes alongside LLM serving stacks like vLLM. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer, Reuters
jobs.description: **Job Description** Own the web delivery layer that keeps Reuters’ content platform available, fast, and easy to configure for customers around the world. You will provision and maintain origin and CDN infrastructure, define the reliability targets that protect the platform, and automate the manual work that slows launches and incident response. This is a hands\-on role at the center of how one of the world’s most trusted news organizations reaches billions of people every day. Reuters employs over 2,700 journalists across nearly 200 locations and delivers real\-time text, images, and video in more than 20 languages. jobs.title: AI Assurance Engineer - MLE Focus
jobs.description: San Jose Regular R\&D \- Security Job ID: A43043A to this job Responsibilities About the Team Detection Engineering is part of Content Assurance and is aligned with USDS JV Security \& Privacy. The team provides product\-independent technical assurance for recommender and generative AI systems, testing whether system behavior remains within declared safety, quality, and governance boundaries before and after release. AI Assurance Engineering builds and operates shared evaluation infrastructure, including test harnesses, benchmark pipelines, replay systems, adversarial\-testing tools, safety\-metric telemetry, and assurance CI/CD. The team is independent from the product teams whose models it evaluates. About the Role As an AI Assurance Engineer, you will design rigorous evaluation methods and production\-quality capabilities for measuring and diagnosing recommender and generative AI behavior. You will develop benchmark datasets, define reproducible test protocols, implement safety, quality, robustness, and drift metrics, and investigate behavioral regressions through adversarial testing and counterfactual replay. This role focuses on evaluation engineering and technical assurance, not product model training, policy setting, moderation, or release ownership. Responsibilities \- Evaluation Methods and Benchmarks: Define reproducible protocols, benchmark suites, sampling strategies, datasets, and statistical analyses for recommender and generative AI evaluations. \- Behavioral Testing and Diagnosis: Test safety, ranking quality, consistency, adversarial robustness, refusal behavior, leakage, factuality within scope, drift, and regressions. \- Evaluation Platforms and Signals: Implement evaluation code, metrics, replay workflows, and assurance signals on shared infrastructure while preserving traceability and repeatability. \- Design Evaluation Methodologies: Define measurable evaluation objectives, metrics, sampling plans, baselines, acceptance criteria, and reproducible protocols for pre\-release and post\-release assurance of recommender and generative AI systems. \- Engineer Benchmark Datasets: Curate, version, document, and quality\-check benchmark and adversarial datasets, including harm\-exposure samples, ranking\-quality cases, jailbreak prompts, leakage tests, and counterfactual replay inputs. \- Implement Behavioral Tests: Build evaluation code for recommender objectives and GenAI behavior, including safety\-category coverage, ranking quality, fairness and consistency, refusal correctness, factuality within scope, adversarial robustness, provenance signals, and drift detection. \- Diagnose Evaluation Results: Apply statistical and experimental rigor to distinguish model\-behavior regressions from data, sampling, or infrastructure effects; analyze post\-release drift against release\-time baselines and produce traceable technical findings. \- Contribute Production\-Quality Platforms: Integrate benchmarks, metrics, replay tests, and red\-team assets with shared evaluation runtimes and assurance CI/CD; improve reproducibility, telemetry quality, and failure diagnosis without assuming ownership of the underlying platform methodology validation. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: \- Education: Bachelor degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. \- Machine Learning Evaluation: Experience evaluating machine learning systems with clearly defined metrics, datasets, baselines, and reproducible test protocols. \- Software Engineering: Experience developing production\-quality evaluation or data\-processing software in Python, Go, C\+\+, or a comparable language. \- Statistical and Experimental Rigor: Strong knowledge of sampling, hypothesis testing, uncertainty, experiment design, error analysis, and regression diagnosis. Preferred Qualifications: \- Recommender\-System Evaluation: Experience with ranking metrics, counterfactual replay, harm\-exposure sampling, cohort consistency, or ranking\-quality benchmarks. \- Generative AI Evaluation: Experience evaluating refusal behavior, jailbreak resistance, leakage, factuality within scope, provenance, or multimodal generative systems. \- Adversarial and Robustness Testing: Experience designing red\-team tests, adversarial datasets, robustness analyses, or continuous post\-release evaluations. \- Evaluation Infrastructure: Experience integrating benchmarks and metrics with test harnesses, replay pipelines, experiment systems, or CI/CD workflows. \- Cross\-Functional Assurance: Ability to communicate evidence, limitations, and technical findings clearly to product engineering, Trust \& Safety, business owners, and governance partners while maintaining ownership boundaries. observability frameworks, libraries and deployment templates for engineering teams * Establish monitoring\-as\-code, alerting\-as\-code and dashboard\-as\-code standards * Design service\-level indicators (SLIs), service\-level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets in partnership with product and engineering teams * Ensure monitoring coverage for cloud, on\-prem, containerized and hybrid environments * Implement distributed tracing and log correlation to enable end\-to\-end transaction visibility * Define observability and tracing standards for AI\-enabled applications, copilots and improvements following major incidents * Develop platform governance standards for monitoring, alerting thresholds, and on\-call best practices * Ensure observability is tightly integrated with CMDB preferred * Skills \& Abilities + Ability to demonstrate success implementing monitoring, logging, and tracing at scale across complex environments + Deep expertise with Datadog and SolarWinds monitoring platforms + Strong experience designing observability for cloud, hybrid and on\-prem environments (Azure, Kubernetes, VMs) + Expertise in logging platforms, APM, distributed tracing and databases, model gateways and tool\-based integrations + Experience with OpenTelemetry or comparable instrumentation standards and the ability to apply trace context across AI, application, API and infrastructure dependencies + Understanding of AI observability concepts including prompt and model versioning, token and cost analysis, latency decomposition, quality evaluation, drift detection, jobs.description: At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. We collaborate closely with colleagues at universities, national labs, and global Toyota. Together, we develop capabilities designed for real\-world impact in both Toyota’s industrial applications and open research more broadly. **The Opportunity** We are looking for a postdoctoral AI Fellow to define an original research direction in model post\-training, using materials discovery as a real\-world testbed. This appointment is anticipated to be for one year, with an option to extend another year by mutual agreement. You will take ownership of problem framing through validation and play a leading role in shaping the research as it evolves. No materials background is required, only the curiosity to learn from domain experts and uncover where AI can make a meaningful difference. The fellowship is also intended to include an academic co\-mentor in AI, with the specific collaboration developed with you after you join TRI, subject to institutional arrangements. committed workforce and provides an excellent benefits program that includes** : Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Flexible Work Schedules including compressed work week and (LTD), Short Term Disability (STD), Employee Assistant Program (EAP) and Paid Leave Benefits. **Senior AI Engineer** Hiring Salary Range: $125,000\-$161,000 **AI Engineer III** Hiring Salary Range: opportunities, including value, effort, data readiness, and risk. * Set stakeholder expectations, communicate progress and results, and make sure delivered solutions are adopted and achieve their intended outcomes. * Lead end\-to\-end delivery of AI solutions across multiple teams and projects, from discovery and design through build, deployment, adoption, and ongoing operation. * Lead the design of advanced AI and analytical solutions for high\-value utility use cases, such as load and renewable forecasting, asset health and predictive maintenance, wildfire and outage risk, and grid operations support. * Coordinate engineering work across teams and with data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business partners to deliver solutions on time and as designed. * Measure and report the business outcomes of delivered solutions, and drive improvements based on results and user feedback. * Define reference architectures, design patterns, and the technical roadmap for AI and machine learning solutions. * Architect AI platforms and shared services across cloud and on\-premises environments, including model hosting, agent infrastructure, retrieval services, evaluation, and observability. * Lead technology and vendor evaluations, build\-versus\-buy analysis, and platform recommendations, including on\-premises AI infrastructure needs. * Determine where AI workloads run and reproducibility. * Define AI engineering standards, including LLMOps and MLOps practices, evaluation frameworks, release gates, security patterns, and production readiness criteria. * Review the technical designs of high\-risk, operationally adjacent, and enterprise\-wide AI solutions. * Lead resolution of critical AI production issues, and drive post\-incident reviews and lasting im meworks (including golden test sets, LLM\-as\-judge, and red\-teaming), observability, and AI cost management. * Deep understanding of AI security, privacy, and risk, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, IT/OT segmentation, and model supply\-chain risk. * Strong working knowledge of AI governance and risk management frameworks, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001\. * Expert Python and software engineering skills, with the ability to prototype hands\-on and review code and designs across teams. * Strong business acumen and stakeholder management skills, including discovery facilitation, problem framing, business case development, and value measurement. * Ability to lead and align multiple teams and stakeholders through influence, technical credibility, and clear direction. * Exceptional written and verbal communication, including executive briefings, solution proposals, and presentations to non\-technical audiences. Other: * Regional travel may be required by up to 10% as needed. Tri\-State is a wholesale power supply cooperative, operating on a not\-for\-profit basis, with electric distribution cooperatives and public power district members in four states: Colorado, Nebraska, New Mexico and Wyoming. Founded in 1952 by its member systems to provide a reliable, cost\-based supply of electricity, Tri\-State is now headquartered in Westminster, Colo., employing approximately 1,000 people across five states. jobs.description: True Zero Technologies, a veteran\-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero is seeking an experienced AI/ML Cybersecurity Specialist to support the security assessment, operational testing, and protection of artificial intelligence and machine learning systems within a federal environment. This role will focus on identifying vulnerabilities in AI/ML applications, conducting adversarial testing, evaluating security risks, and developing defensive strategies to strengthen the organization's cybersecurity posture. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in cybersecurity, hands\-on experience with AI/ML security testing, and the ability to communicate technical findings and actionable recommendations to federal stakeholders. ### **Job Responsibilities** * Conduct Operational Testing and Evaluation (OT\&E) of AI/ML applications, models, and supporting infrastructure to identify security vulnerabilities, operational risks, and potential attack vectors. * Perform adversarial AI/ML security assessments, including model evasion, data poisoning, model extraction, adversarial manipulation, and model inversion testing. * Evaluate existing cybersecurity defenses and identify weaknesses that could be exploited through AI\-enabled attacks, recommending appropriate mitigation strategies and security controls. * Design, implement, and evaluate defensive security measures to protect AI/ML models, training data, inference pipelines, and deployed applications against emerging threats. * Develop detailed technical assessment reports documenting vulnerabilities, testing methodologies, risk severity, and actionable remediation recommendations. * Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), security testing plans, threat models, and repeatable methodologies for AI/ML security evaluations. * Collaborate with cybersecurity engineers, AI/ML developers, technical leads, and federal stakeholders to integrate security best practices throughout the AI/ML development and deployment lifecycle. * Ensure AI/ML security assessments, testing procedures, and defensive implementations align with DHS, CBP, NIST, and applicable federal cybersecurity policies and standards. ### **Job Qualifications** * Demonstrated experience in cybersecurity engineering, security assessments, or penetration testing, with a strong focus on AI/ML security, adversarial machine learning, and model evaluation. * Strong understanding of AI/ML architectures, machine learning algorithms, large language models (LLMs), model training pipelines, and secure deployment practices. * Hands\-on experience identifying and evaluating AI\-specific security vulnerabilities, including prompt injection, adversarial examples, data poisoning, model extraction, model inversion, and evasion attacks. * Experience conducting penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, red teaming, or Operational Testing and Evaluation (OT\&E) of software applications, AI/ML models, or supporting infrastructure. * Proficiency with Python and familiarity with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn, along with security testing tools and adversarial assessment methodologies. * Knowledge of federal cybersecurity requirements and security frameworks, including NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), NIST SP 800\-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and applicable DHS/CBP security policies. * Experience developing technical assessment reports, threat models, security testing methodologies, remediation recommendations, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings and security recommendations to federal stakeholders, engineering teams, and technical leadership. We’re actively searching for talented security and technology practitioners who are ready to experience the True Zero difference. As a True Zero team member, you'll enjoy: * Competitive salary, paid twice per month * Best in class medical coverage * 100% of medical premiums covered by True Zero * Company wide new business incentive programs * Contribution Incentives (i.e. white papers, blog posts, internal webinars, etc.) * 3 weeks of PTO starting \+ 11 Paid Holidays Annually * 401k Program with 100% company match on the first 4% * Monthly reimbursement of Cell Phone and Home Internet costs * Paternity/Maternity Leave * Investment in training and certifications to broaden and deepen your technical skills We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: Head of Hardware Engineering
jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe robots should be the next chapter in making physical labor safer and more affordable. But, nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t have a single robot. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. We build robots that go straight into real factories and warehouses, to do real work, with real impact. Our robot Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Our robot Sonny does handwork, using two arms to achieve human\-like dexterity in picking and packing. Every robot learns on the job, and each one we deploy makes the next one more capable, more affordable, and faster to put to work. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, we do it all in\-house: the robotics hardware, the machine learning, and the field deployment and service. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. **Why Tutor?** Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable. Our team of 160\+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in. **The Role** Tutor is hiring a Head of Hardware Engineering to lead the team that designs and builds our robots. Mechanical, electrical, firmware and embedded, and manufacturing engineering all report to this role. You set the hardware roadmap with the CTO, you grow the team, and you are responsible for every robot we ship working as designed and building at the rate we need. You report to the CTO. The hardware organization will grow a lot, in people and in the range of products it covers. The person in this role builds the teams that make that happen, hires the people who lead them, and keeps the whole thing running well as it gets bigger. ### **Requirements** * You have led and grown a hardware engineering organization to 50 or more people, and shipped a complex electromechanical product in volume through it * You have led mechanical, electrical, and firmware or embedded engineers, and can hire and judge all three * You have owned manufacturing engineering, or worked closely enough with it to build that team: process, test, fixtures, and design for manufacturing * You have developed the managers who lead teams under you * You have worked closely with a technical founder or CTO ### **Nice to haves** * Robotics, actuators, or motion control * Leading engineers in more than one country * Taking a product from first prototype to production at rate * Working with contract manufacturers and overseas suppliers ### **Benefits** * **Fully employer\-covered health insurance**, so you’re protected without the premium. * **A managed 401(k)** to help you plan for the future. * **Generous time off:** unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full\-time salaried employees, and 16\+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1\.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees. * **Regular in\-office meals** and team social events throughout the year. **About Our Roles \& Titles** Everyone in our R\&D organization, including the people who lead it, holds the title Member of Technical Staff (MoTS). Our job postings use standard titles so you can find us. If you join Tutor, you'll be a MoTS who runs hardware engineering. Head of Hardware Engineering is how you'll be known outside the company, because building the team means being legible to the people you're recruiting. In an ideal world everyone here would simply be a MoTS; external titles exist only where the outside world needs them. **Compensation** The base salary range for this role is $250,000 to $350,000, depending on experience. As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond. *Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.*

jobs.title: Head of Quality
jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi\-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end\-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. ### **The Role** Our Watertown factory is ramping Cassie from 30 to 80\+ robots a month and launching Sonny V2 production in 2027\. We're hiring our first Head of Quality to build the function from the ground up. You'll report to our CTO as a peer to the Heads of Manufacturing and Supply Chain, with the authority to hold any shipment that isn't right. This is a builder role. There's no incoming inspection or formal quality system yet. You'll lead root cause yourself at first, then grow a small team around you. ### **What You'll Own** * **Production quality:** incoming, in\-process and final quality gates, first\-pass yield, and ship\-hold authority * **Field reliability:** RMA, failure analysis, FRACAS and the weekly MRB, with MTBF targets set alongside Engineering * **Supplier quality:** audits, PPAP and SCARs across our US and Asia supply base, plus qualifying second sources * **Quality system:** document control, CAPA, product safety certifications (UL/CSA/CE) and ISO 9001 readiness * **Data and tools:** quality data on our MES (ION) and internal platform (Atlas) that every team trusts * **Your team:** hire a Quality \& Reliability Engineer, US and Asia supplier quality engineers, and a quality systems specialist ### **Your First Year** * Zero escapes through the Cassie ramp to 80\+ robots a month * A launch quality plan ready for Sonny V2's ramp to 18 robots a day * Every field failure traced to a root cause and a verified fix * Second\-source suppliers qualified for drives, PCBAs, robot arms and castings ### **What You Bring** * BS or higher in engineering * 8\+ years in hardware quality, including 3\+ leading quality engineers * You've built a quality function or QMS where none existed * You've personally led 8D/RCA to closure on electromechanical hardware * Supplier quality at scale, including suppliers in Asia * A background in robotics, EV/battery/automotive, or capital equipment * The judgment to stop a shipment, and the relationships to keep teams moving * You manage by data. Bonus if you've built tools other people use. ### **Nice to Have** * Lithium battery safety and transport (UN 38\.3\) * Product safety certification experience (UL/CSA/CE) * ASQ CQE/CRE or Six Sigma Black Belt * Mandarin, or direct work with Chinese suppliers * MES/PLM experience (ION, Arena or similar) Plus equity. Exempt, full\-time, on\-site in Watertown, MA, with about 25% travel. **Why Tutor?** Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable. Our team of 160\+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Fleet Reliability
jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe robots should be the next chapter in making physical labor safer and more affordable. But, nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t have a single robot. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. We build robots that go straight into real factories and warehouses, to do real work, with real impact. Our robot Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Our robot Sonny does handwork, using two arms to achieve human\-like dexterity in picking and packing. Every robot learns on the job, and each one we deploy makes the next one more capable, more affordable, and faster to put to work. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, we do it all in\-house: the robotics hardware, the machine learning, and the field deployment and service. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. **Why Tutor?** Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable. Our team of 160\+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in. **The Role** Tutor Intelligence robots run production on customer floors across North America. The fleet is growing faster than the tools behind it. This role exists to fix that by building. The job is to find the parts of the operation that are held together with tape and replace them with something that works. Each project starts with a problem and very little else: no spec, no existing tool, no one to hand the work to. The person in this seat figures out what should exist, builds the first version, puts it in front of the people who need it, and keeps improving it until it runs on its own. Then it's on to the next one. The role reports to the Head of Robot Operations and Reliability. **What the work looks like** Most of what it takes to run a much larger fleet hasn't been built yet. This role builds it. That means looking at how the operation runs today, finding where it breaks or slows down, and building what should be there instead. The work is tools, data, and the way the work itself gets done. The work will keep changing as the fleet grows. What stays the same is the job itself: see the problem, build the fix, put it to use, and keep improving it until it runs on its own. **The hard failures** Some robot failures don't make sense at first. A sensor tests fine on the bench and fails on the floor. A robot runs clean for three weeks and then stops every afternoon at 2:00\. This role leads those investigations. That means pulling logs, reading field reports and parts history, talking to the technician who was there, building a theory, testing it, and staying with it until the cause is found and the fix holds. **Who this is for** Someone who asks why a problem happened, not just how to make it stop, and who looks for the structure behind it: the process, the data, or the handoff that let it happen. Someone who, after watching a team struggle with the same problem twice, has already sketched a fix that keeps it from happening a third time, and built the first version. Someone who would rather own a result than report on one. This can be an early\-career role for someone with clear momentum, or a step up for someone five or more years in who is done reporting on problems they could have fixed. Either way, someone who learns fast, gets noticeably better every quarter, and wants the job to grow with the fleet. ### **Projects on the list** * A training system that gives a field technician real\-time instructions on the robot in front of them, built from what the fleet has already learned about that failure. * Issue tracking that joins robot telemetry to what the technician saw on the floor, so an investigation goes from symptom to root cause and the fix can be checked across the fleet. * Predictive tooling that flags a robot likely to fail before it does, from telemetry and parts history. * Capacity planning for a regional network of technicians: where they should be based, how many, and how fast they need to reach a robot. * The reliability data itself: what gets captured, how it connects, and which numbers are worth tracking. ### **How the work gets done** * Code is a daily tool here, and so are AI agents. Build systems where agents pull the data, run the checks, and draft the write\-ups, so the work runs without a person in the loop. * Ship a rough first version early, put it in front of real users, and improve it from what they say. * Work side by side with engineering, customer success and field technicians. Much of the best input comes from the people closest to the robots. * When something finally works, write it down so the next person can run it without asking. ### **Required** * 2–7 years as a technical program manager, industrial engineer, or engineer, or in operations or a similar technical role. * A track record of building. At least one system, tool or program designed from scratch and put into real use, with a result that can be stated in numbers. * Comfortable building software with AI coding tools and agents, or ready to pick it up fast. The language matters less than having shipped something that works. * Clear thinking, and the ability to turn data into a clean picture that others can act on. * Clear writing for engineers, customers and leadership. * A degree in engineering or a technical field, or equivalent experience. ### **Stands out** * Has started something at a past job that didn't exist before, and it's still running. * Experience in robotics, automation, manufacturing, logistics or fulfillment. * Builds outside of work too: side projects, a home lab, something made just to see if it could be done. ### **Probably not the right fit for someone who** * Prefers a clear task list and regular check\-ins. * Would rather maintain an existing system than build a new one. * Wants the same week, every week. ### **Why join** * Few places hand one person this much ownership of how a fleet runs. * What gets built here becomes how a robotics company runs its fleet. * The role grows as the fleet grows. ### **Benefits** * **Fully employer\-covered health insurance**, so you’re protected without the premium. * **A managed 401(k)** to help you plan for the future. * **Generous time off:** unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full\-time salaried employees, and 16\+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1\.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees. * **Regular in\-office meals** and team social events throughout the year. **Compensation** The base salary range for this role is $100,000 to $140,000, depending on experience. **Location and travel** In office in Watertown, MA. Travel to customer sites and regional teams as needed, roughly 10–25%. **To apply** Along with a résumé, send a short note about something you built: what the problem was, what you made, and what happened after. Links, photos and code are all welcome. As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond. *Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.*

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer 2
jobs.description: **See yourself at Twilio** Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory. **About the job** This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves. You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first\-class part of the work. **Responsibilities** In this role, you’ll: * Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets. * Own the retrieval path that answers "what do we know about this person?" in milliseconds, working with embeddings, vector search, and ranking * Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships. * Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces. * Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria. **Qualifications** Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! **Required:** * Experience building backend services, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages, frameworks, and tools as the problem demands. * A curious approach to service management: ability to investigate how systems actually behave in production, and desire to continuously learn how to operate them with rigor and accountability. * Experience building or working with evaluation/quality\-measurement systems, such as regression detection or quality metrics, or the desire to learn. * Solid grounding in observability practices: structured logging, metrics, and using them to debug distributed systems in production. * Fluency with AI\-assisted dev tools (e.g. agents for code generation, review, debugging), applied with deliberate direction and critical thinking. **Desired:** * Experience with Go and/or Python. * Experience with event\-streaming systems (e.g. Kafka). * Experience building LLM\-backed products. * Practical experience applying ML, e.g. building, evaluating, or productionizing models. **Location** * This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas. **Travel** We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in\-person meetings. **What We Offer** Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. **Compensation** * *Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.* The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: * Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $128,560 \- $160,700 * Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $136,000 \- $170,000\. * This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. **Application deadline information** Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 13, but may change based on business needs.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Our client runs the compliant system of record you build on to move, store, and grow money. Launch financial products your customers love. We provide the financial primitives, licenses, and compliance, and our forward deployed team gets you live in two weeks. Under the hood, fiat and blockchain run as one system. Their customers never see any of it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there. **The Role** Our customers don't just call our APIs. They build their products on us. Their balances, their payment operations, their compliance state. Which means our business succeeds exactly as far as theirs do. Forward Deployed Engineering is the team that makes that true, one customer at a time. You'll report to our CTO and embed with one strategic customer at a time, the enterprises building their products where we're investing deepest. You'll understand their business, their constraints, and their pain points better than anyone, and then you'll build what their launch needs. Here's a concrete example. A global payouts customer is expanding into a new market where we don't yet have local account infrastructure. You scope the requirements with their engineering team, then build the virtual account infrastructure, in our core codebase, that their launch depends on. When it ships, it's not a one\-off. It becomes a core product that we sell to the next ten customers. That's the defining property of this role. This is not a services role, and it's not technical support. You're a product engineer whose roadmap comes from a live customer instead of a planning doc. Everything you build lands in the core platform, and the best of it becomes product the whole company resells. Engagements are scoped at contract time. You're delivering what we've committed to, not absorbing unbounded requests. But within that scope, the what, the why, and the how are yours to figure out with the customer. **What You'll Do** * **Deploy into customer contexts.** Iterate daily with your customer's engineering and operations teams, mostly over Zoom and Slack, with some travel to spend real time on site. * **Scope the build with the customer.** You're not handed a spec. You work out what to build and why with the customer directly, paired with a deployment strategist who owns the commercial side. * **Build across the full stack.** TypeScript and React, NestJS with Postgres and Prisma, and AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambda). New account infrastructure, blockchain integrations, API endpoints, compliance workflows, whatever the launch requires. * **Generalize the bespoke.** Identify patterns across implementations and work with product to turn engagement output into first\-class platform features. * **Prototype fast, ship carefully.** Rapid iteration against live customer workflows, accepting some throwaway work and making sure what isn't throwaway gets productized properly, all while debugging production issues in real time, sometimes with the customer watching. * **Design for correctness and auditability.** This is money\-movement infrastructure. Edge cases have real consequences, and you think about failure modes before they happen. * **Communicate crisply** with customer engineers, operators, founders, and finance leaders, and with our own product leads, whose pods your work must generalize into. **Who You Are** * **You're a builder first.** We're flexible on tenure. We'll hire a scrappy engineer straight out of school or a seasoned customer\-facing engineer. We're not flexible on the bar. You ship production\-grade, full\-stack work, and you have something you've built to prove it. * **You're AI\-native.** Agentic tools are how you already build, and we'll ask you to show us. * **You're energized by customers, not shielded from them.** You're comfortable operating directly with an enterprise engineering team, under ambiguity, where the requirements are yours to discover. * **You're obsessed with correctness and resilience.** You love a good state machine. You think carefully about what happens when things go wrong, because with money they can't. * **Strong pluses.** Payments and fintech infrastructure experience, blockchain and stablecoin integration work, and a forward\-deployed or solutions architect background where you *built* rather than just configured. **What Success Looks Like** * Your customer launches on time, on our rails, and their volume ramps because what you built works. * The infrastructure you shipped for one customer is now core product being sold to the next ten. * Your customer's engineering team treats you as one of their own, and our team trusts what you merge. * You've defined, alongside our CTO, what "forward deployed" means. * You're an early member of a function we're building the company around. **How We Work** We run on three principles: * **2% better, every day.** One percent for yourself, one percent for the people around you. * **Telos.** From the Greek word telos, meaning not just done but fulfilled. Everyone here is focused on one mission and knows each other's Telos. * **Build.** Embody the builder's mindset. Make things, solve problems, and have fun doing it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there. **The Role** You'll be joining a lean, high\-intensity engineering team at an inflection point, processing billions in volume today. You'll work directly with our CTO, contributing full\-stack from week one. **1\. Building Infrastructure That Moves Money** You'll work on the core systems that power global payments. State machines, transaction pipelines, reconciliation flows. Accuracy is non\-negotiable when money is on the line, but so is the ability to build systems that adapt as the financial landscape evolves. You'll own features end\-to\-end, think carefully about failure modes, and write code you're proud to put your name on. **2\. Shaping the Product** You're not just implementing tickets. You'll collaborate closely with our CTO, BD team, and directly with customers to evolve our API and platform, making complex financial flows feel intuitive for the developers and businesses building on top of us. If you see a better way to build something, you'll say so. If a tradeoff matters, you'll surface it. We want engineers who think like owners. **3\. Setting the Bar** As an early engineering hire, you'll have an outsized influence on how we build. The patterns we establish, the standards we hold, the culture we cultivate. We believe quality engineering lives at the intersection of theory and experimentation. Think rigorously, ship decisively. You move fluidly between frontend and backend depending on what the problem requires. You care about design and have high standards for what you ship. Not just whether it works, but whether it feels right. You're **built for startups.** You know what it means to operate in an environment with high ambiguity and real stakes. You move fast, make good decisions under uncertainty, and find energy in the challenge rather than frustration in the chaos. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI & Business Platforms
jobs.description: Do you want to build the system a whole company runs on, not one more feature in someone else’s product? Do you use AI coding tools every day, and still read every line before it ships? Would you rather spend an hour watching how a warehouse actually works than a week guessing from a requirements document? United Material Handling (UMH) is looking for a Principal Software Engineer, AI \& Business Platforms to take technical ownership of UMH\-os, our internal operating system, and UMH Connect, our distributor partner portal. The foundation is already in place: Azure infrastructure, single sign\-on, CI/CD, a design system, an approved catalog of applications across ten departments, and a written blueprint. Our CEO has been building much of it himself with Claude Code. Now we need a professional engineer to own it, build it out, and run it. You will work directly with the CEO, ship to production in your first two weeks, and build AI agents that produce real proposals for real distributors. **KEEP READING IF:** **YOU ARE A BUILDER WHO SHIPS.** You measure progress in working software that people use, not in plans. You like small, frequent releases, and you can take a feature from a conversation on the warehouse floor to production in days. When you inherit code, you assess before you rewrite, fix what is fragile, and leave alone what works. **YOU ARE SERIOUS ABOUT AI IN PRODUCTION.** You have put LLM agents into production, not just demos, and you know the hard part is evaluation, logging and guardrails, especially when an agent is putting prices on a proposal. You treat AI coding tools as power tools, not authors, and you can explain every line in production no matter who or what wrote it. **YOU ARE THE ENGINEER THE BUSINESS TRUSTS.** You can sit with a buyer, a warehouse lead or the CFO, figure out what they actually do, write it down in plain English and get their sign\-off before you build. You push back with a reason and an alternative, and once a decision is made, you commit. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES MAY INCLUDE:** **In the first 30 to 60 days and ongoing:** * Learns the business: tours our Corona headquarters and Moreno Valley distribution center and sits with Sales Operations, Supply Chain, Operations and Finance to see how work gets done. * Reads the UMH\-os codebase, standards and blueprint end to end, and delivers a written assessment of what to strengthen first. * Ships a first production change within two weeks and takes ownership of the deployment pipeline. * Agrees a clear working split with our IT Administrator, who owns accounts, devices and user support. **By the third month and ongoing:** * Reviews and approves every change to UMH\-os and UMH Connect before production, including work from AI tools and outside partners. * Takes a major new application, starting with Order Management, from specification to daily use. * Tightens the engineering standards so AI\-written code comes out consistent the first time. * Becomes the technical owner of our outside development partners. **By the sixth month and ongoing:** * Runs one shared agent runtime for both platforms, with evaluation, logging and guardrails. * Launches UMH Connect with pilot distributors, including a proposal agent and a proposal check agent. * Connects Fellow, Dialpad and Microsoft 365 activity to Salesforce so customer records stay current automatically. * Recruits and leads a small nearshore engineering team if the work calls for it. **By the twelfth month and ongoing:** * Brings order management into UMH\-os, with job costing, WIP and field time capture under way. * Documents the platform well enough that a new engineer ships within two weeks of joining. * Plans the next stage of our ERP roadmap with the CEO. **EDUCATION, SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE:** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering, including 3\+ years leading or architecting production business applications, required * Expert TypeScript, React and Node.js, required * Microsoft Azure (App Service, Azure SQL, Entra ID) and GitHub Actions CI/CD, required * Relational data modeling and SQL for operational workflows, required * LLM agents or tool\-calling features shipped to production (Claude, Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry; MCP or similar), required * Integrations with Salesforce, Microsoft Graph and an ERP, required * Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, required * Application security fundamentals, including securing an external portal, required * Experience as one of a small number of engineers owning a platform end to end, required * Microsoft Dynamics NAV or Business Central experience, preferred * Salesforce platform development, preferred * Manufacturing, distribution or logistics experience, preferred * Experience leading remote or nearshore engineers, a plus * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience **WHO WE ARE:** United Material Handling is a pallet rack manufacturer, distributor and warehouse automation integrator headquartered in Corona, California, with a distribution center in Moreno Valley. We serve customers through three channels: direct storage solutions, resellers and distributors, and automation integrators. We are growing fast, and we are building our own systems to scale with us. **THIS OPPORTUNITY WILL OFFER THE RIGHT INDIVIDUAL:** * The chance to architect the operating system of a growing company: orders, projects, supply chain, finance approvals, hiring, budgeting and a partner portal, all on one platform. * Real AI work on a modern stack, connected to a live CRM, ERP and CPQ, with leadership that uses these tools daily and invests in them. * A direct line to the CEO, decisions in days rather than quarters, and work the whole company sees. * A growth path to leading a small team and the platform as it scales. This is a full\-time, hybrid position based in Corona, California, with two to three days per week on site and the rest remote. Occasional visits to our Moreno Valley distribution center are part of the job. Travel beyond that is limited, at up to 10 percent. **OUR HIRING PROCESS:** We use a structured process: a screen with Employee Experience, an interview with the hiring manager, a hands\-on work sample using our real codebase and AI tools, and a final conversation with leadership. The work sample takes about three hours and needs no preparation.

échelle. **Ce que vous ferez** * Travailler au sein d’une équipe agile afin de concevoir et de développer des fonctionnalités et des Workflow dans l’éditeur Unity qui prennent en charge ces de la conception et de la mise en œuvre d’ensembles de fonctionnalités évolutifs dans une base de code multithread de grande envergure. * Des compétences en diagnostic, en débogage et en profilage des performances. **Vous avez peut\-être également** * Une compréhension approfondie de C\# et des environnements d’exécution gérés. * Une connaissance des méthodes de rendu 3D en temps réel et des API graphiques modernes, y compris Vulkan. * Une approche méthodique de la recherche et du développement de solutions d’optimisation novatrices. * Une passion pour l’avenir des jeux vidéo ou des jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a new team delivering Unity platform support for a key platform partner bringing games to TV and mobile form factors. To reach every screen, we will be leveraging both streaming from Linux in the cloud and Web browser builds to be instantly loadable. The team’s goals include delivering stable platform support, realizing developer workflows for Unity users to unlock the unique features of this platform, and leading optimization initiatives to enable Unity to be efficient on the widest possible array of target devices. You have probably worked on performance\-critical, cross\-platform applications in the past and you know the importance of writing fast, portable and scalable code. You may also be familiar with real\-time, browser\-based application development using technologies such as HTML5, WebGL/WebGPU, WebAssembly/Emscripten; and/or Linux application technologies such as SDL, Wayland, Linux desktop. **What you’ll be doing** * Working as part of an agile team, to design and develop features and workflows in the Unity Editor to support these specific platform configurations. * In collaboration with Unity R\&D teams around the world, profile and optimize WebGPU/WebAssembly performance — tackling load times, memory management, and the unique constraints of a browser\-hosted Unity runtime. * Ensure a stable platform by investigating and resolving bug reports * Strengthen quality and delivery through automated testing and thoughtful code reviews — while fostering a culture of innovation, teamwork, and technical excellence. **What we’re looking for** * **Strong C\+\+ in a large production codebase.** Modern C\+\+, in performance\-critical systems where memory, threading, and cache behavior are things you reason about deliberately. * **Meaningful WebAssembly experience.** Emscripten in the browser is the most direct path, but we're open: Rust compiled to Wasm counts, and so does Wasm outside the browser — server\-side compute, Node, edge runtimes, or work on the runtimes and toolchain themselves.
