jobs.title: Associate Professor or Professor and Inaugural Director, planned School of Applied Engineering
jobs.description: Associate Professor or Professor and Inaugural Director, planned School of Applied Engineering \| Job Details Associate Professor or Professor and Inaugural Director, planned School of Applied Engineering Posting Category: **Summary:** The University of Illinois Springfield invites applications for the inaugural Director of the planned School of Applied Engineering. The position is a tenure\-system appointment at the rank of Associate or Full Professor, with the potential for a tenure waiver. The Director will provide academic, strategic, and operational leadership for a new School launching a Bachelor of Applied Science in Engineering Technology through a work\-based learning model. The Director will build the School's academic systems, faculty, employer and community college partnerships, and pathway to ABET accreditation. The is a nine\-month appointment with an administrative stipend for year\-round director responsibilities. Anticipated start date is July 1, 2027, with an earlier start date negotiable. This is a full\-time on\-campus tenure\-track academic appointment. UIS tenure\-system faculty are expected to be available and engaged in the university community, with assigned professional responsibilities for teaching, scholarship, and service. *Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.* **Duties \& Responsibilities:** **Teaching:** One to two upper\-division Engineering Technology courses per year. **Scholarship**: Scholarship in engineering education, work\-based learning, or applied engineering, consistent with tenure\-system expectations at rank. **Service:** Service as inaugural Director and Unit Executive Officer (UEO) of the planned School of Applied Engineering. This includes leading faculty recruitment and onboarding, working with industry and community college partners, leading accreditation planning, and taking part in College and University leadership as appropriate. **Minimum Qualifications:** Earned doctorate in engineering, engineering education, engineering technology, or a closely related field; Record of teaching, scholarship, and service sufficient for tenure at the rank of Associate or Full Professor; Significant applied or professional engineering experience appropriate for engineering technology programs; Demonstrated academic or organizational leadership experience (e.g., program director, department chair, center director, or comparable role); Experience with curriculum development and academic assessment; Ability to build and sustain partnerships with employers and external stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications:** Experience launching new academic programs or academic units; Experience with work\-based learning, cooperative education, or experiential learning models; Familiarity with ABET accreditation standards; Experience working with community colleges and transfer pathways. **Application deadline:** 1/4/2027 $135\-165,000 nine\-month salary plus administrative stipend for year\-round director responsibilities. **Application instructions:** Click the "Apply Now" button at the top or bottom of the posting, create or update your profile, complete the online application, and upload current curriculum vita or resume, cover letter addressing the required and preferred qualifications, leadership philosophy, and interest in this founding role; and a concept paper (2–3 pages): the candidate’s approach to launching the BAS in Engineering Technology through a work\-based learning model at a public regional university, addressing program design, the ABET ETAC pathway, employer and community college partnerships, and enrollment. Contact information for professional references will be requested later in the search process. Formal review of applications will begin soon after application deadline and continue until the position is filled or the search is terminated. **About UIS:** Located in the state capital, the University of Illinois Springfield is one of three members of the University of Illinois system. The University serves approximately 4,000 students in 60 undergraduate programs of study, 41 minors, 44 graduate programs of study, 1 doctorate, 43 graduate certificates, coursework that leads to 8 ISBE endorsements. The academic curriculum offers students a strong liberal arts core, a wide range of professional programs, and close faculty interaction. Making the most of its location in the state capital, UIS is broadly engaged in public policy and service. Its diverse student body includes traditional, non\-traditional, and international students. Twenty\-five percent of majors are in 17 undergraduate and graduate online degree programs and the campus has received several national awards for its implementation of online learning. UIS faculty are committed teachers, active scholars, and professionals in service to society. The University emphasizes excellence in teaching, and faculty are also expected to provide a balance of scholarship and service activities to meet requirements for tenure and promotion. You are encouraged to visit the university web page at https://www.uis.edu and the college web page at https://uis.edu/chst **About Springfield, Illinois:** https://www.uis.edu/academic\-affairs/about\-our\-springfield\-community/ The University of Illinois System is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer dedicated to building a community of excellence, equity, and diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment and we welcome applications from qualified individuals of all backgrounds and identities. The University of Illinois System does not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on their real or perceived race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, order of protection status, genetic information, marital status, disability, sexual orientation including gender identity, unfavorable discharge from the military or status as a protected veteran and will comply with all federal and state nondiscrimination, equal opportunity and affirmative action laws, orders and regulations. Visit University of Illinois Non\-Discrimination Statement The University of Illinois System conducts background checks on all job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent offer of employment. Convictions are not a bar to employment. Background checks will be performed in compliance with state and federal law. The University of Illinois System requires candidates selected for hire to disclose any documented finding of sexual misconduct or sexual harassment and to authorize inquiries to current and former employers regarding findings of sexual misconduct or sexual harassment. For more information, visit Policy on Consideration of Sexual Misconduct in Prior Employment. As a qualifying federal contractor, the University of Illinois System uses E\-Verify to verify employment eligibility. The University of Illinois offers a very competitive benefits portfolio. Click for a complete list of Employee Benefits. **Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.** UIS employment in this role is not covered by Social Security, and instead, is covered by the State Universities Retirement System * You do not pay Social Security taxes and your earnings will not be on your Social Security record. (Your record will, however, show your Medicare wages.) * Your pension from the State Universities Retirement System may affect the amount of your: * Social Security benefit and * Social Security benefit as a spouse Applicants with disabilities are encouraged to apply and may request a reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act (2008\) to complete the application and/or interview process. Requests may be submitted by contacting UIS HR at hremployment@uis.edu or call 217\-206\-6652\. **\*\*\*Please Note: All postings close at 5:00pm CST on the posting close date.\*\*\***

jobs.title: UI/Accessibility Expert - Front-End Tech Lead
jobs.description: The client requires a dedicated Front\-End Tech Lead to support and lead the development of Staff MIUI screens within IWD. This is a senior, lead\-level role with responsibility for technical direction, engineering standards, accessibility compliance, and CI/CD improvement. The position combines expert\-level front\-end engineering with formal accessibility certification, and provides both hands\-on development and team leadership. **Key Responsibilities** Serve as technical lead for the front\-end codebase (Angular, SASS, HTML), setting architecture, direction, and coding standards. Develop, review, and maintain high\-quality front\-end code for Staff MIUI screens. Implement and enforce the U.S. Web Design System and client Design System across the project. Own accessibility strategy and ensure compliance with WCAG 2\.2 AA, Section 508, Title I, and Title II requirements. Perform accessibility validation using automated testing tools, screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver), and manual keyboard/tabbing navigation. Lead code reviews, design reviews, and mentor front\-end developers. Improve and maintain front\-end CI/CD processes and pipelines. Identify architectural gaps and define the front\-end technical roadmap. Collaborate with Java backend teams to integrate APIs and services (no Java development required). Produce technical documentation, decision records, and process documentation. Apply secure development practices aligned with government security and sensitive data handling requirements. **Required Qualifications** Proven experience as a Front\-End Tech Lead or senior\-level front\-end engineer. Expert knowledge of Angular, SASS, HTML. Experience implementing a design system; USWDS experience strongly preferred. Formal accessibility certification (CPACC, WAS, or equivalent). Hands\-on accessibility testing experience using automated tools, screen readers, and manual navigation. Strong understanding of CI/CD and front\-end deployment workflows. Ability to work effectively with Java backend teams. Demonstrated leadership skills, mentoring ability, and experience driving engineering best practices. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including documentation. Understanding of government security and sensitive data handling requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with Section 508 and Title I/Title II accessibility compliance. with Vue.js (and typescript). * **Deep practical experience** designing, deploying, and maintaining applications using serverless architectures (preferably AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and managed services). * **Proficiency** with SQL, preferably PostgreSQL. * **Solid understanding** of event sourcing and event\-driven architecture patterns, including experience with message brokers or streaming services (e.g., SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or Kinesis). * **Experience** with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * **Demonstrated Fluency in AI\-Assisted Development**: Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, hands\-on experience using AI\-powered coding tools to achieve specific, quantifiable productivity gains, while also clearly understanding and mitigating the associated risks (e.g., code quality, security, IP concerns). **Nice to Have** ---------------- * **Experience** with advanced AWS services (e.g., Step Functions, Kinesis, SageMaker). * **Experience** working in a regulated or compliance\-focused environment. * **A Bachelor's or Master's degree** in Computer Science or a related technical field. **AI and the Evolution of Software Engineering \& Ops** ======================================================= All candidates must be prepared to discuss and demonstrate the following during the interview jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: AI Solutions Engineers are the hands of the AI program. You embed beside a business team, understand their work deeply, and rewire it with AI — then hand the result over and measure the win. This is not a help desk and not a build queue: you're an elite generalist deployed to the highest\-value friction in the company, owning problems end\-to\-end, from discovery sessions to the working solution to the story of what it saved. Primary Job Duties 1\.Discover \& record. Embed with a team, shadow and record how the work actually gets done, and find the high\-volume, high\-friction, rules\-heavy workflows worth rewiring. 2\.Define the SOP before AI. Make the current process explicit — you can't improve what you haven't written down. 3\.Engineer the AI\-driven SOP — human\-in\-the\-loop. Redesign the workflow around AI, keeping review and approval checkpoints wherever judgment, risk, or client trust require them. AI drafts; humans own. 4\.Build the assets. Turn the redesign into reusable capability — prompts, playbooks, harness workflows, automations (n8n / ChatGPT / Claude / agentic tooling), and small bespoke apps or integrations. You'll be able to work with developers as complex scenarios arise. 5\.Capture the win. Help employees log board\-grade wins in the AI Wins Tracker, convert their hurdles into wins, and package repeatable patterns into the shared playbook / prompt library for other teams. 6\.Clear the path. Partner with IT, security, and infrastructure on access, connectors, and permissions; escalate recurring blockers into infrastructure and policy asks. 7\.Create the moments people remember. Notice the task someone dreads and build the thing that makes it disappear — the tailored touch that produces trust and success. 8\.Business \& Customer workflows — operations across TFS, Class Action, Restructuring, and customer\-facing teams: document and case work, claims, proposals, correspondence, support. 9\.Internal \& Technical workflows — automation, reporting, data plumbing, and agentic development /QA enablement for the technical teams. Ø Hands\-on fluency with modern AI assistants — ChatGPT and Claude (Desktop / Code / agentic modes) — used daily to get real work done, not just demoed. Ø Prompt engineering — you can design, test, and iterate prompts and reusable prompt libraries that hold up in production, and you understand context, tools, and where models fail. Ø Workflow automation fluency (n8n / Zapier / similar) — you can build working automations end\-to\-end, including multi\-step flows, triggers, and API calls. Ø Working with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, wire systems together with Ø REST/webhooks/auth, and move data between tools without hand\-holding. Ø Light scripting / building — comfortable enough in C\#, SQL \& JavaScript (or a low\-code equivalent) to build small apps, scripts, and glue, and to read code others wrote. Ø Process mapping — you can sit with a team, extract how the work really happens, and write a clear SOP before you touch AI. Ø Data literacy — spreadsheets, structured data, and basic SQL; you can quantify a before/after and defend the number.

jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description: **Job Description** **ABOUT VICTAULIC** Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. This role is responsible for strengthening Agile ways of working, improving delivery predictability, enabling scalable Agile practices, and helping teams deliver measurable business value through modern product\-oriented delivery. As a Scrum Master, you will serve as a servant leader, Agile coach, transformation partner, and delivery facilitator for one or more cross\-functional Agile teams. You will work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Engineering Leaders, Business Analysts, Architects, QA, DevOps, Security, PMO partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to establish healthy team operating rhythms, improve backlog readiness, remove impediments, manage dependencies, and foster a culture of accountability, transparency, psychological safety, and continuous learning. The role is expected to help establish repeatable standards for Scrum ceremonies, Kanban flow, team working agreements, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, estimation, sprint planning, dependency management, Agile metrics, retrospective improvement actions, and scaled delivery practices as the organization continues to mature toward enterprise Agile and product\-centric ways of working. **WHAT YOU'LL BUILD \& OWN** * Serve as Scrum Master for one or more cross\-functional Agile teams delivering enterprise software, digital products, ERP modernization, cloud transformation, data, AI, automation, or technology modernization initiatives. * Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, Sprint Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement while ensuring events remain focused, productive, and aligned with Agile principles. * Coach teams to become self\-organizing, cross\-functional, collaborative, accountable, and focused on sustainable delivery practices. * Remove organizational, process, technical, and dependency\-related impediments that impact delivery commitments, team flow, or business outcomes. * Protect teams from unnecessary disruption, unclear priorities, and avoidable scope changes while maintaining transparency with stakeholders. * Establish newly formed Agile teams by defining team norms, working agreements, operating models, ceremonies, roles, responsibilities, and collaboration practices. * Assess Agile maturity and implement tailored coaching strategies that improve team performance, delivery predictability, collaboration, estimation accuracy, and team health. * Mentor teams transitioning from Waterfall or hybrid delivery approaches to Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and product\-centric delivery practices. * Coach Product Owners on backlog management, prioritization, user story refinement, acceptance criteria, stakeholder engagement, and value\-driven planning. * Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Delivery Leaders, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, Architecture, Security, PMO partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to improve Agile execution across multiple teams. * Guide teams in establishing effective Definition of Ready and Definition of Done standards t ing, negotiation, relationship building, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills. * Demonstrated servant leadership, organizational influence, coaching and mentoring ability, conflict resolution, emotional intelligence, consensus building, and change leadership. * Ability to balance standardization and flexibility so Agile practices remain consistent enough to scale while adaptable enough to fit each team’s context. * Self\-motivated, collaborative, adaptable, empathetic, accountable, and customer\-focused, with the ability to work independently while influencing across teams and leadership levels. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, Organizational Leadership, Project Management, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered. * Ability to travel as needed to support stakeholder engagement, team workshops, Agile transformation events, PI planning, delivery alignment, and enterprise modernization initiatives. **WHAT SETS YOU APART** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, Organizational Leadership, Project Management, or a related discipline. * Certifications such as Certified Scrum Master, Advanced Certified Scrum Master, Certified Scrum Professional – Scrum Master, Professional Scrum Master I, II, or III, SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Advanced Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist, SAFe Release Train Engineer, SAFe Lean Portfolio Manager, PMI\-ACP, PMP, ICAgile Agile Coaching, ICAgile Enterprise Agile Coaching, Lean Six Sigma, or Prosci Change Management Certification. **WHAT WE OFFER** **Build A Better Career** * Competitive compensation with performance\-based incentives * Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within * Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities **Build A Better Future** * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings plans with company match * Life insurance and disability coverage **Build A Better You** * Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable * Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources * Inclusive, team\-oriented culture where people look out for one another **Build A Better World** Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day. **IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP** Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H\-1B, TN, or other work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the applicable country on a full\-time basis without the need for employer\-sponsored immigration support now or in the future. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status. (Background checks may be required as part of our pre\-employment process). **VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY** All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non\-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non\-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process. **Let's Build a Better World Together.** victaulic.com/careers

jobs.title: WordPress Developer: Landing Pages & Testing
jobs.description: **Title: WordPress Developer: Landing PagesTesting** **Location:** Remote **Type:** Contract (freelance). 3\-month initial term, renewable. **Pay Range:** $40\-45 per hour Most meat in this country is raised far from the people eating it, by systems designed so nobody asks too many questions. Walden exists because we think the questions are worth asking \- and good answers should be available to anyone willing to look. We deliver 100% grass\-fed, pasture\-raised meat to 23,000\+ member families across New England and New York. Every cut is traceable to one of over 35 named farms on the East Coast. The farmers are paid 3x above commodity prices. The animals live on pasture as long as seasons allow \- no antibiotics, no hormones, no feedlots. We send our beef to an independent lab in Massachusetts and publish how nutrient\-rich it is compared to grocery store meat. The output is delicious meat that members love. We're a Certified B Corp and a small but mighty team. The work is demanding, the standards are high, and the people here chose it because they'd rather build something honest and enduring than something that just looks good on a label. Walden is seeking a hands\-on freelance WordPress developer to build the landing pages behind our creator programs and paid campaigns, and to run the A/B tests that make them convert better. **What You'll Do** Our Marketing Director of Acquisition decides what to test and why. You make it real: fast, clean, on brand, and tracked properly so the results can be trusted. This is a hands\-on build role. If you like seeing your work go live within days and watching the numbers move, you'll enjoy it. * Turn briefs, and sometimes AI\-generated drafts, into responsive, accessible, on\-brand pages using custom HTML and CSS where our theme and page builder fall short. * Collaborate on A/B test variants from the Director of Acquisition's test plans, without slowing pages down or causing content to flicker on load. * Build and maintain a small library of reusable page sections that marketing can rearrange and edit on their own. * Connect the dots between rough wireframes and finished pages, making smart visual decisions where our design library falls short. * Tag every page you ship correctly: Mixpanel and GA4 events, ad pixels, UTM parameters, and promo codes that carry through to checkout. * QA every page across mobile and desktop browsers before it goes live. * Keep a running log of what we tested and what won, written so it doesn't depend on WordPress. **How we work together** * Every request comes from the Director of Acquisition with a written brief. * Turnaround targets: a net\-new page within about a week, a test variant within 2 business days * You build and test on staging. Our Systems team approves new plugins and production changes outside the agreed list. * Walden owns all code, templates and documentation you create. **What You'll Bring** ===================== **Non\-negotiables** * Solid HTML and CSS, including responsive layouts. * Hands\-on WordPress experience: block patterns, custom fields, and working within a theme and page builder. * Working knowledge of GA4 and analytics tagging. * A portfolio, class projects, or personal sites that show your HTML/CSS work. Recent graduates are welcome if your portfolio shows the skills above. * Comfort using AI tools, and the judgment to check and fix what they produce. * Pride in finished work. You care that a page loads fast, looks right on a small phone, and fires every event it should. * Speed without sloppiness. You can manage several page requests at once and say early when a deadline is at risk. **Bonus points** * Experience with Google Tag Manager and Mixpanel. * A sharp eye for design detail and for staying consistent with an established brand. * You've built or run A/B tests on landing pages. * You care where your food comes from and would like to help more people eat meat from farms they can name. You don't need to check every box. Nobody here did. What matters is whether you do thoughtful work, tell the truth when it's easier not to, and care enough about the details to get them right when no one's watching. **What We Offer** ================= * Remote work. * A 3\-month initial project, paid hourly against an agreed estimate, with more work available for the right fit. * A direct line to the Director of Acquisition, written briefs, and clear turnaround targets. * Work that goes live within days, on a site where scaled paid traffic makes the results measurable. **When You Join Walden...** =========================== The work you'll do is in support of Walden's mission. We focus on sourcing meat from East Coast farms who do it right, delivering it to families who care, and holding ourselves to standards most companies would find inconvenient. We sweat the details because our members notice. We need people who'd rather get it right than get it done fast. Who can handle the truth that regenerative agriculture is hard, the margins are real, and the shortcuts don't exist here. If that sounds like more fun than it sounds like work, we should talk. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We don't just tolerate differences in race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status \- we thrive on them.

jobs.title: AI & Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse’s mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace. ### **About the role:** As a Manager, AI \& Software Engineering you will lead the AI \& Software Engineering team within Data \& AI, made up of AI/software engineers and UI/UX designers. The team designs production\-grade AI applications (including standalone bertha™), agent\-based workflows, Technology Bricks and user interfaces for Westinghouse and its customers. You will deliver the team's AI and software commitments and for developing the team. You will report to the Director, AI Delivery and work a hybrid/mobile role based in Cranberry, PA. ### **Key Responsibilities:** **AI application and agent engineering:** Develop and deliver AI applications and agent\-based workflows, including business logic, orchestration, integrations and user interfaces. Ensure commitments are delivered on time, on budget and to the required quality. **Estimation and prioritization support**: Prepare estimates, scope assumptions and capability needs for potential new developments and commercial projects. Data \& AI leadership prioritizes the portfolio and support proposals and customer commitments. **Code quality, security and maintainability:** Ensure code quality, application security, application\-level monitoring and reliability. Produce the technical documentation required for maintainability and governance, and improve findings. **Human–AI experience**: Define and apply UX and interaction guidelines so that AI solutions give users safe experiences. **Collaboration with AI \& Data Infrastructure:** Work with the leadership of the AI \& Data Infrastructure teams to build applications within the approved architecture, platforms, AI models, data architecture and deployment environments owned by those teams. Contribute application requirements and feedback, and raise application\-driven architecture and technology needs to them. Architecture decisions remain with those teams. **Engineering standards**: Apply the common AI Software Development Lifecycle (AI SDLC) across the team, including code review, CI/CD, test automation, documentation and Definition of Done. Ensure work uses the approved technology stack and follow the exception process, and that the team applies secure\-by\-design practices and Westinghouse software quality requirements. **Innovation Process**: Provide the engineering inputs and deliverables required for Technology Bricks and AI projects managed under the Westinghouse Innovation Process and Stage Gate Reviews (BMS\-RT\-3\). **Team capacity and growth:** Plan team capacity against the prioritized portfolio, and propose and manage engineer assignments within Data \& AI capacity governance. Scale the team as demand grows by defining hiring needs, leading recruitment and onboarding, and engaging contractors and third\-party companies when needed, while keeping critical knowledge and intellectual property within Westinghouse. **People leadership and development:** Lead the team, overseeing goal setting, performance management, recognition and succession. Mentor team members through coaching, mentoring, career plans and upskilling or reskilling in AI engineering, so that software engineers grow into AI engineering roles. ### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Engineering or a related discipline required. Master's degree with a focus on AI/ML helpful * 8\+ years in software engineering, including at least 3 years delivering AI, ML or GenAI solutions to production. 3\+ years leading engineering teams, including hiring and growing teams. * Azure or Google Cloud certifications helpful **Generative AI**: LLM integration, RAG and GraphRAG, agentic AI frameworks, tool use and MCP\-based integrations, prompt and context engineering, and AI evaluation. **Machine learning:** Understanding of ML models and how to integrate and consume them within applications. **Software engineering**: Python, APIs, front\-end and back\-end development (e.g., React/MUI), UX design (e.g., Figma), Docker and containers, and CI/CD. Data: working knowledge of databases and data platforms, including MongoDB, Databricks and lakehouse architectures. We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. The base salary range for this position, which is dependent upon experience, qualifications and skills, is estimated to be $130,400 to $163,000 per year. \#LI\-Hybrid **Why Westinghouse?** **Our benefits package is tailored to meet the diverse needs of our employees, while also promoting wellness and career growth. The following are representative of what we offer:** * Comprehensive Medical benefits which could include medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage and Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions options * Wellness Programs designed to support employees in maintaining their health and well\-being including Employee Assistance Program providing support for our employees and their household members * 401(k) with Company Match Contributions to support employees' retirement * Paid Vacations and Company Holidays * Opportunities for Flexible Work Arrangements to promote work\-life balance * Educational Reimbursement and Comprehensive Career Programs to help employees grow in their careers * Global Recognition and Service Programs to celebrate employee accomplishments and service * Employee Referral Program **Westinghouse Electric Company is the global nuclear energy industry's first choice for safe, clean, and efficient energy solutions. We enable our delivery of this vision by living our value system:** * Safety and Quality * Integrity and Trust * Customer Focus and Innovation * Speed and Passion to Win * Teamwork and Accountability **While our Global Headquarters are located in Cranberry Township, PA, we have over 11,000 employees working at locations in 19 different countries. You can learn more by visiting** http://www.westinghousenuclear.com. Westinghouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Westlake offers you the potential to enrich your work life and career experience in an entrepreneurial environment. We work together to enhance peoples' lives through our products and presence in the communities in which we operate.** We are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to help drive automation strategy and execution across our building products manufacturing operations. In this role, you will execute automation projects from concept through commissioning, improve plant safety and performance, and partner cross\-functionally with engineering, operations, IT, and manufacturing teams to implement practical, high\-impact solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced engineer who thrives in a hands\-on manufacturing environment and wants to make a meaningful impact across multiple sites. Westlake Royal Building Products offers a broad range of exterior siding and trim solutions designed for beauty, durability, and low maintenance. Our innovative vinyl, composite, and specialty materials support residential and commercial construction across diverse styles and climates. We promote a culture centered on innovation, collaboration, and growth. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * + Lead automation projects from concept and design through installation, commissioning, and startup. + Develop solutions that improve safety, reliability, productivity, and operational efficiency. + Partner with engineering, manufacturing, IT, and project teams to identify automation and AI opportunities. + Manage scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder communication. + Perform feasibility studies and technical assessments to support sound engineering decisions. + Troubleshoot complex issues and provide post\-implementation support. + Provide technical guidance and training to plant teams. + Collaborate with production teams to identify and implement process improvements through automation. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * + Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. + 10\+ years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment. + 5\+ years of experience in automation, capital project management, engineering design, and equipment integration. + Hands\-on knowledge of PLC/HMI programming, ladder logic, and industrial robotics such as FANUC, ABB, or KUKA. + Strong project leadership, troubleshooting, and communication skills. + Experience with project planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk assessment, and technical documentation. + AutoCAD experience is a plus. **Why Join Us** --------------- This is an opportunity to take on visible, high\-impact work in a hands\-on manufacturing environment. You’ll partner with cross\-functional teams, help shape automation strategy across multiple sites, and play a key role in driving meaningful operational improvement. **Work Environment \& Travel** ------------------------------ This role includes both office and plant\-floor work. Travel is expected approximately 40–50%, and candidates should be comfortable working in an industrial environment and using required PPE. If you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges and leading impactful automation projects, we encourage you to apply. **Competitive Pay \& Benefits** * Benefits effective day one. * Medical, dental, and vision coverage. * 401(k) with company match. * Annual retirement contribution. * Life and AD\&D insurance. * Paid vacation. * Tuition assistance program. * Fitness reimbursement program. * Career growth and advancement opportunities. This opportunity will give you experience in the infrastructure sector in the United States with a company that is a globally recognized leader in power generation, water/wastewater, and telecommunications infrastructure — and one of the most established names in EPC project delivery, with a history spanning over 100 years. **LOCATION** Overland Park, KS 66112 **COMPENSATION** $85\-$93 full benefits offered **SCHEDULE** Monday\- Friday (40 hrs per week) **CONTRACT TERM** 6 month long contract with high likelihood of extension or conversion to a full\-time employee **POSITION OVERVIEW – Senior Electrical Engineer, Data Center VI** The Senior Electrical Engineer leads the detailed electrical design of large\-scale hyperscale data center projects (40 MW\+). They work directly with top data center clients to recommend design options that meet each client’s resiliency and redundancy requirements. The role uses AutoCAD, Revit, and BIM to develop and review drawings, calculations, and medium\-voltage (13\.8 kV\+) layouts, and makes sure projects follow codes and stay on scope, budget, and schedule. The engineer also mentors and supervises junior engineers and designers in a fast\-paced, client\-facing environment. **KEY RESPONSIBILTIES** * Lead efforts to deliver detailed design of large\-scale data center environments while following all company, client and project design; may involve leading teams dedicated to these design. * Lead and communicate design options with clients. Articulate and provide recommendations that align with client’s resiliency and redundancy requirements. * Work closely with engineering project teams and field personnel to complete and review projects on scope, budget and schedule. Incorporate schedules, budgets and project criteria into physical design and layouts. * Possess a willingness to function in multiple job roles simultaneously. * Provide guidance and insight into design risk factors for redundancy and resiliency. * Conducts field surveys, drawings, and other data to assess conditions of existing facilities and develop summary reports. * Prepare and/or review technical drawings to ensure that installations and designs conform to standards and customer requirements. * Review drawing and modeling production work, including problem analysis. * Provide guidance to ensure that designs comply with specifications, codes, and customer requirements. * Compiles data and creates engineering studies and reports. * Perform detailed calculations as needed by the project. * Mentor, provide guidance, and supervise junior\-level engineers and designers. * Provides training for other technical personnel. * Coordinate with internal and external clients to determine proper requirements for projects. * Professional written and verbal communication skills and strong analytical and problem\-solving skills are imperative to success in this position. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** • Previous experience with hyperscale Data Centers of at least 40 MW. * Demonstrated understand of design risk factors for redundancy and resiliency. * Understanding of design differences in hyper\-scale, edge, and colocation data centers. * Possesses a proficiency in 3D modeling as well as managing and creating complex families with custom parameters within Autodesk Revit. * Familiarity with Data Center tier rating systems. * Familiarity with different topologies associated with Data Centers. * Strong knowledge of Autodesk Revit * Experience utilizing BIM 360, Navisworks, Revit work sets, view templates and project phasing. * Understanding of medium\-voltage equipment (13\.8KV and above) and ability to coordinate and develop layouts based on available site test fits. * Minimum of 11 years related work experience. * Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Ability to thrive in an ambiguous environment. * Self\-motivated to deliver results when given a deadline. * Attention to detail with the ability to manage competing priorities simultaneously. * Demonstrated ability to analyze and leverage data and metrics to challenge current assumptions. * Sound, professional communication skills to engage in client\-facing activities. * Ability to lead projects including management of project schedules, budgets, and staffing. * Support business development, including developing scope\-of\-work, level\-of\-effort, and site visits to understand the scope of the pursuit. * Strong leaderships skills, with desire to train and develop early career and/or inexperienced professionals.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Partner - Tech
jobs.description: **Wordsmith** ------------- Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in\-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in\-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in\-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with. **The Role** ------------ Our product is only as good as the people who build it. You'll own R\&D hiring from intake to signed offer: Product Engineers, Applied AI and LLM Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Managers and Designers. You'll partner with engineering and product leaders to define what great looks like at each level, run technical processes that candidates respect, and close people who have offers from AI labs and big tech. This is not a coordination role. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Deliver bar\-raising R\&D hires each quarter * Own a robust, fair and fast recruiting process that is optimized to hire the best talent vs the best interviewers * Source engineers directly: GitHub, research communities, alumni networks and competitor teams, with AI\-personalised outreach * Run technical loops that move fast: tight take\-homes, calibrated interviewers, debriefs within 24 hours * Own the candidate from first message to first day, and close against higher cash with equity, scope and the problem * Report on your funnel every week and fix what the data shows **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Essential** * 5\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting, with at least 3 hiring software engineers at product\-led tech companies * Comfortable discussing stacks, levels and system design with engineers, and spotting weak signal * A track record you can put numbers on: hires per quarter, offer acceptance, how your hires performed * Most of your recent hires sourced by you, not from inbound * Fluency with Ashby or a similar ATS, and real use of AI in your own workflow ### **Valued** * Hired AI, ML or LLM engineers * Hired product managers and designers alongside engineering * Relocated engineers into the UK, including visa sponsorship Compensation Range: $140K \- $200K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Work Truck Solutions is the operating system for the commercial vehicle industry. While the retail auto market is saturated with software, the $130B\+ commercial truck market was operating in the dark—until we turned on the lights. We are the only platform that connects the entire ecosystem: OEMs, upfitters, dealerships, and fleet buyers. By digitizing complex inventory data (chassis \+ upfits) and streamlining the supply chain, we don’t just help dealers sell trucks; we ensure American businesses get the mission\-critical vehicles they need to work. We are a team of innovators, disruptors, and problem\-solvers dedicated to one mission: removing the friction from the commercial vehicle industry. We are profitable, growing, and aggressively scaling our technology to remain the undisputed authority in this space. **The Role** ------------ This is a remote Staff Software Engineer role, our senior individual\-contributor track, and the bar is high. A senior engineer is measured by the work they ship; a staff engineer is measured by what the team ships because of them. You are the person others look to when the problem is hard, the requirements are unclear, or the stakes are real. You set technical direction that reaches beyond a single team, choose the patterns others build on, and take the ambiguous, high\-impact work that has no obvious owner and drive it to done. Our engineering team is moving to an agentic way of working, where much of our code is written by AI agents under human review. You will help lead that shift. You know how to build and maintain the skills, agents and context that make AI agents useful on a real codebase, and you set the standards that keep what they produce correct, secure and maintainable. You define how the team builds with AI, not just which tools it uses. This role is backend focused. You will spend most of your time in .NET and SQL Server, and you will know the frontend well enough to own a feature end to end. You will work day to day inside a software development team of 4\-5 engineers, but your influence extends across teams. You make the engineers around you better through the standards you set, the reviews you give, and the way you teach. You have a bias toward action: you would rather ship something real, learn, and correct than debate an abstraction for a week. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Technical leadership across teams. Own the technical direction for your domain and influence it across teams. Make architecture decisions end to end, advocate for the better way to do things, and mentor engineers well beyond your own squad. * Lead AI\-driven development. Build and maintain the skills, agents, rules and context (such as MCP servers and the documentation agents read) that let the team build with AI. Use AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) to speed up delivery and to refactor and migrate code at scale. * Set the standard for AI\-generated code. Define how agent\-written pull requests are reviewed and tested, including agentic testing, so that speed does not cost correctness, security or maintainability. * Raise the team’s AI fluency. Teach engineers to work this way through pairing, code review and shared tooling. Evaluate new tools and measure whether they actually help. * Drive the hard, ambiguous work. Take the projects that lack a clear owner or a clean spec, define the plan and the tradeoffs, and lead them to a shipped result. * High\-quality output. Build secure, scalable, high\-performance applications with a strong focus on maintainability and clean architecture, and set the standard the team builds to. * Lead through writing and specs. Write clear technical specifications to frame and lead a project. Establish the performance metrics for your domain, and make sure observability and reliability are designed in, not bolted on. * Set and enforce quality. Own coding standards and lead peer code reviews. Use reviews and pairing to teach, not just to gate. * Collaboration. Communicate clearly with a distributed team, surface issues early, and work fluently with both technical and non\-technical partners. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- We are hiring a backend\-focused engineer, and .NET is required. You must be expert in .NET (C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API) and SQL Server, with a working foundation in frontend development. Beyond that depth, we expect: * A staff\-level track record. Years of building and operating production systems, with a clear history of raising the bar on the teams you have been part of. * AI development process experience (required). You know what skills and agents are, and you have built and maintained them for a real codebase and team. You can talk about that work in specifics: skills, agent configurations, rules or MCP integrations you wrote, how you kept them current as the code changed, and a time AI\-generated code went wrong and how you caught it. You have a point of view on where these tools help, where they get in the way, and how to review what they produce. * Full\-stack range. Backend is your home, but you can own a feature from the database to the UI. * Strong Git workflow. Branching, pull requests, and code reviews are second nature. **Backend Depth** ----------------- This is the core of the role. * Years of building and operating production\-grade systems in .NET (C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API). * Demonstrated ownership of scalable, fault\-tolerant, performance\-critical systems. * Strong experience designing API architectures (REST and/or GraphQL) with attention to versioning, maintainability, and real\-world tradeoffs. * Proven ability to handle complex system challenges, including: * + Concurrency, data consistency, and race conditions. + Caching strategies (Redis, in\-memory) and invalidation. + Asynchronous processing and queue\-based architectures. * Deep expertise in SQL Server: * + Schema design and data modeling. + Query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning. * Sound judgment on when to use an ORM versus direct SQL. * Experience with distributed systems and integrations, including: * + Event\-driven architectures (queues, pub/sub). + Resilient integrations (retries, idempotency, failure handling). * Strong understanding of security fundamentals (JWT, OAuth, RBAC). * Experience with observability and production operations: logging, monitoring, debugging, and root cause analysis. * Experience deploying and operating systems in Azure (App Services, Functions, Service Bus, Redis) preferred. * Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar). **Frontend Foundation** ----------------------- * Experience building production web applications with React and/or Svelte / SvelteKit. * Proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript. * Comfortable with component patterns, application state, and integrating UIs with REST/GraphQL APIs. * NodeJS experience is a plus. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building LLM\-powered product features, such as tool use, retrieval, or evaluations of AI output. **Benefits** ------------ * Meaningful work on industry\-changing products. * Competitive salary and a Monday\-Friday work week. * Excellent medical, dental, 401k, and complimentary life insurance. * Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays. * Flexible schedule (subject to manager’s discretion). **Work Truck Solutions DOES NOT sponsor H\-1B visas.** **The pay range for this role is:** 180,000 \- 230,000 USD per year(Remote)

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Business Process Optimization
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. jobs.title: Software Developer 2
jobs.description: **Software Developer 2** *Location:* Centennial, CO (In\-Office) *Company:* RefiJet *Reports to:* Director of Software Development **The Opportunity** RefiJet processes a high volume of auto refinance applications every month across a network of 30\+ lending partners. The software running that operation spans borrower\-facing applications, lender integrations, and internal tools used by our operations teams. The quality, reliability, and usability of that software directly affects real financial outcomes for real people. Software Developer 2 is the level where you stop needing the work handed to you fully defined. You already know how to ship. This role is about widening what you can be trusted with: features that touch more than one system, requirements that arrive incomplete, and problems where the right answer is not obvious from the ticket. You will work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, lender integrations, and internal operations tools. This level carries in both directions. You are still learning, and you still have people invested in your development: structured code review, a manager whose job includes your growth, and senior engineers who will make you better when you use them. You are also now someone other people learn from. You will mentor Software Developer 1 engineers, review their code with care rather than speed, and answer the questions that are still hard when you are new to a codebase. Carrying someone else is part of the job at this level, not an extra. We are deliberately stack and platform agnostic. We care that you can think clearly, learn a codebase quickly, and write code other engineers can build on. We do not care which language or framework you learned first. The specific technologies you will work in are covered in the interview process, and they will change over the course of your career here. The fundamentals will not. **Location and schedule.** Plan on five days per week on site in Centennial, Colorado. We say that plainly instead of calling the role hybrid, because the mentoring and cross\-team work this level depends on happens faster in person and because we would rather be clear now than surprise you at offer stage. One or two remote days per week may become available once you are established and performing well. You earn it, the Director of Software Development decides it, and no date is attached to it. **What You'll Do \- Key Responsibilities** **Strategy \& Leadership** At this level, leadership means owning outcomes rather than tasks, and starting to make the engineers around you better. * Own the features and components assigned to you end to end, including design decisions within an agreed approach, testing, release, and support after release * Mentor Software Developer 1 engineers through pairing, code review, and onboarding, and treat their questions as part of your workload rather than an interruption * Review code as a contributor of useful feedback, not a rubber stamp. Catch the design problem, not only the style problem. * Push back on work that does not hold together, and propose the alternative rather than only naming the objection * Estimate your own work with enough accuracy that others can plan around it, and communicate a slipping estimate before the date, not after * Improve how the team works by strengthening documentation, tightening standards, and reducing recurring toil * Represent engineering credibly in conversations with product, operations, and other internal partners, including explaining technical constraints in terms a non\-engineer can act on **Discovery \& Execution** * Deliver features across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and internal tools, including work that spans more than one service or team boundary * Take a requirement that is incomplete or ambiguous, ask the questions that make it concrete, and turn it into a workable plan before writing code * Author specifications for your own work and review specifications written by others, under our spec\-driven development practice in which a feature is specified in writing and agreed before it is built * Design and build API integrations, including work with external lending partner systems, with attention to error handling, retries, idempotency, and failure modes * Model and query data correctly, and understand the performance and integrity consequences of the schema and queries you write * Write and maintain automated tests that give the team real confidence, and recognize when a test is protecting behavior rather than only raising coverage * Debug production issues methodically, identify the actual cause, verify the fix, and record what you learned so the next person does not repeat it * Participate in release, deployment, monitoring, and production support for the systems you build * Use AI\-assisted development tools as part of normal daily work, and remain fully accountable for every line you ship, whether you or a tool wrote it first **Growth \& O er data responsibly and follow all internal security, privacy, and data handling requirements. We operate in a regulated industry. Careful data handling is a condition of the role, not a preference. * Never move production data into a non\-production environment, share credentials, or work around a security control to save time. If a control is blocking legitimate work, escalate it and help fix the control. * Contribute to a collaborative engineering culture by being dependable, communicative, and open to feedback **Required Skills \& Experience** This list is short and every item on it is real. If you meet these, apply. * Professional experience building and maintaining production web applications across both frontend and backend, with a track record of features you delivered end to end * Working proficiency in a modern backend language and a modern frontend framework, with enough depth to debug problems in both * Practical experience with REST APIs or service\-to\-service integration, including handling failures rather than only the happy path * Practical experience with relational databases, including writing queries you can reason about and schema changes you can defend * Experience writing automated tests and using them to ship with confidence * Experience debugging issues in a running production system * Comfortable working from written specifications, and able to identify when a specification is wrong or incomplete * Version control fluency with Git and collaborative development workflows * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a technical tradeoff to someone who is not an engineer * Demonstrated ability to give and receive feedback constructively * Legally authorized to work in the United States, and able to work on site in Centennial, CO five days per week **Education:** No specific degree is required. A computer science or related degree, a bootcamp, self\-directed learning, or equivalent practical experience are all acceptable paths. We evaluate demonstrated ability. **On experience level:** This role is scoped for roughly 2 to 5 years of professional experience. Range is a proxy, not the bar. If you are outside it in either direction and the rest of this description fits, apply anyway and let us make the call. **Nice to Have** None of the following is required, and their absence will not remove you from consideration. * Experience owning a feature area or service that other engineers depended on * Experience mentoring or onboarding a more junior engineer * Experience integrating with third\-party or partner APIs where you did not control the other side * Experience with containerized or cloud\-hosted environments and the deployment pipeline that reaches them * Experience with observability tooling, including tracing a real incident through logs and metrics * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools with good judgment about when to trust them * Interest in fintech, lending platforms, or transaction\-heavy software products * Experience with auto lending, auto refinancing, or consumer credit products. * Familiarity with loan origination systems (LOS), credit decisioning, or lending infrastructure. * Experience working with external partners or B2B clients in a product\-led organization. **Compensation \& Benefits** **Base Salary:** $108,000 \- $137,000 annually, commensurate with experience **Bonus:** Eligible for an annual performance\-based bonus with a defined target percentage of base salary, tied to company and individual goals. **Benefits:** Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k), PTO, career development opportunities, and the chance to join Denver's Best Place to Work (2024 \& 2025\) with a dynamic culture focused on internal promotion and employee growth. **Equal Opportunity Statement** Yield Solutions Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description: ### **Location: US, Remote (Eastern Hours)** ### **About BOI** BOI is the AI partner that Walmart, Coca\-Cola, and Mastercard call when AI needs to drive growth, not just savings. We rebuild how work gets done, starting from the outcomes each team exists to deliver: agents do the work, people own the judgment, and the capacity it frees goes to growth. We bring together the unusually strong in frontier enterprise AI, then give them the ownership to make it happen. If you're looking for a comfortable place to hide, we're not it. If you want to build the future of enterprise AI with people who will make you better: welcome home. ### **Your Role** ### **Own the Technical Build** * Own the architecture and engineering quality of every client build, from first prototype to production in the client's environment. * Shape solution architecture across models, clouds and platforms, and make build, buy or configure calls you can defend to a client CTO. Our clients run on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud. We're independent of every vendor, so the answer is whatever is best for the client. * Set the engineering standards every build meets: evaluation of AI outputs, security and data governance, observability, and production reliability. * Build the reusable components, patterns and internal products that let each engagement start further ahead than the last. ### **Lead with Clients** * Sit with client CTOs, CIOs and business executives as BOI's senior technical voice. Explain technical choices in terms of cost, risk and value, so non\-technical leaders can decide. * Lead client security, compliance and procurement reviews, and get our systems approved to run in their environments. * Work forward deployed: get into client environments early, build alongside their teams, and keep building as the relationship grows. ### **Shape What We Sell** * Scope and estimate builds for proposals with our Directors of Applied AI, so what we sell can be built on time and to standard. * Turn what we've built into case studies, reusable IP and technical thought leadership. ### **Build the Team** * Lead, coach and grow our engineering team, roughly doubling it over the next year. Set high standards, give direct feedback, and give credit generously. * Run AI\-first ways of working across engineering, with your own tools and workflows as the example. * Help build BOI like an owner, alongside our leadership team in the US and Europe. ### **What We Look For** We are deliberately not for everyone. We look for a specific combination of qualities: * You've shipped AI systems to production at enterprise scale, inside environments with real security, compliance and data constraints. * You've led engineering in a consultancy, agency or other project\-based environment. You're comfortable with work that changes shape every few months and with stacks you didn't choose. * You've founded a company or been early at a startup. You can build the team as well as the system, and you make good decisions before everything is known. * You explain technical choices to non\-technical executives in plain language, and they leave the room ready to decide. ### **What We Offer** * You'll set the technical direction of a growing AI company and shape how BOI builds in every market we work in. * You'll build compounding skills at the frontier of AI while others are still catching up. * What your team builds goes live in client systems within weeks, and you see the value it creates. * We're independent of every vendor, so you work across every model and cloud, building with whatever is best and swapping it when something better ships. * You get the freedom to prototype, experiment, and push boundaries on what's possible with AI. ### **Benefits** We also offer comprehensive health benefits, 401(k), 25 days PTO, hybrid working (if based out of NYC), professional development support, and the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's leading AI practitioners on high\-impact enterprise transformations. BOI is an equal opportunity employer: we celebrate diversity and welcome all backgrounds and identities.

actually work. * Design and implement the access and governance model for agentic coding tools: which repositories and environments agents can access, which actions require human approval, how actions are logged and attributed, and how these controls map to compliance frameworks. * Define and enforce guardrails for autonomous agents in production\-adjacent systems, including least\-privilege access, audit trails, rollback paths and incident response when an agent takes an unintended action. ### **Measurement and Team Building** * Track software delivery, developer experience and AI usage through metrics such as DORA and developer surveys, and use what you learn to set priorities. * Build the business case for a Developer Platforms team as the scope grows. * Hire and lead the Developer Platforms team. **KPIs** -------- * Software delivery performance (DORA metrics) * Developer experience (developer survey results) * AI coding\-tool usage **About You** ------------- * You have 8\+
